title_en: Heavy exposure! The Taiwan authorities' "cyber army" once attempted to steal information about our military exercise plans.
body_en: Original title: Heavy exposure! Taiwan authorities' "Information and Electronic Warfare" once attempted to steal intelligence on our military exercise plans On the 5th, the National Computer Virus Emergency Response Center and other departments released a latest report showing that, against the background of the PLA Eastern Theater Command's implementation of the "Joint Sword" series of exercises, hacker organizations supported by the Taiwan Democratic Progressive Party's "Information and Electronic Warfare" specifically targeted maritime-related units in our coastal areas with phishing email attacks, attempting to steal maritime-related intelligence to predict the PLA's exercise action plans. On the 5th, the National Computer Virus Emergency Response Center, the National Engineering Laboratory for Computer Virus Prevention and Control Technology, and 360 Security Group jointly released the "David and Goliath - Investigation Report on the Network Attack Activities of the Taiwan Democratic Progressive Party's 'Information and Electronic Warfare' Hacker Organization," which deeply exposed the historical background, organizational structure, personnel composition, work locations, work tasks, and insider information on network attack cases of the Taiwan Democratic Progressive Party's "Information and Electronic Warfare." The report revealed that the Taiwan "Information and Electronic Warfare," formally known as the "Ministry of National Defense Information and Electronic Warfare Command," is a "fourth branch" created with the support of the US military after Tsai Ing-wen took office. Its predecessor belonged to the Taiwan authorities' "Ministry of National Defense Tiger Team" network force, responsible for coordinating the Taiwan authorities, the Taiwan military, and civilian network technology forces, specifically conducting network attacks and penetration against the mainland and Hong Kong and Macao regions, massively stealing sensitive data and important intelligence information, coordinating with anti-China forces in the US to conduct public opinion and cognitive warfare against us, secretly plotting "color revolutions," attempting to disrupt our social order, create ethnic divisions, amplify social contradictions, and obstruct national reunification, being referred to as the "most mysterious force in Taiwan." The "Information and Electronic Warfare" is divided into four internal institutions: Information and Communication Department, Network Operations Department, Electronic Warfare Department, and Logistics Department, as well as a training and testing center with a training nature. Its technical strength is mainly concentrated in the Information and Communication Department's Information and Communication Brigade, the Network Operations Department's Network Warfare Brigade, and the Electronic Warfare Department's Electronic Warfare Center. The report also exposed five hacker organizations supported by the Taiwan Democratic Progressive Party and commanded by the Taiwan authorities' "Information and Electronic Warfare" forces: APT-C-01 (Toxic Cloud Vine), APT-C-62 (Tricolor Violet), APT-C-64 (Anonymous 64), APT-C-65 (Golden Leaf Ivy), and APT-C-67 (Ursula). These hacker organizations have systematically and plannedly conducted numerous large-scale network attacks on key departments and areas such as national defense military industry, aerospace, government departments, energy transportation, maritime affairs, scientific research and technology enterprises in the mainland and Hong Kong and Macao regions, attempting to bypass target system security measures, obtain internal network control permissions, steal sensitive data and important intelligence information, disrupt normal business operations of enterprises, with extremely malicious nature. Among them, APT-C-67 (Ursula) is the hacker organization that was previously officially reported to have attacked a technology company in Guangzhou. On May 20th, the Tianhe District Branch of the Guangzhou Public Security Bureau issued a "Police Report" stating that a technology company in Guangzhou was attacked by overseas hackers, and the public security organs immediately launched an investigation, extracted relevant attack program samples, comprehensively fixed relevant evidence, and organized a professional technical team to conduct technical tracing. On May 27th, the Tianhe District Branch issued another "Police Report" stating that the investigation into the network attack on a technology company in Guangzhou by overseas hackers had made important progress: the network attack suffered by the company was carried out by a hacker organization related to the Taiwan Democratic Progressive Party authorities. The report stated that APT-C-67 (Ursula) bypassed the victim company's network protection devices, illegally entered the backend system of autonomous devices, and controlled multiple internal network devices of the company through lateral movement penetration, further uploading multiple malicious attack programs to the backend systems of these devices, causing the company's official website and some business systems to be affected, with network services interrupted for several hours, causing disruption to the company's normal production and operation. According to sources, the activities of APT-C-67 (Ursula) have been active for a long time. Compared with other organizations, this organization's attack targets are relatively scattered. They often use public network asset mapping platforms or batch network address scanning to detect network addresses of known vulnerabilities in network security systems, network cameras, and other Internet of Things systems exposed on the public Internet in our territory, and use vulnerabilities to gain control of monitoring system backends, further deploying remote control tools or Trojans, obtaining database information, infiltrating internal networks of relevant units, and ultimately gaining full control and data access permissions of security systems, using real-time video and historical video information of security systems to collect intelligence on target areas. The report also disclosed the characteristics of four other hacker organizations and specific cases of network attacks against us. In 2024, the Taiwan authorities colluded with external forces to continuously provoke "independence," seriously endangering cross-strait relations and peace and stability in the Taiwan Strait. Starting in May 2024, the PLA Eastern Theater Command conducted multiple "Joint Sword" series of exercises around Taiwan Province, punishing the "Taiwan independence" separatist forces and issuing a severe warning to external forces interfering and provoking. Against this background, APT-C-01 further extended its attack targets to the maritime field and specifically targeted maritime-related units in our coastal areas with phishing email attacks, attempting to predict our Navy's exercise action plans by stealing maritime-related intelligence. In addition, in the first half of 2024, the US State Department approved the sale of weapons worth over 600 million US dollars to Taiwan, including 720 sets of Spring Knife 300 cruise missiles, 100 sets of ALTIUS600M-V cruise missiles, and other advanced offensive weapons, and held the "Taiwan-US Defense Industry Forum" in Taiwan in June 2024. During the same period, the APT-C-62 organization timely strengthened its network penetration attacks on key information infrastructure such as national defense military industry, transportation, energy infrastructure, in response to the "US aid," attempting to sell sensitive intelligence information related to our national defense, military, and energy reserves to the US. During the 19th Hangzhou Asian Games in September 2023, the APT-C-64 organization remained active, repeatedly using web system vulnerabilities to penetrate attacks on mainland China and Hong Kong and Macao units' portal websites, outdoor electronic screens, network TVs, etc., attempting to manipulate social opinions by gaining control and posting illegal content after obtaining control permissions, disrupting social order. The report stated that the activities of the APT-C-65 organization have a very clear pattern, closely related to the so-called "foreign affairs activities" of the Taiwan authorities' leaders. The APT-C-65 organization conducted intensive attack and espionage activities against key information infrastructure units in the fields of national defense military industry, government agencies, energy, transportation, scientific research, and education in our country, especially in the aerospace, ports, maritime, and other related scientific research, production, and management units, during the visits of then-US House Speaker Nancy Pelosi to China's Taiwan Province in August 2022 and then-Taiwan Province Democratic Progressive Party representative Lai Ching-te's visit to the US in August 2023 under the guise of "transit," aiming to make "tributes" during the Taiwan authorities' close contact with anti-China forces abroad. The report stated that although the Taiwan APT organizations have their own characteristics in terms of attack targets, tactics, and activity cycles, there is a clear coordination and consistency in their attack intentions, purposes, and the frequent "Taiwan independence" and treasonous actions taken by the Taiwan Province Democratic Progressive Party authorities, fully exposing the ugly face of the Taiwan Province Democratic Progressive Party authorities' attempt to "rely on foreign support" for political gain, at the expense of national and ethnic interests. According to sources, the Taiwan Democratic Progressive Party authorities have long colluded with the US National Security Agency (NSA), the Central Intelligence Agency (CIA), and other intelligence agencies, relying on the "Information and Electronic Warfare" to carry out network attack and sabotage activities against the mainland and Hong Kong and Macao regions, in coordination with the US "Indo-Pacific strategy," acting as a "running dog" for the US, attempting to "rely on the US for independence." The US intelligence agencies have long provided personnel training and technical equipment support to the Taiwan "Information and Electronic Warfare," repeatedly sending so-called "hunting" teams to Taiwan (under separate investigation) to conduct network attacks against us. For example, the wanted individuals such as Shen Yuxuan, who went to the US for training in July 2018, have repeatedly participated in network attacks against the mainland and Hong Kong and Macao regions, and specifically carried out network attacks against the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of China in the summer of 2019, committing numerous crimes. Nevertheless, the network attack methods of the Taiwan "Information and Electronic Warfare" are clearly "unskilled." Du Zhenhua, a senior engineer at the National Computer Virus Emergency Response Center, told the Global Times reporter that the reason the report is called "David and Goliath" is to mock the arrogance of the Taiwan authorities, "David and Goliath, ridiculous arrogance." Du Zhenhua stated that when the Taiwan "Information and Electronic Warfare" conducts network attacks, it exposes a large amount of attack source information, making it not difficult to trace and track, providing favorable conditions for us to quickly identify the attackers. In addition, the methods of the Taiwan "Information and Electronic Warfare" are despicable and dirty. When they cannot penetrate the target system or obtain valuable data from the network platform, they often become impatient and maliciously disrupt the target system, delete system and user data, maliciously tamper with data or add false information, format system storage devices, severely disrupting normal business operations of enterprises. In response, Zhou Hongyi, founder of 360 Group, stated that the technical level of the network attack personnel of the Taiwan "Information and Electronic Warfare" is generally low, the attack methods are simple and crude, and there is not much concealment, belonging to a third-rate level. Xiao Xinguang, founder of Ant Group, stated that the network attack personnel of the Taiwan "Information and Electronic Warfare" mostly use open-source tools, rarely using "zero-day" vulnerabilities, which to some extent indicates that they lack the ability to develop their own tools and related technical reserves. Global Times-Global Network Report Special Correspondent Yuan Hong Review | Lu Changyin Editor | Wang Xiaojiao

title_en: Robam Unveils New Enamel Steam, Roast, and Fry Integrated Machine, a Versatile "Master Chef" to Aid Culinary Creativity
body_en: Currently, the main consumer groups for kitchens and kitchen appliances have shifted, entering the era of "new waves." Compared to the previous generation, more and more young people are filled with aspirations and yearnings for kitchen and culinary life. However, culinary life inevitably faces challenges in the three dimensions of willingness, experience, and achievement. Under these various challenges, how can modern people be brought back to the kitchen and their culinary creativity be inspired? Robam Appliances has provided the answer. On September 25th, Robam Appliances officially held the first Culinary Creator Conference themed "Hello, Creator." Both internal and external refinement, the all-new Chefmate Enamel Steam, Bake, and Fry Integrated Machine is launched. The role of kitchen space is shifting, changing and leading people's new imagination and understanding of life. Especially for young people, "going to the kitchen" is no longer a mandatory option; they enter the kitchen more for the joy of cooking. Against this backdrop, the Chefmate Enamel Steam, Bake, and Fry Integrated Machine, with its high aesthetics, multi-functionality, and strong performance, meets the pursuit of life aesthetics and delicious food by young culinary creators. High-aesthetic countertop kitchen appliances, instantly elevate kitchen taste. In terms of product design, the color scheme of the Chefmate Enamel Steam, Bake, and Fry Integrated Machine is derived from natural ingredients, which can not only embellish the kitchen but also stimulate the desire to cook. At the same time, its extra-large capacity of 30L, capable of steaming 45 steamed buns at once, can fully meet the cooking needs of the whole family. It is worth mentioning that this product innovatively applies an enamel liner, typically used in high-end built-in ovens, which is resistant to high temperatures and easy to clean, making it the industry's first countertop enamel steam, bake, and fry integrated machine. Innovative application of the "Flowing Blue" enamel liner. Traditional steam and bake appliances mostly fall under the category of small appliances, thus suffering from common issues such as lack of professionalism, poor durability, and single functionality. The Chefmate brand, positioned as a professional multi-functional cooking integrated machine, inherits over 40 years of Robam Appliances' kitchen appliance R&D experience. It not only designs countertop kitchen appliances with the concept of durable products but also incorporates patented built-in technology. Dual-spray vortex steaming, with characteristics of fast preheating, large steam volume, and strong penetration. In terms of product performance, the dual-spray vortex steaming technology equipped in the Chefmate Enamel Steam, Bake, and Fry Integrated Machine surpasses professional steam ovens, boasting a large steam volume of 15.2L/min, enough to fill 46 cola bottles per minute. For users who enjoy baking and fried foods, the Chefmate Enamel Steam, Bake, and Fry Integrated Machine's all-dimensional cyclone baking can even rival commercial ovens. Its unique all-dimensional stereo heating system and independent upper and lower temperature control functions for the cavity, combined with a multi-dimensional stereo air duct, make the temperature field more uniform, allowing the baked food to achieve a perfect balance of color, aroma, and taste. Both internet-famous desserts and sophisticated Chinese and Western dishes can be easily prepared. The oil-free air frying effect is superior to air fryers, with 2000 rpm high-speed circulating hot air that can extract 80% of the oil from food, leaving only the fried aroma without the burden. In addition to the three main functions of steaming, baking, and frying, the Chefmate Enamel Steam, Bake, and Fry Integrated Machine is also a "talking" smart appliance. By integrating with Tmall Genie APP and ROKI APP, it can help users achieve voice smart control. With 130 automatic cooking recipes, the entire cooking process becomes easier, allowing even cooking beginners to instantly become chefs. Furthermore, the Chefmate Enamel Steam, Bake, and Fry Integrated Machine also has 6 auxiliary functions such as defrosting, fermentation, sterilization, keep warm, descaling, and drying, truly achieving multi-functionality in one machine, stacking and replacing functions within limited space. Emerging as a dark horse, capturing the high-end countertop kitchen appliance market. As early as March this year, Robam Appliances launched a brand-new high-end countertop culinary appliance brand – Chefmate. By applying patented built-in technology to countertop kitchen appliances and designing countertop cooking appliances with the concept of durable products, Chefmate has perfectly solved the problems of unprofessional technology, high idle rates, and poor durability in small appliance products. In the past six months, Chefmate's craftsmanship concept has gained recognition from many consumers and achieved excellent sales results. In the six months since its establishment, it has consistently ranked TOP1 in sales in the Tmall electric oven category, received recommendations from numerous celebrity users, and garnered a flood of positive reviews on social media. The launch of the Chefmate Enamel Steam, Bake, and Fry Integrated Machine has further elevated product standards from the three dimensions of high aesthetics, multi-functionality, and strong performance. From the grand blueprint of "creating a new Chinese kitchen" to focusing on the niche field of "creating new cooking centers beyond open flames," Robam Appliances, with its foresight into the development of kitchen appliances, has newly created the youthful brand "Chefmate" and launched high-end countertop products represented by the Chefmate Enamel Steam, Bake, and Fry Integrated Machine. While enriching the product matrix and enhancing product strength, it also takes the perspective of modern young users, providing kitchen appliances that better understand Chinese cooking to alleviate the burden of Chinese cooking, assist in culinary creation, inspire culinary creativity, and enable more users to unleash their passion and inspiration for exploring cooking. 72 Previous Article: Aesthetic redefinition, intelligent perception refresh, Robam Appliances Creator Series leads the advancement of kitchen appliance products. title_en: Boss Dishwasher Hand Cat Big Brand Day: A Marketing Campaign to Help Young People Overcome the Difficulty of Washing Pots
body_en: In the kitchen appliance industry, when it comes to brands that "know how to play," Robam Appliances is undoubtedly the one. As a leading kitchen appliance brand deeply rooted in internet culture, Robam Appliances has been actively embracing the internet and boldly trying out a rich and diverse range of marketing and promotional methods. Various marketing approaches such as topical discussions, cooking challenges, lucky draws, and celebrity live streams not only engage with young people but also win their favor, making the brand a darling among consumers. Recently, Robam Appliances, leveraging Tmall's "Super Brand Day" for mobile devices, launched a marketing campaign themed "No More Dishwashers," based on accurately understanding the needs of young people. Through multi-platform efforts and creative interactive marketing methods, they delivered an unforgettable consumer experience. **Multi-platform collaboration ignites resonance among young people** With the consumer base becoming younger, brands must constantly adapt their marketing strategies. The new generation of consumers places more emphasis on self-importance and tends to fulfill their desires through consumption. Therefore, marketing methods that resonate with the vast majority of young people will undoubtedly be twice as effective with half the effort. In this marketing campaign, Robam Appliances precisely targeted the pain points of young consumers, based on their aversion to washing dishes and pots and their pursuit of efficiency. By launching the #NoMoreDishwashers hashtag on Robam Appliances' official Weibo account, they conveyed a message of saving effort, washing more, and achieving greater cleanliness, catering to the needs of Chinese consumers. This covered various resonance points for young consumers, achieving in-depth communication, sparking widespread discussion and dissemination, and becoming a trending topic on the platform. During the event, Robam Appliances partnered with Weibo KOLs to release attitude posters, expressing the troubles of washing dishes and pots from different perspectives, further amplifying consumer resonance and attracting more users to the topic. In this way, Robam Appliances and young users were on the same side, narrowing the gap between them, strengthening emotional exchange, and naturally winning the favor of young consumers. Recently, popular young female star Meng Meiqi directly interacted on Weibo with the #NoMoreDishwashers topic, with creative in-video placements, leveraging her fan base to continuously expand the topic's reach and generate buzz for new product pre-orders. Concurrently, Robam Appliances collaborated with Douyin musician Wang Bo to adapt the catchy song "The Song of No More Dishwashers." The addictive melody of this earworm sparked nationwide cover singing and discussions, with the collision of greasiness and degreasing creating a strong visual and sensory contrast. Douyin KOLs such as Qing Tian Gong Zi, Wang Bo, and Wu Di Hao Ke successively adapted and covered the song. This youthful and trendy entertainment marketing was well-received by netizens, continuously occupying trending charts, prompting user participation in topic discussions, deepening their understanding of Robam dishwashers, and further capturing consumer mindshare. With resonance topics as touchpoints, Weibo KOLs as support, and Douyin platform's entertainment marketing, this multi-platform dissemination method allowed Robam Appliances' dishwashers to penetrate consumer circles from multiple dimensions, awakening brand awareness and product demand, leading consumers to be successfully "influenced" by Robam dishwashers. **Various creative interactions, engaging with young people** When it comes to people and things they like, today's young generation prioritizes emotion and intuition. However, in most consumption scenarios, they tend to be more rational. Therefore, to impress more young people, brands must speak through their strength. Robam Appliances deeply integrated into this summer's hottest food variety show, "Heard It's Delicious," and invited celebrity guests for interactions, continuously reinforcing product information. Additionally, renowned chefs provided verbal recommendations, and exclusive videos were aired as commercials on Zhejiang TV. The end board displayed information about Tmall's "Super Brand Day" for mobile devices, gaining authoritative endorsement and deepening users' brand impression. The purpose of launching a marketing campaign is to maximize traffic monetization. Throughout the entire marketing process, Robam Appliances focused on the #NoMoreDishwashers theme, continuously deepening consumer understanding and facilitating the transition from emotional interest to action in subsequent engagement. "Tmall Super Brand Day" for mobile devices is Tmall's mobile app's single-brand marketing IP, which helps brands amplify their major events. It integrates resources from all ends and also facilitates external word-of-mouth promotion, enabling dialogue between brands and users, and achieving a synergistic effect of brand creativity and performance. In this marketing campaign, Robam Appliances collaborated with Tmall's "Super Brand Day" for mobile devices to create exclusive co-branded merchandise: canvas bags in a more youthful style, celebrating the attitude of not being a dishwasher person, and custom insulated mugs and umbrellas that are more deeply integrated into the lives of young users, demonstrating Robam Appliances' deep understanding of young people's needs and better incorporating their characteristics. Off-platform, continuous content seeding through Weibo, Xiaohongshu, and Douyin multi-platform collaboration, with top KOLs reviewing products and producing high-quality promotional videos, has allowed Robam dishwashers to gain long-term, sustained attention. The marketing of strong collaborations brings ripple effects. Relying on the powerful product strength of Robam Appliances and leveraging Tmall's "Super Brand Day" for mobile devices, Robam Appliances has perfectly achieved product launch and promotion, amplified brand creativity, showcased Robam Appliances' brand attitude, continuously consolidated its position in the young consumer market, allowed young people to experience the charm of the "China New Kitchen Plan," and maximized marketing effectiveness. 32 Previous Article: Accelerating the implementation of China's dishwasher popularization plan, Robam Appliances contributes to the beautiful kitchen life of the nation. title_en: The Era of Hardcover Homes Arrives, Robam Takes the Lead with Layout, Winning Favor from 70% of Top 100 Real Estate Enterprises
body_en: According to data monitored by AVC, a real estate big data company, in the first half of 2018, there were 804 projects in the overall market for finished and furnished projects, a year-on-year increase of 31.2%. The total scale of finished and furnished projects reached 798,000 units, a year-on-year increase of 49.7%. Since the beginning of 2018, the overall finished and furnished market has shown a stable trend. Real estate market regulation policies have directly affected the growth rate of the kitchen appliance industry; on the other hand, finished and furnished policies have also brought new growth opportunities to the kitchen appliance market. AVC's real estate big data monitoring shows that in the first half of this year, all levels of decoration standards have increased significantly, with high-end decoration standards surging by 160% year-on-year. As a high-end brand in the kitchen appliance industry, Robam established an independent engineering department as early as 2008 and began to lay out the real estate finished and furnished sector. After 10 years of deep cultivation, Robam has achieved cooperation with over 70% of the top 100 real estate enterprises. Driven by policies, supply, and demand, finished and furnished housing has become an inevitable trend, which means that the engineering channel of the home appliance industry, which currently accounts for a small proportion, is expected to rise significantly in the future. Robam, which entered the finished and furnished market early, has gained a first-mover advantage, and the finished and furnished market may become a new engine for enterprise growth. (Robam attends the 2018 China Real Estate Enterprise Brand Value Summit Forum) Central Range Hoods, Ushering in a New Era of Quality Residences Data shows that as of early October, real estate regulatory measures across the country have accumulated nearly 400 times in 2018. The intensity of real estate regulation continues to increase, and the development ecosystem of the real estate industry is gradually entering a new stage, with finished and furnished housing becoming a future development trend in real estate. Currently, developers that dare to launch finished and furnished housing are strong real estate developers. As a high-end product among finished and furnished items, kitchen appliances are indispensable for real estate developers to rely on excellent kitchen appliance suppliers. As early as 2008, Robam keenly perceived the potential of the real estate engineering market. Robam targeted the high-quality, finished and furnished market, aiming to work with major real estate enterprises to usher in a new era of quality residences. In response to the problem of kitchen fume pollution in China, Robam developed central range hoods as early as 2015. Today, the technology for this product is mature, and the fumes from an entire building must be purified by the main unit, achieving a composite fume purification rate of 99.5%. Compared with traditional range hoods, central range hoods can not only effectively solve problems such as smoke duct blockage during peak cooking hours, insufficient exhaust power for low-floor residents, fume backflow, and odor cross-contamination, reduce the working noise of range hoods, but also greatly reduce the contribution of residential fumes to atmospheric PM2.5, bringing new breakthroughs to the green transformation of the real estate industry. (Robam Central Range Hood Model) As of the end of June 2018, more than 70 top 100 real estate customers had reached cooperation with Robam. Robam's central range hoods have been installed in more than 20 cities and have achieved strategic cooperation with many branded real estate enterprises such as Vanke, China Overseas, China Merchants, Country Garden, Sunac, Greentown, Lansi, and Binjiang, with over 40 residential projects implemented. In recent years, Robam's engineering sector has maintained steady growth. In 2015, the compound annual growth rate of Robam's engineering sector reached as high as 67%. In 2017, the engineering channel successfully renewed contracts with many real estate developers such as Evergrande, Vanke, and Country Garden. Central range hoods have established 18 demonstration projects nationwide through signing contracts. The introduction of national precise housing policies will rapidly increase the proportion of the engineering channel in market share. Under the trend of finished and furnished housing, Robam, as a supplier, is also continuously improving its service capabilities, transforming from simple product output to providing integrated supply chain docking and service capabilities. Robam's central range hoods provide real estate enterprises with a systematic solution of "products + services." This product utilizes "LORA" intelligent variable frequency IoT technology, high-precision power distribution technology, and collaboration with Alibaba to build an intelligent cloud platform technology, providing real-time intelligent monitoring services for kitchen fumes, collecting data on range hood usage by residents, and achieving high-precision control of kitchen fume emissions, providing technical and data support for the green and intelligent transformation of the real estate industry. Green finished and furnished housing is the future mainstream, and Robam has huge potential for development. The "13th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Construction Industry" issued by the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development also proposes that by 2020, the proportion of green buildings in urban areas will reach 50% of new buildings, the area of newly started finished and furnished completed housing will reach 30%, and the application proportion of green building materials will reach 40%. The market potential for finished and furnished housing is enormous. From the consumer's perspective, finished and furnished housing integrates the entire process from construction to decoration, greatly improving quality and efficiency, and offering advantages of saving time, effort, and money. At the same time, people's environmental awareness is gradually increasing, and "finished and furnished" is an important way to achieve green, low-carbon, environmentally friendly, and energy-saving outcomes. Therefore, green, environmentally friendly, and finished and furnished housing will become the mainstream direction for real estate development. It is precisely because Robam's central range hoods can provide systematic range hood solutions for residences and are highly in line with the current energy-saving and environmental protection trends that they are highly favored by the real estate industry. In 2016 and 2018, Robam was twice selected for the "Top 5 Listed Companies in China's Real Estate Supply Chain for Investment Value" list. In 2017, the company was awarded the "Preferred Strong Brand for China's Real Estate Component Suppliers 2016-2017" award. In 2018, Robam topped the list of preferred supplier brands for "kitchen appliances" in real estate and received the title of "2018 China Real Estate Supplier Technology Innovation Brand Value." (Robam selected as "Top 5 Listed Companies in China's Real Estate Supply Chain for Investment Value 2018") In addition, Robam's central range hoods have also received strong support from government departments. The Beijing Municipal Commission of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Beijing Municipal Development and Reform Commission, and the Beijing Municipal Science and Technology Commission have issued official documents for the promotion of Robam's central range hoods in Beijing. Government endorsement has played a role in promoting cooperation between Robam and real estate developers. title_en: "People's Daily" Reports on Robam Again, Central Range Hood Receives Attention
body_en: Chinese cuisine is renowned for its profound and extensive culture, but the issue of kitchen grease fumes is also particularly prominent. For a long time, kitchen fume extraction has faced three major persistent problems: inefficient extraction, backflow of fumes, and odor permeation. Simultaneously, the direct external discharge of residents' kitchen grease fumes without treatment further pollutes the air. After extensive research into fume issues and extraction technologies, the high-end kitchen appliance brand Robam Appliances invented a product that can revolutionarily solve these problems – the Central Range Hood. This year, Robam Appliances has fully pushed this product onto the market, gaining attention from national-level media such as *People's Daily* and CCTV. On May 3rd, *People's Daily* published a comprehensive report titled "Robam Appliances' Central Range Hood Favored by the Market, Whole Building Installation of Main Unit, No Noise in the Kitchen." The report stated that the product "transformed a household range hood product into a solution related to urban air purification." (Robam Appliances Central Range Hood) The product has been installed in multiple branded real estate enterprises. According to *People's Daily*, a high-end residential complex in Hangzhou had persistently prominent issues with fume backflow and odor permeation in its kitchens, leading to significant complaints from residents. Despite various attempts such as installing additional fans on the rooftop to assist with fume extraction and purchasing well-known international brands of range hoods, the results remained unsatisfactory. Robam Appliances undertook this renovation project. After an actual site survey, they discovered that the root cause of the problem lay in excessively long fume pipes, severe leakage in the exhaust ducts, and a non-return valve for fume backflow that had become ineffective due to years of use. They provided a specific solution using the Central Range Hood, installing the main unit on the rooftop and an intelligent power distribution valve at the fume duct outlet of each kitchen. This resulted in an over 45% increase in the exhaust efficiency of the entire building and a more than 59% increase in airflow. From the birth of the first distributed Central Range Hood in 2014 to the appearance of the centralized Central Range Hood in 2016, the iterated and upgraded Central Range Hood has comprehensively solved the challenges of kitchen grease fumes. To enhance extraction efficiency, the Central Range Hood treats the fume extraction power unit and exhaust duct as an entire extraction system, employing intelligent variable frequency IoT technology, intelligent power distribution technology, and intelligent cloud platform technology developed in collaboration with Alibaba Group to address the issue of fume extraction. To reduce the pollution of air by grease fumes, the Central Range Hood is designed with a centralized fume purification and treatment stage. All grease fumes from the entire building must undergo purification and treatment by the main unit before being uniformly discharged outside the building. (Diagram of the Central Range Hood) Testing has shown that the Central Range Hood can improve fume extraction efficiency on lower floors by over 40%, effectively resolving fume backflow and odor permeation. Its composite fume purification rate reaches as high as 99.5%, and operating noise is reduced by 10 decibels. Even before gaining attention from national media, the Central Range Hood, in collaboration with Shou Chuang Properties in 2015, was selected for the Beijing Municipal Science and Technology Commission's "Capital Blue Sky Action" project. Subsequently, the Beijing Municipal Commission of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Beijing Municipal Development and Reform Commission, and the Beijing Municipal Science and Technology Commission successively issued consultative documents regarding the promotion of Robam Appliances' Central Range Hood in Beijing. Currently, Robam Appliances' Central Range Hood has been introduced to over 20 cities in China and has established strategic partnerships with numerous branded real estate enterprises such as Vanke, Country Garden, Sunac, Greentown, Lanhai, and Binjiang, and has been implemented in over 30 residential projects. Central media has praised national enterprises multiple times. 2017 marked the third consecutive year that Robam Appliances' range hoods achieved the global sales championship. In January of this year, *People's Daily*, under the title "National Kitchen Appliances Enter Global Kitchens," reported on Robam Appliances' achievements and strategic layout in the global kitchen appliance market. CCTV also awarded Robam Appliances the title of "CCTV Global Leading National Brand." On May 10th, "China Brand Day," Robam Appliances was also invited to appear on CCTV's prime-time program "Great Nation Brands." (Robam Appliances awarded the title of "CCTV Global Leading National Brand") The Central Range Hood represents another self-disruption by Robam Appliances in the field of kitchen appliances. Liu Buchen, a seasoned analyst in the home appliance industry, believes that the advent of the Central Range Hood is a mark of range hoods transitioning from the "era of traditional range hoods" to the "era of clean range hoods" / "era of central range hoods." He states, "The emergence and promotion of the Central Range Hood are of great significance to Robam Appliances, not only further defending its dominant position in the range hood field but also opening up an entirely new product category, representing an incremental market for Robam Appliances." Through 39 years of innovation and development, Robam Appliances has become a representative of high-end Chinese kitchen appliance brands and has firmly occupied a core position among high-end brands in the global kitchen appliance market. Since the beginning of this year, Robam Appliances has proposed to base its operations on technological innovation, combining in-depth insights into traditional Chinese culinary culture and contemporary Chinese life, and manufacturing high-end kitchen appliance products with users at the center to create new Chinese kitchens. The favor shown by Chinese users towards the Central Range Hood marks a solid step towards creating new Chinese kitchens. 1 Previous: Robam Appliances Guest on Zhejiang Voice: Adhering to Quality, Creating New Chinese Kitchens Next: China's New Interior Design Power List National Launch, Robam Appliances Crosses Over to Bloom in Design

title_en: Robam Partners with Tencent's "Golden Phoenix Award" to Embark on a Journey of "Insightful Understanding" into the Future of Design
body_en: On May 16th, Robam Appliances, in collaboration with Tencent Home and the China Interior Decoration Association, launched the "2018 Tencent Home Annual Design Fashion Festival · Golden Phoenix Award" Northwest Regional promotion event in the ancient city of Xi'an. "Meeting with passion for design, understanding the times to see the future," many renowned interior designers, local designer groups, and designer organizations gathered in Xi'an, with the theme of "Understanding the Future Amidst Change," to embark on a journey to "understand" future design. With the upgrading of consumption, people have higher demands for living environments, and the real estate industry has entered an era of "fully decorated" homes that emphasize quality. The kitchen is a focal point in home renovation, and the integration of kitchen appliance configuration and kitchen design is becoming increasingly important. Robam Appliances holds multiple designer summits nationwide every year, inviting internationally renowned design masters and experienced domestic industrial and home design professionals to discuss design concepts. (Scene of the Golden Phoenix Award promotion in Xi'an) "Understanding" the Future of Design Amidst Change "We are committed to helping young Chinese designers grow, fostering deep collaboration between excellent designers nationwide and Tencent Home, enhancing the design level and artistic cultivation of domestic designers, and promoting the development of the design industry," said Zhang Yongzhi, Editor-in-Chief of Tencent Home, revealing the original intention of the Golden Phoenix Award competition. In this era of rapid technological development, change is the only constant. For this year's Xi'an event, the organizers invited several top designers, including "Space Magician" Shi Nanqiao, "Celebrity's Preferred Designer" Meng Ye, and original furniture designer Chen Dari. Drawing on their years of design experience, they contemplated how to "understand" and find the future direction of home design. What kind of transformations are occurring in this era? At the event, renowned designer Shi Nanqiao reviewed his 38-year design career, sharing his experiences designing in Taiwan and mainland China. He interpreted his thoughts, attitudes, and design works from different periods, his sincere and heartfelt sharing deeply resonated with many designers, sparking a round of reflection on design dreams. (Shi Nanqiao shares his design career) Chen Dari delivered a brilliant presentation titled "Talking Big About Design," expressing his aspiration to become a designer for the people and encouraging fellow designers present. "Celebrity's Preferred Designer" Meng Ye recounted his journey from obscurity at the beginning of his design career to his present life, unreservedly sharing his passion and dedication to private residence design. He emphasized that in an era of change, "not following the crowd in design" is the value of his design team. It is understood that the 2018 Golden Phoenix Award, while continuing to select eleven major awards and showcase TOP100 outstanding design works, has added six major competition zones nationwide, with each zone selecting its TOP30. Award-winning works will be printed in the "Tencent Home Annual Design Fashion Festival · Golden Phoenix Award Yearbook," excellent works will be displayed on the homepage of the Tencent Home official website, and promoted nationwide. Designers who win the eleven major awards will be invited to the grand awards ceremony in Beijing in November and will participate as guest speakers in the third Golden Phoenix Award roadshow. Robam Appliances Transforms Kitchen Life Through Design A kitchen with aesthetic appeal requires not only the planning of interior designers but also appliances with sophisticated design taste. The mission of designers is to translate users' understanding of home and their aspirations for a better life into spatial planning and layout design. As a leader in high-end kitchen appliances, Robam Appliances, with its mission to "create all the beautiful aspirations of humanity for kitchen life," strives to build quality lifestyles. Robam Appliances' design team is committed to integrating aesthetic design into its products, transforming lives through design. For Robam Appliances, design is inseparable from product technology research and development, extending beyond the visual aspect to encompass the entire product concept and form. For example, the Robam range hood 5610, which won the 2018 iF Design Award, features a design with an inner circle and an outer square, embodying Eastern artistic aesthetics and reflecting the minimalist and grand style consistently advocated by the Robam design team. The circular baffle of this range hood creates a negative pressure zone when opened, ensuring powerful smoke extraction and solving the problem of smoke attraction; when closed, the circular baffle retracts into the body, making the range hood surface flat and easy to clean, thus solving the cleaning problem; simultaneously, the baffle effectively prevents smoke backflow when closed. A single design solves three problems, merging aesthetics with practicality. (Robam range hood 5610 with inner circle and outer square design) In March of this year, six Robam Appliances products jointly received the "German Red Dot Product Design Award," known as the "Oscars" of the design world. Prior to this, Robam Appliances had successively won numerous domestic and international design awards, including the German iF Design Award, GDA Design Award, Red Star Award, Golden Hook Award, Golden Dot Award, China Good Design Award, and Most Successful Design Award, fully demonstrating the company's leading position in the global kitchen appliance industrial design field. In 2018, Robam Appliances further proposed the concept of "Creating a New Chinese Kitchen," and while designing products most suitable for Chinese kitchens, it deepened cooperation with designers to organically integrate kitchen appliances with interior design, creating the aspirational and beautiful kitchen life that Chinese families envision. 0 Previous Article: Robam Appliances Meets the Forbidden City Ice Cellar for a Grand Offering on May 26th, Reviving a Lost Ancient Banquet Next Article: Robam Appliances Collaborates with Tmall to Create the Food Show "Greatly Surprised," Smart Kitchen Gains Significant Attention!

title_en: ROBAM Leads the Kitchen Appliance Industry with Chinese Intelligent Manufacturing
body_en: The "Industry 4.0 Strategy," first proposed by Germany, signifies a global transformation in intelligent manufacturing, as humanity undergoes a fourth industrial revolution marked by intelligence. Innovation in manufacturing is currently a focal point of global industrial competition. In addition to Germany, the United States, to support "re-industrialization," has launched the "National Network for Manufacturing Innovation" with a total investment of US$1 billion, promoting the development of digital manufacturing innovation across the U.S. The Singapore government, to stimulate the innovation capabilities of its local small and medium-sized manufacturing enterprises, has partnered with McKinsey to plan the "Lighthouse" project. Governments worldwide are sparing no effort to enhance their domestic manufacturing's creativity and innovation capabilities to address the advent of the fourth industrial revolution. The fourth industrial revolution will also serve as an opportunity for the transformation of China's manufacturing sector, enabling it to transition from "Made in China" to "Intelligently Made in China." According to the "Made in China 2025" strategic plan, "intelligent manufacturing" is positioned as the primary focus, and intelligence is key for China to seize the technological commanding heights in the adjustment of the global manufacturing competitive landscape. As a leader in the high-end kitchen appliance industry, Robam is completing its brand strategic upgrade from "Made in China" to "Intelligently Made in China." With the vision of "becoming a benchmark manufacturing factory for kitchen appliances in China," Robam has built an industry-leading lean production and intelligent manufacturing system. Robam's Intelligent Manufacturing Leads China's Kitchen Appliance Industry An intelligent kitchen ecosystem is also a future development trend for Robam. Based on the "Made in China 2025" strategy, Robam is continuously improving its intelligent strategy. Through years of research and development innovation, Robam's intelligence is leading China's kitchen appliance industry and has even reached a globally leading level, securing a future strategic advantage. In 2016, Robam established the industry's first digital intelligent manufacturing base and created the first industry innovative product incubation platform – the Super Factory. In 2017, it established the kitchen appliance industry's first overseas innovation center – the California Innovation Center in the United States, initiating global innovation for Chinese kitchen appliances. As early as 2014, Robam launched the first generation ROKI smart cooking system, enabling the linkage of range hoods and stoves and recipe navigation. After several years of iterative updates, the ROKI smart cooking system can better assist consumers in experiencing the joy of cooking by automatically adjusting stove heat and range hood airflow according to the selected recipe, as well as the cooking programs and times for steam ovens and ovens, realizing intelligent cooking for users. (Robam Intelligent Manufacturing Information Command Center) In the future, Robam will be guided by "Made in China 2025," continue to focus on technological innovation in the kitchen appliance field and its intelligent ecosystem strategy, adhering to measures such as "technology-driven, channel integration, global vision, and focus on built-in appliances," and integrate technological innovation into every aspect of the company's development. As early as 20 years ago, Robam recognized the importance of innovation. title_en: New Marketing Play for Youthful Kitchen Appliances: Check Out Robam Appliances' "Full-Screen Range Hood" Black Technology
body_en: When we talk about "full screen," what comes to mind? vivo? OPPO? Or iPhone? In the parlance of the tech industry, full screen refers to a smartphone design with an ultra-high screen-to-body ratio. Since the iPhone X debuted in 2017, the smartphone industry has been swept by a frenzy for the "full screen" concept, with "screen-to-body ratio" and "screen size" becoming important selling points pursued by major smartphone manufacturers and consumers. To date, 6.4 inches is the largest full screen on a smartphone, and the limit for smartphone screen-to-body ratio is 93.8%. Recently, the tech community has been discussing the topics of #FullScreenGoneWild and #40InchFullScreen, which have sparked heated debate among netizens, with the Weibo topic reaching a popularity of 200,000. Even more astonishing is that the initiator of this topic is none other than Robam, a home appliance brand. "40-inch full screen," "100% screen-to-body ratio," and "Robam" – these keywords alone can ignite one's imagination. Many are wondering what Robam has done this time. Have they ventured into the smartphone industry? Is it a breakthrough technology? Or something else entirely? "The one who tied the bell to the tiger must untie it." Robam has finally unraveled this series of questions by launching its first full-screen range hood, the 27X6, once again igniting discussions in the industry. Robam's new range hood has become a sensation even before its official launch. One must admit that Robam has executed this marketing campaign brilliantly, earning admiration from both the tech and home appliance circles. So, what exactly did Robam do in this successful marketing campaign? Collaboration: Matching optimal marketing resources to maintain new product exposure When launching a new product, some companies are too eager to get it to market and pay little attention to marketing, which is a taboo in new product marketing. What marketing goals to set, what channels and strategies to use, and where to connect and interact with the target consumer group are all questions that businesses need to consider when launching a new product. In terms of the promotion path for new products, Robam's full-screen range hood has done an excellent job. Step 1: Collaborated with GeekPark to create a suspenseful concept of "40-inch full screen" through posters and by pushing Weibo trending topics. GeekPark is China's largest community for innovators, characterized by its focus on internet products and technology trends, gathering China's top internet entrepreneurs and product professionals, and serving as a platform for geeks to learn and interact. This step accurately conveyed the new concept of "40-inch full screen" to the target audience, shaping the product's technological image and attracting the attention of the tech community. (GeekPark Communication) Step 2: Bombarded various media outlets in the industry with a large number of PR articles to ensure consumers could browse and search for relevant information, thereby increasing consumer attention. Step 3: Created a Weibo topic to interact with consumers, officially answering their questions, and inviting influential Weibo users to participate in the interaction to amplify the buzz and build anticipation for the new product launch. Step 4: The full-screen new product was exhibited and pre-sold at the Tmall flagship store. During the new product promotion period, through coupons, price protection, video sharing, and gifts, consumers were able to experience the product firsthand, fostering a positive market reputation. Step 5: Collected customer feedback for product improvement and service enhancement. Robam's after-sales service has always had a good reputation in the industry. Building on this, it is easier to obtain, analyze, and address issues from consumers during the new product promotion phase. This series of marketing plans encompasses the pre-launch, mid-launch, and post-launch phases, ensuring new product exposure while enabling the product to quickly gain market recognition and win over consumers. Innovation: Thinking what others dare not, doing what others cannot In this internet era, technological iteration in products is rapid. To make a product stand out and gain a competitive edge in the market, the most fundamental approach is a company's own creativity. Many companies promote innovation, but few truly understand it because the cost of innovation is too high, thus, truly innovative companies are rare. Innovation in the market relies on two forms of technology: first, product technological innovation; and second, understanding unmet user needs and providing solutions. Both are forms of innovation. Taking Robam's full-screen range hood as an example, the combination of "full screen" and "range hood" has no precedent in the home appliance industry, and no company would even consider linking the two. In other words, it sounds like an "absurd" idea. From the perspective of technological innovation, to be fair, Robam has always been one of the top experts in the home appliance industry, and its range hood update speed is unparalleled. Unlike before, the newly released full-screen range hood utilizes new full-screen technology to enhance the consumer "experience," allowing consumers to feel the technological experience brought by the full screen through operation, ushering in a new era of full-screen range hoods. This seemingly absurd idea has become a reality, making Robam the "first person to eat crab" in the home appliance industry. From the consumer's perspective, both in terms of consumption concepts and purchasing power, the post-80s and post-90s generation are the absolute main consumer groups. Like humans, brands have their own life cycles, going through birth-growth-maturity-aging. To capture the core consumer group of the era, "brand youthfulness" has become the most discussed topic among many brands. Every company talks about brand youthfulness, but only those that truly think from the perspective of young people can win consumer recognition. Robam has been established for 39 years, making it a "veteran" in the home appliance industry. Through this new product marketing event, it is evident that Robam's brand youthfulness strategy has been very successful. By matching a kitchen appliance like a "range hood," which has a low presence in the eyes of young people, with the cutting-edge technology that young people are interested in, this approach has deeply resonated with young consumers. Robam's full-screen range hood is undoubtedly a classic case of "counter-attack product design" in marketing. Full-Screen Range Hood: The Inevitable Victory of a "Blockbuster" Product "Talk is cheap, action speaks louder than words." Good promotional ideas must exist within the context of consumers' real lives. The closer it is to consumers' real lives, the greater its communicability and topic potential. The creation of "blockbuster" home appliances is inseparable from consumers' cooking experience. Robam is targeting the post-80s and post-90s generations who grew up with the internet. "Pursuit of novelty, admiration for brands, emphasis on individuality, and attention to emotion and intuition" are the distinct characteristics of this group's consumer psychology and behavior. Currently, high-definition large screens on range hoods on the market are generally within 10 inches, and the screen is on the same plane as the fan. For young consumers, these range hood products are simply "not cool." Robam's 27X6 range hood breaks tradition by innovating with a 40-inch full screen and a 100% screen-to-body ratio. In actual operation, through infrared sensing, the full screen automatically rises and falls without buttons, is oil-resistant, and offers gesture control, making it more novel. In addition to the full-screen technology, this range hood also features an infrared sensing function. Consumers can wave their hand towards the center of the full screen display, and upon approach, it will turn on. A second wave instantly activates the "stir-fry" mode, and a third wave turns it off. The entire process does not require touching the panel, thus humanely preventing oil stains from soiling the range hood. "Appearance" is an important factor for young people when choosing a product. The Robam 27X6 range hood features an all-black mirror surface, exuding minimalist European aesthetics, sophisticated and elegant yet trendy, perfectly matching various Chinese kitchen styles and delivering a strong visual impact with a modern artistic sense, which is sure to resonate with the "new middle class." The Robam 27X6 range hood perfectly integrates modern elements such as life aesthetics, leading technology, and trendy fashion, upgrading intelligent technology to an unprecedented level. With its distinctive product features, it wins the favor of young consumers, and it is believed that this range hood will lead the range hood industry into a new era of full screens. From Robam, we can see that to create a "blockbuster" product, the essence of its marketing lies in: first, actively embracing internet technology and boldly experimenting with rich and diverse marketing and promotional expressions to enhance affinity, evoke customer resonance, and achieve organic dissemination; second, adhering to a customer-centric approach, starting from consumer needs to create products that are most suitable for Chinese consumers to use, allowing consumers to enjoy the pleasure of cooking; third, constantly maintaining corporate innovation, which is key to sustaining corporate vitality and achieving brand youthfulness. In this process, companies must observe everything about young people, discover what they like, what they talk about, what their habits are, and what their troubles are... only then can they infuse fresh vitality into the brand and restore the brand's "youth." 0 Previous Article: Robam Gas Stove 32B0: Even heat cooks delicious food, she's also the "most easy-to-care-for girlfriend" Next Article: Robam's Revolutionary Masterpiece, Creating a Stylish Kitchen for "Those Who Love to Cook"

title_en: Suning, Gome, Tmall, and JD.com: Four Major Platforms Join Forces to Jointly Promote Robam's High-Suction Range Hoods
body_en: Not long ago, Zhejiang Gome and Robam Appliances (Zhejiang region) jointly held a super sales event themed "Private Kitchen Fun, Noble Enjoyment." Robam's high-suction range hoods, gas stoves, disinfection cabinets, and other high-end kitchen appliances set off the first wave of purchase storms in Zhejiang province in 2014. It is understood that this is an innovative marketing activity where Robam Appliances (Zhejiang region) and Zhejiang Gome joined forces to jointly promote high-suction range hoods. And during the Spring Festival, a Suning advertisement warmed many people. The slogan, "You inhale more than this every day, let's get a new one!" resonated with many people's hearts and inspired many consumers to consider replacing their range hoods with high-suction models for their loved ones. In addition, JD.com, a leading comprehensive online retailer in China, also reached a strategic partnership with Robam Appliances at the end of 2013. JD.com will leverage its own resources and platform advantages to engage in deeper, all-round brand cooperation with Robam Appliances in 2014, while vigorously promoting high-suction range hoods. In the kitchen appliance sales section of Tmall Mall, Robam Appliances, after dominating sales on Double Eleven, once again took the lead in sales in the kitchen appliance industry on Tmall Mall in 2013. Through the promotion of high-suction range hoods, Tmall Mall and Robam Appliances have brought a distinctive high-end consumption experience to consumers, leading to the sustained popularity of high-suction range hoods in the online market. Gome, Suning, Tmall, and JD.com, the four major home appliance sales platforms, are all working together to jointly promote Robam's high-suction range hoods. On the one hand, this indicates that the range hood industry has entered the era of high suction, with high suction becoming the main battlefield for kitchen appliance brands to compete. On the other hand, it also demonstrates the recognition of Robam's high-suction range hoods by major platforms. Industry Giants Flock In, High Suction Becomes the Main Battlefield Reporters visited several Gome and Suning stores in Beijing, and browsed the kitchen appliance sections of Gome Online, Suning.com, Tmall Mall, and JD.com. It was found that high-suction range hoods are selling briskly both online and offline. A relevant person in charge of Gome told reporters, "Robam's high-suction range hoods are very popular with consumers and have always maintained sales leadership. In addition, Siemens and Haier's high-suction range hoods are also selling well. Currently, the entire range hood market is leaning towards high suction." It is understood that Robam Appliances launched its first high-suction range hood, model 8210, as early as 2008, creating a "high suction" trend in the market. Subsequently, Robam Appliances successively launched several other high-suction range hoods, such as models 8216 and 8212, and they quickly climbed the industry's best-selling range hood rankings. In 2013, Robam's 8218 high-suction range hood was launched, redefining the industry standards for "high-suction range hoods" in terms of "collection, strong filtration, rapid exhaust, and energy saving," providing consumers with new standards for purchasing high-suction range hoods. At the same time, brands such as Siemens, Haier, Shuaikang, and Wanhe have also entered the high-suction market. Shuaikang has launched high-airflow, high-air-pressure range hoods, while Siemens, known for its German quality, has released a full series of new range hoods featuring "efficient high suction and intelligent self-cleaning." The collective entry of industry giants has made high suction the main battlefield for the range hood industry, and the entire industry has entered the era of high suction. High-Suction Range Hoods Sell Well, Robam Appliances Continues to Lead With the joint promotion by the four major platforms and the entry of various brands in the industry, the sales of high-suction range hoods have soared. According to data monitored by AVC (All View Cloud) at the end of 2013, the high-suction market maintained a continuous growth trend. In the first quarter of 2012, the high-suction market only accounted for 21% of the share, while by October 2013, it had exceeded 30%. The market share of high suction has continued to grow rapidly, with growth rates in September and October approaching 30%. The mainstream trend of high suction is even more evident in the online market. In Q3 2013, the share of high-suction products online was 4.5 percentage points higher than offline. The market share of high suction is expected to continue its growth trend in 2014. title_en: Robam Appliances once again selected for Asia's Top 500 Brands, exclusively honored for the industry for 9 consecutive years.
body_en: On September 24th, at the 2014 "World Executive Summit," the "Asia's Top 500 Brands" ranking was grandly unveiled in Hong Kong. Robam Appliances, due to its outstanding market leadership, product innovation capabilities, excellent performance growth, and its original high-end brand model, was once again selected as one of "Asia's Top 500 Brands" by the World Brand Laboratory, led by Robert Mondavi. This makes Robam the only enterprise in China's kitchen appliance industry to be consecutively shortlisted for nine years. Distinguished experts and scholars from around the world, including Professor Ziv Carmon, a senior professor at INSEAD (European Institute of Business Administration) and a master of marketing, and Professor Ravi Dhar, a senior professor at the Yale School of Management and director of the Yale Consumer Monitoring Center, delivered insightful speeches at the summit. In addition to Robam Appliances, other leading Asian brands such as Alibaba, Lenovo, Toshiba, and Panasonic were also listed. It is understood that the evaluation system for "Asia's Top 500 Brands" comprehensively assesses and scores strong Asian enterprises based on four major dimensions: market performance, development potential, quality level, and operational efficiency. After rigorous evaluation, Robam Appliances received recognition from the Asian Brand Assessment System (ABAS) expert committee in areas such as brand age, internationalization level, marketing mix, brand awareness, total asset growth rate, innovation capability, after-sales service, quality, operating revenue, and net profit, ultimately ranking on the list for nine consecutive years. Robam Appliances Tops Top 500 for Nine Consecutive Years, Remaining the Industry's Only One As a leading brand in China's kitchen appliance industry, Robam Appliances has focused on the high-end market for 35 years, achieving 16 years of leading sales and firmly holding the top position in the industry. This has become the most important factor for Robam's consecutive nine-year inclusion in "Asia's Top 500 Brands." According to data from Zhongyikang, a reputable third-party research institution in China, from January to August this year, the overall retail volume of the range hood market saw a year-on-year cumulative decrease of 1.13%, while the retail sales saw a year-on-year cumulative increase of 10.09%. In contrast, the sales of Robam Appliances' high-suction range hoods showed exceptional growth, increasing by 9.28% against the trend, with a year-on-year cumulative retail sales increase of 22.57%, far exceeding the industry average. The data also indicates that in the first eight months of this year, both the retail volume and sales of non-high-suction range hoods experienced negative growth to varying degrees, while the retail volume and sales of high-suction range hoods grew by 35.21% and 47.16% respectively, fully demonstrating the dominant position of high suction in the market. At the summit, Zhang Xuan, Brand Director of Robam Appliances, spoke on behalf of the award-winning companies, explaining Robam Appliances' high-end brand model to the guests. The attendees expressed their affirmation and praise for Robam Appliances' original high-end brand model. Robam Appliances' High-End Brand Model Receives International Recognition, Highlighting Its Leading Position At the summit, Professor Ravi Dhar of the Yale School of Management witnessed Robam Appliances' growth, transformation, and brilliant achievements. The organizing committee of "Asia's Top 500 Brands" also stated that over the years, Robam Appliances has consistently maintained a high-end brand positioning in its market competition with foreign brands and comprehensive home appliance brands, successfully defending its market leadership and achieving nine consecutive years of inclusion, creating a brand miracle. Professor Ravi Dhar and Professor Ziv Carmon Jointly Endorse Robam Appliances' High-End Brand Model Looking at the Top 500 rankings over the years, many of the included foreign brands are industry leaders, occupying significant market share and holding industry influence. Robam Appliances, as the only brand in China's kitchen appliance industry to be included in "Asia's Top 500 Brands" for nine years, not only reflects the international community's affirmation of Robam's industry leadership but also its recognition of Robam's "high-end brand model." Through 35 years of exploration and innovation, Robam Appliances has built an R&D team with the highest technical level, strongest innovation capabilities, and fastest market response speed in the industry. It has also pioneered a high-end business model consisting of "one foundation, one core, and three characteristics": the foundation is to focus on one industry and conduct in-depth research; the core is high value; and the three characteristics are continuous innovation and leadership in product technology, enhancement of brand cultural value in brand connotation, and exceeding consumer expectations in consumer experience. The high-quality team and unique business model have made Robam Appliances' path to a high-end brand increasingly stable. Currently, Robam Appliances, with its high-end brand model, has gained recognition from the world's top three brand valuation institutions: "Asia's Top 500 Brands" by World Brand Lab; the Outstanding Brand Building Case Award selected by Interbrand; and "Top 100 Most Valuable Chinese Brands" by BrandZ. While the high-end brand model has garnered international recognition, it has also become a model for many foreign companies to learn from. Robam Appliances was also named one of the "2014 China TOP 100 Best Employers." This award was jointly organized by the world-leading management magazine "World Executive" in collaboration with World HR Lab, "World Entrepreneur" magazine, and "President" magazine. In the future, Robam Appliances will continue to adhere to the concept of "Exquisite Technology, Easy Cooking," deeply understand consumer needs, lead industry development with innovation and technology, and enable more families to enjoy the convenience of cooking brought by technology. 1 Previous Article: Double Eleven, High Suction Understands High-End Better Next Article: Robam Appliances ROKI Builds a Smart Cooking Ecosystem
