The first chapter of the law aims to eliminate the market bottlenecks and institutional obstacles faced by the current development of the private economy. The stability of enterprises leads to economic stability, and strong enterprises lead to a strong economy. Why is the private economy so important? The answer can be found in the data set "56789": as of 2024, private enterprises have contributed more than 50% of tax revenue, over 60% of the national GDP, more than 70% of technological innovation achievements, over 80% of urban employment, with the number of private enterprises accounting for over 90% of the total number of enterprises, and the total import and export value accounting for over 50% of the total foreign trade value. Behind "56789," the private economy has grown into a solid pillar of the national economy, playing a core role in stabilizing the Chinese economy, ensuring people's livelihoods, promoting innovation, and driving development. However, in recent years, the development of the private economy has faced a series of significant challenges, including the impact of the three-year pandemic, the China-US trade war, and the transformation and upgrading of the Chinese economy. Private enterprises are at the forefront of the market, facing the greatest difficulties and pressures. According to statistics, private investment has been negative for two consecutive years, with the proportion falling to 50.1%, a decrease of 15 percentage points from the peak ten years ago. According to the 2024 national survey data from the China Economic System Reform Research Association of the National Development and Reform Commission, the main operational difficulties faced by private entrepreneurs currently are "few orders, few customers, insufficient consumption" (57.8%), "fierce competition, low profits" (42.2%), while the urgent need for government support for private enterprises includes "strengthening talent and employment demand guarantees" (45.2%), "implementing fair competition policy systems" (42.6%), "improving the normalization of prevention and clearance mechanisms for overdue payments" (32.5%), "improving financing support policy systems" (32.2%), "supporting private enterprises to enhance technological innovation capabilities" (31.4%), and "removing market access barriers" (30.6%), among others. It is urgent to eliminate the market bottlenecks and institutional obstacles that hinder the further development of private enterprises, promoting high-quality and leapfrog development of the private economy. The promulgation of the Private Economy Promotion Law is timely. The new law consists of 9 chapters and 78 articles, based on the principles of "equal treatment, fair competition, equal protection, and common development." It comprehensively formulates legal provisions to promote the development and growth of the private economy from seven aspects, including fair competition, investment and financing promotion, technological innovation, and rights protection, focusing on key issues encountered in the current development of the private economy. As the first fundamental law specifically addressing the development of the private economy, the new law explicitly defines the legal status of the private economy for the first time, incorporating the "two adherences" into the law. It also includes the statement that "promoting the sustained, healthy, and high-quality development of the private economy is a major long-term policy of the state" into the legal provisions. This marks a historic leap for China's private economy from "policy support" to "legal escort," fully demonstrating the firm determination of the Party Central Committee to promote the development and growth of the private economy. The private economy is the source of innovation for China's economic growth, and establishing a fair competition mechanism is the economic and legal foundation for implementing a unified national market. Strengthening and expanding the private economy is the fundamental guarantee for achieving common prosperity. title_en: In Q1 of 2025, JD's revenue reached 301.1 billion, ranking first in the internet industry.
body_en: On June 5th, it was reported that during this period, major domestic internet companies have successively announced their Q1 2025 performance. Some media outlets have compiled a revenue and profit chart based on the financial data of various companies for comparison and analysis. From this intuitive display chart, it can be clearly seen that JD Group led by Liu Qiangdong topped the list with a revenue of 301.1 billion yuan in Q1 2025, an increase of 15.8% compared to Q1 2024. It is understood that JD Group's revenue in Q1 2025 far exceeded market expectations, achieving the highest year-on-year growth rate in nearly three years, reaching 3.4 times the market growth rate during the same period, leading the industry. In addition, the net profit attributable to ordinary shareholders of the company was 10.9 billion yuan, compared to 7.1 billion yuan in the same period last year, achieving significant growth. Alibaba, another industry giant, ranked second with a total revenue of 236.454 billion yuan in Q1 2025, a year-on-year increase of 7%. In terms of revenue scale, although it is not as high as JD, its growth rate is also not low. Alibaba's annual revenue was 996.347 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 6%, demonstrating strong stability. It is worth mentioning the outstanding achievements of JD here. Some analysts believe that JD's success is due to its continuous efforts in optimizing cost expenditures, focusing on supply chain advantages, and expanding overseas markets. JD's advantages in core categories are becoming more solid. In the first quarter, revenue from electronics increased by 17.1% year-on-year, while revenue from daily necessities increased by 14.9% year-on-year. The supermarket category has maintained double-digit year-on-year revenue growth for five consecutive quarters. At the same time, JD's quarterly active user count has achieved double-digit year-on-year growth for six consecutive quarters, with a growth rate exceeding 20%. In addition, it is necessary to mention the efforts of JD's founder Liu Qiangdong. It is understood that JD's performance has continued to accelerate over the past year, which is closely related to Liu Qiangdong personally overseeing the front line and participating in business innovation at JD Group. Source: 21IC

title_en: Notice on holding the 2024 Academic Annual Conference of the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association (Second Round)
body_en: Relevant units: Pharmaceutical excipients are an important foundation in China's pharmaceutical industry, and are one of the key factors determining the quality of generic drugs and the high-quality development of innovative formulations. The supply chain security of pharmaceutical excipients used in high-end formulations in China urgently needs to strengthen the technological innovation and industrial support for domestic pharmaceutical excipients. At the same time, ensuring the quality of clinical medication, reducing drug costs, and alleviating the pressure on medical insurance, to a large extent, also depend on the quality improvement of domestic pharmaceutical excipients. In line with the principle of "promoting technological innovation in pharmaceutical excipients and enhancing the new quality productivity of the pharmaceutical industry," the "2024 Annual Academic Conference of the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association," hosted by the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association, is scheduled to be held in Hefei, Anhui Province from November 8th to 10th, 2024. This academic conference will feature conference reports in the fields of materials science related to pharmaceutical excipients, innovative drugs, and innovative formulations, analyzing the development difficulties and innovations of pharmaceutical excipients; inviting authoritative experts to deeply discuss the in vivo processes of pharmaceutical excipients and drug delivery carriers, as well as the improvement and innovation of excipient quality. The conference will set up expert venues and young scholar sub-venues with three themes: "Pharmaceutical Excipients, Packaging Materials, and Drug Delivery Devices," "New Materials, New Carriers, and Innovative Formulations," and "Pharmaceutical Excipients and Innovative Drugs," to promote the wide participation of enterprises, academia, and young scholars, and jointly focus on the technological innovation and industrial research and development of pharmaceutical excipients. The relevant matters are hereby notified as follows: 1. Conference theme Promoting technological innovation in pharmaceutical excipients and enhancing the new quality productivity of the pharmaceutical industry 2. Time and place November 8th Registration Venue: New Ji Hotel, Hefei (2766 Wenzhong Road, Yaohai District, Hefei, Anhui Province) November 9-10 Main venue and sub-venues are both at the Shaoquanhu Campus of Anhui University of Chinese Medicine in Hefei, Anhui Province (350 Longzihu Road, Yaohai District, Hefei, Anhui Province) 3. Conference arrangements The conference will adopt a format of main venue and sub-venue reports for communication. The conference will invite well-known experts and scholars from domestic universities, research institutes, pharmaceutical companies, research and development units, medical institutions, regulatory agencies, etc., to give keynote speeches and special lectures. Please refer to Annex 1 for the detailed schedule. 4. Participants Researchers, managers, graduate students, etc., engaged in research and development related to pharmaceutical excipients, pharmaceutical packaging materials, drug delivery devices, formulation quality control, formulation equipment, pharmaceutical services, etc., from higher education institutions, research institutes, pharmaceutical companies, research and development units, medical institutions, drug regulatory agencies, and other related institutions. 5. Conference paper submission 1. Requirements for paper submission Chinese and English abstracts and paper format. Papers that have not been published in publicly distributed journals or presented at national academic conferences are the responsibility of the authors; please ensure clear expression and accurate data. Researchers in the pharmaceutical field are welcome to actively submit papers. 2. Paper submission method: Please submit the paper abstract before October 20, 2024, by logging into the conference website https://yyfl2024.sciconf.cn, clicking on the "Online Paper Submission" button on the right, and following the process to upload your paper abstract. After successful upload, you will receive an automatic email confirmation of online submission. After expert review, the organizing committee will select several papers and notify for further communication or publication in the "Drug Analysis" journal. 3. Poster submission method and time: Same as for papers. The conference welcomes poster submissions, which should be in A1 standard size. 6. Registration (1) Registration method 1. Please log in to the conference website link https://yyfl2024.sciconf.cn and click on the "Individual Representative Registration" or "Group Representative Registration" button to register; 2. Or scan the QR code below with your mobile phone WeChat, click on the "Individual Representative Registration" or "Group Representative Registration" button to fill in the registration information and submit. (2) Registration deadline The registration deadline is October 30, 2024. (3) Notes on registration 1. To ensure that participants receive registration confirmation, invoices, etc., please fill in accurate and true email addresses, mobile phone numbers, and other information; 2. This registration website is only for registration, and the payment channel is not yet open; 3. Registered individuals can log in to the conference website's personal center to check and modify their registration information; 4. Participants who do not submit papers can also attend the conference. 7. Conference fees (1) Conference registration fee 1. Registration fee standard The registration fee includes conference material fees and lunch during the conference. 2. Payment methods (1) Telegraphic transfer: After registering for the conference, participants should pay the registration fee by bank transfer, supporting both corporate and personal transfers to the following account: Payee: Chinese Pharmaceutical Association Bank: Bank of China Head Office Account number: 778350009320 It is recommended to use online banking for personal transfers, or you can also use Alipay transfer (to a bank card, with the name filled in the "Chinese Pharmaceutical Association" column). Please indicate "Pharmaceutical Excipients + Participant's Name + Unit Abbreviation" in the remittance note. After successful payment, please upload the remittance voucher to the conference website promptly for the secretariat to confirm the payment information and issue an invoice; (2) On-site payment: Registration fees can be paid through mobile online banking, or by scanning the payment QR code (Alipay, WeChat) on-site; there is no POS machine on-site, and payment by card swipe, UnionPay QuickPass, etc., is not supported. (2) Invoice matters 1. The conference can provide a VAT ordinary invoice for "conference registration fees" (electronic invoice). After uploading the personal remittance voucher (photo, screenshot, etc., of the complete order) to the conference system, please accurately fill in the invoice information in the billing instructions section of the personal information. 2. In cases where the name of the remitter does not match the participant's name, one unit remits for multiple representatives, or the unit remits collectively but requests separate invoices, please send detailed explanations by email to the secretariat at z38@cpa.org.cn, providing the remitter's name, participant's name, work unit, contact information, detailed information for issuing invoices, number and amount of invoices, and the person and address to receive the invoice. 3. Representatives who are unable to attend due to special reasons after remittance can apply for a full refund of the registration fee by sending an email to the secretariat. The refund process will be handled collectively after the conference, and the refund will be made back to the original payment method. For accurate refund processing, please indicate the full name and account information (account number, bank) of the original remitter in the refund application email. 8. Other matters Accommodation and transportation expenses: Accommodation and transportation expenses for participants are self-funded. Please refer to Annex 2 for hotel booking and transportation information. 9. Conference credits Full attendance at the conference will be awarded 3 continuing education credits from the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association. 10. Contact person and contact information 1. Contact person: Zhu Yizi (conference paper submission, registration fee payment, etc.) Peng Can, Duan Xiaohui, Lu Jia (conference consultation, accommodation arrangements, etc.) 2. We will continue to summarize good experiences and practices from various regions, guide power supply companies to comprehensively promote new initiatives such as "scanning code for electricity use," continuously innovate the "three-zero" service model, provide rural residents with free installation and fast electricity services, support rural revitalization and development, and help stimulate consumption vitality. Thirdly, gradually improve the level of equal services in urban and rural areas. We adhere to the overall planning of urban and rural areas, further narrow the gap in power supply between urban and rural areas, guide power supply companies to establish sound rural power supply service standards, standardize and improve service processes, extend high-quality power supply service resources to rural residents through the establishment of rural power stations and convenient service electricity, provide more convenient and efficient electricity installation, repair, and information disclosure services for rural residents, continuously promote the equalization of power supply services between rural and urban areas, and enhance the satisfaction and sense of obtaining electricity services for the masses. That's all I have to answer, thank you. China Finance News reporter: Recently, various central departments including the National Energy Administration have issued a series of policy measures to promote the high-quality development of the private economy. What are the benefits of the "Opinions" issued this time for private economic organizations? Thank you. Song Hongkun: Thank you for the question from the China Finance News reporter, it is a very good question because supporting the development of the private economy is also a key focus of the "Opinions." The National Energy Administration attaches great importance to serving the development of the private economy and recently issued the "Notice on Several Measures to Promote the Development of the Private Economy in the Energy Sector," which aims to support private enterprises through policy guidance, service optimization, market opening, and innovation breakthroughs, continuously increasing support for private enterprises. A good electricity business environment is an important guarantee for promoting the healthy development of private enterprises. To better serve the development of the private economy, we have proposed a series of reform measures in the "Opinions" to support private enterprises in electricity installation and use. Firstly, reduce the electricity installation costs for enterprises. We focus on reducing the burden on private enterprises. Building on the existing "three-zero" service for low-voltage small and micro enterprises, we will further expand the scope of the "three-zero" service to benefit more private economic organizations. For example, individual businesses opening stores, farmers running agritainment, and others who need to apply for electricity can enjoy free electricity connection. We estimate that after the issuance of the "Opinions," it is expected to benefit around 1.5 million households in five years. Secondly, provide precise services to enterprises. In the process of electricity installation, besides the investment in electricity installation, private enterprises are most concerned about how to apply for electricity and when they can start using electricity. In this regard, the "Opinions" propose that power supply companies should clarify the electricity installation standards and make them public, match capacity needs precisely based on actual electricity demand, characteristics of electricity equipment, and future development considerations, explore the implementation of contract electricity connection services, manage expected electricity connection, private enterprises can agree with power supply companies on project implementation and power delivery time, timely ensure the electricity needs of private enterprises, and better support the production and operation of a large number of private enterprises. Thirdly, help enterprises save energy and increase efficiency. To further help private enterprises reduce production and operation costs, we will guide power supply companies to provide free energy monitoring, energy efficiency diagnosis, energy efficiency consulting, and other public services. By promoting service models such as "energy efficiency bills," we will help private enterprises optimize their electricity usage structure and reduce electricity expenses. At the same time, we encourage more market entities to carry out comprehensive energy services, providing energy management and energy efficiency services such as energy efficiency transformation for private enterprises, helping them reduce comprehensive energy costs. Thank you. Xing Huina: Please continue to raise your hand for questions, we have two more reporters. Southern Metropolis Daily Southern+ reporter: Electricity security and stable supply are important factors in ensuring the production and life of the people. What specific measures will the National Energy Administration take to improve the resilience of the distribution network, reduce power outage time and frequency, etc.? With the peak summer season approaching, what measures are planned for ensuring electricity supply this summer? Thank you. Song Hongkun: Thank you for the question, this question will be answered by Mr. Hao Ruifeng. Hao Ruifeng: Thank you for your question. Electricity is the foundation of economic and social development, and all industries rely on stable and reliable electricity supply. In recent years, the National Energy Administration has focused on strengthening the planning and construction of the distribution network, continuously enhancing the management of power reliability, and has achieved positive results. Next, we will base ourselves on higher levels and stricter standards, continuously improve power supply capacity and quality, better meet the increasing demand for electricity for a better life for enterprises and the masses. Firstly, strengthen the planning and construction of the distribution network. A strong and reliable distribution network structure is the prerequisite and foundation for improving power supply quality. Based on the high-quality electricity needs of enterprises and the masses, we guide power supply companies to plan the main distribution network comprehensively, optimize the layout of power grid facilities, enhance the flexibility and self-healing capabilities of the distribution network, build a strong and flexible distribution network, and improve the resilience of the distribution network. At the same time, further optimize investment management, tilt construction and renovation funds towards weak power supply areas such as rural areas and old residential areas, gradually narrow the gap in power supply between urban and rural areas and regions; combined with the development of clean energy, strengthen the upgrade and transformation of the distribution network, and systematically enhance the comprehensive carrying capacity of the distribution network. Secondly, strengthen the operation and maintenance management of the distribution network. To ensure the safe and stable operation of the distribution network, it is not only necessary to build it well but also to manage it well. We guide power supply companies to strengthen the application of new technologies and equipment, such as using drones for equipment inspections, promoting non-stop power operation technology, continuously improving the lean operation and maintenance management level of the distribution network, further reducing the number of fault power outages, outage time, and impact range. At the same time, we guide power supply companies to optimize the power outage maintenance plan, coordinate and arrange management, implement "one outage, multiple uses," avoid repeated power outages on the same line, and minimize the number of power outages for users. Thirdly, carry out frequent power outage governance on a regular basis. In 2023, we launched a special campaign to address frequent power outages, focusing on solving 510 power outage problems that were strongly reflected by the people. Based on this, we have established a sound long-term mechanism. Since 2024, we have further intensified our efforts, continuously deepening and solidifying the work of addressing frequent power outages, and have achieved positive results. This year, we will continue to consolidate the results of the rectification, focusing on improving standards, refining measures, and improving mechanisms, making efforts to accelerate the comprehensive governance of problematic substations and lines, requiring power supply companies to achieve zero frequent power outage issues. At the same time, for the first time, the "Opinions" introduce a mechanism for public supervision, using the judgment and feelings of the people as an important criterion to evaluate the effectiveness of governance, jointly promoting the continuous improvement of power supply quality. You also asked about the upcoming peak summer season. The peak summer season is approaching, and everyone is concerned about ensuring electricity supply during this period. Today, the temperature in Beijing has reached 37 degrees, with some areas in Hebei, Henan, and Shandong exceeding 39 degrees. From the current situation, it is expected that the overall national electricity supply during this year's peak summer season will be guaranteed, but there may be localized electricity supply shortages during peak periods in some areas. The National Energy Administration will resolutely implement the decisions and arrangements of the Party Central Committee, aiming to ensure that there is flexibility in normal supply, measures for short-term shortages in specific areas, and effective responses to extreme situations. We will tighten the responsibilities of all parties, strengthen energy and power monitoring and early warning, fully leverage the potential for ensuring supply during peak periods, accelerate the construction and commissioning of supporting power sources, optimize cross-provincial and regional power optimization and mutual assistance, strengthen demand-side response, and make every effort to ensure the safe and stable supply of electricity during the peak summer season. That's all I have to say, thank you. Xing Huina: One last question. National Business Daily reporter: In the context of digital transformation, how do grid enterprises use advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence to enhance the intelligence level of "obtaining electricity" services and optimize user service experience? Thank you. Song Hongkun: Thank you for the question, this question will be answered by Mr. Pang Xiaogang. Pang Xiaogang: Thank you for your question. Artificial intelligence is a hot topic in today's society. Indeed, artificial intelligence is a strategic technology that leads a new round of technological revolution and industrial transformation, and it is also an important engine for nurturing and developing new productive forces. This year, the government work report proposed to continue to promote the "AI+" action, better integrating digital technology with manufacturing advantages and market advantages. In recent years, State Grid Corporation of China has also conducted some research and applications in artificial intelligence. We focus on future development, deepen reform and innovation, and continue to explore the application of artificial intelligence technology in the electricity industry. Last year, we released the Guangming Power Big Model, which is like an artificial intelligence expert in the field of energy and power, providing a "super brain" for ensuring the safe and stable operation of the power grid, promoting the integration of new energy consumption, and providing good power supply services. Next, we will further implement the national "AI+" action, accelerate the integration and application of the new generation of artificial intelligence technology represented by the big model in the field of power supply services. Below, I will elaborate on three aspects: The first aspect is to deepen the application of "AI+ electricity installation." We will vigorously promote the construction of a digital twin power grid (which means that we will construct another digital power grid in the digital space that completely mirrors the existing physical power grid), integrate artificial intelligence technology into the power supply solution response process, create a new intelligent electricity installation model, focus on enhancing the deep learning ability of the big model in industry knowledge such as policies, regulations, and technical standards, automatically match power grid resources based on customer electricity installation needs, intelligently generate power supply solutions quickly, and provide multiple sets of intelligent comparison solutions to better support customers in quickly connecting to electricity and early production. Some explorations have been made in this area, for example, our Jiangsu company has applied intelligent power supply solution generation technology to over 50,000 projects, reducing the time for generating solutions by more than half compared to the previous year. The second aspect is to deepen the application of "AI+ customer service." We will deepen the application of artificial intelligence in online and offline service scenarios to provide customers with more proactive, efficient, and intimate services. In terms of online services, we will upgrade and revamp channels such as 95598 and online State Grid, promote intelligent voice, text recognition, autonomous outbound calls, and other service functions, enhance service interaction and accuracy. In terms of offline services, we will focus on the large volume of routine business transactions and diverse customer needs in current business halls, build "digital employees" for smart services, deploy artificial intelligence service terminals, improve the efficiency of routine business transactions such as payment and repair, provide electricity business consultation, policy answers, intelligent queries, and other services for on-site customers, and enhance the actual experience of users. The third aspect is to deepen the application of "AI+ repair." We use the Guangming Power Big Model to improve the quality and efficiency of proactive repair services, enhance power supply guarantee capabilities. Strengthen the dynamic topology construction of the digital power grid, realize the "perceptible and fully monitored" status information, analyze the power outage range in real-time, accurately judge the cause of the fault, quickly arrange personnel for on-site repair, promote the transformation of power repair services from passive to proactive and intelligent, and minimize customer waiting time. There are many examples in this area as well, for example, after the pilot project in Tongzhou, Beijing, the efficiency of handling power outage faults has been significantly improved, with an average saving of about 20 minutes in repair time. We will continue to innovate and launch similar "AI+ power" products, and continuously optimize them to make electricity more secure and comfortable. That's all I have to answer. Thank you! Xing Huina: Today's press conference ends here, thank you to the four presenters, and thank you to all the media friends for participating. Goodbye!

We adhere to the overall planning of urban and rural areas, further narrow the gap in power supply between urban and rural areas, guide power supply companies to establish sound rural power supply service standards, standardize and improve service processes, extend high-quality power supply service resources to rural residents through the establishment of rural power stations and convenient service electricity, provide more convenient and efficient electricity installation, repair, and information disclosure services for rural residents, continuously promote the equalization of power supply services between rural and urban areas, and enhance the satisfaction and sense of obtaining electricity services for the masses. That's all I have to answer, thank you. China Finance News reporter: Recently, various central departments including the National Energy Administration have issued a series of policy measures to promote the high-quality development of the private economy. What are the benefits of the "Opinions" issued this time for private economic organizations? Thank you. Song Hongkun: Thank you for the question from the China Finance News reporter, it is a very good question because supporting the development of the private economy is also a key focus of the "Opinions." The National Energy Administration attaches great importance to serving the development of the private economy and recently issued the "Notice on Several Measures to Promote the Development of the Private Economy in the Energy Sector," which aims to support private enterprises through policy guidance, service optimization, market opening, and innovation breakthroughs, continuously increasing support for private enterprises. A good electricity business environment is an important guarantee for promoting the healthy development of private enterprises. To better serve the development of the private economy, we have proposed a series of reform measures in the "Opinions" to support private enterprises in electricity installation and use. Firstly, reduce the electricity installation costs for enterprises. We focus on reducing the burden on private enterprises. Building on the existing "three-zero" service for low-voltage small and micro enterprises, we will further expand the scope of the "three-zero" service to benefit more private economic organizations. For example, individual businesses opening stores, farmers running agritainment, and others who need to apply for electricity can enjoy free electricity connection. We estimate that after the issuance of the "Opinions," it is expected to benefit around 1.5 million households in five years. Secondly, provide precise services to enterprises. In the process of electricity installation, besides the investment in electricity installation, private enterprises are most concerned about how to apply for electricity and when they can start using electricity. In this regard, the "Opinions" propose that power supply companies should clarify the electricity installation standards and make them public, match capacity needs precisely based on actual electricity demand, characteristics of electricity equipment, and future development considerations, explore the implementation of contract electricity connection services, manage expected electricity connection, private enterprises can agree with power supply companies on project implementation and power delivery time, timely ensure the electricity needs of private enterprises, and better support the production and operation of a large number of private enterprises. Thirdly, help enterprises save energy and increase efficiency. To further help private enterprises reduce production and operation costs, we will guide power supply companies to provide free energy monitoring, energy efficiency diagnosis, energy efficiency consulting, and other public services. By promoting service models such as "energy efficiency bills," we will help private enterprises optimize their electricity usage structure and reduce electricity expenses. At the same time, we encourage more market entities to carry out comprehensive energy services, providing energy management and energy efficiency services such as energy efficiency transformation for private enterprises, helping them reduce comprehensive energy costs. What specific measures will the National Energy Administration take to improve the resilience of the distribution network, reduce power outage time and frequency, etc.? With the peak summer season approaching, what measures are planned for ensuring electricity supply this summer? Thank you. In recent years, the National Energy Administration has focused on strengthening the planning and construction of the distribution network, continuously enhancing the management of power reliability, and has achieved positive results. Next, we will base ourselves on higher levels and stricter standards, continuously improve power supply capacity and quality, better meet the increasing demand for electricity for a better life for enterprises and the masses. Firstly, strengthen the planning and construction of the distribution network. A strong and reliable distribution network structure is the prerequisite and foundation for improving power supply quality. Based on the high-quality electricity needs of enterprises and the masses, we guide power supply companies to plan the main distribution network comprehensively, optimize the layout of power grid facilities, enhance the flexibility and self-healing capabilities of the distribution network, build a strong and flexible distribution network, and improve the resilience of the distribution network. At the same time, further optimize investment management, tilt construction and renovation funds towards weak power supply areas such as rural areas and old residential areas, gradually narrow the gap in power supply between urban and rural areas and regions; combined with the development of clean energy, strengthen the upgrade and transformation of the distribution network, and systematically enhance the comprehensive carrying capacity of the distribution network. Secondly, strengthen the operation and maintenance management of the distribution network. To ensure the safe and stable operation of the distribution network, it is not only necessary to build it well but also to manage it well. We guide power supply companies to strengthen the application of new technologies and equipment, such as using drones for equipment inspections, promoting non-stop power operation technology, continuously improving the lean operation and maintenance management level of the distribution network, further reducing the number of fault power outages, outage time, and impact range. At the same time, we guide power supply companies to optimize the power outage maintenance plan, coordinate and arrange management, implement "one outage, multiple uses," avoid repeated power outages on the same line, and minimize the number of power outages for users. Thirdly, carry out frequent power outage governance on a regular basis. In 2023, we launched a special campaign to address frequent power outages, focusing on solving 510 power outage problems that were strongly reflected by the people. Based on this, we have established a sound long-term mechanism. Since 2024, we have further intensified our efforts, continuously deepening and solidifying the work of addressing frequent power outages, and have achieved positive results. This year, we will continue to consolidate the results of the rectification, focusing on improving standards, refining measures, and improving mechanisms, making efforts to accelerate the comprehensive governance of problematic substations and lines, requiring power supply companies to achieve zero frequent power outage issues. At the same time, for the first time, the "Opinions" introduce a mechanism for public supervision, using the judgment and feelings of the people as an important criterion to evaluate the effectiveness of governance, jointly promoting the continuous improvement of power supply quality. Today, the temperature in Beijing has reached 37 degrees, with some areas in Hebei, Henan, and Shandong exceeding 39 degrees. From the current situation, it is expected that the overall national electricity supply during this year's peak summer season will be guaranteed, but there may be localized electricity supply shortages during peak periods in some areas. The National Energy Administration will resolutely implement the decisions and arrangements of the Party Central Committee, aiming to ensure that there is flexibility in normal supply, measures for short-term shortages in specific areas, and effective responses to extreme situations. We will tighten the responsibilities of all parties, strengthen energy and power monitoring and early warning, fully leverage the potential for ensuring supply during peak periods, accelerate the construction and commissioning of supporting power sources, optimize cross-provincial and regional power optimization and mutual assistance, strengthen demand-side response, and make every effort to ensure the safe and stable supply of electricity during the peak summer season. That's all I have to say, thank you. Xing Huina: One last question. National Business Daily reporter: In the context of digital transformation, how do grid enterprises use advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence to enhance the intelligence level of "obtaining electricity" services and optimize user service experience? Thank you. Song Hongkun: Thank you for the question, this question will be answered by Mr. Pang Xiaogang. Pang Xiaogang: Thank you for your question. Artificial intelligence is a hot topic in today's society. Indeed, artificial intelligence is a strategic technology that leads a new round of technological revolution and industrial transformation, and it is also an important engine for nurturing and developing new productive forces. This year, the government work report proposed to continue to promote the "AI+" action, better integrating digital technology with manufacturing advantages and market advantages. In recent years, State Grid Corporation of China has also conducted some research and applications in artificial intelligence. We focus on future development, deepen reform and innovation, and continue to explore the application of artificial intelligence technology in the electricity industry. Last year, we released the Guangming Power Big Model, which is like an artificial intelligence expert in the field of energy and power, providing a "super brain" for ensuring the safe and stable operation of the power grid, promoting the integration of new energy consumption, and providing good power supply services. Next, we will further implement the national "AI+" action, accelerate the integration and application of the new generation of artificial intelligence technology represented by the big model in the field of power supply services. Below, I will elaborate on three aspects: The first aspect is to deepen the application of "AI+ electricity installation." We will vigorously promote the construction of a digital twin power grid (which means that we will construct another digital power grid in the digital space that completely mirrors the existing physical power grid), integrate artificial intelligence technology into the power supply solution response process, create a new intelligent electricity installation model, focus on enhancing the deep learning ability of the big model in industry knowledge such as policies, regulations, and technical standards, automatically match power grid resources based on customer electricity installation needs, intelligently generate power supply solutions quickly, and provide multiple sets of intelligent comparison solutions to better support customers in quickly connecting to electricity and early production. Some explorations have been made in this area, for example, our Jiangsu company has applied intelligent power supply solution generation technology to over 50,000 projects, reducing the time for generating solutions by more than half compared to the previous year. The second aspect is to deepen the application of "AI+ customer service." We will deepen the application of artificial intelligence in online and offline service scenarios to provide customers with more proactive, efficient, and intimate services. In terms of online services, we will upgrade and revamp channels such as 95598 and online State Grid, promote intelligent voice, text recognition, autonomous outbound calls, and other service functions, enhance service interaction and accuracy. In terms of offline services, we will focus on the large volume of routine business transactions and diverse customer needs in current business halls, build "digital employees" for smart services, deploy artificial intelligence service terminals, improve the efficiency of routine business transactions such as payment and repair, provide electricity business consultation, policy answers, intelligent queries, and other services for on-site customers, and enhance the actual experience of users. The third aspect is to deepen the application of "AI+ repair." We use the Guangming Power Big Model to improve the quality and efficiency of proactive repair services, enhance power supply guarantee capabilities. Strengthen the dynamic topology construction of the digital power grid, realize the "perceptible and fully monitored" status information, analyze the power outage range in real-time, accurately judge the cause of the fault, quickly arrange personnel for on-site repair, promote the transformation of power repair services from passive to proactive and intelligent, and minimize customer waiting time. There are many examples in this area as well, for example, after the pilot project in Tongzhou, Beijing, the efficiency of handling power outage faults has been significantly improved, with an average saving of about 20 minutes in repair time. We will continue to innovate and launch similar "AI+ power" products, and continuously optimize them to make electricity more secure and comfortable. That's all I have to answer. Thank you! Xing Huina: Today's press conference ends here, thank you to the four presenters, and thank you to all the media friends for participating. Goodbye!

title_en: Qing Shan District has over 300 "street corner new homes" to warm the new employment groups.
body_en: On the morning of June 5th, at 6 o'clock, in the Nalin Pedestrian Street in Baotou City, Meituan rider Chen Xiao parked his electric bike next to a breakfast car with red and white colors and the words "Glorious Community Warm 'New' Service Mobile Car" on it, scanned the code and took out soy milk from the temperature-controlled cabinet. This 3-square-meter service mobile car is now emitting waves of warmth - the indicator lights of the power bank form a starry sea, and the smart screen scrolls with warm tips such as "Today it will rain, riders remember to add clothes". This is not a popular check-in spot, but one of the 300+ "new homes on the street corner" tailored for the new employment groups in Qingshan District, Baotou. "In the past, when waiting for orders, if my phone ran out of battery, we had to plug it in at the convenience store entrance." SF Express courier Li Liang turned on the direct drinking water tap of the service mobile car and filled his 1.5-liter water bottle. This small space has been designed with "space magic" by the designer: the folding seats unfold to become a "Rider Academy" classroom, the medicine box on the wall is equipped for both winter and summer seasons, with warmers for winter and cool patches for summer regularly rotated. The most popular feature is the intelligent battery exchange cabinet, where riders can scan the code and complete the battery replacement for their electric bikes in 3 seconds, with a daily service volume exceeding 200 people. During the lunch break, in the "Rider Cinema" set up along the streets for the riders in the community, 20 riders are watching the safety special of the movie "The Captain". This is Chen Xiao's third time participating in the movie learning session. This year, he submitted a party membership application to the Meituan delivery rider party branch. "I also joined the 'Rider Heart Collaboration' volunteer service team," Chen Xiao said happily. This change began with the "Dual Coverage" action in Qingshan District. Through big data screening by the Civil Affairs and Market Supervision departments, multiple new business formats within the jurisdiction were accurately targeted, and 11 new party organizations were established in emerging fields such as the online car-hailing driver party branch and the live streaming industry joint party branch through the "individual establishment + joint establishment" method. Qingshan District has set up 40 party building guidance stations in commercial buildings, with 412 instructors assisting in the development of the "Rider Refueling Station" mini-program. By clicking on the party emblem on the map, the mini-program immediately displays the nearest charging pile, restroom, and emergency medicine point. "Wanda Golden Street No. 3 manhole cover has been moved, and a warning sign has been set up." At 11 o'clock at night, Ele.me rider Zhang Xiaojie uploaded his inspection record in the grid staff group chat, this is the 8th time he has reported safety hazards this month. As a mobile grid staff member hired by the community, he now has an additional line of red text on his chest badge: Food Supervision Officer. The innovative "24-hour Citizen Snapshots" launched by Qingshan District has mobilized 63 riders to participate in grassroots governance, eliminating more than 300 safety hazards. This two-way empowerment is reshaping the urban governance ecosystem. At the Yongshengcheng Supermarket's "Red Energy Station," the second layer of the shelves is dedicated to a rider storage area; the Construction Bank branch has opened a "Rider Express Lane," where riders can enjoy exclusive call services when handling business. What's even more surprising is that the riders have spontaneously formed the "Rider Heart Collaboration" volunteer team, actively carrying out various service activities. From the core "Flagship Station" in the business district to the "Micro Relay Station" at the community entrance, Qingshan District has spent 3 years weaving a service network for the new employment groups. In the Science Road Street, the "Rider Home" transformed from an old factory building is equipped with a shared kitchen and capsule apartments; at the bank branches, foldable rest cabins provide "1 square meter of warmth"; even the glass windows of pharmacies are labeled with "Red Energy Station" signs, providing free blood pressure measurement services for the riders. Service is not a one-way street, but a concentric circle of co-construction and sharing. A research report from Qingshan District in Baotou shows that more than 60 new employment groups in new business formats have actively joined the volunteer service team, serving as community mobile grid staff, food supervision officers, etc., assisting in solving more than 300 problems, with the number of people submitting party membership applications in emerging fields doubling compared to the previous year. When rider Chen Xiao wrote on the message wall of the mobile car, "Here understands riders better than home," another "Red Energy Station" was labeled in the equipment manufacturing industrial park 30 kilometers away. From the transformation experiment of a breakfast car to the systematic upgrade of comprehensive services, Baotou's Qingshan District has proven over time: the temperature of the city is not only hidden in the GDP data, but also flows in those moments on the streets where people are treated gently. As night falls, the warm yellow lights outline the figures of the riders shuttling back and forth, illuminating the governance answer of "serving a group of people, warming a city".

title_en: The Shanghai Cooperation Organization Youth "Perception of Common Wealth Road" activity was held in Zhejiang "A journey of innovation, discovery, and realization of dreams" (Promoting the "Shanghai Spirit": SCO in action)
body_en: From June 2nd to 6th, the Shanghai Cooperation Organization Youth "Perception of Shared Prosperity" event, organized by the China Association for People's Diplomacy and hosted by the Foreign Affairs Office of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Government, was held in Zhejiang. More than 20 young representatives from Shanghai Cooperation Organization countries visited Hangzhou, Huzhou, Shaoxing, and other places to experience the vibrant energy of China's modernization. Walking towards the "new," with ample power for high-quality development "What experiences from Zhejiang Province can be referenced for addressing the issue of unbalanced development?" "Can you further introduce the implementation of pairing urban and rural schools?" "Why was DeepSeek able to be born in Hangzhou?" On the morning of the 3rd, officials from the Zhejiang Provincial Development and Reform Commission introduced the construction of Zhejiang's demonstration area for common prosperity to young representatives from Shanghai Cooperation Organization countries from various angles such as economy, education, and healthcare. The young representatives actively asked questions based on their own work experiences, and there was positive interaction between both sides. Autonomous guided transport robots shuttle back and forth, picking and moving goods in designated areas on shelves according to instructions; goods are automatically stored and retrieved, and the operation of the automated three-dimensional warehouse is orderly... At Alibaba's Xixi Park, Abdulaziz Nasser Hadad, an engineer from the Industrial Development Department of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry of Qatar, continuously took photos while watching the real-time monitoring screen inside the Cainiao Wuxi Intelligent Warehouse. Hadad said that China's development of the internet economy has matured, not only giving rise to new formats in trade, entertainment, and other fields but also deeply integrating and changing people's daily lives. "Qatar has the foundation for developing related industries and looks forward to deeper cooperation with China in areas such as cross-border e-commerce." "Hangzhou is a city full of innovative vitality." At the Dream Town in Yuhang District, Hangzhou, Nick Mitchell, the founder and CEO of Hangzhou Xigu Video Technology Co., Ltd., shared his entrepreneurial story in Hangzhou with the young representatives, introducing Hangzhou's entrepreneurial support policies and measures for attracting international talent, hoping that more "foreign entrepreneurs" will come to develop in Hangzhou. "This is a 'dream incubator' for young entrepreneurs." After listening to Mitchell's experience, Maldivian parliamentarian and Chairman of the Trade Union Federation, Maluf Zajil, said that Hangzhou is a youth-friendly city, and the relevant policies allow young entrepreneurs to have no worries. At Zhejiang Dahua Technology Co., Ltd., understanding the application of smart IoT solutions in various fields; engaging in dialogue with Alibaba's Ali Entertainment Super Realistic Digital Human Liri; researching the complete entrepreneurial chain of "talent + capital + incubation"... Sherif Zimeti, an independent music producer from Egypt, had a fruitful trip to Hangzhou. He said, "This is a journey of innovation, discovery, and realizing dreams. I came to China 10 years ago. In the past 10 years, China's achievements in high-quality development have become more significant. The China now is completely different from the one I had in mind, which makes me look forward to China's future development even more." Walking towards the "green," with a beautiful color of sustainable development The green water meanders away, and the green mountains face each other. After the rain, the Anji Yucun in Huzhou is lush and green. "Green! There is green everywhere here!" As soon as he got off the car, Yasmin Mufid, the Director of Public Relations and Marketing of the Bahrain Traditional Sports Committee, did not stop taking photos. Today, Yucun is characterized by clear mountains and waters, clean villages, harmonious people and beautiful scenery, and prosperous businesses. Mufid exclaimed, "My Chinese friends had told me before that the villages in Zhejiang are very beautiful. At that time, I was still skeptical, how beautiful can a village be? But when I actually arrived here, everything far exceeded my imagination." The transformation of old factory buildings into village libraries, and old mines into camping parks... Mufid posted the photos he took of Yucun's scenery on social media, captioning it as "The rural landscape of beautiful China." Green waters and green mountains are as valuable as gold and silver. Over the past 20 years, guided by this concept, Yucun has strengthened environmental governance and infrastructure construction, promoting ecological restoration through methods such as nurturing soil and land reclamation, reshaping the landscape, and human culture. After hearing the story of Yucun's significant efforts in ecological environment improvement, Anus Kelos, Vice President of the Indian Student Union and President of the Kerala Branch, raised a question: with factories closed and mines shut down, how can the villagers' income be guaranteed? Kelos' hometown, the state of Kerala in India, is about to overcome extreme poverty, and learning from China's poverty reduction experience is her most important goal on this trip. At the Yucun cinema, a documentary about the transformation of Yucun answered Kelos' questions. From relying on mountains for resources to enriching the mountains, the people of Yucun have redefined their development plan, implementing projects to enhance the village's greenery, lighting along the roads, and beautifying courtyards, constructing ecological landscapes such as colorful rice fields and sunny flower seas, and taking the lead in exploring integrated reforms such as the "three land" reform in rural areas and the bamboo forest carbon sequestration reform. "These are valuable experiences worth learning from. I want to bring back the good practices I learned here to my country and explore practical ways suitable for my hometown," Kelos said. At the Youth Talent Community in Dayu Village, Mikhail Grinchko, Deputy Minister of the Youth Department of the Belarusian Youth Union, exchanged contact information with relevant community officials. "The Youth Talent Community has achieved a two-way flow of youth and rural values, and this model is worth considering for Belarus," Grinchko said. "The community provides a broad platform for young talent innovation and entrepreneurship. I have just completed the registration and become a 'cloud villager' of Yucun. I look forward to seeing more possibilities in the 'cloud-based Yucun.'" Walking towards the "heart," with a strong warmth in grassroots governance As the "last mile" of national governance, grassroots governance is connected to both national policies and the daily lives of the people. Over the past 60 years, the "Fengqiao Experience" has continuously enriched and developed in practice, forming a distinctive new era "Fengqiao Experience." At the Fengqiao Experience Exhibition Hall in Fengqiao Town, Zhuji, Shaoxing, the wax figure of "Drafting the 'Fengqiao Experience' at the Stove" attracted the attention of Israfil Abdulayev, Chief Advisor of the Foreign Policy Affairs Department of the Office of the President of Azerbaijan, who stopped for a long time. "Various places flexibly apply the 'Fengqiao Experience' according to their actual situations, truly focusing on issues and putting people first." Abdulayev learned that Yiwu has hired foreign mediators specifically to mediate disputes among foreigners, not only resolving the most common commercial and economic disputes but also helping to resolve conflicts arising from cultural and habitual differences. Entering the convenience service station in Fengyuan Village, Fengqiao Town, Gulbahar Ezturk, Secretary-General of the Youth Department of the Justice and Development Party of Turkey, was curious about the multifunctional government self-service machine and the medical insurance self-service acceptance terminal in the corner of the service station. After learning that villagers can self-query policy information and handle related business here, Ezturk gave a thumbs up: "Without cumbersome procedures, villagers can handle business 'one-stop' without leaving the village, and this intelligent and efficient system is admirable!" Today, in Fengyuan Village, neighbors can have heart-to-heart talks at neighborhood dispute mediation meetings for small conflicts, and seek advice from local wise men at the council for major issues and challenges. Various social organizations for deliberation and consultation have fully participated in village-level construction and conflict resolution affairs. "The new era 'Fengqiao Experience' makes grassroots governance more humane," said Onto, Director of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization Affairs Office of the International Cooperation Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Cambodia. Walking on the bluestone road in Fengqiao Ancient Town, with white walls and black tiles, the copper bells on the eaves jingled in the wind. In the old grocery store on the street, silver-haired elders sat around chatting; in the coffee shop opened by young people, coconut Americano was selling well in the summer. "A governance model with warmth shapes a city and people with warmth. China's grassroots governance model contains Eastern wisdom, inspiring people," Ezturk said.

After the rain, the Anji Yucun in Huzhou is lush and green. "Green! There is green everywhere here!" As soon as he got off the car, Yasmin Mufid, the Director of Public Relations and Marketing of the Bahrain Traditional Sports Committee, did not stop taking photos. Today, Yucun is characterized by clear mountains and waters, clean villages, harmonious people and beautiful scenery, and prosperous businesses. Mufid exclaimed, "My Chinese friends had told me before that the villages in Zhejiang are very beautiful. At that time, I was still skeptical, how beautiful can a village be? But when I actually arrived here, everything far exceeded my imagination." The transformation of old factory buildings into village libraries, and old mines into camping parks... Mufid posted the photos he took of Yucun's scenery on social media, captioning it as "The rural landscape of beautiful China." Green waters and green mountains are as valuable as gold and silver. title_en: The global trend of playing economy is booming, and brands are competing for "explosive IP".
body_en: Upright pointed ears, smiling with sharp teeth... A trendy toy called LABUBU started to become popular in 2024, and soon this trend began to sweep the global market. In order to buy LABUBU, overseas consumers directly searched for LABUBU as the top trending keyword on the cross-border e-commerce platform "AliExpress" under Alibaba. With the blessing of LABUBU, the stock price of Pop Mart continues to soar, and its latest market value has exceeded 326.3 billion Hong Kong dollars. At the same time, with the rise of emotional economy and blind box economy in the consumer market, the new force of trendy toys represented by TOPTOY and 52TOYS is also turning their attention to going public. LABUBU is popular worldwide LABUBU is a character in the Pop Mart trendy toy IP "THE MONSTERS Elf Group". Unlike other blind boxes that are more for static collection, LABUBU's vinyl plush toys have broken through the barriers and enriched application scenarios, moving from closed display cases to public places such as streets and cafes. LABUBU's phenomenal popularity is also due to the strong endorsement of the "star effect", with many A-list celebrities such as Rihanna, Lisa, and Dua Lipa being photographed carrying LABUBU, further promoting the IP's breaking through in the field of trendy culture. The popularity of LABUBU can be seen in the frenzy of purchases in offline stores. An employee of a Pop Mart offline store said that the third generation and cola version of LABUBU are currently out of stock. In the Pop Mart store in Stratford, London, queues for buying Pop Mart products have caused chaos. As the first online channel in North America, the 20,000 new products launched in the TikTok Shop live broadcast room were sold out instantly, driving a single session GMV of 1.5 million US dollars (approximately 10.78 million yuan) in 8 hours. In addition, in the second-hand market, the highest asking price for new LABUBU products can exceed 1,000 yuan, more than 10 times the original price of 99 yuan, and ordinary styles are generally 1-2 times more expensive than the original price. How popular is LABUBU? The following set of data can explain it all: In 2024, the revenue of THE MONSTERS series to which it belongs soared from 368 million yuan in 2023 to 3.04 billion yuan in 2024, a year-on-year increase of 726.6%, with a monthly production capacity of 10 million units, topping the Pop Mart IP list. The overseas market is also skyrocketing, with LABUBU becoming a global trend. On the eve of "6.18" overseas, consumers from markets such as the UK, Australia, and Brazil flocked to AliExpress just to buy LABUBU. In the view of analysts, the star effect and globalization marketing are the core factors behind LABUBU's popularity. As the scale of the trendy toy industry continues to expand, the market is also expecting more local trendy toy brands to move from "phenomenal explosive products" to "global classics". Pop Mart's market value takes off LABUBU sweeping the globe has driven Pop Mart's market value to take off. Pop Mart's 2024 financial report shows that its revenue from the four major IPs THE MONSTERS, MOLLY, SKULLPANDA, and CRYBABY all exceeded 1 billion yuan for the first time in 2024, especially with LABUBU's global popularity last year, driving THE MONSTERS' revenue to exceed 3 billion yuan. The overseas income growth rate in the first quarter of 2025 reached 475% to 480%. By the end of 2024, Pop Mart had operated 120 stores and 172 robot stores in over 30 overseas markets. On June 5, FTSE Russell announced the latest index quarterly review results, with Pop Mart included in the FTSE China 50 Index. On that day, Pop Mart's opening stock price hit a new all-time high, closing at 243 Hong Kong dollars per share, rising more than 5 times since August last year, with a market value approaching 330 billion Hong Kong dollars. Pop Mart, along with Heytea and Lao Pu Huang Jin, were also dubbed the "three golden flowers of Hong Kong stocks" by the market. The secondary market is also quickly following suit. Data shows that as of the end of the first quarter of this year, a total of 182 funds were heavily invested in Pop Mart, holding a total of 60.7924 million shares. In the first quarter of last year, only 30 funds were heavily invested in Pop Mart, holding a total of 44.6876 million shares. Key to the success of explosive IP products The soaring stock prices of "Pop Mart" and others are not only due to the global popularity of top trendy toys, but also to the continuous expansion of the trendy toy market. The "China Trendy Toy and Animation Industry Development Report (2024)" shows that the scale of the "trendy toy" industry has grown nearly tenfold in 8 years, with the total market value increasing from 6.3 billion yuan in 2015 to 60 billion yuan in 2023, and is expected to reach 110.1 billion yuan by 2026. Some industry analysts point out that the popularity of the trendy toy market is due to changes in consumer demand. With the improvement of people's living standards, consumer attitudes are gradually shifting from material consumption to spiritual consumption. Trendy toys, as products that combine artistic and collectible value, happen to meet consumers' needs for personalized and emotional consumption. In recent years, the strong rise of local IPs is gradually reshaping the market landscape. In addition to Pop Mart, the trendy toy brand TOPTOY under Miniso has also surpassed 3,000 overseas stores. Many consumers are looking forward to more big IPs with long-term influence worldwide. The popularity of trendy toy brands is also rising in the Hong Kong stock market. Following Pop Mart, Brucol, and Kayout, the trendy toy company 52TOYS has also submitted an application to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. Miniso also released an announcement on June 6 regarding rumors of the listing of its TOPTOY brand trendy toy business. The company is conducting a preliminary evaluation of the potential spin-off listing of its trendy toy business operated under the TOPTOY brand in order to optimize shareholder value. Earlier, according to media reports, sources revealed that TOPTOY, the trendy toy brand under Miniso, has recently hired JPMorgan Chase and UBS Group to provide services for its Hong Kong IPO. Miniso also hopes to introduce new investments for TOPTOY from potential investors such as sovereign wealth funds before selling shares. This is the second time this year that TOPTOY has been rumored to be seeking a listing in Hong Kong. In this regard, some industry insiders point out that in the current hot trendy toy market, the rush of 52TOYS and TOPTOY to go public meets market expectations. The advantage of TOPTOY lies in its backing by Miniso, with strong channel capabilities and IP integration resources, while the challenge lies in whether it can create explosive IP toys, as the series of explosive IP products is the key to its sustainable development. Reporter Yang Shuo
