title_en: DeepSeek runs fast.
body_en: China Economic News reporter Li Kun-kun Li Zhenghao Beijing reported Against the backdrop of the industry's anticipation of the reemergence of DeepSeek R2, DeepSeek recently only announced to the user group that "the DeepSeek-R1 model has completed a minor version upgrade." On the second day after the announcement was made, DeepSeek open-sourced DeepSeek RI (0528). Although there was no press conference, the new version of DeepSeek-R1, which reduced the model's illusion by half and performed on par with OpenAI o3 and Gemini2.5Pro, still impressed overseas developers with its evolution in mathematical and programming capabilities. The "open-source" gesture once again made the industry marvel at its status as a "true OpenAI." Prior to this, the DeepSeek V3 model also underwent a minor version upgrade, which was also announced to the public through official communication groups without much fanfare. Some industry insiders, in an interview with China Business News, likened this "minor version upgrade" to DeepSeek quietly taking small steps forward. Financial columnist Ma Jipeng also told reporters, "If we were to compare, from different perspectives, DeepSeek is more powerful in terms of basic capabilities (compared to mainstream large models in China), but other large models in China perform better in applications and are closer to users." Where are the updates According to DeepSeek, DeepSeek-R1 (0528) still uses the DeepSeekV3Base model released in December 2024 as its foundation, but more computing power was invested in the post-training process, significantly enhancing the model's depth of thought and reasoning ability. The updated R1 model achieved outstanding results in various benchmark evaluations in mathematics, programming, and general logic, surpassing all domestic models and approaching other top international models in overall performance, such as the new models o3 and Gemini-2.5-Pro released by OpenAI on April 17th of this year. On the code testing platform Live Code-Bench, DeepSeek-R1 (0528) performed comparably to OpenAI's o3 in terms of performance, scoring close to OpenAI's o3 (75.8 points) and o4-mini (80.2 points) with a score of 73.1, ranking fourth. DeepSeek stated that compared to the old version of R1, the new model showed significant improvement in performance in complex reasoning tasks. For example, in the AIME2025 test, the accuracy of the new model increased from 70% in the old version to 87.5%. This improvement was attributed to the enhanced depth of thought during the reasoning process: in the AIME2025 test set, the old model used an average of 12K tokens per question, while the new model used an average of 23K tokens per question, indicating a more thorough and in-depth thought process in solving problems. Additionally, DeepSeek mentioned that after distilling DeepSeek-R1 (0528), they trained the Qwen3-8BBase model, resulting in Deep-Seek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B. This model ranked second in the AIME2024 math test, surpassing Qwen3-8B by 10.0% and being on par with Qwen3-235B. DeepSeek believes that the thought chain of DeepSeek-R1-0528 will have significant implications for research on reasoning models in academia and the development of small models in the industry. "After DeepSeek gained popularity, Dou Bao and Kimi also made some upgrades and added reasoning functions, so at this stage, it is actually difficult to determine which one is better or worse," Ma Jipeng said. Dou Bao, a mixed-element large model, can answer questions and provide users with more accurate answers by combining their existing data. For example, the mixed-element large model combines unique data from WeChat official accounts to provide users with more comprehensive and insightful answers. It is understood that the new version of DeepSeek R1 has been optimized for improving the model's illusions. Compared to the old version, the updated model reduced the illusion rate by 45%-50% in scenarios such as rewriting, summarizing, and reading comprehension, providing more accurate and reliable results. In terms of creative writing, the updated R1 model, based on the old version of R1, has been further optimized for different styles of writing such as essays, novels, and prose, enabling it to output longer works with more complete structures and a writing style closer to human preferences. Fierce competition After DeepSeek announced the update of R1, Tencent immediately announced that products such as Tencent Yuanbao, Sogou Input Method, and QQ Browser were the first to integrate DeepSeek-R1-0528. The latest news reveals that two representatives from OpenAI announced at the AI Summit in Mexico that the company is developing the next-generation base model GPT-5 and plans to engage in more intense competition with competitors through this model. They also explicitly stated that GPT-5 is about to be released, with some reports suggesting it may be in July of this year. Alibaba Cloud also announced the official launch of the Tongyi Lingma AI IDE, which users can download for free from the Tongyi Lingma official website. Tongyi Lingma now has two product forms: plugins and IDE. As a native AI development environment tool, Tongyi Lingma AI IDE is deeply integrated with the latest Qwen3 large models and fully integrates the capabilities of Tongyi Lingma plugins, providing programming intelligence, inter-line suggestion prediction, inter-line conversation, and other functions. Yang Zhilin, the founder of Kimi, mentioned at the end of last year that the development of AI is like swinging on a swing, switching between two states: "Sometimes, the algorithm and data are ready, but the computing power is insufficient, so what we need to do is increase the computing power; but today we find that continuously expanding the scale of computing power may not directly solve the problem, so we need to break through this bottleneck by changing the algorithm." The competitive analysis report of the Chinese AIGC (Artificial Intelligence Generated Content) application market in the first quarter of 2025 released by the business intelligence data service provider Quest-Mobile shows that as of the end of February 2025, the monthly active users of native AI apps exceeded 240 million, an increase of 115 million from January, representing an 88.9% increase. The average monthly usage time and frequency of use of native AI apps in March reached 113.7 minutes and 52.4 times, respectively. The top three in terms of monthly active users of native AI apps in March changed from Dou Bao, Kimi Intelligent Assistant, and Wen Xiaoyan to Deep-Seek, Dou Bao, and Tencent Yuanbao, with user bases of 194 million, 116 million, and 42 million, respectively. In terms of user sources, in March, Deep-Seek users came from Dou Bao, Kimi Intelligent Assistant, and Tencent Yuanbao, accounting for 22.2%, 3.8%, and 3.3%, respectively; Dou Bao users came from DeepSeek, Tencent Yuanbao, and Kimi Intelligent Assistant, accounting for 37.6%, 5.7%, and 5.6%, respectively; Tencent Yuanbao users came from DeepSeek, Dou Bao, and Kimi Intelligent Assistant, accounting for 52.3%, 32.9%, and 9.6%, respectively. DeepSeek founder Liang Wenfeng once said, "In the long run, we hope to establish an ecosystem where the industry can directly use our technology and achievements, other companies can develop B2B/B2C services based on our models, and we focus on basic research. If the industrial chain is complete, we don't need to develop applications ourselves. Of course, if necessary, we are fully capable of doing so, but research and innovation will always be our top priority." "Whether a large model is good or not depends on two aspects of its capabilities: one is its technical capabilities, such as reasoning and analytical abilities, but more importantly, its data capabilities," Ma Jipeng said. For DeepSeek, it should definitely still be a base for general large models, as its capabilities are currently unmatched by other large models in a short period of time, so it may continue to strengthen this advantage in the future.

title_en: The "free" moxibustion clinic is digging a hole again.
body_en: Recently, this newspaper exposed the behavior of multiple community group buying "supermarkets" using the name "1 yuan to receive eggs" to attract elderly people into the group, and then sell health products to them (see page 11 of May 12). After the article was published, the company involved was interviewed. Several readers subsequently reported that some moxibustion clinics also used the same tactics, first attracting elderly people into the store with "free trials," and ultimately selling "miraculous" health products. The reporter conducted an investigation on this matter. On-site visits: Moxibustion clinics crowded with elderly people early in the morning "My mother used to go to the morning market to buy vegetables as soon as she got up. Now, she doesn't make breakfast anymore, but instead goes for moxibustion early in the morning with an alarm set for around 6 o'clock!" Ms. Sun from Baosheng West Lane in Haidian District said that since a community opened a moxibustion clinic claiming to be "public welfare and free," her mother's habits have changed - no longer leisurely strolling in the morning market, but rushing to do moxibustion every day. Ms. Sun said that her mother had been doing moxibustion for over a month, praising it as "comfortable," and indeed had not spent any money. However, one day while cleaning the house, she found a pile of royal jelly health products in the cupboard. Upon asking, she found out that the old lady had quietly spent over a thousand yuan. "What kind of moxibustion clinic is this? Why are they also selling royal jelly?" Ms. Sun was puzzled. Based on the clues provided by Ms. Sun, the reporter visited the brand's store in Dongcheng District. At 2:30 pm, more than twenty elderly people were lined up in front of the "Tianmi xx" moxibustion clinic on Donghuashi Street in Dongcheng District. "Free 40-minute moxibustion, with noodles and flour provided!" an auntie enthusiastically introduced. The reporter tried to enter the store for inquiries but was stopped by the front desk staff: "The free moxibustion activity has ended, and there are no more prizes." However, when the reporter left, he saw two elderly people entering the store for free moxibustion. In the following month, the reporter visited this store twice and saw elderly people lining up in front of the store each time. The reporter's investigation found that there are quite a few "free" moxibustion clinics like this. At 7:30 am on May 19, near Zhouzhuangzi Community in Fengtai District, the "Aishang xx" moxibustion clinic was bustling with elderly people coming in and out. "It's always crowded early in the morning." An elderly person told the reporter that moxibustion is done for free in the store every day starting at 6:30 am, with each session lasting 40 minutes, five sessions in the morning and two in the afternoon. "They don't charge, and they even have several staff members serving us. Those who attend all the sessions receive material rewards every month!" However, when the reporter entered the store at 10:30 am to inquire about moxibustion, the store staff seemed particularly vigilant. "We are busy now, it's not convenient, please come back later." Despite there being no elderly people inside, the staff hurriedly escorted the reporter out. At 8:30 am on May 28, near Han Zhuangzi Erlu in Fengtai District, there were also more than a dozen elderly people waiting in line outside the "Qi Ai xx" moxibustion clinic. "We do moxibustion every day for free, the last session hasn't ended yet." an elderly person said. Taking advantage of the break between sessions, the reporter entered the moxibustion clinic and saw a schedule of moxibustion services posted on the left side of the entrance. Starting from 6:10 am, there are 8 sessions every day, lasting until 3:10 pm. Inside the moxibustion room, there were about forty to fifty moxibustion stools, which were quickly filled by the elderly people entering the store. The front desk staff were busy stamping the attendance cards for the elderly people, with two stacks of cards piled up to almost half a meter high, estimated to be around a hundred cards. The front desk of the moxibustion clinic displayed multiple price lists for moxibustion services, but when the reporter expressed interest in experiencing it, the staff said, "It's easy to get overheated in hot weather, so these services are temporarily suspended. Currently, we only offer electronic smokeless moxibustion for the elderly." When the reporter requested to sign up, they were still refused: "We only serve the elderly." title_en: First year "free"! Ma'anshan introduces new policy
body_en: Starting from June 1st, this new policy will be implemented through full government financial subsidies to achieve the goal of "born insured, zero threshold for protection" for newborns, providing the warmest "health gift" to thousands of families and effectively reducing the medical burden on newborn families. According to the detailed implementation rules of the policy, newborns can enjoy medical insurance benefits retroactively from the day of birth until the end of the year; those beyond this period can enjoy medical insurance benefits from the day of registration until the end of the year, without the benefit of cross-year insurance premium payment. In order to ensure the accurate implementation of the policy, the Municipal Medical Insurance Bureau, in conjunction with the departments of finance, health, and taxation, has established a collaborative working mechanism with the goal of "making data run more and people run less," building an "online + offline" service system, optimizing the joint processing process of "birth registration" to achieve simultaneous processing of insurance registration, issuance of "birth medical certificates," household registration, and other matters. Insurance registration can be completed through the "Efficiently Completing One Thing" platform on the Anhui Affairs App for instant enjoyment, or through the WeChat and Alipay "Anhui Medical Insurance Public Service" mini program for registration, special population identity verification, and "paperless handling." Insurance registration can also be done at the windows of various levels of medical insurance collection and handling agencies, or at village (community) service centers to enjoy the first year of free insurance for newborns. This reform is an important measure taken by Ma'anshan to implement the national policy of optimizing childbirth, solving the problem of the "coverage gap" in newborn medical insurance benefits through institutional arrangements. The person in charge of the Municipal Medical Insurance Bureau stated that they will continue to track the implementation effects of the policy, continuously improve the children's medical security system, and provide strong support for promoting long-term balanced population development.

title_en: Women's sports events are becoming increasingly popular, and this Chinese couple who invested six years ago are now making a lot of money.
body_en: At the end of May this year, defending champions New York Liberty narrowly defeated the Golden State Warriors 82-77 at home, maintaining a five-game winning streak and securing the top spot in the WNBA league. At the same time, the defending champions also made a major announcement in the sports trading market, selling shares of the New York Liberty for an estimated value of $450 million, setting a record for the highest valuation of a women's professional sports club. The funds from this sale will mainly be used to build a new training facility. In March of this year, the Liberty announced plans to build a 75,000 square foot training facility in the Greenpoint area of Brooklyn, expected to be completed by 2027. This facility will be the WNBA's first training base "designed by players, for players," with a budget of $80 million. In recent years, women's sports events have been on the rise and gaining high levels of attention, leading to a doubling of the value of some women's sports clubs. This has also allowed some early investors to make significant profits after selling their teams. Chinese couple invest in women's sports The Liberty had been up for sale since November 2017. Alibaba Group's board chairman Joe Tsai and his wife Clara Wu Tsai purchased a portion of the Liberty from New York Knicks owner James Dolan for a price ranging from $10-14 million in 2019. Joe Tsai was a basketball enthusiast during his time at Yale University. He once said, "I believe that sports not only teach you discipline and hard work, but also teach you how to face failure. If you fall down, lose a game, you have to get back up. Many principles apply in business as well." In terms of the management of the Liberty, Clara Wu Tsai is responsible for the specific daily operations and decision-making. After completing the acquisition, Wu moved the team's home games from a suburban venue to the Barclays Center where the Nets play, and systematically improved the team's infrastructure and operational level. "Everything we did to turn around this 'bad asset' after the acquisition - the first thing was to move the team back to the Barclays Center where the fan base is, and the second thing was to build a team that can win," she said. The continued investment has paid off. By the end of last year, the Liberty had over 50 sponsors, a nearly 61% increase from the previous year, bringing the team a 68% increase in revenue. In the last season, the New York Liberty ranked second in home attendance in the WNBA, behind only the Indiana Fever. In the 2024 WNBA season, the New York Liberty defeated the Minnesota Lynx 67-62 in a comeback victory to win their first-ever championship. Clara Wu Tsai celebrated with the team at the scene, saying, "We have proven that when you are willing to invest in women, you can build a championship team, and you can fill the arena to capacity." At a recent Forbes Iconoclast summit in New York, Clara Wu Tsai confirmed the accuracy of the transaction figures mentioned above to the media, and admitted that the increase in valuation had even surprised herself. "Women's sports is a growth asset with huge long-term upside potential," she said. Wu expressed her high expectations for the future of the Liberty, believing that by the mid-2030s, the team could become the "first women's sports franchise worth $1 billion." It is worth mentioning that starting from the next season, the WNBA will launch a new media rights agreement worth about $200 million annually for 11 years. Recently, there have been rumors on the internet that the Tsai couple made a huge profit from investing in the Liberty, with returns exceeding 30 times this year. However, in reality, after initially purchasing a portion of the basketball team in 2019, the couple continued to add investments. According to some foreign media estimates, the Tsai couple actually spent a total of $100 to $140 million to acquire the Liberty from Dolan. Huge potential in the women's sports market Deloitte once released a research report titled "The Rise of Women's Sports: Towards Commercialization," which showed that over the past decade, many cases have shown that women's sports will attract a large number of TV viewers, create value for sponsors, and attract tens of thousands of sports fans to watch a single event. In another report titled "Elite Women's Sports: Breaking the Billion Dollar Barrier," the organization estimated that by 2024, global women's sports event revenue would reach $1.28 billion, a 300% increase from the 2020 valuation. Specifically, revenue is mainly divided into three categories: commercial revenue (including club sponsorships, partnerships, and merchandise sales) accounts for the largest share of total revenue ($696 million, 55%), followed by broadcast revenue ($340 million, 27%) and match day revenue ($240 million, 18%). "In recent years, we have seen remarkable growth in global women's sports, driving a significant increase in its commercial value, which in turn has attracted more and more interest from investors around the world," said Jennifer Haskel, head of Deloitte's sports business insights. "The surge in fan and investor engagement has brought new and better opportunities for clubs and leagues, including larger commercial partnerships, more engagement, and bigger match days. To ensure that this growth remains consistent and sustainable, sports organizations must ensure that investments are directed in the right places, such as encouraging fan loyalty, player welfare, and maintaining cross-league competition." The expansion of women's sports events is reflected in various aspects such as event scale, influence, and commercial value. At the same time, women's sports events are gaining more and more commercial opportunities and social media influence. In the field of sponsorship marketing, women's sports events have evolved from cooperation with traditional sports brands like Nike and Adidas to partnerships with diverse brands such as mineral water Cool Ridge Water and office equipment (Epson), greatly expanding the boundaries of the future women's sports business landscape. As women's sports events expand, the commercial value of female athletes is rapidly increasing. In 2024, the top 20 highest-earning female athletes increased by 15% compared to 2023, reaching $226 million. Taking tennis as an example, the high viewership of WTA events and the influence of star players have directly driven the growth of personal commercial sponsorships. Sarah Goff-Frederickson, founder of the women's sports business cooperation marketing company Trailblazing Group, said, "Many studies have shown that from the perspective of return on investment (ROI), the engagement of social media posts when working with female athletes is twice that of working with male athletes, which is what advertisers and brands care about."

title_en: Learn skills, digital assistants are here to help.
body_en: Reshaping artificial intelligence (AI) in thousands of industries is empowering more skilled talents. Not long ago, at a training event called "AI First Lesson" held in Shenzhen, skilled talents from various industries such as automotive maintenance, numerical control technology, chefs, and housekeeping shared their experiences of using AI. A Cantonese chef said he is trying to use AI to research recipes from different cuisines such as Sichuan cuisine, which helps in the development of fusion dishes. When foreign guests visit the restaurant where he works, the large model can help him summarize and refine the characteristics of a particular dish; a vice president of a housekeeping company said that new maternity matrons often have beginner questions, but through tools like AI knowledge bases, the training time can be greatly shortened from six months. "With the popularity of AI products like DeepSeek, Yuanbao, and IMA, ordinary people can also use AI." Ling Yuanqiang, director of the Shenzhen Vocational Skills Training Guidance Center, who was also present at the event, said that the training aims to empower skilled talents through AI. In his view, AI is not just a tool, but when applied in thousands of industries, it will create a new ecosystem for skills. Digital assistants boost skills improvement With the development of AI and other digital technologies, the "vertical force" AI large model is increasingly becoming a digital assistant for skilled talents, becoming a "stable employment engine." In the past week, Zhang Haiying from the Quality Management Department of the Chemical Manufacturing Center of Transfar Group has shared her AI learning achievements more than once: she has gradually mastered the application of AI tools in production and management scenarios, independently developing an intelligent recognition and analysis system for product quality assurance forms. The system can complete form sorting in a few seconds, increasing efficiency by more than 10 times, saving an estimated 1800 hours per year. On May 26, Zhang Haiying and more than 20 colleagues participated in the group's "AI Intelligent Body Creation Camp" training. "The previous AI general training inspired me to use AI tools for work, and this time we will collaborate to explore more application scenarios." Including familiar quality inspection scenarios for this senior student, the AI training conducted by the group covers 58 scenarios in 12 areas including office, management, marketing, service, intelligent manufacturing, and supply chain. "AI must be combined with the industry to create real value." According to Xu Guanjie, chairman of Transfar Group, compared to repetitive and simple job positions in the past, the working environment of intelligent factories has fundamentally changed, and organizational capabilities and team structures urgently need to be iteratively updated. Regarding how to promote industrial workers to transition from "blue-collar" to engineers, Xu Guanjie believes that industrial workers need to be proficient in professional skills as well as modern technology tools and equipment. Currently, the group invests over 100 million yuan annually in employee skills training, with an average of 75 hours of learning per employee by 2024, doubling compared to before. In terms of business volume, the group's business volume has increased fivefold in the past decade. "This is the innovative contribution of improving the capabilities of technical and skilled talents." Xu Guanjie said. Facing the structural changes in talent demand brought about by business transformation and intelligent upgrading, many traditional enterprises are exploring new paths for vocational training to address challenges, with a greater focus on stabilizing and expanding employment and improving employment quality. At Fuyao Group, a supplier of integrated solutions for automotive glass and automotive accessories, special classes such as "Fuyao Industry Class" and "Order Class" have been established. The group also collaborates with multiple universities nationwide to build an integrated "industry-education-research-application" cooperation model, opening up internship positions in materials, research and development, machinery, intelligent manufacturing, and other fields. An official from the Talent Configuration and Development Department of Fuyao Group introduced that this year, the group has created new project bases in Hefei, Anhui, and Fuqing, Fujian, as well as carried out intelligent transformations of existing projects, resulting in the addition of 6,750 new jobs. Among them, 4,963 frontline technical workers cover new positions such as intelligent equipment operation and quality AI testing; 1,787 professional technical positions cover roles such as product design, research and development technology, and equipment technology, including cutting-edge positions such as car communication research and development engineers and dual-carbon managers. New opportunities for career development In fact, including traditional manufacturing enterprises, various types of business entities are the main force in stabilizing employment. In terms of empowering employment with AI, companies such as Alibaba, Huawei, Baidu, and Tencent leverage their technological advantages to promote the "last mile" of youth employment, growth, and talent development through digital means. "When cars were invented, no one chased cars with horse carriages, but instead transformed from carriage drivers to drivers themselves." At the aforementioned "AI First Lesson" for skilled talents, Liang Peng, an AI trainer from Tencent who exchanged ideas with many skilled talents, believes that on one hand, AI has become a "24-hour working partner," and people, in the process of using AI, also inadvertently evolve their cognitive patterns; on the other hand, AI is reshaping the traditional apprenticeship model of "masters teaching apprentices." "The efficiency improvement in maternity matron training is not achieved at the expense of quality, but through algorithm optimization to build a more scientific training system." Liang Peng said. It is certain that under the wave of AI popularization promoted by many Internet companies, more ordinary workers will have the opportunity to acquire new skills for career development and more fully "be employed." Lu Jian, head of the Corporate Social Responsibility Department of Baidu, recently stated in an interview with the media that in the future, Baidu will collaborate with universities based on the Baidu PaddlePaddle open-source deep learning platform to empower 5 million AI technical talents and promote the transformation of technology into industry. At the same time, based on the capabilities of Baidu Intelligent Cloud, combined with vocational skills assessment, 5 million applied talents such as industrial workers, digital professionals, and new employment groups will be empowered. In 2024, Baidu will launch the "Second Skills Learning Platform for Workers" in collaboration with the Wuhan General Union of Labor, serving 3.08 million workers and 21,000 grassroots trade union organizations in Wuhan. So far, the platform has been opened in multiple provinces and cities such as Wuhan, Shanxi, Nanjing, and Shenzhen, empowering workers with second skills and effectively promoting the fair transformation of AI in society. From being "replaced" to being "enhanced," the exploration of AI empowerment in employment by various parties makes technology more accessible and gives technology a warmer touch. In Lu Jian's words, AI technology should not be a barrier, but a bridge. "We hope to break down employment barriers and enable more people to obtain the 'entry ticket' for career development in the intelligent era through technology empowerment and ecosystem co-construction."

title_en: Using roads as a medium, integrating and empowering.
body_en: Reporter Li Chenghan On the vast land of Yunling, the mileage of highways has exceeded ten thousand miles, and favorable policies continue to be released. The path of integrated development continues to expand, and economic and social benefits are accelerating. A reform centered around the integrated development of highways is vigorously advancing. From a single transportation artery to a comprehensive benefit network, Yunnan has introduced the "Several Policy Measures to Promote the Integrated Development of Highways (Trial)" to unveil the strategic blueprint of "Highway +", covering six major paths including "Highway + Industry" and "Highway + Culture and Tourism". This anchors the sustainable development goals of highways and empowers economic and social development with high quality. Building a dense road network to create a new development pattern Yunnan's mountainous terrain poses challenges to transportation construction, but the footsteps of progress have never stopped. In recent years, the construction of highways in our province has made remarkable progress. By 2024, the total mileage of highways in the province has reached 10,758 kilometers, ranking second in the country, covering 124 counties (cities, districts), providing strong support for economic and social development. However, due to the influence of terrain and topography, the bridges and tunnels of highways in Yunnan are high and costly, with a high average cost per kilometer, long payback periods, and some highway projects facing operational pressures. Influenced by the development model, the integration of highways with industries and resources along the route is insufficient, and there is still great potential to tap into economic benefits. Challenges breed new opportunities. The Yunnan Provincial Party Committee and Provincial Government have implemented the "Several Policy Measures to Promote the Integrated Development of Highways in Yunnan (Trial)" this year. This set of 16 specific measures focuses on the dimensions of foundation, path, vitality, and guarantee, fully promoting the comprehensive transformation of highways from a single transportation function to comprehensive benefits. In the view of Shang Zhongkai, Chief Accountant of Yunnan Construction Investment Group, Secretary of the Party Committee and Chairman of the Board of Directors of Jitou Company, the precise and powerful "policy measures" are a timely rain for enterprises. The company will actively seize policy opportunities, promote the deep integration of road networks, logistics networks, and energy networks, vigorously promote the development of industries such as "Highway + Industry, Culture and Tourism, Photovoltaics, Logistics, Stone Materials, and Smart Numbers", further increase project revenue, expand cash flow, achieve "revenue with profit, profit with cash flow", and explore a new path for the sustainable development of highways. Industry insiders point out that the introduction of the "policy measures" is conducive to boosting the confidence of market entities, and will bring significant benefits to highway enterprises in anchoring high-quality development tasks and promoting market-oriented transformation. For example, supporting the "opening" projects of highways will greatly activate the operating potential of service facilities along highways, promote the integrated development of advantageous industries in our province such as industry, culture and tourism, and highland characteristic agriculture with highways, improve the cooperation efficiency of industrial parks along the route, accelerate the creation of "road-city integration" operating scenarios, create new opportunities for market entities along the route, and open up new space for the coordinated development of the primary, secondary, and tertiary industries. "Tian Jingsong, a second-level inspector of the Yunnan Provincial Department of Transportation, said, "The Yunnan Provincial Department of Transportation actively cooperates with the Provincial Development and Reform Commission to comprehensively promote differentiated toll collection. Based on ensuring the sustainable operation capacity of highways and maintaining the stable order of national networked toll collection, adhering to the principle of government guidance and enterprise independent participation, using government toll pricing standards as the upper limit, guiding and supporting operating enterprises to independently choose differentiated toll collection methods and set preferential rates, steadily and orderly promoting the implementation of differentiated toll collection measures, and effectively exerting the policy effectiveness." According to statistics, from 2022 to March 31, 2025, the differentiated toll collection of highways in the province has reduced vehicle tolls by a total of 14.985 billion yuan, benefiting 2.323 billion vehicle trips, making a huge contribution to reducing the cost of social travel and optimizing the business environment. Integrated development stimulates new economic growth in the region Entering the Songming Service Area of the Xiaopu to Wulong Highway, photovoltaic panels are spread along the slope of the service area. As the first distributed photovoltaic power station on highways in the province, this project has become a vivid practice of the integration of "Highway + Photovoltaic" in Yunnan since it was connected to the grid in 2020. From the construction of photovoltaics on highway slopes to photovoltaic road lighting, and charging stations in photovoltaic service areas, energy conservation and carbon reduction, the integration of photovoltaics and transportation scenes is deepening, and the application of photovoltaics in the transportation field is becoming increasingly diverse. "The Provincial Energy Bureau will actively cooperate with relevant departments to promote the landing of the 'Energy-Transportation Integration' policy." Fu Hui, Chief Engineer of the Provincial Energy Bureau, said that in the future, they will adhere to planning first, understand the resource base, and formulate development plans; promote classified construction, advance distributed and centralized photovoltaic projects based on planning; actively seek support, and fully guarantee the steady progress of "Highway + Photovoltaic". Along the highways, stories of industrial synergy development are unfolding one after another, and the integration of culture and tourism is also shining. On May 22, five sites including the Yunnan Post Service Area, Nake Li Service Area, Taoyuan Scenic Spot, Ganzhuang Service Area, Lujiangba Service Area, and Yunnan Highway Museum were selected as the "2025 Transportation and Tourism Integration Innovation Projects". These service stations integrate regional culture, link advantageous natural resources, deeply integrate highway services with tourism experiences, providing tourists with a richer and more diverse travel experience. At the same time, it drives the sales of local agricultural and specialty products, promotes cultural and creative products, forms a "highway + industry + culture + tourism" integrated development model, and provides valuable experience and models for the integrated development of transportation and tourism nationwide. With the clarification of six major integration paths such as "Highway + Industry", "Highway + Culture and Tourism", and "Highway + Photovoltaic", the "Highway +" model will blossom in multiple points across the province. In terms of "Highway + Industry", the implementation of the "opening" projects list, interchanges, and transformation of connecting lines closely connect towns, parks, and enterprises, helping Yunnan's characteristic industries set sail; "Highway + Logistics" relies on ports and parks to build logistics hubs, use service areas and parking areas to build logistics bases, and ensure smooth flow of goods; "Highway + Stone Materials", the state (city) government revitalizes sand and stone resources in accordance with the law and regulations to fill the funding gap in highway construction; "Highway + Smart Numbers", operating units collect and analyze data in accordance with the law to provide strong support for development decisions. In the future, the smooth highways will transform into the link of resource integration, the springboard for industrial ascension, and the corridor for green development, becoming the dynamic engine for high-quality development. "Highway + Culture and Tourism" Roadside economy connects "poetry and the distance" "Welcome to Chengcheng Expressway. I am the anchor 'Lazy Sheep'. Chengcheng Expressway is 15 kilometers long, with famous attractions such as Fuxian Lake and Maotianshan World Natural Heritage along the route. It features local specialties such as Chengjiang lotus root powder, Chengjiang blueberries, and delicious Chengjiang anti-wave fish. Wishing you a pleasant journey." From 10:00 to 12:00 on May 23, at the toll booth of the Cheng (Gong) Cheng (Jiang) Expressway invested and constructed by Yunnan Construction Investment Group, toll collector Zou Yuchen was conducting a live broadcast on the internet, providing information on road conditions, traffic safety knowledge, and cultural and tourism resources along the route to passengers, transforming the small toll booth into a "traffic entrance" activating cultural and tourism resources along the route. The recently completed Yongjin Expressway Jiayuan section connects the Xinping Chucheng Orange Base, Yuanjiang Mango Industrial Park, and Ailao Mountain Ecotourism Area, creating a "tropical fruit cold chain corridor" and a "nationality cultural experience corridor". This highway is not only the main transportation and commercial artery connecting Xinping County in Yuxi City to Yuanjiang County in the southern region of Yunnan, but also a golden tourist route integrating natural wonders, ethnic cultures, historical sites, and characteristic cuisine. Combining cultural and tourism resources along the highway projects, Yunnan Construction Investment Group is committed to turning the projects themselves into attractions. title_en: These hospitals in Jilin Province use mobile payment to achieve mobile medical insurance settlement (with detailed list attached)
body_en: Are you still worried about the long queues at the payment window? Have you ever missed valuable time due to cumbersome reimbursement processes? Good news from the Jilin Provincial Medical Insurance Bureau: you can now handle medical insurance settlements using your mobile phone! 95 designated medical institutions in Jilin Province have opened mobile payment for medical insurance, which can facilitate patients to pay outpatient fees in the clinic, inpatient fees in the ward, and registration fees at home (see list for specific institutions, actual scenarios may vary). Mobile payment for medical insurance refers to insured individuals completing medical insurance payments through mobile devices such as phones during the medical treatment process, without the need for a physical insurance card or waiting in line at the window to make payments, avoiding back and forth trips, making it more convenient for the public to seek medical treatment and purchase medication. This service is available for insured individuals seeking medical treatment at hospitals in Jilin Province that have implemented mobile payment for medical insurance, including provincial employees (active and retired), residents, and insured individuals from other provinces who have completed the medical treatment record transfer. Insured individuals can log in to the medical institution's mini-program or the "Jilin Smart Medical Insurance" APP, Alipay's "Jilin Province Medical Insurance Mobile Payment" mini-program, WeChat's "Jilin Medical Insurance Public Service" mini-program, etc., to access the mobile payment page and find the pending orders for payment. Depending on the scenario, mobile phones can be used to pay registration fees, examination fees, medication costs, etc., with the medical insurance reimbursement portion deducted directly, and the self-payment amount paid online, with clear and detailed billing information. Of course! The online payment deduction method is the same as the window settlement deduction method. Currently, apart from the medical insurance reimbursement portion (paid by the patient), the expenses are first deducted from the individual's personal account balance, followed by deductions from the linked family mutual aid account (or the individual's medical insurance wallet), with the remaining amount paid in cash. For online appointments, patients should wait in the doctor's office according to the scheduled time. For in-clinic medication payments, patients can directly go to the pharmacy to collect medication by scanning the medical insurance code. For in-clinic examination fee payments, patients can wait in the examination area. For hospital deposit payments, patients can register for admission in the inpatient treatment area. Mobile payment for medical insurance is a key measure to improve the public's medical experience and make it easier for the public to handle matters with fewer errands. The Jilin Provincial Medical Insurance Bureau will continue to expand the scope of mobile payment access, optimize the mobile payment process, broaden application scenarios, and allow insured individuals to enjoy the convenience brought by digital reforms! The list of designated medical institutions implementing mobile payment for medical insurance will be dynamically updated in the "Jilin Medical Insurance Public Service" official account - "Service Hall" - "Mobile Payment". title_en: Maotai cultural tourism accelerates "breaking the circle"
body_en: Recently, the Feitian Night · Huang Xiaoxi Music Festival and the 2025 Maoyou Carnival were staged at Maotai College in Renhuai City, Zunyi City, Guizhou Province. This music festival organized by China Guizhou Maotai Distillery (Group) Cultural Tourism Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Maotai Culture and Tourism") in conjunction with relevant units, combined with Guizhou intangible cultural heritage, Maotai cultural and creative elements, attracted many tourists. In recent years, Maotai Culture and Tourism has explored new paths for the integration of wine and tourism through the development of cultural and creative products, the upgrading of industrial tourism, and innovative marketing and promotion. To achieve a "good" integration of wine and tourism The development of wine and tourism integration initially focused mainly on the tour mode: guided by staff from wine companies, tourists visited wine history museums, product display halls, etc. Later, some large wine companies began to focus on creating more experiential scenes by combining their own wine culture, and Maotai Culture and Tourism has made many attempts in immersive experiences. As soon as you enter Maotai Town in Renhuai City, you can deeply feel the saying "the fragrance of wine does not fear the depth of the alley." Maotai Town is where the Maotai Distillery is located, and the air is filled with the aroma of soy sauce wine. Relying on the resources of the Maotai Distillery, the local area began promoting the integration of wine and tourism early on. The China Wine Culture City, built from 1993 to 1997, covers an area of over 30,000 square meters and systematically showcases the origin of Chinese wine, brewing techniques, wine customs, and flavors. In 2014, the China Wine Culture City was established as a national 4A-level tourist attraction. The person in charge of the China Wine Culture City introduced that there are seven exhibition halls in the park, including the China Wine Source Museum, China Wine Technology Museum, and Maotai · Famous Wine World Museum. In 2024, the China Wine Culture City received 320,000 visitors. "I am from Shaanxi, and I didn't expect to see our hometown's Xifeng wine here. It was named one of the four famous wines in 1952." In the Maotai · Famous Wine World Museum, a visitor from Xi'an proudly said, "The content displayed here is very rich, and I have learned a lot." Maotai Culture and Tourism also organizes tours of the Maotai Distillery for tourists, allowing them to experience the brewing process up close with the aroma of wine. In 2024, "Maotai Distillery: Wine and Tourism Integration Helps Industrial Heritage Revitalization" was selected as a typical case of industrial heritage protection and utilization by the National Cultural Relics Bureau and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. "We will strive to enrich the experience of tourists, integrating wine culture into their lives through cultural influence, technological empowerment, tourism performances, etc." Maotai Culture and Tourism General Manager Chen Junrui introduced that Maotai Culture and Tourism is exploring ways to present the production and tasting scenes of Maotai wine in an immersive and dramatic way. This project will integrate rich Maotai culture into accommodation, dining, and other formats, allowing tourists to immerse themselves in Maotai culture and experience the poetic feeling of "wandering in a painting." title_en: Notice on holding the 2024 Academic Annual Conference of the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association (Second Round)
body_en: To all relevant units: Pharmaceutical excipients are an important foundation in China's pharmaceutical industry, and are one of the key factors determining the quality of generic drugs and the high-quality development of innovative formulations. The supply chain security of pharmaceutical excipients used in high-end formulations in China urgently needs to strengthen the technological innovation and industrial support for domestic pharmaceutical excipients. At the same time, ensuring the quality of clinical medication, reducing drug costs, and alleviating the pressure on medical insurance to a large extent also depend on the quality improvement of domestic pharmaceutical excipients. In line with the principle of "promoting technological innovation in pharmaceutical excipients and enhancing the new quality productivity of the pharmaceutical industry," the "2024 Annual Academic Conference of the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association," hosted by the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association, is scheduled to be held in Hefei, Anhui Province from November 8th to 10th, 2024. This academic conference will feature conference reports in the fields of materials science related to pharmaceutical excipients, innovative drugs, and innovative formulations, analyzing the development difficulties and innovations of pharmaceutical excipients; inviting authoritative experts to deeply discuss the in vivo processes of pharmaceutical excipients and drug delivery carriers, as well as the improvement and innovation of excipient quality. The conference will set up expert venues and young scholar sub-venues with three themes: "Pharmaceutical Excipients, Packaging Materials, and Drug Delivery Devices," "New Materials, New Carriers, and Innovative Formulations," and "Pharmaceutical Excipients and Innovative Drugs," to promote the wide participation of enterprises, academia, and young scholars, and jointly focus on the technological innovation and industrial research and development of pharmaceutical excipients. The relevant matters are hereby notified as follows: 1. Conference theme: Promote technological innovation in pharmaceutical excipients and enhance the new quality productivity of the pharmaceutical industry. 2. Time and location: November 8th Registration location: New Ji Hotel, Hefei (2766 Wenzhong Road, Yaohai District, Hefei, Anhui Province) November 9-10 Main venue and sub-venues are both at the Shaoquan Lake Campus of Anhui University of Chinese Medicine in Hefei, Anhui Province (350 Longzihu Road, Yaohai District, Hefei, Anhui Province) 3. Conference arrangements: The conference will adopt a format of main venue and sub-venue reports for communication. The conference will invite well-known experts and scholars from domestic universities, research institutes, pharmaceutical companies, research units, medical institutions, regulatory agencies, etc., to give keynote speeches and special lectures. Please see the detailed schedule in Annex 1. 4. Participants: Researchers, managers, graduate students, etc., engaged in research and development related to pharmaceutical excipients, pharmaceutical packaging materials, drug delivery devices, formulation quality control, formulation equipment, pharmaceutical services, etc., from higher education institutions, research institutes, pharmaceutical companies, research units, medical institutions, drug regulatory agencies, and other related institutions. 5. Conference paper submission: 1. Requirements for paper submission: Chinese and English abstracts and paper format. Papers that have not been published in publicly distributed journals or presented at national academic conferences are the responsibility of the author; please ensure clear expression and accurate data. We welcome active submissions from researchers in the pharmaceutical field. 2. Paper submission method: Please submit the paper abstract to the conference website https://yyfl2024.sciconf.cn before October 20, 2024, click on the "Online Paper Submission" button on the right, follow the process to upload your paper abstract, and you will receive an automatic "Online Submission Confirmation Letter" email after successful submission. After the paper is reviewed by experts, the organizing committee will select several papers for further communication or publication in the "Drug Analysis" journal. 3. Poster submission method and time: Same as for papers. The conference welcomes poster submissions, which should be in A1 standard size. 6. Registration: (1) Registration method: 1. Please register by clicking on the "Individual Representative Registration" or "Group Representative Registration" button on the conference website link https://yyfl2024.sciconf.cn; 2. Or scan (or long-press to recognize) the QR code below with your mobile phone, click on the "Individual Representative Registration" or "Group Representative Registration" button to fill in the registration information and submit. (2) Registration deadline: The registration deadline is October 30, 2024. (3) Notes on registration: 1. To ensure that participants receive registration confirmation, invoices, etc., please fill in accurate and true email addresses, phone numbers, and other information; 2. This registration website is only for registration, and the payment channel is not yet open; 3. Registered individuals can log in to the conference website's personal center to check and modify their registration information; 4. Participants who do not submit papers can also attend the conference. 7. Conference fees: (1) Conference registration fee: 1. Registration fee standard: The registration fee includes conference materials and lunch during the conference. 2. Payment methods: (1) Telegraphic transfer: After registering for the conference, participants should pay the registration fee by bank transfer, supporting both corporate and personal transfers to the following account: Payee: Chinese Pharmaceutical Association Bank: Bank of China Head Office Account number: 778350009320 It is recommended to use online banking for personal transfers, or you can also use Alipay transfer (to a bank card, with the name field filled in as "Chinese Pharmaceutical Association"). Please indicate "Pharmaceutical Excipients + Participant's Name + Unit Abbreviation" in the remittance note. After successful payment, please upload the remittance voucher to the conference website promptly for the secretariat to confirm the payment information and issue an invoice; (2) On-site payment: Registration fees can be paid through mobile online banking, or by scanning the payment QR code on-site (Alipay, WeChat) for transfer; there is no POS machine on-site, and payment by card swipe or UnionPay QuickPass is not supported. (2) Invoice matters: 1. The conference can provide a VAT ordinary invoice for "conference registration fees" (electronic invoice). After uploading the personal remittance voucher (photo, screenshot, etc., of the complete order) to the conference system, please accurately fill in the invoice information in the billing instructions section of your personal information. 2. In cases where the name of the remitter does not match the participant's name, one unit makes payments for multiple representatives, or the unit makes unified payments but requests separate invoices, please send detailed explanations by email to the secretariat at z38@cpa.org.cn, providing the remitter's name, participant's name, work unit, contact information, detailed invoice information, number and amount of invoices, as well as the person receiving the invoice and the mailing address. 3. Representatives who are unable to attend the conference due to special reasons after remittance can apply for a full refund of the registration fee by sending an email to the secretariat. The refund process will be handled collectively after the conference, and the refund will be made back to the original payment method. For accurate refunds, please indicate the full name and account information (account number, bank) of the original remitter in the refund application email. 8. Other matters: Accommodation and transportation expenses for participants are self-funded. Please refer to Annex 2 for hotel booking and transportation information. 9. Conference credits: Full attendance at the conference will be awarded 3 continuing education credits from the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association. 10. Contact person and contact information: 1. Contact person: Zhu Yizi (conference paper submission, registration fee payment, etc.) Peng Can, Duan Xiaohui, Lu Jia (conference consultation, food and accommodation arrangements, etc.) 2. Contact information: 010-67095606, 13956024560, 13956990010, 15212451687 3. Secretariat email: z38@cpa.org.cn Annex 1. Tentative schedule for the 2024 Annual Academic Conference of the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association.docx Annex 2. Hotel booking and transportation information.docx

title_en: "Practical work and achievements benefit the people and enterprises"
body_en: "TCL Zhonghuan deeply feels the high attention paid by Tianjin Municipality to private enterprises, as well as the clean, efficient, and professional work style..." After the urgent matter was efficiently resolved, TCL Zhonghuan New Energy Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as TCL Zhonghuan) recently sent a thank-you letter to the Municipal Bureau of Commerce. "As graduation season approaches, the 'Double First-Class' universities' 'Spring Recruitment' organized by the municipal human resources department is very timely." Zhang Jiaming, a computer technology major student at Nankai University, said, "Tianjin is my first choice for career planning. I have confidence and look forward to rooting and developing in Tianjin in the future." To ensure that the spirit of the Eight-point Central Regulations takes root in Tianjin, since the in-depth implementation of the learning and education of the spirit of the Eight-point Central Regulations, the vast number of party members and cadres in the city have deeply studied, carefully followed, and earnestly implemented, integrating learning and education with actual work, and promoting the whole process of learning, checking, and rectifying with the "strict" standards and "practical" style throughout, testing the effectiveness of learning and education in solving the urgent and difficult problems of the masses. Delivering satisfactory "high scores" with practical work and achievements With a focus on real achievements, the Municipal Bureau of Commerce closely monitors the key links of learning, checking, and rectifying, continuously transforming the results of learning and education into intimate services and truly assuming the responsibility of helping enterprises prosper. (Continued on page 3) (Continued from page 1) "Understanding what the enterprise needs and addressing the urgent needs of the enterprise has helped the project proceed smoothly." In the thank-you letter, TCL Zhonghuan "praised" the Municipal Bureau of Commerce. As a global leading manufacturer of photovoltaic materials, the enterprise recently needed to file for overseas investment projects, with a huge workload for centralized declaration, coinciding with a critical period when the Municipal Bureau of Commerce was leading the preparation for an international conference. "Building a service-oriented work style is the road to serving the people. We promote practical work through learning and effectively transform the results of learning and education into practical actions that benefit enterprises and the people," said a relevant official of the Municipal Bureau of Commerce. Faced with difficulties such as tight deadlines and heavy tasks, the relevant departments of the bureau overcame obstacles, coordinated with relevant municipal departments, opened up a green channel for enterprises through special consultations and precise guidance. At the same time, the Municipal Bureau of Commerce worked overtime and followed up throughout the process to ensure that the project was filed within the planned time frame, providing solid support for enterprises to seize international opportunities. title_en: Various well-known companies are actively recruiting talents in the field of AI.
body_en: This year, AI talents are in high demand at major job fairs nationwide. Employment is closely linked to economic conditions and the well-being of countless families. Since the beginning of this year, with the rapid development of new technologies, industries, and formats, a group of enterprises in key areas such as advanced manufacturing, information technology, and service consumption have released new job demands and expanded new employment opportunities as they accelerate their advancement towards the new and intelligent. Enterprises are focusing on AI talents as they advance towards the new and intelligent. In Beijing's Haidian District, at Baidu Tower, 120 new employees, including social recruitment employees, campus recruitment employees, and interns, recently gathered for Baidu's new employee training. "We have opened up more than 3,000 summer internship opportunities for students. We hope to recruit talents in fields such as machine learning, natural language processing, large model algorithms, as well as front-end and back-end development, and AI product managers," said Liu Shuai, Baidu's campus recruitment manager, adding that they plan to open 21,000 internship positions for graduates in the next three years. Since the beginning of this year, there has been a strong demand for recruitment in fields such as artificial intelligence and quantum technology, with companies competing to attract talents in algorithms, machine learning, and other areas. Not long ago, Tencent announced the launch of a new employment plan - to add 28,000 internship positions within three years, including 10,000 campus recruitment interns by 2025, with an increased focus on conversion to full-time employment. "As of early March, Tencent has more than 55,000 full-time employees, with over 40,000 in technology-related roles. The company's various businesses have fully embraced AI, hence we continue to strengthen our forward-looking talent reserves in recruitment," said Luo Haibo, Tencent's global recruitment manager, adding that over 60% of the open campus recruitment positions this year are in technology-related fields such as artificial intelligence, big data, cloud computing, and game engines, with an unprecedented expansion in recruitment efforts. Alibaba has also increased its recruitment and training of AI talents. It is understood that Alibaba started its spring 2026 internship recruitment in February, opening up over 3,000 internship positions. Among them, AI-related positions account for nearly half, with some business sectors having even higher proportions, such as Gaode at around 65% and Alibaba Cloud at over 80%. Meituan plans to provide over 15,000 positions to campuses by 2025, including recruiting over 6,000 graduates, offering internship opportunities with the chance of conversion to full-time employment for 4,000 interns, and having over 5,000 daily interns. Meituan has set up a special AI large model zone in its training to better stimulate talent vitality and drive innovative development. Platform empowerment of the real economy is releasing a multiplier effect on employment. The booming digital economy has not only brought about the emergence of digital and intelligent positions but also seen some platform companies empowering the real economy, releasing a cumulative multiplier effect and creating a broader employment space. While creating a lively atmosphere, a live atmosphere engineer is responsible for equipment debugging, backstage operations, maintaining live order, data review, etc. As a live atmosphere engineer, post-2000s Wen Miao has been exploring carefully for half a year, helping sell tens of thousands of agricultural products to distant places. In addition to live atmosphere engineers, many new professions such as online anchors, live recruitment specialists, life service experience staff, and user growth operation specialists come from the platform's "live track." Over the next three years, Kuaishou plans to conduct professional skills training for 10 million people online and offline around new professions. In the face of complex and changing external environments with many uncertainties, in the past two months, many e-commerce platforms have optimized services to help foreign trade companies expand into the domestic market and stabilize their workforce. From on-site coordination of purchasing and sales teams to providing rapid store opening, omni-channel marketing support, and launching an export-to-domestic support plan, JD.com has entered substantive procurement negotiations with over 10,000 companies since launching the plan in April. JD.com stated that it plans to purchase no less than 200 billion yuan worth of export-to-domestic goods in the coming year. Meituan has opened a green channel to fully support the online operations of foreign trade goods; Pinduoduo plans to invest 100 billion yuan in supporting the high-quality development of merchants over the next three years, while increasing subsidies for small and medium-sized merchants; Didi has added 2 billion yuan in special funds, with 1 billion yuan used to subsidize drivers in regions heavily affected by tariffs, and the other 1 billion yuan to subsidize passengers to increase their travel frequency. Platform companies are making various efforts, and the role of the employment "reservoir" is becoming increasingly evident. The "new wind" of industries is opening up new employment space. As the pace of economic transformation and upgrading accelerates, the move towards high-end "new manufacturing" is continuously opening up new employment paths, with industries such as consumer electronics, new energy, and integrated circuits showing vibrant employment opportunities. "In 2025, Midea Group will continue to increase campus recruitment, providing over 2,000 employment positions, and has already absorbed a group of research and development talents in areas such as smart appliances and robotics, new energy, medical, power electronics, algorithms, and intelligent manufacturing," said a relevant person from Midea Group's human resources department. Huawei will open over 10,000 recruitment positions by 2025, covering over 60 types of positions such as AI engineers, software development engineers, hardware technology engineers, and will also launch internship programs in areas such as development, testing, and exploration of cutting-edge technologies, planning to train over 5,000 future talents throughout the year. A group of advanced manufacturing enterprises are stimulating new talent demands as they optimize and upgrade, and lay out for the future. Since the beginning of this year, Fuyao Group has successively put into operation new bases and intelligent transformation projects in Hefei, Anhui, and Fuqing, Fujian, creating 6,750 new jobs. Among them, nearly 5,000 frontline positions have been created in automated intelligent factories, giving rise to new job types such as intelligent equipment operators and AI quality inspectors. "With the commissioning of new projects such as the ultra-high voltage Jiquan line power source and the establishment of new companies, technical research and development and project development-related positions have become new directions for recent recruitment," said a person in charge of Wanneng Group, adding that the company plans to recruit nearly a thousand people by 2025, mainly in energy and power, electrical engineering, and other specialties. Stable employment not only requires attention to the quantity of positions but also a focus on the quality of employment. By improving the training system and salary guarantee system, Transfar Group promotes the dual growth of employees' technical skills and income. In recent years, the group's business volume has increased fivefold, with the number of employees remaining at around 16,000, and the compound annual growth rate of per capita income exceeding 11%. "Employees and companies need to work together to create sustainable employment positions," said Xu Guanju, chairman of Transfar Group. (Reported by Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, June 10)

title_en: Liuzhou Two-Sided Needle Co., Ltd. Reply Announcement Regarding the Inquiry Letter on Information Disclosure Supervision of the 2024 Annual Report
body_en: Stock Code: 600249 Stock Abbreviation: LIAN MIAN ZHEN Announcement Number: L2025-026 The Board of Directors and all Directors of this Company guarantee that the announcement does not contain any false records, misleading statements, or material omissions, and they shall bear individual and joint responsibility for the authenticity, accuracy, and completeness of its content. Liuzhou LIAN MIAN ZHEN Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as the "Company") recently received the "Inquiry Letter Regarding Information Disclosure of Liuzhou LIAN MIAN ZHEN Co., Ltd.'s 2024 Annual Report" (Shangzheng Gonghan [2025] No. 0656) (hereinafter referred to as the "Inquiry Letter") from the Shanghai Stock Exchange. The Company and Zhongxi Certified Public Accountants (Special General Partnership) (hereinafter referred to as the "Annual Auditor") have carefully reviewed the issues raised in the Inquiry Letter item by item and hereby respond to the relevant questions in the Inquiry Letter as follows: 1. Regarding Monetary Funds. The annual report disclosed that at the end of the reporting period, the Company's monetary funds were 1.273 billion yuan, accounting for 46.78% of total assets. Short-term borrowings were 90 million yuan, a year-on-year increase of 55.17%. The Company has increased short-term borrowings while holding a large amount of cash. Please the Company to: (1) supplement disclosure of the main monetary fund deposit situation, including deposit institutions, amounts, account nature, interest rates, etc.; (2) analyze and explain the matching of interest income and the scale of monetary funds, combined with the monthly average daily monetary fund scale and interest rate level; (3) explain the reasons and rationality for the Company to take on new external borrowings while holding a large amount of monetary funds, combined with the change in the scale of short-term borrowings and interest rate levels; (4) self-examine and explain whether there are other potential restrictive arrangements for monetary funds, whether monetary funds or certificates of deposit are pledged to provide guarantees for the controlling shareholder or other related parties, whether there are joint or co-managed accounts with the controlling shareholder or other related parties, and whether monetary funds have been actually used by other parties. The annual auditor is requested to provide an opinion. [Company Reply] (1) Supplement disclosure of the main monetary fund deposit situation, including deposit institutions, amounts, account nature, interest rates, etc.; At the end of 2024, the Company's balance of monetary funds on hand was 1.273 billion yuan, of which the parent company's end-of-period monetary fund balance was 1.142 billion yuan, accounting for 89.71%. The parent company has a large amount of funds on hand due to the Company's transfer of equity in Liuzhou LIAN MIAN ZHEN Paper Co., Ltd. and Liuzhou LIAN MIAN ZHEN Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., as well as the Company's claims against these two companies to Chansheng Group in 2019, which was a major asset transaction. The principal and interest of the consideration received were approximately 1.2 billion yuan (for details on the receipt of funds, see Announcement No. L2021-029 dated December 11, 2021, "Announcement on Receiving the Final Payment for the Major Asset Disposal Project"). The main monetary fund deposit situation of the parent company and its subsidiaries is as follows: (2) Analyze and explain the matching of interest income and the scale of monetary funds, combined with the monthly average daily monetary fund scale and interest rate level; The interest income for each month in 2024 is as follows: Unit: Ten Thousand Yuan In 2024, the Company's average monetary fund balance was approximately 1,260.5411 million yuan. The Company's monetary funds were held in demand deposits, agreement deposits, and other forms. Interest income was 40.7246 million yuan, with an average comprehensive annual interest rate of 3.26%. The main accounts settled interest at the end of each quarter according to agreement deposits, achieving stable profits, which is consistent with the scale of monetary funds. (3) Explain the reasons and rationality for the Company to take on new external borrowings while holding a large amount of monetary funds, combined with the change in the scale of short-term borrowings and interest rate levels; The parent company's loan situation is as follows: The subsidiary Yikang Pharmaceutical's loan situation is as follows: In 2024, the Company borrowed a total of 90 million yuan. According to the above data, the reasons for the Company to take on new external borrowings while holding a large amount of monetary funds are: First, after enjoying national subsidies for civilian products and loans for scientific and technological innovation, the actual funding cost is between 0.22% and 2.6%, which is lower than the People's Bank of China's one-year LPR loan interest rate, and even lower than the Company's agreement deposit interest rate. Second, maintaining a certain scale of financing lines is conducive to maintaining good cooperative relationships with various financial institutions, enabling the Company to obtain timely financing support from banks when it has project financing needs. [Annual Auditor's Review Opinion] Regarding the above issues, we have performed the following audit procedures: 1. Understood and tested key internal controls related to monetary fund management; 2. Obtained the detailed statement of monetary funds and reconciled it with the general ledger and financial statements; 3. Conducted on-site supervision of cash on hand at the inventory date and back-calculated the expected balance of cash on hand at the balance sheet date. During the on-site supervision, we paid attention to any discrepancies between accounts and physical inventory caused by IOUs, misappropriation of cash, etc.; 4. Printed the list of bank account openings and the statements of major bank accounts. We selected major bank account daily ledgers and bank statements for two-way reconciliation to verify the completeness of bank deposit records; 5. Strengthened the bank deposit confirmation procedures at the end of the period, controlled the process of sending and receiving bank deposit confirmation letters, and enhanced the reconciliation of bank deposit statements, transaction details, unreconciled items, and bank deposit reconciliation statements; 6. Implemented cutoff tests for monetary funds to confirm whether they matched physical inventory and were owned by the Company, and analyzed whether the funds had specific uses or usage restrictions based on the return letters; 7. Calculated bank interest income based on demand and time deposit data; 8. Inquired with banks about the enterprise credit report to check for any pledge or guarantee situations; 9. Performed confirmation procedures for all bank loans, analyzed the reasons for the increase in short-term borrowings while the Company had large bank deposits, and checked the situation of bank loan interest subsidies. After verification, we believe that: (1) The Company's end-of-period monetary funds have been appropriately reported; (2) Interest income is matched with the scale of monetary funds; (3) The Company's new external borrowings while holding a large amount of monetary funds are reasonable; (4) No other potential restrictive arrangements for monetary funds were found, nor were monetary funds or certificates of deposit pledged to provide guarantees for the controlling shareholder or other related parties, nor were there joint or co-managed accounts with the controlling shareholder or other related parties, nor were monetary funds actually used by other parties. 2. Regarding Profitability. The annual report disclosed that the Company achieved a non-recurring net profit of 8.95 million yuan during the reporting period, a year-on-year decrease of 37.13%. The gross profit margin of the main daily chemical products was 13.84%, which was basically flat year-on-year. The Company has incurred losses or minimal profits in its non-recurring net profit for many consecutive years since 2004. During the reporting period, the Company's selling expenses were 113 million yuan, a year-on-year increase of 6.99%, of which advertising and promotion expenses increased by 17.14% year-on-year. Management expenses were 84 million yuan, a year-on-year increase of 15.33%. The sum of these two expenses accounted for 18.68% of operating revenue, which is higher than the overall gross profit margin. Please the Company to: (1) analyze and explain the reasons for the weak profitability of the Company's main business, combined with the overall development of the industry, the situation of comparable companies in the same industry, the competitive landscape, customer markets, changes in prices of main raw materials and products, and changes in selling expenses and management expenses, and explain whether it is consistent with the overall industry trend; (2) explain the Company's specific arrangements for improving continuous profitability in the future, and fully warn of risks related to uncertainties; (3) list the amounts, business content, paying parties, and whether they are related parties for the main items in advertising and promotion expenses, and explain whether there are circumstances where relevant funds ultimately flow to related parties or potential related parties. The annual auditor is requested to provide an opinion. [Company Reply] (1) Analyze and explain the reasons for the weak profitability of the Company's main business, combined with the overall development of the industry, the situation of comparable companies in the same industry, the competitive landscape, customer markets, changes in prices of main raw materials and products, and changes in selling expenses and management expenses, and explain whether it is consistent with the overall industry trend; The Company's main business is the daily chemical industry. Currently, the business includes two segments: daily chemicals and pharmaceuticals. The Company's daily chemical segment is mainly composed of the parent company, the holding subsidiary LIAN MIAN ZHEN (Jiangsu) Industrial Co., Ltd.
