title_en: Is there an abnormal sign for your express delivery?
body_en: The annual "618" shopping season is approaching, and major e-commerce platforms have started their mid-year promotions, igniting consumers' shopping enthusiasm. However, unscrupulous individuals have taken advantage of this opportunity to set up various traps, such as second-hand platform scams, "free gift" scams, fake SMS messages from "couriers," and e-commerce customer service "refund claims," among others. Many consumers have unfortunately fallen victim to these scams. We remind consumers to remain vigilant while enjoying the shopping frenzy, recognize various scam tactics, and safeguard their "wallets." Second-hand platform scam: Scanning to pay = losing money and goods Xiao Zhang met a seller on a second-hand trading platform when purchasing a phone. The seller claimed that the platform fees were high and asked Xiao Zhang to add their WeChat. Subsequently, the seller sent a QR code for Alipay to Xiao Zhang, requesting a payment of 1980 yuan. Xiao Zhang complied. Several days later, when Xiao Zhang did not receive any shipping information, he contacted the seller again. The seller falsely claimed that due to company reasons, they could not ship the item and would provide a full refund to Xiao Zhang. However, there was a limit on the refund, and Xiao Zhang needed to add 2000 yuan to complete the refund process. Xiao Zhang, although suspicious, added the 20 yuan. Unexpectedly, the seller requested Xiao Zhang to pay an additional 100 yuan, promising a refund of 2500 yuan, with 400 yuan as compensation. At this point, Xiao Zhang realized something was wrong and immediately reported it to the police. Police remind that when purchasing goods online, please conduct transactions through official e-commerce platforms to avoid using unverified third-party websites or applications, and avoid private transactions outside the platform under various pretexts. "Free gift" scam: Scanning to receive gifts turns out to be a brushing scam Recently, Ms. Wang received a parcel from an unknown courier, which contained a business activity card. Out of curiosity, Wang scanned the QR code on the card and added an account named "Activity Officer." Wang clicked on the link sent by the person, downloaded an app, and was told that registering as a member on the app would entitle her to a box of milk. Ten minutes later, a delivery person knocked on the door and delivered a box of milk to Wang. Believing it to be true, Wang informed the "Activity Officer" that she had received the milk. Subsequently, the person added Wang to a group chat, where the administrator announced a lottery activity. Wang participated and won a refrigerator and a rice cooker, with the administrator promising delivery in three days. Later, the administrator posted rebate tasks in the group. Wang paid 4999 yuan by scanning a QR code but did not receive the rebate. When Wang contacted the administrator, they claimed that another order needed to be made to receive the rebate, with the task amounting to 30,000 yuan. Following the instructions, Wang placed cash in a cardboard box and left it by the right rear wheel of a van at a designated location. Shortly after, Wang received a warning call from the anti-fraud center, realizing she had fallen for a scam. Police advise that online brushing is illegal, and any part-time brushing that requires upfront payment for tasks such as "doing tasks," "reviews," or "voting" is a scam. Any request to send cash, gold, or purchase large amounts of supermarket gift cards to strangers is a scam! "Courier" fatal text message: Screen sharing = sharing wallet Not long ago, Ms. Chen received a text message from someone claiming to be a courier. Chen contacted the person through the phone number provided in the message, and they informed her that they had activated a Douyin membership. If not deactivated, it would deduct 800 yuan monthly. Chen asked for help to deactivate the membership and was instructed to download a video conferencing software for screen sharing. The person remotely operated Chen's phone under the guise of helping her disable the bank card's no-password payment function. Subsequently, Chen's phone frequently blacked out and became unusable. After being alerted by family members, she realized she had been scammed, losing 5000 yuan. Police remind that when receiving an unknown courier pick-up notification, do not easily believe the content of the notification. Verify the information first. When receiving calls or messages claiming that failure to close services like "live membership," "e-commerce membership," or "million-dollar guarantee" will result in "deductions" or "automatic renewals," be cautious and do not easily believe. Any request from a stranger to enable screen sharing on your phone could be a scam! E-commerce customer service "refund claims": Claims are fake, theft is real Recently, Ms. Zhao received a call from someone claiming to be a customer service representative from a courier company, stating that her package was lost, and the company would provide triple compensation. The "claims officer" said that the "WeChat million insurance" compensation needed to be transferred to Zhao's bank account and guided her to click on a website link to apply. After following the instructions, Zhao opened a page with the words "Tencent Micro Insurance" and was asked to download a conference software called "Office Assistant." Following the instructions, Zhao entered her name, ID number, phone number, and other information. Subsequently, the person claimed that to close the insurance and avoid a 20,000 yuan deduction, Zhao needed to provide a phone SMS verification code. Zhao ultimately lost 14,000 yuan. Police recently exposed the tactics of these scams. Firstly, scammers capitalize on the recent "618" hot topic, using real orders to lower the victim's guard. They obtain online shopping information through illegal channels and use phrases like "abnormal delivery receipt" and "damaged compensation" to target the recipient's attention. During this process, scammers send out "phishing" messages or directly make phone calls to complete the "drainage." After successful "drainage," scammers use short videos, adding WeChat, grabbing red envelopes, etc., to publish false part-time job information such as likes and brushing orders. Once the victim contacts them, scammers induce them to download brushing apps or log in to brushing websites, contact customer service, and distribute tasks. After gaining the victim's trust through small profits, they persuade them to undertake larger tasks with higher commissions. Once the victim invests a large sum of money, scammers induce them to provide crucial information for the scam. Police advise that when receiving calls or messages claiming that a package is lost, damaged, or there are quality issues, please verify the authenticity through official channels of the courier company or e-commerce platform. Do not click on links or scan QR codes sent by strangers, and do not share your screen to protect your personal privacy information. (Source: Beijing Daily Client, etc.)

title_en: High-frequency data in May reflects the economy improving towards the "new" direction.
body_en: In May, the offline consumption heat index increased by 25.7% year-on-year, the online retail sales of household appliances increased by 31.0% year-on-year, the amount of winning bids in national projects increased by 21.5% year-on-year, and the production heat index of industrial parks increased by 21.2% year-on-year... The reporter of "Economic Reference News" learned on June 12 from the Big Data Development Department of the National Information Center that multiple high-frequency data show that in May this year, China's consumption, investment, industrial production, and other fields have seen a surge in "heat," reflecting a positive trend in the economy towards the "new" and strong vitality. The data shows that in May, various high-frequency consumption indicators in China showed an upward trend, with overall consumption showing a steady improvement. In terms of offline consumption, the offline consumption heat index constructed by the National Information Center based on sample business district foot traffic data increased by 25.7% year-on-year in May. Online consumption vitality is also steadily increasing. The life service consumption heat index constructed by the National Information Center based on user consumption order data from life service e-commerce platforms increased by 14.6% year-on-year in May, with leisure and entertainment, accommodation, catering, and tourism industries increasing by 28.8%, 12.1%, 10.8%, and 2.3% respectively. "The rise in consumption market heat is inseparable from the continuous effectiveness of various consumption-promoting policies," said Yang Daoling, Director of the Big Data Analysis Department of the Big Data Development Department of the National Development and Reform Commission National Information Center. On the one hand, a series of convenient policies have driven the popularity of "traveling in China" to new highs. Data from the National Immigration Administration shows that during the "May Day" period this year, the number of foreign nationals entering and exiting the country was 1.115 million, an increase of 43.1% compared to the same period last year; Alipay data shows that in the first three days of the "May Day" holiday, the consumption amount of inbound tourists using Alipay increased by 180% year-on-year. Holiday consumption has led to a continuous increase in the number of inbound tourists in many places. As of May 27, the total number of inbound and outbound personnel at Beijing ports exceeded 8 million, an increase of 22.1% year-on-year; as of May 29, the number of inbound and outbound personnel at Shenzhen Airport ports has exceeded 2.6 million this year, an increase of 31.1% year-on-year. On the other hand, the enthusiasm for "trading in old for new" remains unabated, and household appliance consumption maintains a relatively high growth rate. Monitoring data from the National Information Center on the online retail sales of major household appliance categories show that the online retail sales of related household appliances increased by 31.0% year-on-year in May, with a growth rate 8.7 percentage points higher than the previous month, continuing the strong growth momentum since the beginning of this year. At the same time, government investment continues to increase, with data showing that the year-on-year growth rate of the amount of winning bids for projects in May continues to expand. "Since the beginning of this year, fiscal policies have been continuously strengthened to provide more solid financial support for various major projects," said Yang Daoling. Monitoring and analysis of bidding data by the National Information Center show that the amount of winning bids for national projects increased by 21.5% year-on-year in May, an increase of 9.2 percentage points from the previous month. The fields of medical and health, municipal facilities, energy and chemical industry, and transportation engineering have shown faster growth rates, indicating that various projects are further accelerating their implementation and matching with fund allocation. From the production side, the heat of industrial production in May remained high, and enterprises showed strong vitality in developing towards the "new." The industrial park production heat index of the National Information Center shows that this index increased by 21.2% year-on-year in May, an increase of 0.3 percentage points from the previous month, maintaining high production vitality. Among them, the heat of traditional industries starting production has generally increased. The industrial production heat index constructed based on the starting rate of 31 industrial products increased by 1.0 percentage points year-on-year and by 1.4 percentage points month-on-month, with the starting heat index of major product categories such as textiles, chemicals, steel, and plastics increasing by 1.9, 1.5, 1.1, and 1.1 percentage points respectively. The data also shows that the innovation vitality of enterprises continues to burst forth. The entrepreneurial vitality index of start-up enterprises of the National Information Center shows that this index increased by 39.4% year-on-year in May, an increase of 14.3 percentage points from the previous month. The entrepreneurial vitality index of technology innovation enterprises increased by 28.9% year-on-year in May, an increase of 6.9 percentage points from the previous month. "This indicates that start-up enterprises and technology innovation enterprises are showing strong development momentum, and their innovation vitality continues to be unleashed," said Yang Daoling.

title_en: Quanzhou Zhonglian | Helping "Jinpin Going Global" Weitou - Kinmen Maritime Silk Road Cross-border · Jin Yun Route Maiden Voyage
body_en: At 18:30 on June 7th, the "Yixin" ship, loaded with ten containers, slowly set sail from Weitou Port in Jinjiang to Kinmen Port, marking the official opening of the "Jinpin Out to Sea" Weitou-Kinmen Maritime Silk Road. Quanzhou Zhonglian, with its accurate and efficient tallying services, provided solid guarantees for the rapid customs clearance of goods. Weitou Port in Jinjiang, as the closest port on the mainland to Kinmen, actively integrates into the "Maritime Silk Road Economic Belt" due to its unique geographical advantage. The journey on this route only takes 2 hours, significantly shortening the logistics time for goods entering Taiwan from platforms like Alibaba, and effectively reducing costs, providing a convenient channel for enterprises to expand overseas markets through "Jinpin Out to Sea." To ensure the smooth progress of tallying operations, Quanzhou Zhonglian conducted detailed communication and coordination with the port, shipowners, and agents in advance, and organized pre-operation meetings to carefully develop a detailed tallying operation plan. During the operation, the staff meticulously checked each container number and seal number according to the export manifest provided by the agent, strictly controlling the operation standards, safety quality, and data accuracy to ensure the entire operation process is precise and error-free. In the future, Quanzhou Zhonglian will continue to deepen service innovation, continuously improve the professional level of tallying operations, provide more solid guarantees for the prosperity and development of cross-strait trade, and help cross-strait economic and trade cooperation reach new heights. Source | Zhonglian Tallying, China Inspection and Testing.

title_en: Just now! Central Bank, latest release!
body_en: On June 13, the latest financial data released by the People's Bank of China showed that in May, social financing increased by 2.29 trillion yuan, an increase of 224.7 billion yuan year-on-year; new RMB loans increased by 620 billion yuan. At the end of May, the broad money supply (M2) increased by 7.9% year-on-year, a slight decrease of 0.1 percentage points from the previous month, and an increase of 0.9 percentage points from the same period last year. Authorities pointed out that when looking at financial aggregate data, one should not only consider absolute amounts and growth rates, but also relative amounts and growth rates. In the past few years, China's nominal economic growth rate was close to 10%, and the scale of social financing and loan growth rates also remained slightly above 10%, matching each other; in recent years, as the macroeconomy entered a phase of high-speed growth, the financial aggregate continued to maintain a growth rate of over 8%, about 4 percentage points higher than the nominal economic growth rate. The magnitude of the financial aggregate indicator exceeding the nominal economic growth rate is at a historical high, and has been sustained for a relatively long period of time. On May 7th of this year, the central bank issued a package of financial support measures, including reserve requirement ratio cuts, interest rate cuts, and optimization and creation of structural monetary policy tools. The above-mentioned authoritative experts stated that the measures were very forceful, and it takes time for the effects of monetary policy to manifest, but all policies have gradually and effectively been implemented. The central bank will also comprehensively use various monetary policy tools to maintain reasonable and adequate liquidity. Government bonds and corporate bonds drive social financing growth. Under the impetus of direct financing such as government bonds and corporate bonds, the scale of social financing in May increased by 2.29 trillion yuan, an increase of 224.7 billion yuan year-on-year. At the end of May, the stock of social financing increased by 8.7% year-on-year, maintaining a consistent growth rate with the previous month, an increase of 0.3 percentage points from the same period last year, maintaining a reasonable growth rate. In the past month, the net financing progress of government bonds has accelerated further, reaching a monthly scale of 1.46 trillion yuan. Although the issuance speed of replacement bonds used to replace existing hidden debts slowed down in May, local governments issued 443.2 billion yuan of new special bonds in a single month, reaching a new high for the year. In addition, special national bonds began to be issued in the second quarter, and the overall issuance speed of government bonds remained fast in that month. Sun Kunpeng, associate professor at the School of Finance and Taxation of the Central University of Finance and Economics, told reporters that the slowdown in replacement bonds will free up space for the issuance of new special bonds, and there is a significant demand for special bonds in key areas such as real estate, which suggests that the pace of special bond issuance in the second half of the year will accelerate, continuing to drive demand. In terms of a single month, corporate bond net financing exceeded 140 billion yuan in May. Since the second quarter, the overall cost of corporate bond issuance has been on a downward trend, and net corporate bond financing has improved since April. The average yield of 5-year AAA-rated corporate bonds due in May was 1.97%, further decreasing from April. Under the backdrop of low interest rates, some companies have taken advantage of favorable conditions to increase their bond financing efforts, reducing overall financing costs. Interest rate cuts help support loan demand. Although the scale of new RMB loans in May was lower than the same period last year, at the end of May, the balance of RMB loans increased by 7.1% year-on-year, indicating that loans are still growing steadily. In terms of loan structure, nearly 530 billion yuan of new RMB loans were added to the corporate sector in May. Market participants believe that the interest rate cuts in May will help support loan demand growth, as evidenced by a significant increase in corporate withdrawal intentions; at the same time, changes in the external environment also have a marginal impact on the credit situation. In mid-May, the US-China trade negotiations in Geneva reached an agreement to significantly reduce tariffs on each other within 90 days, prompting some foreign trade companies to seize the exemption period to increase exports, accelerating the landing of credit demand and providing support for loan growth. Nearly 54 billion yuan of new RMB loans were added to the household sector in May, and the growth of personal loans also reflects changes in economic activity. Some banks have reported that as local real estate transactions continue to pick up, there has been an increase in personal mortgage loans. In addition, loan rates continue to operate at low levels and remain stable. In May, the weighted average interest rate for new corporate loans (domestic and foreign currencies) was about 3.2%, approximately 50 basis points lower than the same period last year, and remained relatively stable compared to the previous month; the weighted average interest rate for new personal housing loans (domestic and foreign currencies) was about 3.1%, approximately 55 basis points lower than the same period last year, and remained relatively stable compared to the previous month. The continued substitution effect of bonds on loans is evident. In recent times, the increased financing intensity of government bonds and corporate bonds has also had a substitution effect on loans. Bonds and loans account for nearly 90% of the scale of social financing, and although they have different applications, they can to some extent complement each other as substitutes, creating a favorable financial environment for stable economic growth. In the short term, local government financing platforms repaying bank loans through debt swaps may affect the total amount of credit. From the fourth quarter of last year to the end of May this year, the cumulative issuance of replacement bonds has exceeded 3.6 trillion yuan. According to preliminary estimates from market research, the issued replacement bonds correspond to approximately 2.3 trillion yuan of loans replaced, and after adjustment, the growth rate of RMB loans at the end of May is still around 8%. Additionally, there is a certain overlap between the investment direction of government bonds and bank loans. For example, in infrastructure projects, special bonds and bank loans can both serve as sources of funding; in the acquisition of existing commercial housing for affordable housing projects, in addition to bank loans, this year's special bonds can also be used as a supporting tool. In the first four months of this year, the source of funds for fixed asset investment, including national budget funds such as government bonds, increased by 16.7% year-on-year, significantly higher than the growth rates of self-raised funds, domestic loans, and other sources of funds. According to several banks in a province in eastern China, fiscal policies have been more proactive this year, with local governments and related enterprises more inclined to use special bonds to meet the funding needs of project construction, playing a certain substitutive role for bank loans. In addition to the impact of interest rates, the financing methods of enterprises have also undergone a transformation as bond issuance channels become more accessible. Some companies, especially private and innovative enterprises, have become more active in corporate bond financing, and the increase in corporate bond financing has to some extent replaced bank loans. Industry experts generally believe that the transformation and upgrading of the economic structure cannot be achieved without the support of a financing system that is compatible with it. Direct financing has the characteristics of risk sharing, benefit sharing, and long-term companionship, which are more suitable for new areas of high growth, heavy research and development, and light assets, and will play a greater role in the financial system in the future. Three major reasons for the difference in deposit and loan growth. Compared to the slight decrease in year-on-year growth of new RMB loans in May, the year-on-year increase in new RMB deposits for the same month was larger. Data shows that new RMB deposits in May increased by 2.18 trillion yuan. Regarding the difference in monthly growth between deposits and loans, authoritative experts pointed out that this mainly reflects the diversification of financial institutions' assets and changes in financing structures. First, it is necessary to consider the growth of deposits and loans from a longer-term perspective. In recent years, there have been instances where the growth of deposits and loans in individual months in China has been inconsistent. Experts state that monthly growth in deposits and loans can be influenced by various factors, leading to significant fluctuations; looking at a longer time frame, the average growth rates of deposits and loans in China since 2021 have been around 9% and 9.6%, respectively, which are generally matching. Second, it is necessary to consider both on-balance sheet deposits and off-balance sheet wealth management products together. In recent years, China's financial markets have developed rapidly, with a variety of wealth management products such as wealth management continuously enriching. The flow of corporate and household deposits into wealth management products has become more convenient, and changes in asset prices such as stocks and bonds may also lead to a return of wealth management funds to deposits, resulting in more frequent fluctuations in deposits in individual months. Since April, progress has been made in US-China negotiations, and after the release of a package of financial support policies, market expectations have improved further, leading to a rebound in the stock market. However, bond yields have risen, causing some wealth management products invested in bonds to flow back to household deposits and securities company client margin deposits, resulting in a significant increase in deposits in the short term. Preliminary estimates show that when on-balance sheet deposits and off-balance sheet wealth management products are combined, the overall growth rate remains stable at around 8%, within a reasonable range. Third, the channels for banks to derive liabilities have become more diversified. In theory, deposits as liabilities on the bank's balance sheet are created by the expansion of the bank's asset side. If the bank's asset side only has loan business and the liability side only has deposit business, then the increase in loans will lead to an increase in deposits, and there will be no difference in the growth of deposits and loans. However, as the channels for financial support to the real economy become more diversified, in addition to loans, banks' asset side can also expand through channels such as purchasing bonds, expanding funding to non-bank financial institutions, and investments, while the liability side is also influenced by interbank certificates of deposit and financial bonds. Loans and deposits are only part of the assets and liabilities, and their growth is no longer a one-to-one relationship, leading to differences in growth in individual months. "Active money" growth accelerates significantly. At the end of May, narrow money (M1) increased by 2.3% year-on-year, an increase of 0.8 percentage points from the previous month. Industry insiders analyzed that the current M1 statistical caliber includes currency in circulation (M0), demand deposits of units and individuals, and reserves of non-bank payment institutions (such as WeChat Pay, Alipay balances, etc.), which are considered as more liquid "active money" compared to fixed-term deposits sitting in bank accounts. "The growth rate of this 'active money' in May has accelerated significantly, reflecting that the recent release of a package of financial support measures has effectively boosted market confidence, with signs of a rebound in investment, consumption, and other economic activities," said the industry insider mentioned above. title_en: The education hardware market is hot, and the stationery consumption trend is surging.
body_en: The picture shows a child experiencing an AI learning machine at an exhibition. Xinhua News Agency reporter Fu Tian Currently, the "618" promotion is in full swing, and with the summer vacation approaching, the education hardware market is entering its peak sales season. According to the Economic Reference News, from mental arithmetic computers to word machines, from desk lamps to eye-protecting screens, from error printing machines to AI learning companions... new types of stationery are becoming standard educational hardware for many families with children, and new brands and products are emerging in every niche market. Experts interviewed believe that the current consumption of new types of stationery exhibits characteristics such as intelligence, health, and personalization. With the advancement of technology and the updating of educational concepts, it is expected that the market for new types of stationery will continue to expand, and products will become more diverse. However, it is also necessary to be vigilant against negative tendencies such as excessive marketing, inflated prices, and varying quality, while consumers should avoid impulse buying. Market demand is strong: diverse categories, high sales Recently, in the live broadcast room of "Professor Cao Wen" on Xiaohongshu, an AI learning companion machine called "Xiaofangji" made its debut and attracted a large number of fans to watch. Several hundred learning companion machines were sold out within half an hour of their initial release, prompting the live broadcast room to urgently start pre-sales. A parent in Beijing, Keke Mom (pseudonym), followed this live broadcast closely and quickly placed an order to grab this learning companion machine. "My shopping cart is always filled with various new stationery items, ranging in price from hundreds to thousands of yuan. From the electric pencil sharpener that can easily sharpen a pencil in 2 to 3 seconds, to the mini error printing machine that wirelessly connects to a phone, to the current desk lamps, eye-protecting screens, learning machines, and learning companions." Keke Mom told reporters that during this year's "618" promotion, she has already purchased a batch of "black technology" stationery. Currently, new types of stationery are becoming standard educational hardware for many families. According to information from various e-commerce platforms, the market for educational hardware has been consistently hot this year, with significant sales of new types of stationery. Data from Pinduoduo shows that since May of this year, the sales of electronic educational hardware products have been continuously increasing. The Yangtze River Delta, Guangdong, and Central China, among other major education provinces, have supported a significant portion of the platform's sales of electronic educational hardware. According to Douyin e-commerce data, since the "618" promotion, the transaction volume of electronic educational products has increased by more than 60%, with the transaction volume of listening learning machines increasing by more than 8 times year-on-year. "Significant growth in vertical categories tailored to specific learning scenarios." Zhang Yu'ang, the person in charge of the 618 project at What's Worth Buying, said that from mini machines focused on mental arithmetic practice to error printing machines, and now to AI learning machines, these niche products not only cater to the precise education pursuit of Generation Z parents but also drive the market towards specialization. "The increasing willingness to invest in education, coupled with the emergence of various emerging educational scenarios, further stimulates the consumption demand in the new type of stationery market." Wu Qi, a senior researcher at Pangu Think Tank, pointed out that by 2025, the market size of China's education smart hardware will exceed 100 billion yuan, a 15% increase from 2023. Showcasing new consumer trends: more intelligent, more personalized In the eyes of industry insiders, the consumption of new types of stationery in the market is showing new characteristics such as higher technological content, more intelligence, increased environmental and health awareness, increased demand for personalization and customization, integrated multi-functionality, and the integration of online and offline. Since May, the sales of smart calligraphy pens on the Pinduoduo platform have increased by more than 400% year-on-year, while the sales of learning machines, educational companion machines, translation pens, and other electronic educational hardware have all seen growth. "AI education hardware equipped with large models has become the first choice for many parents because it can provide personalized teaching. In the first hour of JD.com's 618 promotion, the transaction volume of learning machines increased by more than 19 times year-on-year." The person in charge of JD.com's electronic education procurement and sales told reporters that with the end of the semester, the college entrance examination season, and the arrival of the summer vacation, AI education hardware is expected to continue to sell well. The surge in demand for health functions has also driven the hot sales of eye-protecting desk lamps, eye-protecting screens, and other products. Tmall stated that with the support of the national subsidy during the "618" promotion, the transaction volume of desk lamps increased by double digits year-on-year. On the What's Worth Buying platform, since January 2025, the sales of desk lamp-related products have increased by 50.55% year-on-year. Zhang Yu'ang believes that the new type of stationery market has entered the stage of "technology-driven + deep cultivation of scenarios," with health and intelligence integration becoming a standard feature of many products. In addition, products that highlight personal needs and satisfy emotional value continue to emerge. JD.com data shows that on IP Fan Day (June 10th), the overall transaction amount of stationery increased by 170%, while the transaction volume of IP stationery increased by 3 times year-on-year. "Products featuring well-known IPs such as the Forbidden City, Pokemon, and Disney are welcomed by many users," said the person in charge of JD.com's electronic education procurement and sales. The person in charge of Douyin e-commerce stated that in recent years, personalized learning demands have continued to rise, and consumer demands are showing a layered phenomenon. "Consumer demand for new types of stationery products has shifted from simple practical value to practical + emotional value." The person in charge of Tmall stated that the role and mission of stationery products have changed from being just writing tools in the past to now assisting in growth, and even self-expression, which determines the change in the entire value of consumer demand for stationery. Beware of negative tendencies: excessive marketing, impulse buying However, several experts interviewed also pointed out that the current new type of stationery market has issues such as excessive marketing of some products, varying quality, inflated prices, and some parents also have a tendency towards impulse buying, which needs attention. Zhu Keli, Executive Director of the China Information Association and Founding Dean of the National Research Institute of New Economy, believes that the current outbreak of educational hardware is to some extent a dual projection of exam pressure and technological anxiety. In Zhu Keli's view, there are three distortions on the supply side - first, technological packaging has become inflated, with some eye-protecting desk lamps claiming to be "myopia prevention" by simply adjusting the color temperature, lacking medical evidence. Second, there is a lack of data security, with children's voice recordings being used for algorithm training without a clear authorization mechanism. Third, there is severe price discrimination, with the same chip word machine having a price difference of three times due to differences in shell design. On the demand side, there are two layers of confusion - on one hand, parents equate equipment purchases with educational investment, overlooking the core value of parent-child companionship; on the other hand, students overly rely on tools to solve problems, weakening their fundamental thinking abilities. Wu Qi pointed out that some products have similar designs, repetitive functions, lack core technological support, and competition mainly focuses on price promotions. Some products have exaggerated advertising, with a gap between functional experience and actual effects, leading to consumer complaints. In terms of content, there are also individual products with content or functions that do not conform to educational guidelines, which can easily lead to controversy. How to promote the healthy development of the new type of stationery market? Zhang Yu'ang believes that companies should focus on demand-oriented product innovation, deeply understand the real usage scenarios of users, continuously invest in technological research and development, and launch products that truly solve user pain points. Consumers, especially parents, should enhance their ability to make rational decisions, choose products based on actual learning needs, and focus on core functionality rather than marketing concepts. "Companies should strive to improve product quality, price reasonably, avoid excessive hype; at the same time, the government and industry associations should strengthen supervision, establish industry standards, and promote fair competition and healthy development of the market." Hong Yong, an expert from the China Digital Integration 50 People Forum think tank, said.

On the What's Worth Buying platform, since January 2025, the sales of desk lamp-related products have increased by 50.55% year-on-year. Zhang Yu'ang believes that the new type of stationery market has entered the stage of "technology-driven + deep cultivation of scenarios," with health and intelligence integration becoming a standard feature of many products. In addition, products that highlight personal needs and satisfy emotional value continue to emerge. JD.com data shows that on IP Fan Day (June 10th), the overall transaction amount of stationery increased by 170%, while the transaction volume of IP stationery increased by 3 times year-on-year. "Products featuring well-known IPs such as the Forbidden City, Pokemon, and Disney are welcomed by many users," said the person in charge of JD.com's electronic education procurement and sales. The person in charge of Douyin e-commerce stated that in recent years, personalized learning demands have continued to rise, and consumer demands are showing a layered phenomenon. "Consumer demand for new types of stationery products has shifted from simple practical value to practical + emotional value." The person in charge of Tmall stated that the role and mission of stationery products have changed from being just writing tools in the past to now assisting in growth, and even self-expression, which determines the change in the entire value of consumer demand for stationery. Beware of negative tendencies: excessive marketing, impulse buying However, several experts interviewed also pointed out that the current new type of stationery market has issues such as excessive marketing of some products, varying quality, inflated prices, and some parents also have a tendency towards impulse buying, which needs attention. Zhu Keli, Executive Director of the China Information Association and Founding Dean of the National Research Institute of New Economy, believes that the current outbreak of educational hardware is to some extent a dual projection of exam pressure and technological anxiety. Third, there is severe price discrimination, with the same chip word machine having a price difference of three times due to differences in shell design. Zhang Yu'ang believes that companies should focus on demand-oriented product innovation, deeply understand the real usage scenarios of users, continuously invest in technological research and development, and launch products that truly solve user pain points. Hong Yong, an expert from the China Digital Integration 50 People Forum think tank, said.

title_en: Build a new pattern of cooperation and create a golden signboard for economic and trade.
body_en: As the most important event in Sino-African economic and trade cooperation this year, the Fourth China-Africa Economic and Trade Expo is jointly hosted by the Hunan Provincial People's Government and the Ministry of Commerce in Changsha, China. The China-Africa Economic and Trade Expo is moving from the "initial stage of the exhibition" to the "mature stage of the brand," becoming a "golden signboard" for Sino-African economic and trade cooperation. Recently, an Economic Daily reporter interviewed Cao Zhiqiang, Vice Governor of the Hunan Provincial People's Government, on related topics. Reporter: The China-Africa Economic and Trade Expo has become an important platform for promoting economic and trade exchanges and cooperation between China and Africa. What are the new features and highlights of the Fourth China-Africa Economic and Trade Expo compared to previous editions? Cao Zhiqiang: The China-Africa Economic and Trade Expo is one of the two national-level platforms for Africa given to Hunan Province by the country. Hunan is making every effort to build a pattern of "Hunan setting the stage, the whole country performing, and China and Africa sharing together," striving to make each edition better than the last. This edition of the expo aims to promote the "Ten Major Partnership Actions for China-Africa Modernization" and is centered around the theme of "China and Africa Taking Joint Action to Achieve Modernization." The new highlights include: First, highlighting internationalization and increasing brand influence. In the current global trade environment where free trade is hindered, focusing on joint action, in line with the goal of building a new era of China-Africa all-weather community of shared future, connecting the implementation of the outcomes of the China-Africa Cooperation Forum ministerial meeting, expanding the China-Africa economic and trade circle, and continuously enhancing the influence of the expo. Currently, there are over 30,000 participants from 53 African countries, 11 international organizations, 27 domestic provinces, regions, and cities, and over 4,700 Chinese and African enterprises, business associations, financial institutions, etc. High-level representatives from organizations such as the United Nations Industrial Development Organization, International Trade Center, and Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations have come to Hunan to participate. Second, emphasizing specialization and increasing the effectiveness of activities. The expo is returning to its economic and trade attributes, aligning with the needs of China-Africa modernization development, focusing on complementary advantages in areas such as China-Africa industrial chain cooperation, green mining, infrastructure, traditional medicine, cultural trade, youth innovation, and entrepreneurship, and organizing 30 specialized economic and trade activities. Five sister provinces and cities are hosting specialized economic and trade exchange activities with Africa to jointly create windows for local economic and trade cooperation with Africa. Nine African countries, including Kenya, Zimbabwe, and Rwanda, are hosting specialized economic and trade exchange and promotion activities, making it the largest in history. Third, emphasizing market orientation for better exhibition results. This edition of the expo adheres to market-oriented operation, stimulating the participation of domestic and foreign business entities in the exhibition. It has set up special exhibition areas such as the China-Africa Cooperation Famous Brand Exhibition, Africa's Good Products Exhibition, China-Africa Cultural Tourism Exhibition, and China-Africa Traditional Chinese Medicine Cooperation Exhibition for the first time. Reporter: Since the China-Africa Economic and Trade Expo was held, what new achievements and breakthroughs has Hunan made in its economic and trade cooperation with Africa? Cao Zhiqiang: In 2024, on the basis of hosting the China-Africa Economic and Trade Expo, the country approved the construction of a China-Africa deep cooperation pilot zone in Hunan. Hunan has leveraged the role of the two national-level platforms to continuously explore new practices and paths, providing strong support for China-Africa economic and trade cooperation. In summary, the main achievements include the following three aspects: First, innovation in mechanisms to build a collaborative network. Establishing cooperation mechanisms between 14 cities and prefectures in Hunan and 28 African countries, the network for cooperation with Africa is taking shape. Constructing the China-Africa Economic and Trade Headquarters Building to attract over a hundred domestic and foreign enterprises engaged in economic and trade cooperation with Africa. Introducing a series of measures, including the establishment of the China-Africa Economic and Trade Deep Cooperation Service Fund, to provide strong policy support for business entities engaged in China-Africa economic and trade activities. Second, breakthroughs in approaches to address economic and trade bottlenecks. Playing a pioneering role, addressing the bottlenecks and pain points in China-Africa economic and trade cooperation such as market access, exchange rates, trade facilitation, investment and financing, standards, and rules, exploring new cooperation approaches. Conducting standard cooperation with Africa to promote the establishment of import inspection and testing laboratories in African countries. Third, deepening project cultivation to nurture exemplary cases. Highlighting comparative advantages, initiating over 40 industrial projects in 16 African countries around the linkage of production and trade, investment and trade, and physical trade, supporting Kilimall's cross-border e-commerce platform in completing the layout of 1,500 African version "Rookie Stations." Establishing logistics channels, setting up 17 public overseas warehouses in node cities and ports in 12 African countries such as Nigeria and Ivory Coast. Creating cooperation platforms, such as the Amazon Web Services China-Africa Industry Empowerment Innovation Center and the Alibaba Global AliExpress (China-Africa) Cross-border E-commerce Industrial Park, have settled in the Changsha Economic Development Zone. In 2024, the trade volume between Hunan Province and Africa reached 54.85 billion yuan, doubling from 18.16 billion yuan in 2018, ranking eighth in the country and first in the central and western regions. Reporter: In the next step, how will Hunan deepen its economic and trade cooperation with Africa to help elevate China-Africa economic and trade cooperation to a higher level? Cao Zhiqiang: As a pioneer and new frontier in China's development of relations with Africa, Hunan will strive to build the China-Africa deep cooperation pilot zone, host the China-Africa Economic and Trade Expo well, continuously improve the China-Africa economic and trade cooperation system, and promote high-quality development of China-Africa trade. First, focusing on increasing convenience to facilitate cooperation channels. Targeting the bottlenecks and pain points in current China-Africa economic and trade cooperation, integrating innovative policies in market access, inspection and testing, logistics channels, and financial services to enhance convenience for economic and trade cooperation. Second, focusing on strong support to build a cooperation matrix. Leveraging Hunan's characteristic industries and Africa's resource advantages, deepening the integration of industrial chains and supply chains, creating a number of landmark cooperation projects, building a cooperation industrial matrix, and expanding the scale and benefits of trade with Africa. Third, focusing on promoting improvement to host cooperation platforms. Emphasizing market-oriented, specialized, and internationalized event organization, promoting the China-Africa Economic and Trade Expo from "exhibition traffic" to "economic and trade increment," from "short-term activities" to "long-term mechanisms," from "government-led" to "market-driven," and from "regional platform" to "global hub" transformation, continuously enhancing brand influence to help elevate the level of China-Africa economic and trade cooperation.

title_en: Kangshengyao Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. Announcement on the Progress of Litigation Enforcement of a Subsidiary (V)
body_en: Stock Code: 600518 Stock Abbreviation: Kangmei Pharmaceutical Number: Announcement 2025-024 The board of directors and all directors of the company guarantee that the announcement does not contain any false records, misleading statements, or major omissions, and they bear legal responsibility for the authenticity, accuracy, and completeness of its content. Important Information Prompt: ● The company has received an "Execution Ruling" from the Intermediate People's Court of Jieyang City, Guangdong Province. The Jieyang Intermediate Court has ruled to change China Cinda Asset Management Co., Ltd. Anhui Branch to be the applicant for enforcement in case No. (2024) Yue 52 Zhi 62. Kangmei Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as the "Company") recently received the "Execution Ruling" (No. (2025) Yue 52 Zhi Yi 18) from the Intermediate People's Court of Jieyang City, Guangdong Province (hereinafter referred to as the "Jieyang Intermediate Court"). In the case of loan contract dispute between the obligee Bohai International Trust Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Bohai Trust") and the obligors Kangmei (Bozhou) Huatuo International Traditional Chinese Medicine City Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Kangmei TCM City"), Bozhou New World Trading Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "New World Trading"), Kangmei (Bozhou) Century Guoyao Traditional Chinese Medicine Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Century Guoyao TCM"), etc., China Cinda Asset Management Co., Ltd. Anhui Branch (hereinafter referred to as "Cinda Asset Anhui Branch") applied to be changed to the obligee. The Jieyang Intermediate Court has now ruled to change Cinda Asset Anhui Branch to be the applicant for enforcement in case No. (2024) Yue 52 Zhi 62. The details are as follows: I. Basic Situation of the Litigation Case (I) On January 29, 2022, the Company disclosed the "Announcement of Kangmei Pharmaceutical Regarding Major Litigation" (Announcement No.: Lin 2022-018). The main content is as follows: Kangmei Industrial Investment Holding Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Kangmei Industrial") and Bohai International Trust Co., Ltd. signed the "Trust Loan Agreement" on November 28, 2018, and the "Supplementary Agreement to the Trust Loan Agreement" on December 5, 2018, with a total loan of RMB 3,560,000,000.00. To guarantee the aforementioned loans, Kangmei Industrial and related parties provided guarantee measures to Bohai Trust and signed relevant agreements. During the performance of the loan contract, Kangmei Industrial and related parties failed to fulfill all repayment obligations and bear relevant responsibilities to Bohai Trust as agreed. Bohai Trust requested the court to order the defendant to repay the principal of the loan of RMB 1,752,244,700.00, interest and penalty interest of RMB 803,655,200.00, and bear litigation costs and lawyer fees; it requested to exercise relevant mortgage rights on the immovables mortgaged by Kangmei TCM City, New World Trading, and Century Guoyao TCM; and it requested to exercise pledge rights on the equity held and pledged by Kangmei Industrial and related parties. (II) On September 3, 2022, the Company disclosed the "Announcement of Kangmei Pharmaceutical on the Progress of Major Litigation Involving the Company" (Announcement No.: Lin 2022-052). Bohai Trust changed its litigation claims, requesting the court to order the defendant to repay the principal of the loan of RMB 2,822,244,700.00, interest and penalty interest, and bear litigation costs and lawyer fees; it requested to exercise mortgage rights on the immovables mortgaged by Kangmei Industrial, Kangmei TCM City, New World Trading, and Century Guoyao TCM; and it requested to exercise pledge rights on the equity held and pledged by Kangmei Industrial and related parties. The first-instance judgment ruled that Kangmei Industrial shall bear the payment obligations of the principal of RMB 2,819,894,700.00 and interest and penalty interest, and Bohai Trust has the right to obtain priority compensation from the appraised value or the proceeds from the auction or sale of the immovables mortgaged by the aforementioned subsidiaries. (III) On October 29, 2022, the Company disclosed the "Announcement of Kangmei Pharmaceutical on the Progress of Major Litigation Involving the Company" (Announcement No.: Lin 2022-059). The Company filed an appeal with the Higher People's Court of Guangdong Province within the prescribed time limit. (IV) On August 17, 2023, the Company disclosed the "Announcement of Kangmei Pharmaceutical on the Result of Major Litigation Involving the Company" (Announcement No.: Lin 2023-027). The Higher People's Court of Guangdong Province made a second-instance final judgment, changing the first item of the first-instance judgment to Kangmei Industrial bearing the principal of RMB 2,819,894,700.00 and part of the interest and penalty interest (shortening the penalty interest period), and upheld the second, third, fourth, and fifth items of the first-instance judgment. (V) On May 18, 2024, the Company disclosed the "Announcement of Kangmei Pharmaceutical on Receiving Court Execution Ruling" (Announcement No.: Lin 2024-020). The Jieyang Intermediate Court ruled to auction or sell the immovables mortgaged by Kangmei TCM City, New World Trading, and Century Guoyao TCM. (VI) On August 7, 2024, the Company disclosed the "Announcement of Kangmei Pharmaceutical on the Progress of Litigation Execution of Subsidiaries" (Announcement No.: Lin 2024-026). The Jieyang Intermediate Court publicly auctioned the mortgaged immovables of the obligors Kangmei TCM City and New World Trading on the Taobao judicial auction online platform from 10:00 on September 15, 2024, to 10:00 on September 16, 2024 (excluding extended bidding) with the lease in place. (VII) On August 20, 2024, the Company disclosed the "Announcement of Kangmei Pharmaceutical on the Progress of Litigation Execution of Subsidiaries (II)" (Announcement No.: Lin 2024-027). After querying the Taobao online judicial auction platform, the Company learned that the aforementioned auction was withdrawn. The reason for withdrawal displayed on the auction online platform was that the applicant for enforcement and other enforcement creditors withdrew their enforcement applications. (VIII) On October 9, 2024, the Company disclosed the "Announcement of Kangmei Pharmaceutical on the Progress of Litigation Execution of Subsidiaries (III)" (Announcement No.: Lin 2024-033). The Jieyang Intermediate Court ruled to terminate the execution of case No. (2024) Yue 52 Zhi 62 and lift the seizure and freezing measures on the properties of the obligors Kangmei TCM City, New World Trading, Century Guoyao TCM, etc. (IX) On April 19, 2025, the Company disclosed the "Announcement of Kangmei Pharmaceutical on the Progress of Litigation Execution of Subsidiaries (IV)" (Announcement No.: Lin 2025-018). Due to the signing of a "Debt Transfer Agreement" between Bohai Trust and Cinda Asset Anhui Branch, Bohai Trust legally transferred its claims and all rights and interests against the obligors Kangmei TCM City, New World Trading, Century Guoyao TCM, etc., to Cinda Asset Anhui Branch. Cinda Asset Anhui Branch applied to the Jieyang Intermediate Court, requesting to be changed as the obligee in case No. (2024) Yue 52 Zhi 62. II. Main Content of the Execution Ruling The Jieyang Intermediate Court ruled to change China Cinda Asset Management Co., Ltd. Anhui Branch to be the applicant for enforcement in case No. (2024) Yue 52 Zhi 62. III. Other Relevant Explanations and Risk Warnings (I) Based on the prudent principle and in accordance with the relevant provisions of accounting standards and the judgment results, the Company has previously accrued estimated liabilities for pending litigation, limited to the book value of the immovables mortgaged by Kangmei TCM City, New World Trading, and Century Guoyao TCM, totaling RMB 609,162,800.00. (II) It is not ruled out that relevant rights holders may re-apply to the court for enforcement, requesting the court to auction or sell the immovables mortgaged by Kangmei TCM City, New World Trading, and Century Guoyao TCM. The Company will closely monitor the subsequent progress of this matter and fulfill its information disclosure obligations in a timely manner in accordance with laws and regulations. (III) The designated information disclosure media of the Company are "China Securities Journal," "Shanghai Securities News," "Securities Times," "Securities Daily," and the Shanghai Stock Exchange website (www.sse.com.cn). All information of the Company shall be subject to the information disclosed in the aforementioned designated media. Investors are advised to pay attention to investment risks. Hereby announced. The Board of Directors of Kangmei Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. June 14, 2025

title_en: Notice on adjusting the closure construction time of the main line from K424+000 to K467+100 of the Beijing-Harbin Expressway
body_en: According to the needs of the fourth phase of the construction and expansion project of the Suizhong (Jiliao border) to Panjin section of the Beijing-Harbin Expressway, the main line of the Beijing-Harbin Expressway from K424+000 to K467+100 was originally scheduled to be temporarily closed for construction from 20:00 on June 14, 2025 to 06:00 on June 15, and the closure notice was issued on June 8. However, due to the impact of this year's Typhoon "Butterfly", the meteorological department predicts a significant rainfall process from June 14 to 15, with heavy to torrential rain in some areas, accompanied by short-term thunderstorms, strong winds, or hail and other severe convective weather, affecting traffic operations and construction safety. It is proposed to adjust the closure construction time of the main line of the Beijing-Harbin Expressway from K424+000 to K467+100, and the relevant announcement is as follows: 1. Closure time The original plan from 20:00 on June 14, 2025 to 06:00 on June 15, 2025 is adjusted to 21:00 on June 15, 2025 to 07:00 on June 16, 2025, a total of 10 hours (dynamic adjustments will be made in case of rain or other special weather conditions). 2. Closed sections (1) Beijing-Harbin Expressway (Shenyang to Shanhaiguan direction) from K467+100 to K424+000. (2) Beijing-Harbin Expressway (Shanhaiguan to Shenyang direction) from K424+000 to K451+300. 3. Recommended travel routes (1) Vehicles intending to travel through the closed section of the Beijing-Harbin Expressway (Shenyang to Shanhaiguan direction) should exit at Linghai Toll Station and Jinzhou East Toll Station in advance, detour on ordinary roads, and enter the Beijing-Harbin Expressway at Huludao East Toll Station or Huludao Toll Station. (2) Vehicles intending to travel through the closed section of the Beijing-Harbin Expressway (Shanhaiguan to Shenyang direction) should exit at Huludao Toll Station or Huludao East Toll Station in advance, detour on ordinary roads, and enter the Beijing-Harbin Expressway at Jinzhou Toll Station or Jinzhou East Toll Station. (3) Vehicles from the Nanpiao area of Huludao intending to travel to the Beijing-Harbin Expressway (Shanhaiguan to Shenyang direction) can enter the Beijing-Harbin Expressway at Jinzhou Toll Station; vehicles intending to travel to the Beijing-Harbin Expressway (Shenyang to Shanhaiguan direction) can enter the Beijing-Harbin Expressway at Huludao East Toll Station. (4) In order to reduce the merging of vehicles from the connecting roads of the Beijing-Harbin Expressway construction and expansion section and prevent long-distance traffic congestion, vehicles intending to enter the Beijing-Harbin Expressway from the Danshi Expressway (Chaoyang to Jinzhou direction) should exit at Jinzhou West Toll Station; vehicles intending to enter the Beijing-Harbin Expressway from the Fuxin Expressway (Fuxin to Jinzhou direction) should exit at Shuangyang Toll Station. The above-mentioned vehicles heading to the Beijing-Harbin Expressway (Shenyang to Shanhaiguan direction) can enter the Beijing-Harbin Expressway at Huludao East Toll Station after detouring on ordinary roads; those heading to the Beijing-Harbin Expressway (Shanhaiguan to Shenyang direction) can enter the Beijing-Harbin Expressway at Jinzhou East Toll Station or Linghai Toll Station after detouring on ordinary roads. Vehicles intending to enter the Beijing-Harbin Expressway from the Xingjian Expressway (Jianchang to Xingcheng direction) and travel to Shenyang should exit at Baita Toll Station, detour on ordinary roads, and enter the Beijing-Harbin Expressway at Jinzhou Toll Station. During the temporary road closure period, the general public with travel needs can refer to the above travel routes, make travel plans in advance, and we apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. It is recommended to use navigation software such as Gaode, Baidu, and Tencent for guidance when traveling. For any inquiries, please contact the 24-hour customer service hotline of Liaoning Expressway: 024-96199; you can also follow the real-time road conditions information released by the "Liaoning Traffic Police" and "Liaoning Expressway" new media matrix. Traffic Management Detachment of Liaoning Provincial Public Security Department Liaoning Expressway Operation and Management Co., Ltd. June 14, 2025

title_en: Case link
body_en: Case One: In early November 2019, Fu Zu and Fu went to a certain advertising company to print their own Alipay payment QR codes, and then went to market stalls to switch the QR codes and commit theft. Fu Zu switched the QR codes of 17 stalls, obtaining a total of 2823 yuan; Fu switched the QR codes of 18 stalls, obtaining a total of 2425.03 yuan. The court believed that Fu Zu and Fu, with the aim of illegal possession, repeatedly stole the property of others, and their actions constituted theft. Case Two: Between February and October 2018, Li went to different hotels multiple times, taking advantage of the opportunity when no one was paying attention, to cover his own or Alipay payment QR codes applied for in the name of others under his actual control on the QR codes of various hotels or businesses, thereby illegally obtaining 7792.49 yuan. The court believed that Li, with the aim of illegal possession, fraudulently obtained 7792.49 yuan of others' property, constituting the crime of fraud. Case Three: In April 2019, Jiang signed a transportation contract with Company A on behalf of the individual transport fleet affiliated with Company B, transporting coil screw steel bars. In late March 2020, Jiang conspired with Zhou to steal and sell the coil screw steel bars carried by his fleet for profit. Subsequently, drivers such as Ye and Yin, according to Jiang's arrangement, drove to the steel market designated by Company A, loaded the coil screw steel bars, then transported them to a certain iron factory, cut off a part for sale, replaced the truck bed with a modified one containing a hidden water tank, had someone fill the tank with water to increase the weight to the original steel weight for weighing, then emptied the water on the way to the construction site, unloaded the steel bars at the construction site, and left after weighing the empty truck. The court believed that the above actions constituted theft. Case Four: Through premeditated collusion, during the transportation and unloading process of liquid alkali, Du and others sold some of the liquid alkali in the tank truck to Zhang and others, then added water to the tank to make the weight after adding water basically the same as the weight when leaving the factory, and then transported the watered-down liquid alkali to a certain company. The sampling personnel of the company, including Lin, knew that the quality of the liquid alkali was substandard, and after receiving a "bribe," unloaded the watered-down liquid alkali into the alkali pool. On March 7, 2018, Du sold 8 tons of liquid alkali to a buyer, and added water to the tank to maintain the weight. Early the next morning, Du arrived at the company and handed a bottle of qualified liquid alkali prepared in advance to Lin as a sample. With Lin's help, the unqualified liquid alkali on the truck was unloaded into the alkali pool. The court believed that the actions of Du, Lin, and others constituted the crime of fraud.

title_en: Notice on holding the 2024 Academic Annual Conference of the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association (Second Round)
body_en: To all relevant units: Pharmaceutical excipients are an important foundation in China's pharmaceutical industry, and are one of the key factors determining the quality of generic drugs and the high-quality development of innovative formulations. The security of the supply chain of pharmaceutical excipients used in high-end formulations in China urgently requires the strengthening of technical innovation and industrial support for domestically produced pharmaceutical excipients. At the same time, ensuring the quality of clinical medication, reducing drug costs, and alleviating the pressure on medical insurance to a large extent also depend on the improvement of the quality of domestically produced pharmaceutical excipients. In line with the principle of "promoting technological innovation in pharmaceutical excipients and enhancing the new quality productivity of the pharmaceutical industry," the "2024 Annual Academic Conference of the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association," organized by the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association, is scheduled to be held in Hefei, Anhui Province from November 8th to 10th, 2024. This academic conference will feature conference reports in the fields of materials science related to pharmaceutical excipients, innovative drugs, and innovative formulations, analyzing the development difficulties and innovations of pharmaceutical excipients; inviting authoritative experts to deeply discuss the in vivo processes of pharmaceutical excipients and drug delivery carriers, as well as the improvement and innovation of excipient quality. The conference will set up expert venues and young scholar sub-venues on the themes of "Pharmaceutical Excipients, Packaging Materials, and Drug Delivery Devices," "New Materials, New Carriers, and Innovative Formulations," and "Pharmaceutical Excipients and Innovative Drugs," promoting the wide participation of enterprises, academia, and young scholars to jointly focus on the technological innovation and industrial research and development of pharmaceutical excipients. The relevant matters are hereby notified as follows: 1. Conference theme: Promoting technological innovation in pharmaceutical excipients and enhancing the new quality productivity of the pharmaceutical industry 2. Time and location: November 8th Registration location: New Ji Hotel, Hefei (2766 Wenzhong Road, Yaohai District, Hefei, Anhui Province) November 9-10 Main venue and sub-venues are both at Shaoquanhu Campus of Anhui University of Chinese Medicine in Hefei, Anhui Province (350 Longzihu Road, Yaohai District, Hefei, Anhui Province) 3. Conference arrangements: The conference will adopt a format of main venue and sub-venue reports for communication. The conference will invite well-known experts and scholars from domestic universities, research institutes, pharmaceutical companies, research and development units, medical institutions, regulatory agencies, etc., to give keynote speeches and special lectures. Please see the attached schedule for the conference agenda. 4. Participants: Researchers, managers, and graduate students engaged in research and development related to pharmaceutical excipients, pharmaceutical packaging materials, pharmaceutical devices, formulation quality control, formulation equipment, pharmaceutical services, etc., from higher education institutions, research institutes, pharmaceutical companies, research and development units, medical institutions, drug regulatory agencies, and other related institutions. 5. Conference paper submission: 1. Requirements for submission of papers: Abstracts and papers in Chinese and English. Papers that have not been published in publicly distributed journals or presented at national academic conferences are the responsibility of the authors; please ensure clear expression and accurate data. We welcome active submissions from researchers in the pharmaceutical field. 2. Paper submission method: Please submit the abstract of the paper before October 20, 2024, by logging on to the conference website https://yyfl2024.sciconf.cn and clicking on the "Online Paper Submission" button on the right to upload your paper abstract according to the process. After successful submission, you will receive an automatic email confirmation of the online submission. After expert review of the paper, the organizing committee will select several papers for further communication or publication in the "Drug Analysis" journal. 3. Poster submission method and deadline: Same as for papers. The conference welcomes poster submissions, which should be in A1 standard size. 6. Registration: (1) Registration method: 1. Please log on to the conference website link https://yyfl2024.sciconf.cn and click on the "Individual Representative Registration" or "Group Representative Registration" button to register; 2. Or scan (or long-press to recognize) the QR code below with your mobile phone, click on the "Individual Representative Registration" or "Group Representative Registration" button to fill in the registration information and submit. (2) Registration deadline: The registration deadline is October 30, 2024. (3) Notes on registration: 1. To ensure that participants receive registration confirmation, invoices, etc., please fill in accurate and true email addresses, phone numbers, and other information; 2. This registration website is only for registration purposes and does not currently have a payment channel; 3. Registered individuals can log in to the conference website's personal center to check and modify their registration information; 4. Participants who do not submit papers can also attend the conference. 7. Conference fees: (1) Conference registration fee: 1. Registration fee standard: The registration fee includes conference material fees and lunch during the conference. 2. Payment methods: (1) Telegraphic transfer: After registering for the conference, participants should pay the registration fee by bank transfer, supporting both corporate and personal transfers to the following account: Payee: Chinese Pharmaceutical Association Bank: Bank of China Head Office Account number: 778350009320 It is recommended to use online banking for personal transfers, or you can also use Alipay transfer (to a bank card, with the name field filled in as "Chinese Pharmaceutical Association"). Please indicate "Pharmaceutical Excipients + Participant's Name + Unit Abbreviation" in the remittance note. After successful payment, please upload the remittance voucher to the conference website promptly for the secretariat to confirm the payment information and issue an invoice; (2) On-site payment: Registration fees can be paid on-site through mobile banking transfers, or by scanning the payment QR code (Alipay, WeChat) on-site; there is no POS machine on-site, and payment methods such as card swiping and UnionPay QuickPass are not supported. (2) Invoice matters: 1. The conference can provide a VAT ordinary invoice for "conference registration fees" (electronic invoice). After uploading the personal remittance voucher (photo, screenshot, etc.) to the conference system, please accurately fill in the invoice information in the billing instructions section of your personal information. 2. In cases where the name of the remitter does not match the participant's name, one unit makes payments for multiple representatives, or the unit requests separate invoices, please send detailed explanations by email to the secretariat at z38@cpa.org.cn, providing the remitter's name, participant's name, work unit, contact information, detailed information for issuing invoices, number of invoices and amounts, as well as the person receiving the invoice and the mailing address. 3. Representatives who are unable to attend the conference due to special reasons after making a payment can apply for a full refund of the registration fee by sending an email to the secretariat. The refund process will be handled collectively after the conference, and the refund will be made back to the original payment method. For accurate refunds, please indicate the full name and account information (account number, bank) of the original remitter in the refund application email. 8. Other matters: Accommodation and transportation expenses for participants are self-funded. Please refer to Attachment 2 for hotel booking and transportation information. 9. Conference credits: Full-time participants will be awarded 3 continuing education credits from the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association. 10. Contact person and contact information: 1. Contact person: Zhu Yizi (conference paper submission, registration fee payment, etc.) Peng Can, Duan Xiaohui, Lu Jia (conference consultation, accommodation arrangements, etc.) 2. Contact information: 010-67095606, 13956024560, 13956990010, 15212451687 3. Secretariat email: z38@cpa.org.cn Attachment 1. Hotel booking and transportation information.docx
