The security of the supply chain of pharmaceutical excipients used in high-end formulations in China urgently requires the strengthening of technical innovation and industrial support for domestically produced pharmaceutical excipients. At the same time, ensuring the quality of clinical medication, reducing drug costs, and alleviating the pressure on medical insurance, to a large extent, also depend on the improvement of the quality of domestically produced pharmaceutical excipients. In line with the principle of "promoting technological innovation in pharmaceutical excipients and enhancing the new productive forces of the pharmaceutical industry," the "2024 Annual Academic Conference of the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association," organized by the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association, is scheduled to be held in Hefei, Anhui Province from November 8th to 10th, 2024. This academic conference will feature conference reports in the fields of materials science related to pharmaceutical excipients, innovative drugs, and innovative formulations, analyzing the development difficulties and innovations of pharmaceutical excipients; inviting authoritative experts to deeply discuss the in vivo processes of pharmaceutical excipients and drug delivery carriers, as well as the improvement and innovation of excipient quality. The conference will set up expert venues and young scholar sub-venues on the themes of "Pharmaceutical Excipients, Packaging Materials, and Drug Delivery Devices," "New Materials, New Carriers, and Innovative Formulations," and "Pharmaceutical Excipients and Innovative Drugs," promoting the wide participation of enterprises, academia, and young scholars to jointly focus on the technological innovation and industrial research and development of pharmaceutical excipients. The relevant matters are hereby notified as follows: 1. Conference theme: Promoting technological innovation in pharmaceutical excipients and enhancing the new productive forces of the pharmaceutical industry. 2. Time and place: November 8th Registration Venue: Hefei Xinji Hotel (2766 Wenzhong Road, Yaohai District, Hefei City, Anhui Province) The main venue and sub-venues on November 9-10 are both at the Shaoquan Lake Campus of Anhui University of Chinese Medicine in Hefei, Anhui Province (350 Longzihu Road, Yaohai District, Hefei City, Anhui Province). 3. Conference arrangements: The conference will adopt the form of reports at the main venue and sub-venues. The conference will invite well-known experts and scholars from domestic universities, research institutes, pharmaceutical companies, research and development units, medical institutions, regulatory agencies, etc., to give keynote speeches and special lectures. Please refer to Annex 1 for the detailed schedule. 4. Participants: Researchers, managers, and graduate students engaged in research and development related to pharmaceutical excipients, pharmaceutical packaging materials, drug delivery devices, formulation quality control, formulation equipment, pharmaceutical services, etc., from universities, research institutes, pharmaceutical companies, research and development units, medical institutions, drug regulatory agencies, and other related institutions. 5. Call for papers: 1. Requirements for submission of papers: Chinese and English abstracts and paper format. Papers that have not been published in publicly distributed journals or presented at national academic conferences are the responsibility of the authors; please ensure clear expression and accurate data. We welcome active submissions from researchers in the pharmaceutical field. 2. Paper submission method: Please submit the abstract of the paper to the conference website https://yyfl2024.sciconf.cn before October 20, 2024, click on the "Online Paper Submission" button on the right, follow the process to upload your paper abstract, and you will receive an automatic email confirmation of the online submission. After the paper is reviewed by experts, the organizing committee will select several papers for further communication or publication in the "Drug Analysis" journal. 3. Poster submission method and time: Same as the paper. The conference welcomes poster submissions, which should be in A1 standard size. 6. Registration: (1) Registration method: 1. Please register by clicking on the "Individual Representative Registration" or "Group Representative Registration" button on the conference website link https://yyfl2024.sciconf.cn; 2. Or scan (or long-press to recognize) the QR code below with your mobile phone, click on the "Individual Representative Registration" or "Group Representative Registration" button to fill in the registration information and submit. (2) Registration deadline: The registration deadline is October 30, 2024. (3) Notes on registration: 1. To ensure that participants receive registration confirmation, invoices, etc., please fill in accurate and true information such as email address and mobile phone number; 2. This registration website is only for registration, and the payment channel is not yet open; 3. Registered participants can log in to the personal center of the conference website to check and modify their registration information; 4. Participants who do not submit papers can also attend the conference. 7. Conference fees: (1) Conference registration fee: 1. Registration fee includes conference material fee and lunch during the conference. 2. Payment methods: (1) Telegraphic transfer: After registering for the conference, participants should pay the registration fee by bank transfer, supporting both corporate and personal transfers to the following account: Payee: Chinese Pharmaceutical Association Bank: Bank of China Head Office Account number: 778350009320 It is recommended to use online banking on a computer or mobile phone for personal transfers, or use the transfer function of Alipay (transfer to a bank card, with the name field filled in as "Chinese Pharmaceutical Association"). Please indicate "Pharmaceutical Excipients + Participant's Name + Unit Abbreviation" in the remittance note. After successful payment, please upload the remittance voucher to the conference website in a timely manner for the secretariat to confirm the payment information and issue an invoice; (2) On-site payment: Registration fees can be paid through mobile online banking, or by scanning the payment QR code on-site (Alipay, WeChat) for transfer; there is no POS machine on-site, and payment methods such as card swiping and UnionPay QuickPass are not supported. (2) Invoice matters: 1. This conference can provide a VAT ordinary invoice for "conference registration fee" (electronic invoice). After uploading the personal remittance voucher (photo, screenshot, etc., of the complete order) to the conference system, please accurately fill in the invoice information in the billing instructions section of the personal information. 2. In cases where the name of the remitter does not match the participant's name, one unit remits for multiple representatives, or the unit requests separate invoices, please send detailed explanations by email to the secretariat at z38@cpa.org.cn, including the remitter's name, participant's name, work unit, contact information, detailed information for issuing the invoice, number and amount of invoices, and the person and address to receive the invoice. 3. Representatives who are unable to attend the conference due to special reasons after remittance can apply for a full refund of the registration fee by sending an email to the secretariat. The refund process will be handled collectively after the conference, and the refund will be returned along the original payment path. For accurate refund, please indicate the full name and account information (account number, bank) of the original remitter in the refund application email. 8. Other matters: Accommodation and transportation expenses for participants are self-funded. Please refer to Annex 2 for hotel booking and transportation information. 9. Conference credits: Full-time participants will be awarded 3 continuing education credits from the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association. 10. Contact person and contact information: 1. Contact person: Zhu Yizi (conference paper submission, registration fee payment, etc.) Peng Can, Duan Xiaohui, Lu Jia (conference consultation, accommodation arrangements, etc.) 2. Contact information: 010-67095606, 13956024560, 13956990010, 15212451687 3. Secretariat email: z38@cpa.org.cn Annex 1. title_en: Southbound funds hit a near nine-week high in trading volume this week, with three stocks receiving significant increases in holdings.
body_en: People's Wealth News on June 15th, Southbound funds continued to be active, with increasing participation in the Hong Kong stock market. According to Securities Times Data, the total turnover of Southbound funds this week reached 640.38 billion Hong Kong dollars, hitting a near nine-week high, an increase of 56.36% compared to last week. The total net purchase amount was 15.457 billion Hong Kong dollars, an increase of 3.55% compared to last week. In terms of active stocks this week, a total of 21 stocks made the list, with Xiaomi Group-W, Alibaba-W, Meituan-W, and Pinduoduo all having total turnover in the Hong Kong market exceeding 20 billion Hong Kong dollars this week, appearing on the list 10 times each (Shanghai-Hong Kong Stock Connect and Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect are calculated separately). Tencent Holdings had a total turnover of 18.834 billion Hong Kong dollars, appearing on the list 10 times. In terms of net purchase amount, Meituan-W received the highest net purchase amount from Southbound funds this week, reaching 3.605 billion Hong Kong dollars, with Meituan-W falling by 2.47% this week. Data shows that as of June 13th, Meituan-W has received continuous increases in holdings through the Hong Kong Stock Connect for 18 consecutive trading days, with the latest holding reaching 869 million shares, hitting a new high since May 2024. In terms of changes in holdings, 22 stocks this week saw a month-on-month increase in Southbound fund holdings of over 10%, with Yihai International, BYD Co., and China Everbright New Energy leading the way with increases of 116.02%, 40.38%, and 37.05% respectively, receiving significant increases in Southbound fund holdings.

title_en: Notice on holding the 2024 Academic Annual Conference of the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association (Second Round)
body_en: To all relevant units: Pharmaceutical excipients are an important foundation in China's pharmaceutical industry, and are one of the key factors determining the quality of generic drugs and the high-quality development of innovative formulations. The supply chain security of pharmaceutical excipients used in high-end formulations in China urgently needs to strengthen the technological innovation and industrial support for domestic pharmaceutical excipients. At the same time, ensuring the quality of clinical medication, reducing drug costs, and alleviating the pressure on medical insurance to a large extent also depend on the improvement of the quality of domestic pharmaceutical excipients. In line with the principle of "promoting technological innovation in pharmaceutical excipients and enhancing the new quality productivity of the pharmaceutical industry," the "2024 Annual Academic Conference of the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association," hosted by the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association, is scheduled to be held in Hefei, Anhui Province from November 8th to 10th, 2024. title_en: Exploring the multidimensional examination and innovative development path of ideological and political education in the new era.
body_en: Feng Shiyan Ideological and political education is the key course to implement the fundamental task of cultivating morality and nurturing people. It is not only a platform and carrier for knowledge dissemination, but also the main channel and main battlefield for guiding values, directly influencing students' ideals, values, and moral concepts. With the entry of socialism with Chinese characteristics into a new era, the transformation of the primary contradiction in society, the deep integration of globalization and informatization, and the diversification of youth values have put forward new and higher requirements for ideological and political education. This article examines the era characteristics, theoretical logic, and practical dilemmas of ideological and political education in the new era from a multidimensional perspective, and explores the direction of its high-quality development through innovative practice paths. Multidimensional Examination of Ideological and Political Education in the New Era Era characteristics: the unity of ideological guidance and practical orientation. Ideological and political education in the new era has a distinct ideological guidance, emphasizing guidance by Marxism, guiding students to strengthen the "four consciousnesses," firm up the "four confidences," and achieve the "two defends." At the same time, its practical orientation is reflected in the combination of theoretical teaching and social practice, enhancing students' sense of social responsibility and mission through activities such as voluntary service and rural revitalization research. Currently, some universities organize students to visit villages and enterprises inspected by General Secretary Xi Jinping, making the new ideas, thoughts, and strategies of governance tangible in perceptible practical scenarios, achieving the transformation of political discourse into life narratives. Theoretical logic: the integration of upholding the correct and innovation and interdisciplinary. Upholding the correct and innovation is the core methodology for the development of ideological and political education. On the one hand, it is necessary to adhere to the guiding position of Marxism and the core socialist values; on the other hand, it is necessary to combine technological changes in the era of data intelligence, explore the application of tools such as artificial intelligence and big data in teaching. Some universities use the model of "deep integration of science and education" to support ideological and political education with an academic framework, enhancing theoretical depth. In addition, the introduction of interdisciplinary perspectives (such as sociology, education, information technology, etc.) has provided a new paradigm for ideological and political education, promoting innovative integration of disciplines. Practical dilemmas: the challenge of fragmented resources and the lack of coordination among subjects. Currently, ideological and political education faces problems such as dispersed resources, abstract theories, and insufficient emotional resonance. Some universities tend to focus more on form than content in practical teaching, failing to effectively integrate regional characteristics with national strategies; at the same time, the lack of coordination between teacher leadership and student subjectivity leads to weak classroom interaction. In addition, the mechanism of "coordinated education between ideological and political courses and professional courses" is not yet perfect, leading to the phenomenon of "isolation." Innovative Development Path of Ideological and Political Education in the New Era Innovation of teaching content and methods. In the new era, ideological and political courses can construct a three-dimensional teaching content system based on the context of General Secretary Xi Jinping's inspections, forming a four-dimensional teaching framework of "historical breakthrough - new form of civilization - new journey of development - new paradigm of practice" through temporal and spatial narratives of core topics such as poverty alleviation, technological innovation, and ecological civilization, effectively solving the problem of the superficialization of ideological and political course content. At the same time, ideological and political education in the new era also needs to innovate teaching models, actively promote interactive methods such as blended teaching, situational simulation, and case discussions. For example, by combining ecological study with cultural dialogue through the "mobile classroom," enhancing students' immersive experience; using virtual reality technology to recreate historical scenes of the revolution, enhancing the infectivity of teaching. Empowerment of technology and transformation into data intelligence. Universities with conditions should actively develop intelligent educational tools, fully utilize big data to analyze students' cognitive patterns, draw "heat maps of learning" and "interest spectra," and achieve precise teaching. In the construction of online ideological and political platforms, new media resources such as WeChat public accounts and short videos can be integrated to create "micro-battlefields" and "cloud classrooms," realizing the sharing of high-quality course resources. Improvement of practical system and coordination mechanism. To deepen the connotation of practical teaching in the "grand ideological and political course," it is necessary to establish a long-term mechanism for coordinated education among government, enterprises, and universities, promoting the organic integration of "small ideological and political classrooms" and "large social classrooms." Taking the cooperation between Zhejiang University and Alibaba as a typical example, the two parties jointly carry out practical projects on "digital economy and social responsibility," allowing students to deepen their theoretical knowledge and enhance their application capabilities in real social scenarios, achieving a deep leap from knowledge dissemination to practical education. To build a "five-in-one integration" mechanism for education, ideological and political education needs to be deeply integrated into the construction of professional courses, campus cultural cultivation, and practical education, allowing values to resonate with knowledge dissemination, seamlessly connecting educational goals in professional education, letting ideological and political elements silently infiltrate the classroom, and promoting the formation of a comprehensive educational pattern for all staff, throughout the process, and in all aspects. Optimization of teacher training and evaluation system. To enhance the professional quality of the teaching staff, the "dual mentorship system of ideological and political teachers + subject experts" should be implemented to help teachers break through disciplinary barriers and improve interdisciplinary teaching capabilities. Currently, various universities rely on the "Ideological and Political Course Teaching Innovation Center" of Renmin University of China to regularly conduct systematic training to empower teachers for professional growth. In the construction of evaluation mechanisms, the single model of "scoring only" should be abandoned, and a dynamic evaluation system of "process assessment + practical results evaluation" should be established. Practical results such as voluntary service and research reports should be included in the assessment to comprehensively and three-dimensionally measure the effectiveness of students' learning, promote comprehensive development of students. Future prospects: Towards a new journey of connotative development In the context of the new era, the deepening development of ideological and political education needs to focus on three core directions: First, enhance strategic positioning and ideological consciousness. Based on the overall strategy of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation and the unprecedented changes in the world, accurately anchor the era orientation of ideological and political education, strengthen ideological guidance, enhance the ability to resist the erosion of erroneous ideologies, and build a solid ideological security line. Second, accelerate the deep integration of data intelligence technology. Actively explore innovative paths such as "artificial intelligence + ideological and political education," for example, using the characteristics of blockchain technology to build students' growth records, achieve precision and personalization in ideological and political education driven by data, and promote the innovation of education models. Third, expand the pattern of international exchanges and dialogues. View ideological and political education with a global perspective, systematically sort out and refine the practical experience and theoretical achievements of Chinese ideological and political education, actively participate in international ideological exchanges, contribute Chinese wisdom and solutions to the construction of a community with a shared future for mankind, and enhance the international discourse power of ideological and political education. The innovative development of ideological and political education in the new era is not only an inevitable requirement to respond to the challenges of the times but also a strategic choice to realize the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. By examining its era characteristics and practical dilemmas from multiple dimensions, and leading with upholding the correct and innovation, constructing a development path of "content-technology-practice-mechanism" in an integrated manner, ideological and political education can be promoted from being "meaningful" to "interesting," from "one-way indoctrination" to "two-way interaction," injecting lasting motivation into the new generation of the times who will bear the great responsibility of national rejuvenation. (Author's unit: Marxism College, Yongcheng Vocational College)

title_en: Government debt drives social financing.
body_en: On June 13, the People's Bank of China released financial data for May. The data shows that by the end of May 2025, the scale of social financing was 426.16 trillion yuan, an increase of 8.7% year-on-year, unchanged from the previous month. Among them, the balance of RMB loans issued to the real economy was 262.86 trillion yuan, an increase of 7% year-on-year, a decrease of 0.1 percentage points from the previous month; the balance of corporate bonds was 32.91 trillion yuan, an increase of 3.4% year-on-year, an increase of 0.2 percentage points from the previous month; the balance of government bonds was 87.39 trillion yuan, an increase of 20.9% year-on-year, unchanged from the previous month. In terms of the structure of outstanding loans, the balance of RMB loans issued to the real economy at the end of May accounted for 61.7% of the total social financing scale at the same period, a decrease of 1 percentage point year-on-year; the proportion of government bonds was 20.5%, an increase of 2.1 percentage points year-on-year; the proportion of corporate bonds was 7.7%, a decrease of 0.4 percentage points year-on-year. In terms of incremental changes, the cumulative increase in the scale of social financing in the first five months of 2025 was 18.63 trillion yuan, which was 3.83 trillion yuan more than the same period last year. Among them, RMB loans issued to the real economy increased by 10.38 trillion yuan, an increase of 112.3 billion yuan year-on-year; net financing of government bonds was 6.31 trillion yuan, an increase of 3.81 trillion yuan year-on-year; net financing of corporate bonds was 908.7 billion yuan, a decrease of 288.4 billion yuan year-on-year. Analysts pointed out that the rapid growth of social financing in May was mainly driven by direct financing such as government bonds and corporate bonds, with government bonds playing a major role. This year, the pace of government bond issuance has been accelerated, with a net financing scale of over 3.8 trillion yuan in the first quarter, an increase of 2.5 trillion yuan from the same period last year, especially with a significant increase in the issuance of special refinancing bonds for replacing implicit debts. In the second quarter, as the issuance of special refinancing bonds continues to advance, with the launch of special national bonds, the progress of net financing of government bonds has further accelerated, and there are signs of accelerated issuance of local new special bonds. The above-mentioned analysts also stated that corporate bond financing increased in May. Since the second quarter, the overall cost of corporate bond issuance has been on a downward trend, with the average yield of 5-year AAA-rated corporate bonds in May at 1.97%, further down from the low level in April. Against the backdrop of low interest rates, companies have increased their bond financing efforts, which helps to reduce the overall financing costs. The data shows that nearly 90% of the scale of social financing is made up of bonds and loans, and although the two have different applications, to some extent they can complement each other and create a good overall financial environment for stable economic growth. Authoritative sources told reporters that in recent times, the substitution effect of bonds for loans has been more pronounced, mainly due to the following three factors: First, the issuance of special refinancing bonds to repay bank loans, after the related impact is restored, the loan growth rate is still around 8%. In the short term, the debt replacement of financing platform debts to repay bank loans may affect the total credit volume, but in the long term, it will help alleviate local debt risks, free up more local financial resources for the benefit of the people, promote development, and enhance economic growth momentum. Second, government bonds are replacing bank loans. Some government bond investments overlap with bank loan investments, such as in infrastructure projects, where special bonds and bank loans can both serve as sources of funding. In the acquisition of existing commercial housing for affordable housing projects, in addition to bank loans, special bonds have recently been added to the policy toolbox and are gradually being implemented. For example, several banks in an eastern province have reported that since the beginning of this year, fiscal policies have become more proactive, with an increase in local government bond issuances. Local governments and related enterprises are more inclined to use special bonds to meet the funding needs of project construction, which has a certain substitutive effect on bank loans. Official data shows that in the first four months of this year, the source of fixed asset investment funds, including government bonds, increased by 16.7% year-on-year, significantly higher than self-raised funds (3.9%), domestic loans (2.8%), and other sources of funds (-4.2%). Third, corporate bonds are replacing bank loans. In addition to interest rate effects, some trend and institutional factors are also influencing the choice of financing for enterprises. In recent years, a series of supportive policies have been continuously introduced to facilitate corporate bond issuance, especially in the areas of private and technological innovation, where corporate bond financing has shown more positive changes. In early May, the People's Bank of China and the China Securities Regulatory Commission issued a number of measures to support the issuance of technology innovation bonds. As these measures are gradually implemented, the issuance of technology innovation bonds by enterprises will be facilitated. Furthermore, he pointed out that in the context of increasingly diverse financing channels and accelerated development of direct financing, the scale of social financing is more comprehensive than loans in measuring the strength of financial support. The transformation and upgrading of the economic structure cannot be achieved without the support of a financing system that is compatible with it. Direct financing has the characteristics of risk sharing, benefit sharing, and long-term companionship, and is more suitable for new areas of high growth, heavy research and development, and light assets, and will play a greater role in the financial system in the future. At the end of May, the broad money supply (M2) balance was 325.78 trillion yuan, an increase of 7.9% year-on-year; the narrow money supply (M1) balance was 108.91 trillion yuan, an increase of 2.3% year-on-year. Industry experts analyzed that the M1 statistical caliber currently includes currency in circulation (M0), unit and individual demand deposits, and non-bank payment institution customer reserves (such as WeChat Wallet, Alipay balance, etc.), which are considered as "active money" that is more convenient for payment transactions compared to fixed deposits in bank accounts. The growth rate of this "active money" in May has accelerated significantly, reflecting the effective boost in market confidence from recent comprehensive financial support measures, with signs of improvement in investment, consumption, and other economic activities. Data released by the National Bureau of Statistics recently showed that the manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) in May increased by 0.5 percentage points from the previous month, with the production index of the PMI increasing by 0.9 percentage points to 50.7% compared to the previous month, indicating marginal improvement in social confidence. Thanks to factors such as the increased efforts in policies supporting the "two new" industries, the growth rate of total retail sales of consumer goods this year has been significantly higher than the same period last year, with the number of domestic trips and consumption during the "May Day" holiday increasing by 6.4% and 8% year-on-year, respectively. Investment continues to expand, with rapid growth in investment in emerging industries, and the value added of high-tech manufacturing industries above a certain scale growing significantly faster than the overall manufacturing industry. External uncertainties still exist, but exports remain stable and growing. The data also shows that the CPI in May decreased by 0.1% year-on-year, unchanged from March and April; the core CPI, excluding food and energy prices, increased by 0.6% year-on-year, an increase of 0.1 percentage points from April. The PPI in May decreased by 3.3% year-on-year, compared to a decrease of 2.7% in the previous month, with a cumulative year-on-year decrease of 2.6% from January to May. Industry experts stated that overall, prices have remained low this year, mainly due to the contradictions between supply and demand in the real economy, as well as the impact of external factors such as the decline in international energy prices. In recent years, China's economic structure has been accelerating its transformation and upgrading, with some industries experiencing oversupply compared to demand, which has had an impact on the rise in prices. At the same time, it is also important to note that various macroeconomic policies are boosting domestic demand and the adjustment of supply-side policies is strengthening, accumulating positive factors to support the rise in prices. The interviewed industry experts also emphasized to reporters that promoting a reasonable increase in prices requires regulating the issue of excessive competition in certain industries. If an industry only competes on price and not on quality, it may eliminate the reasonable profit margin, which is not only detrimental to technological innovation by companies but also to ensuring product quality, and may have a spillover effect on upstream and downstream companies in the supply chain, leading to excessive competition in the entire industry chain. Boosting consumption is also seen as an important lever to promote a reasonable increase in prices. The experts mentioned that previous policies such as the "trade-in old for new" have had a significant effect on promoting consumption, and in the future, attention should be paid to increasing residents' disposable income and improving social security levels such as pensions, healthcare, and education, to fundamentally enhance residents' consumption capacity and willingness. They suggested further leveraging the income redistribution role of secondary distribution, focusing on increasing the income share of middle and low-income groups. In their view, the future should support the expansion of high-quality service consumption supply. China has gradually entered a stage of high-quality development, and the structure of residents' consumption is also optimizing and upgrading, with a continuous increase in demand for high-quality services. "In this process, it is necessary to properly grasp the relationship between finance and consumption." The experts admitted that consumer borrowing is essentially a form of pre-consumption behavior based on future income as collateral. Considering that the leverage ratio of Chinese residents is already high, the development of consumer finance should also consider the debt repayment capacity of consumers, focusing on exploring consumer credit customers supported by genuine consumption needs. Currently, the supply of high-quality service consumption in some inclusive areas is clearly insufficient, making it an important focus of future financial policy support for promoting consumption. He also reiterated to reporters that theoretically, lowering interest rates has a certain effect on promoting consumption, but the interest rate level for consumer loans is not necessarily the lower, the better. For residents, even if the interest rate for consumer loans is lower, there are still financing costs that need to be supported by income growth; from the perspective of banks, the interest rate level for consumer loans must cover operating costs, balancing financial support for consumption and the sustainable operation of financial institutions. If an industry only competes on price and not on quality, it may eliminate the reasonable profit margin, which is not only detrimental to technological innovation by companies but also to ensuring product quality, and may have a spillover effect on upstream and downstream companies in the supply chain, leading to excessive competition in the entire industry chain. Boosting consumption is also seen as an important lever to promote a reasonable increase in prices. The experts mentioned that previous policies such as the "trade-in old for new" have had a significant effect on promoting consumption, and in the future, attention should be paid to increasing residents' disposable income and improving social security levels such as pensions, healthcare, and education, to fundamentally enhance residents' consumption capacity and willingness. They suggested further leveraging the income redistribution role of secondary distribution, focusing on increasing the income share of middle and low-income groups. In their view, the future should support the expansion of high-quality service consumption supply. China has gradually entered a stage of high-quality development, and the structure of residents' consumption is also optimizing and upgrading, with a continuous increase in demand for high-quality services. "In this process, it is necessary to properly grasp the relationship between finance and consumption." The experts admitted that consumer borrowing is essentially a form of pre-consumption behavior based on future income as collateral. Considering that the leverage ratio of Chinese residents is already high, the development of consumer finance should also consider the debt repayment capacity of consumers, focusing on exploring consumer credit customers supported by genuine consumption needs. Currently, the supply of high-quality service consumption in some inclusive areas is clearly insufficient, making it an important focus of future financial policy support for promoting consumption. He also reiterated to reporters that theoretically, lowering interest rates has a certain effect on promoting consumption, but the interest rate level for consumer loans is not necessarily the lower, the better. For residents, even if the interest rate for consumer loans is lower, there are still financing costs that need to be supported by income growth; from the perspective of banks, the interest rate level for consumer loans must cover operating costs, balancing financial support for consumption and the sustainable operation of financial institutions. title_en: Do you still need to learn programming to develop intelligent agents without writing code?
body_en: Is it possible to develop an intelligent agent with a personalized interactive interface and a large model "brain" without writing any code? At the recent "Unicom Mingxi Cup" intelligent agent development competition, students from Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications achieved this. The initiator of the competition, Associate Professor of Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications and specially appointed expert in digital education, Xu Tong, introduced that in less than a month, undergraduate and graduate students from 13 colleges of the university, based on the self-developed teaching intelligent agent platform "Chufa" by the university's EZCoding student entrepreneurship team, developed over 200 intelligent agent works, including vocabulary challenge games, AI travel assistants, and more. Xu Tong believes that these intelligent agents are not only the result of student innovation but also a vivid manifestation of the trend of code-free intelligent agent development. He observed that since ChatGPT introduced the GPTs feature, allowing users to customize their own AI assistants in a code-free manner, the trend of code-free development of intelligent agents has gradually emerged. Currently, a series of code-free intelligent agent development platforms have been launched both domestically and internationally, including Baidu's Wenxin, Tencent's Yuanqi, Alibaba's Tongyi Xingchen, and iFlytek's Xingchen Agent platform. Why can many platforms achieve "code-free" development? Xu Tong explained that these platforms use large models as the "brain," which can autonomously handle some tasks, greatly reducing the workload of programming. At the same time, some code-free development platforms provide visual interfaces, allowing developers to complete the development of front-end interfaces and back-end workflows through operations such as dragging controls and writing prompts, thus significantly improving efficiency. He stated that currently, intelligent agents developed through code-free platforms are mainly divided into two categories: chat-based intelligent agents and application-based intelligent agents. In many vertical fields, chat-based intelligent agents may not meet the requirements, necessitating more powerful application-based intelligent agents with user experiences similar to applications (Apps). However, he learned that currently only a few platforms support the development of code-free application-based intelligent agents, including ByteDance's AI application development platform "Kouzi" and Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications' "Chufa" platform. He said that some intelligent agent development platforms do not yet have the functionality to develop code-free application-based intelligent agents, and even if some platforms do, they may have issues such as "few front-end controls" and "simple functions," making it difficult to meet the specific needs of various vertical fields. In Xu Tong's view, despite the existing limitations, the trend of developing code-free application-based intelligent agents is unstoppable. He believes that large model-driven, custom interfaces, and code-free development will become the mainstream mode of intelligent agent development. As long as there is good creativity, everyone may develop their own application-based intelligent agents in the future. As the trend of lowering the threshold for application development emerges, is it still necessary to learn programming? On the day of the interview, the technical director of the "Chufa" platform, undergraduate student Yang Zhongtian from Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, was given a task on the spot: to create an "editing intelligent agent" with functions to recognize and correct misspelled words, language errors, and expression risks. He dragged modules such as "buttons" and other front-end controls one by one into the operation interface, likening it to preparing "pre-made dishes." He then entered commands and prompts, directing the controls to run according to the requirements and in the appropriate order. Although this process of "communicating" with the computer does not require writing code, it still requires clear logic and reasonable arrangement, otherwise the "editing intelligent agent" may "strike" at any time. Yang Zhongtian said that although the operator does not need to write code themselves, they still need to have "programming thinking." As a teacher, Xu Tong also realizes that the trend of lowering the threshold for application development may lead to changes in programming education. He believes that the focus of teaching and learning modes will change in the future. The focus of programming education will gradually shift from learning programming techniques to learning programming thinking, innovative thinking, and problem-solving methods, while the learning mode will shift from traditional lecture-based learning to project-based learning, where students "learn and apply" in the practical process, greatly improving learning efficiency.

title_en: How did the small water town become the "top stream" in Shanghai?
body_en: Reporter Chen Jialin Last weekend, it was rainy and overcast. Driving into Hemu Village in Zhaoxiang Town, Qingpu District, the wheels rolled over the wet asphalt road. One moment, the view outside the car window was a cityscape with towering buildings; the next moment, vast fields and countryside scenery came into view. This seemingly inconspicuous village, traversed by the Xujing River, has more than 20 shops on both sides, forming a winding "Hemu Water Street," nurturing a unique rural economic format. Searching for "Hemu Village" on social platforms yields thousands of related shares, and many citizens and tourists drive from the city to visit. Located in the outskirts of Shanghai, how did a less than 300-meter water street become a new internet sensation? How did Hemu Village grasp the "traffic password" and become a "top stream" in Shanghai and a "model room" for rural revitalization? The reporter visited the site and made some observations. Riverside courtyards are fully occupied If the seamless transition from the city to the countryside momentarily confuses people, then the moment when Hemu Water Street (see Figure 4) comes into view can truly be described as a relaxing experience. Amidst the flowing water, the white walls and black tiles of the houses blend with the lush greenery; parasols and tables and chairs are placed by the riverbank, with some people "lying flat" to rest; next to the Seven-Colored Magpie Bridge, several aunts and uncles are enthusiastically posing for photos; strolling along the riverbank, there are groups of tourists walking together. The misty Hemu Water Street, although not as popular as a sunny day, exudes a sense of leisure and poetry. Walking further in, the riverside courtyards are each more "exquisite" than the last. Around 1 p.m., the restaurant "Hetian Mushi" is still bustling. With its wooden doors wide open, the spacious courtyard is filled with flowers, plants, and greenery. Jujube trees, pomegranate trees, and persimmon trees stretch their branches, and lanterns representing the twenty-four solar terms hang under the eaves; walking past the smoke-filled bluestone slabs, one can choose a bamboo chair and low table to sit around, drink coffee, chat, enjoy delicious food, and have a dog playing at their feet. Despite the unfavorable weather, the courtyard is still full. 36-year-old Ms. Wang, who lives in Xujing, came with her husband and two-year-old daughter, ordered a Mexican burrito and pasta, and enjoyed a leisurely outdoor time, "Our family are regulars here. We have been coming almost every other week since our daughter was six months old, and we stay for most of the day." Ms. Wang said that what attracts her most to the water street is the outdoor environment, which is especially suitable for family outings. She plays with her daughter and pets, while her husband goes to the riverbank with a net and bucket to catch fish. Occasionally, they catch rare species and put them in the fish tank at home. Not only local residents of Qingpu, but also many citizens from the city come to visit the water street. In less than a 5-minute walk, the tea and coffee house Sanmao Xiaoyuan is also bustling. Qi Zhenyi, in his sixties, holds an electric guitar and has started a small "concert" with a few aunts and uncles: order a pot of tea and snacks, and sing thirty to forty songs from morning till now. "We live in Xuhui District and came here on a friend's recommendation. Different from the hustle and bustle of the city, the environment here is quiet and peaceful. Drinking tea, chatting, playing music, we are very happy." Qi Zhenyi said. Less than 300 meters, each step brings a surprise. Men, women, old, and young can all find enjoyment at the water street. This scene makes people sigh: is this still the countryside in our memories? On social platforms, Hemu Village is called the "outlet's backyard." Dong Chunhui, the secretary of the village party branch, told the reporter that this is thanks to Hemu Village's superior geographical location - adjacent to the Dahongqiao Business District, only a hundred meters from the Qingpu Outlet Shopping Center, and not far from the Jiasong Middle Road Station on Metro Line 17 to the northwest. In addition to outstanding location conditions, the lively atmosphere of Hemu Village can also be traced back further: in the 1920s during the era of waterway transportation, there was a market at Luyu Bridge in the Xujing River basin, with streets built along the river, houses standing by the water, and bustling commercial activities. In 2021, nearly a hundred years later, due to the remarkable achievements in beautiful rural construction, Hemu Village became the third batch of demonstration villages for rural revitalization in Shanghai. "With the improvement of hardware, how to promote upgrading and attract industries has become our new focus." Dong Chunhui told the reporter that on the one hand, due to the gradual decline in traditional agricultural income and the continuous outflow of young people, many houses in the village have become vacant; on the other hand, the convenient transportation and developed commerce and trade in the advantageous location can bring huge potential customer flow. This has opened up a new train of thought for them - why not revitalize the idle residential land along the Xujing River and create a boutique rural consumer experience space? Village-enterprise cooperation, action-oriented. Through voluntary transfer and arrangements for the elderly, 23 farmhouses have been successfully transferred, providing a physical space carrier for the project. The Hemu Water Street is taking shape. Makers settle in and businesses thrive Wang Shouwei, the founder of Hetian Mushi, is from Shandong and has been in the furniture industry for 18 years. He has always had a dream of running a restaurant since he was young. In 2018, he accidentally stumbled upon the rapeseed flower sea in Hemu Village with his daughter, and had his first encounter with this small village. "It is quiet amidst the hustle and bustle here, like a 'Peach Blossom Spring,' it would be a pity not to do business here!" A casual expression of regret has created an indissoluble bond between Wang Shouwei and Hemu Village. As the fourth entrepreneur to sign up to settle in Hemu Village, Wang Shouwei was undoubtedly one of the first to try something new. During the May Day holiday in 2023, his self-designed and built Hetian Mushi officially opened, claiming to be a "courtyard filled with human fireworks," and it became popular immediately, breaking even in the first month and turning a profit in the second month. Hetian Mushi was not the first restaurant to open on Hemu Water Street, but its sudden popularity seemed accidental, yet inevitable. The reporter found that Hetian Mushi did not extensively renovate the original farmhouse but preserved the natural texture of the countryside. "Repairing the old as old respects the original architecture and perfectly integrates into the village's style, the courtyard that is both elegant and rustic allows customers to experience the rural atmosphere." Wang Shouwei revealed that at the peak of its popularity, the daily foot traffic exceeded a thousand, with a turnover of over 100,000 yuan. In fact, when Hetian Mushi settled in, there were only a few scattered merchants on the water street. Dong Chunhui admitted that the initial business recruitment was not as smooth as expected, as many merchants were hesitant. But Wang Shouwei was not worried; he believed, "Hemu Village already has a commercial foundation and natural charm. The precise match with the high-end customer positioning of the nearby outlets, business office buildings, villa areas, and the water street's high-end planning has the potential for commercial development." With the success of Hetian Mushi, Wang Shouwei opened the Front Yard Backyard (see Figure 1) and Hemu Yan She, covering multiple formats such as homestays, dining, and tea spaces. The Front Yard Backyard consists of four renovated farmhouses, with 25 rooms in various styles such as Chinese, Wabi-Sabi, and Nordic, featuring study rooms, dining rooms, tea rooms, pet playgrounds, fruit and vegetable picking gardens, bamboo forest tea spaces, and other leisure spaces, providing accommodation, tea breaks, parent-child entertainment, dining gatherings, etc. It was rated as the only five-star rural homestay in Qingpu District last year. During the May Day holiday this year, the total turnover of the three stores exceeded one million yuan. The investor of Sanmao Xiaoyuan, Yuan Sanmao, grew up in rural Shanxi and has a strong rural sentiment. As one of the earliest merchants to settle in Hemu Water Street, Yuan Sanmao has opened four stores on the water street, with an investment exceeding 20 million yuan. Among them, there is the Drink Light Mountain House, which is mainly a tea space suitable for business negotiations, as well as the Hemu Coffee and Sanmao Xiaoyuan, which are affordable and suitable for family and friends gatherings. At the end of May this year, the fourth store, the distinctive Turkish coffee shop "Tuwu TUTU," went online, blending exotic styles with rural charm, attracting many people to come and check in. In the afternoon, 58-year-old Chen Xin and her two sisters came out of the outlet shopping mall and found Tuwu TUTU through social media recommendations, each ordering a cup of Turkish coffee, "We live in Minhang and often come to Hemu Village. Seeing a new store opening, we stop by to rest and chat." To attract more visitors, in October 2023, Yuan Sanmao leveraged the store on the water street to create the "Hemu Persimmon Market" (see Figure 2), recruiting more than 30 fixed vendors, gathering original products such as intangible cultural heritage, handicrafts, and cultural and creative products, and carefully arranging popular attractions such as giant pandas (see Figure 3) and a popular boat. Every weekend, this market is bustling with people, achieving a two-way flow with the stores. Four seasons colorful, guests come in droves The four seasons of Hemu Water Street are colorful. In spring, the bright rapeseed flowers light up with vibrant vitality; in summer, the layers of rice fields turn into endless shades of green; in autumn, the dazzling golden colors surge in the waves of rice; in winter, the most festive Chinese red flows with warmth and joy. In the Front Yard Backyard, the reporter met Lou Xin, a photography enthusiast. He lives in Baoshan District and works near People's Square. He comes to Hemu Village for inspiration every once in a while, "It's easy to take good photos here. Sometimes when I want to shoot night scenes, I stay here for a night." Good scenery attracts new economies, and the market's sense of smell is the most sensitive. Dong Chunhui revealed that since Hetian Mushi became popular, more and more high-quality merchants have settled down, and a new business format of rural leisure tourism centered around the water street has naturally grown, forming a differentiated temperament and tone. South of the Xujing River is more high-end, with strong privacy, suitable for business receptions; north of the Xujing River is more popular, relatively open, and has a strong market atmosphere. As the business formats on the water street continue to diversify, a large influx of customers follows. During holidays, Dong Chunhui always looks out the duty room window, "When the traffic increases, we immediately send volunteers to maintain order." To provide a better playing experience, Hemu Village has unearthed nearly 400 parking spaces to meet the parking needs during peak hours. For the residents of Hemu Village, the water street brings not only popularity and liveliness but also new business opportunities. Not far from the water street, villager Chen Lian took back the farmhouse she had rented out. Having done online business and operated a Taobao store, she returned to her hometown to start a business and opened a private kitchen called "Xixianzhai," with two floors - the first floor serving farmhouse dishes and the second floor serving private dishes. Through word of mouth, the team expanded to 15 people, with over a hundred dishes on the menu. During holidays, business is booming, and reservations are required in advance. With the water street, Hemu Village has undergone a transformation, and some villagers have found new job opportunities. The reporter noticed that whether it was the Drink Light Mountain House, Sanmao Xiaoyuan, or the Front Yard Backyard, the vegetable gardens in the courtyards were preserved, and villagers were hired to cultivate local vegetables and fruits, allowing customers to experience the joy of picking. "The Hemu Water Street has brought a significant increase in foot traffic, making the villagers' wallets fuller." Dong Chunhui told the reporter that after the residential land was transferred, the villagers received higher rents than when they managed it themselves, and the rents are regularly increased proportionally. He said that next, Hemu Village will extend the water street area, introduce more business formats, comprehensively upgrade roads, lighting, and other infrastructure, build more integrated agricultural, cultural, and tourism spaces on the basis of thousands of acres of good farmland, and create Hemu Water Street 2.0. Wang Shouwei noticed a "Ginkgo Stroll Forest" in the rice fields near Hemu Water Street. He plans to continue expanding his business in Hemu Village and open a "Coffee Pet Fun Park" in the forest space, expected to open by the end of this year. As night falls and the lights come on, the night falls on Hemu Water Street. Many villagers also come to the viewing platform to enjoy the night. Dong Chunhui looks forward to more diverse nighttime economic formats being injected into Hemu Village in the future, injecting new vitality into rural revitalization.

title_en: The Chinese Culinary Association held a quarterly work meeting of the Food Safety Research Group.
body_en: On the afternoon of June 10th, the quarterly work meeting of the Food Safety Research Group of the China Cuisine Association was successfully held at the association. Food safety management personnel and related representatives from chain brand catering enterprises such as Yum China, Haidilao, Starbucks, McDonald's, Luckin Coffee, Dicos, Meituan, and Ele.me attended the meeting. Wang Xuelian, Deputy Director of the Catering Department of the Beijing Municipal Market Supervision Administration, fully exchanged views with representatives of participating enterprises to understand the effective measures and methods of chain catering enterprises in implementing food safety main responsibility. At the same time, the meeting summarized the work of the Food Safety Research Group in the second quarter in food safety risk discussions, legal research, standard construction, etc., and reported the focus of the next quarter's work to member units of the Food Safety Research Group, including the release of good food safety case studies, standard construction, and other work. Representatives of participating enterprises expressed professional opinions on related topics.

title_en: "In the heart there is love, in the hands there is AI" - they who have been changed, and they who change.
body_en: What does the encounter between rural women and digital technology mean? Ma Xuemei from Wangtuan Town, Tongxin County, Ningxia, said: "Thanks to the good policies of the country, the 'Go, Mulan' project saved me and my children." Zhao Xinyuan from Boxing County, Shandong, said: "The 'Women in New Agriculture' support program has provided a new stage for rural revitalization for returnee female entrepreneurs like us." Zhu Xiaoling from Yijun County, Shaanxi, said: "I am a farmer and an AI trainer. The 'AI Bean Project' has changed my life and also changed my hometown." All of this stems from a "handshake" in 2023. In June 2023, the "Intelligent and Beneficial Women" public welfare project jointly launched by the China Women's Development Foundation and the Zhejiang Ant Public Welfare Foundation officially started, launching a series of projects including the "Go, Mulan" women's public welfare insurance project, the "Women in New Agriculture" support program, and the "AI Bean Project," exploring a new path of "digital technology + public welfare." By the end of 2024, the project had invested a total of 64 million yuan, benefiting more than 2.7 million women and families in difficulty. Now, the eagerly awaited good news has come again. The "Intelligent and Beneficial Women" public welfare project has ushered in an upgrade in strategic cooperation. As more and more women benefit from the "Intelligent and Beneficial Women" project, as their lives are changed by digital technology, they will also firmly grasp digital technology in their hands and catch the fast-moving train of the times. Digital technology + public welfare, with results On May 23, the strategic cooperation upgrade event of the "Intelligent and Beneficial Women" public welfare project jointly launched by the China Women's Development Foundation and the Zhejiang Ant Public Welfare Foundation was held in Beijing. It is understood that although 2025 is the third year of the "Intelligent and Beneficial Women" public welfare project, it is the seventh year that the China Women's Development Foundation and the Ant Group have jointly carried out public welfare projects and cared for and supported women in underdeveloped areas. Love has gathered, allowing women in underdeveloped areas to receive medical and employment support, and women and families who have suffered losses in major disasters have also received economic assistance. "Along the way, we have witnessed many touching stories and seen many real changes. Women who were once trapped in the shadow of illness have regained confidence in life, sisters who stayed in the countryside have mastered digital skills to achieve economic independence, and female entrepreneurs have led more people onto the path of prosperity," said Du Rui, Chairperson of the China Women's Development Foundation. Protecting the physical health of women in underdeveloped areas, providing scholarships for women in difficulty, the "Go, Mulan" public welfare project was born. As of now, it has raised more than 230 million yuan, covering 62 counties in 18 provinces, and nearly 5.6 million impoverished women have received project guarantees. Caring for the healthy growth of families in difficulty, helping grassroots implement the "Love Mom" pairing assistance task, under the guidance of the All-China Women's Federation, the China Women's Development Foundation launched the "Love Warms Every Home" public welfare action in 2024, which has landed in 119 counties in 31 provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities, and the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, establishing 119 teams of more than 5,000 loving mothers, providing care and support services to 12,200 families in difficulty, benefiting nearly 2 million people. Supporting rural women in underdeveloped areas in employment and entrepreneurship, the "AI Bean Project" tailored for them, helping them engage in various businesses such as finance, unmanned driving, customer service, and medical care through mastering digital technology, truly providing them with the opportunity to "have a brilliant life and make their dreams come true." By the end of 2024, the "AI Bean Project" had carried out digital empowerment training and employment assistance for women in 16 districts and counties in 7 provinces including Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Guizhou, training a total of 9,922 people, with 7,508 people passing the assessment and earning an average monthly income of 3,000-4,000 yuan. At the same time, the "Women in New Agriculture" support program, officially launched in 2024, will also create new opportunities for rural women to make contributions and achievements in the characteristic industries of the countryside. Public welfare always has a warm background, and now, with the support of digital technology, this warmth from the "family" can reach the hearts faster. Digital technology + public welfare, efficient "I didn't expect it to be so fast and convenient." A claim of 20,000 yuan relieved Ma Xuemei of the economic pressure when she was ill, and the claim speed of 5 hours made her both surprised and delighted. "Being sick is like racing against the disease. The efficient operation of this system has bought me time." Ma Xuemei still remembers the moment she received a bank account message while lying in the hospital bed, tears flowing uncontrollably. Ma Xuemei looked at the message over and over again, filled with endless gratitude. Ma Xuemei said, "Go, Mulan" not only reduced the economic burden on her family in terms of medical care, but her daughter also received thousands of yuan in assistance for three consecutive years through the application process. The "family" system also fought for her "two-cancer special assistance" and enjoyed temporary assistance and "low-income support" policies. Now, Ma Xuemei's condition is under control. In addition to her work, she has also become a "spokesperson" for "Go, Mulan," often sharing her story and bringing hope to sisters in similar difficulties. In the operation of the "Go, Mulan" project, the application of digital technology allows more "Ma Xuemei" to receive help more efficiently. It is reported that the "Go, Mulan" project uses front-end image recognition, AI intelligence, and blockchain technology in the insurance and claims process, not only improving the efficiency of project implementation but also enabling the project to expand coverage to counties and benefit more impoverished women in underdeveloped areas with public welfare insurance. On this point, Ma Xuelian, Vice Chairman of the Women's Federation of Dongxiang Autonomous County, Gansu, and also the liaison officer when the "Go, Mulan" project landed in Dongxiang Autonomous County, has deep feelings. "Over the years, I have witnessed the tremendous changes that the 'Intelligent and Beneficial Women' project has brought to Dongxiang women." Ma Xuelian said excitedly, "One family after another has rekindled hope, and Dongxiang women have regained their smiles. They have not only successfully fought against diseases but have also gained a precious strength in this process, supporting them to bravely pursue their dreams and strive for self-improvement." Digital technology + public welfare, with a future At the junction of the Guanzhong Plain and the Loess Plateau in northern Shaanxi, there is a group of rural women who, during busy farming seasons, work in the fields, husking corn and fertilizing; during idle farming seasons, they sit in offices, completing a series of AI training tasks on computers. Zhu Xiaoling is one of them. In July 2024, Zhu Xiaoling participated as an AI trainer in the first phase of the company's vocational skills level certification exam and passed. "The certificate is an affirmation of my work. With a skill, I have confidence to go further in this industry," Zhu Xiaoling said. All of this is thanks to the landing of the "AI Bean Project" public welfare project in Yijun County. With the development of digital technology, the digital economy has become the core engine driving economic growth, social progress, and technological innovation. What development opportunities can women seize from this? With this question in mind, the "AI Bean Project" public welfare project was born. Over the past five years, with the support of grassroots governments, the "AI Bean Project" public welfare project has provided free training in new digital technology skills for economically disadvantaged women with basic education levels who have returned to, entered, or stayed in rural areas, and through a series of assistance such as assessment, application, and stable employment, it has helped economically disadvantaged women in rural areas achieve high-quality employment "at their doorstep." "Statistics show that women entrepreneurs in the Internet field account for 55%. But we also see that in underdeveloped areas, women still face a digital divide, with limited resources and technological barriers becoming stumbling blocks on their path forward," Du Rui said. "The upgrade of the 'Intelligent and Beneficial Women' project, with precise efforts in improving women's digital literacy, researching scientific research topics, and building a global cooperation and exchange platform, is of great significance and far-reaching impact. This is not only a precise response to the needs of women but also a mission to fulfill social responsibility." In the future, the upgraded "Intelligent and Beneficial Women" project may help more women improve their digital literacy, seize opportunities in the digital economy wave, realize their self-worth; bring more warmth and hope to families in difficulty, ensure women's rights, make life more colorful, and make life happier. (According to "China Women's News")

title_en: Dairy and Baking Synergistically Drive Yiming Foods' Steady Performance Growth
body_en: By reporter Wu Jixia Trainee reporter Wang Nan On June 16, Zhejiang Yinming Food Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Yinming Food") held its 2024 Annual and First Quarter 2025 Performance Briefing. During the briefing, the company's management engaged with attendees on issues of concern to investors. At the performance briefing, Zhu Lifu, Chairman of Yinming Food, stated: "In 2024, the company closely follows consumption trends and understands consumer needs, persisting in building brand connotations centered on freshness and health. We are launching more trustworthy, delicious, and fashionable products and services, focusing on brand tags such as 'nutritious breakfast at your doorstep,' 'healthy relay meal for young white-collar workers,' and 'Starbucks for kids.'" Over the past year, under the guidance of its fresh and healthy strategy, Yinming Food has continuously advanced brand upgrades and business format expansion, with stable and increasing operating performance. The company achieved an annual operating revenue of 2.751 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 4.09%. Net profit attributable to shareholders of the listed company reached 28.9438 million yuan, a year-on-year increase of 30.16%. Yinming Food has taken the lead in revolutionizing consumption methods such as the "School Children's Milk Program," "Milk Delivery to Home," and "True Fresh Milk Bar." Through its "Central Factory" and "Chain Stores" combined "Dairy + Baking" chain store sales model, it has formed a comprehensive business scale that is more competitive than traditional single dairy or baking enterprises. Public data shows that as of the first quarter of 2025, Yinming Food had a total of 1897 operating stores. Among these, there were 1407 franchised stores and 490 directly operated stores, with 10 stores signed and awaiting opening. Compared to 2024, the number of operating stores decreased by 71. In response, Lin Yilei, Secretary of the Board of Directors of Yinming Food, told a reporter from Securities Daily that the net decrease in stores in the first quarter was mainly due to structural optimization. On one hand, the company adheres to a "quality-first" expansion strategy, actively closing some stores whose operational efficiency did not meet expectations. On the other hand, some stores chose to exit in an orderly manner due to lease expiration or the non-renewal of franchise contracts. In terms of product strategy, Yinming Food promotes a strategy of large single products based on scenarios. Concurrently, Yinming Food is resolutely advancing its large single product strategy. For example, its Jersey milk topped the sales chart for single products on the Tmall platform from May to June 2024. Yinming Food is also actively exploring the development of new business formats, focusing on creating a composite business format of "milk bar + light catering," steadily expanding product lines such as pizza and coffee, and gradually forming a cooperation network in channels like group catering. Although the new brands are still in the trial stage, their recognition and penetration among young consumers and office white-collar workers are continuously increasing, laying the foundation for the formation of a second growth curve in the future. Zhu Lifu told a reporter from Securities Daily that Houbi Pizza and Yicheng Coffee, as important extensions of the company's strategy, are currently steadily advancing their incubation and channel integration. As of now, "Houbi Pizza" is sold in approximately 400 stores, and "Yicheng Coffee" covers 105 milk bar channels. It has also achieved point-of-sale landings in B-end scenarios such as office buildings and medical institutions. Entering the first quarter of 2025, Yinming Food continued to maintain its performance growth. The company achieved an operating revenue of 654 million yuan, a year-on-year increase of 1.75%. Net profit attributable to shareholders of the listed company reached 13.3067 million yuan, a year-on-year increase of 28.38%. Looking ahead, Zhu Lifu stated that the company adheres to the goal of "building China's leading milk bar chain brand and a leading enterprise in fresh and healthy food." It will focus on its core businesses of dairy and baking, develop core products such as Jersey milk, organic milk, and functional baked goods, increase the proportion of new product sales, create more healthy products with explosive potential, and drive long-term revenue growth.
