title_en: iQiyi takes the initiative to lay out, while Youku and Tencent are cautious and watchful.
body_en: For VR movies, mainland mainstream video platforms iQiyi, Youku, and Tencent Video have different reactions. Public information shows that iQiyi was involved the earliest, producing more than 20 VR video contents in 2017, including "City of No Owner" and "Hot Blood Street Dance Troupe VR," which were linked to popular TV dramas. An industry insider revealed anonymously that due to the low penetration rate of headsets in the consumer market and weak willingness to pay from users, iQiyi's VR department had undergone large-scale layoffs and shifted towards offline scenarios. In 2023, iQiyi launched the "Wind Rising in Luoyang" VR immersive theater in Shanghai, developed based on the popular TV series IP of the same name, integrating live performance and VR immersive interactive technology, making it the world's first VR immersive cross-dimensional interactive entertainment project. To date, iQiyi's self-developed "Wind Rising in Luoyang," "Tang Dynasty Strange Tales: Journey to the West," and "Canglan Jue" series of immersive theater projects have been completed in over 40 stores nationwide, covering more than 20 cities, and established the world's first iQiyi theme park in Yangzhou, combining IP to create an XR large space experience area, aiming to open this year. The industry insider said, "Mainland video platforms are all imitating the 'Disney + Netflix' dual-track model: Netflix focuses on high-quality original content as its core competitiveness, while Disney achieves value maximization through the full industry chain development such as theme parks; mainland platforms want to create hit content (following the Netflix path) while also aspiring to develop IP deeply like Disney (such as building a Chinese version of a theme park). iQiyi is actively laying out offline physical experiences, trying to transform film and television IP into Disney-style physical entertainment projects, achieving a 'content + experience' business closed loop." The industry insider mentioned that Disney and Universal Studios have provided successful models for the combination of "IP + VR," with projects like Disney's "Rise of the Resistance" and Universal Studios' "Forbidden Journey of Harry Potter" proving that VR technology's application in offline theme parks is relatively mature. These projects rely on strong IP (such as Disney's classic characters, movie scenes) and sophisticated interactive design to transform VR technology into highly engaging entertainment products, becoming industry benchmarks. He added, "I believe the short-term opportunity for VR lies in the combination of offline scenarios and strong IP, for example, developing offline VR parks using strong IPs like 'Nezha,' restoring movie scenes through headsets + roller coasters, and designing NPC interactions, which may break through bottlenecks. This model draws on Disney's IP operation logic, transforming VR into an 'IP monetization tool.'" Film and television platforms need to deeply develop IP commercial value The industry insider said, "Current film and television platforms face a core dilemma: the vast majority of TV series and movies struggle to be profitable through traditional broadcasting models. A series usually only has a one-month period of popularity, and relying solely on subscription and advertising revenue cannot cover the high production costs. This forces platforms to deeply develop the commercial value of IP, such as launching blind box peripherals (similar to the Pop Mart model), developing fan economies, and other diversified monetization channels. iQiyi's choice to build offline parks is an extension of this commercial logic—expanding profit points through ticket sales." "Unlike Tencent Video and Youku, iQiyi, as an independently listed company, faces more severe profit pressure. Tencent Video and Youku are backed by Tencent and Alibaba Group, while iQiyi needs to be directly accountable to shareholders. Film and television content itself has a high degree of uncertainty, with numerous examples proving that even with large investments and famous directors, a hit product is not guaranteed. This content risk is directly reflected in financial performance, forcing platforms to find a second growth curve (such as offline entertainment) to balance business risks and demonstrate sustainable profitability to shareholders. Film and television platforms may need to restructure their business models—from 'content providers' to 'IP operators,' reducing reliance on single content through the full industry chain development, which may be the strategic essence of iQiyi's layout of offline ecology." The industry insider pointed out that Tencent Video and Whale Entertainment are also laying out IP. "Whale Entertainment's core IP layout is 'Ali Fish,' which controls the authorization resources of top IPs globally, providing authorization support for the development of blind boxes, toys, and other derivative products, and relying on Youku and Damai Entertainment's two core platforms to achieve all-round development of IP: producing online content such as TV series and variety shows through Youku, and carrying out offline businesses such as movie production, live performances, and OST concerts through Damai Entertainment. This 'one fish, multiple meals' model has formed an entertainment consumption ecosystem covering online and offline scenarios, maximizing the value of IP." "In general, I believe the industry is currently in a game of cautious observation and policy-driven development. Compared to iQiyi, Tencent Video, Whale Entertainment, and other platforms are adopting conservative strategies, taking a cautious attitude towards VR movies, with their focus still on content production and the full industry chain development of IP, such as TV series, offline performances, and derivative products." He said, "The core of cultural consumption products such as film and television variety shows is always 'content quality.' Only when the content is of high quality and recognized by users will other forms of media extension be considered. Classic content has the vitality to transcend cycles, and the industry has shifted from the past model of burning money for expansion to focusing on deepening content, confirming the logic of 'quality content driving long-term value.' He revealed that compared to directly laying out VR movies, Whale Entertainment now tends to serve content production through virtual shooting technology, perhaps stemming from the platform's doubts about the commercial logic of VR movies—whether users are willing to pay for immersive content outside of cinemas still needs time to verify."

title_en: Farewell to Zero-Sum "War of Attrition," E-commerce Platforms Shake Hands to Expand Global Markets Together "618" New Observations:
body_en: By Our Reporter Zhang Min And Intern Reporter Liang Aonan As an important annual event for promoting consumption, "618" is undoubtedly a key window for observing new trends in the consumer market. With the introduction of measures to curb "involutionary" competition, this year's "618" sees the e-commerce industry united under the banner of "anti-involution." Signals from major e-commerce platforms like JD.com, Tmall, Meituan, and Douyin indicate that users are bidding farewell to complex promotional calculations, the merchant ecosystem is continuously being repaired, and platforms are breaking down payment and logistics barriers. The development logic of the e-commerce industry is being reshaped: moving away from zero-sum "attrition wars" and establishing a new ecosystem of symbiotic evolution. E-commerce platforms are reshaping the consumer market landscape with a return to value, and the path of adjustment and optimization has already begun. User Experience Upgrade: No More Complex Calculations Needed Looking back at last year's "618," StarChart data shows that the cumulative sales of comprehensive e-commerce platforms and live-streaming platforms declined by nearly 7% year-on-year, marking the first-ever negative growth in history. When "trick marketing" piled high with complex rules reached its efficiency ceiling, consumers grew tired of the convoluted discount information. This year's "618" promotion, however, has escaped the quagmire of "routine involution." Consumers no longer need to rack their brains over full discounts and stacking coupons (by using different types or sources of coupons to get larger discounts). Platforms are launching direct "instant discounts" strategies, signaling a fundamental shift in promotional logic. On June 18th, this reporter opened the Tmall App and found that banners for "618 instant discounts starting from 85% off" and "618 flash sales" were very prominent on the homepage. Taking a fully automatic coffee machine priced at 1,999 yuan as an example, its product detail page clearly showed that after using official instant discounts, official subsidies, and store coupons, an additional 9% off coupon from an 88VIP account could be stacked. When this reporter clicked to checkout, the system automatically applied all coupons, and the final payment price displayed was 648.80 yuan. The entire shopping process was simple and convenient, requiring no complex calculations. "Consumers simply don't buy into complex promotional activities," Mr. Cheng, an operations manager at an e-commerce platform, admitted to a reporter from Securities Daily. "Previously, we only focused on GMV and user growth. Now, we are more concerned with user retention rates and product repurchase rates, as these are the true indicators of capability." The simplification of gameplay has led to a significant improvement in transaction efficiency. On the first day of this year's "618," nearly 800 brands on Meituan Flash Purchase saw their transaction volume double year-on-year. On Tmall's "618," 43 brands exceeded 100 million yuan in transaction volume within the first hour of sales, and 13,000 brands doubled their transaction volume. During the first hour of JD.com's "618," transaction volume, order volume, and the number of users placing orders all increased by over 200% year-on-year. The consumer market is presenting a new landscape of rationality and diversity. As Hong Yong, an expert at the China Forum for Digital-Real Integration 50, stated, abandoning complex gameplay not only enhances the consumer experience but also aligns with consumers' focus on product quality, value for money, and services. Commercial Ecosystem Optimization: Reducing the Burden and Increasing Efficiency for Merchants From the merchants' perspective, they are shifting from "survival of the fittest" to "support and symbiosis," and the imbalanced commercial ecosystem is being reshaped. Major e-commerce platforms are prioritizing platform governance and improving the business environment for merchants, with ecosystem construction and service quality upgrades taking center stage. The "2024 E-commerce Platform 'Refund Only' Investigation Report" indicates that among the survey samples, 25% of users use the "refund only" service to "snatch up deals." In March of this year, Luo Wen, Director of the State Administration for Market Regulation, introduced at the first "Ministers' Corridor" of the 14th National People's Congress, Third Session, that efforts will be made this year to optimize regulatory methods and means to vigorously promote the healthy development of the platform economy. To address the prominent issue of platforms abusing "refund only" rules, leading to merchants losing both goods and money, platforms will be urged to clarify the scope and specific circumstances for the application of these rules. Furthermore, regarding prominent issues such as platforms implementing "automatic price following" and "lowest price on the entire network" rules, platforms will be urged to standardize promotional activities. On the eve of "618," mainstream e-commerce platforms comprehensively canceled the "refund only" policy. Requests for "refund without returning goods" after consumers receive their orders will be handled by merchants themselves. "Macro policies have created significant opportunities for the development of the e-commerce industry. By decoupling 'refund only,' upgrading shipping insurance, and moving away from low-price involution, we can effectively address long-standing problems in the e-commerce industry and bring about a positive and stable business environment," stated Chu Duan, Vice President of Alibaba Group Holding Limited (hereinafter referred to as "Alibaba") and President of the Taobao Platform Business Unit. Intensive "real money and silver" burden-reduction actions have also been implemented. Taobao and Tmall have launched 12 sets of merchant-benefiting measures to comprehensively improve the business environment. JD.com has broken through traffic barriers with "zero commission entry" and strengthened merchant competitiveness with "10 billion subsidies." Douyin E-commerce has significantly lowered the deposit threshold and launched a "0 yuan trial operation for all categories." A healthy ecosystem where consumers dare to buy, merchants dare to sell, and platforms dare to innovate is accelerating its formation in the crucible of "618." Platform "Dismantling Walls and Breaking Barriers": From Closed Internal Strife to Open Traffic Attraction This year's "618" sees major e-commerce platforms proactively dismantling the walls of traffic blockade, payment fragmentation, and logistics isolation, embarking on a path of win-win cooperation. Payment and logistics, two business areas once considered core barriers by e-commerce, have now become breakthroughs for platform cooperation. In this year's "618" promotion, consumers can experience using WeChat Pay to purchase Taobao items, and JD Logistics delivering goods for Tmall merchants. Wu Jia, Vice President of Alibaba and President of the Taotian User Platform Business Unit, stated that since integrating WeChat Pay, the usage frequency of young users and users in lower-tier markets on Taobao has also increased. Data from commercial intelligence data service provider QuestMobile shows that in May of this year, the scale of overlapping users between Taobao and WeChat increased by 6.7% year-on-year, reaching 875 million. The scale of overlapping users between JD.com and Alipay increased by 20.4% year-on-year, reaching 581 million. Furthermore, a grand alliance has been formed among major e-commerce platforms, with new cooperative relationships constantly emerging. On the eve of "618," Taobao and Tmall collaborated with Xiaohongshu to create the "Red Cat Plan," integrating the entire journey from "seed planting" to purchasing. JD.com has also integrated Xiaohongshu's direct link functionality and partnered with the regional retail leader Pang Donglai to strengthen its fulfillment capabilities through its physical network. "Before, if I saw something I wanted to buy on Xiaohongshu, I had to take a screenshot and then search for it on e-commerce platforms to buy it. This year for '618,' I can jump directly between platforms, and the shopping experience is becoming increasingly seamless," said Ms. Yu, a consumer, to this reporter. Guo Tao, Deputy Director of the China E-commerce Expert Service Center, stated that in a market with maturing growth and limited incremental opportunities, e-commerce platforms are beginning to embrace "traffic giants." This is essentially a desire to win allies and expand more traffic sources, further driving the commercial scale of the e-commerce ecosystem. Incremental Market Development: Global Gold Mining is Now the Time With domestic traffic reaching its peak, "going global" has become the inevitable choice for e-commerce platforms seeking new growth. In 2024, China's cross-border e-commerce imports and exports reached 2.63 trillion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 10.8%. The potential of cross-border e-commerce in "selling globally" is being further unleashed, and its advantage in "buying globally" continues to be leveraged. The global network of infrastructure is accelerating the pace of "going global." Since April, downloads of DHgate, Taobao, and Alibaba.com on the US App Store have surged. "Going global" has become an important strategy for e-commerce platforms to help merchants achieve new growth. It is understood that the number of merchants participating in Tmall's 2025 "618" overseas event has exceeded one million. Hang Xin, head of Tmall Taobao's overseas growth plan, told a reporter from Securities Daily that "going global" not only expands new markets for merchants but also drives explosive growth in some industries. Among them, cross-border transaction volumes in 11 categories on the Taobao platform, including beauty and skincare, sports shoes, and milk powder, have doubled year-on-year. On June 17th, Liu Qiangdong, founder of JD.com, stated: "I hope that one day I can hand over all domestic business to the CEO as soon as possible, and I will devote myself full-time to international business." An insider from Alibaba International Station told reporters that the platform is currently holding a major promotion for the US market in June. This promotion will not only allow Chinese foreign trade merchants to enjoy overseas traffic support and receive foreign orders but will also benefit more "beginner merchants" interested in foreign trade business through promotional policies. "For Chinese enterprises to achieve high-quality global development, they must enhance their brand power to extend their product capabilities and elevate their value. We have good products and strong manufacturing capabilities, but we still lack the ability to 'tell' and 'spread' these advantages. Brands need not only to 'do well' but also to 'speak well'," said Wu Yulin, Senior Business Development Director of The Trade Desk China, a digital advertising technology company, to reporters. The essence of this "going global" wave is value reconstruction. E-commerce platforms will use cross-border infrastructure as their vessel, and merchants will use product innovation as their oars, jointly sailing towards the deep waters of brand building, where "doing well is as important as speaking loudly." As Zhuang Shuai, a retail e-commerce industry expert and visiting consultant for the China Chain Store & Franchise Association, put it, the main theme for e-commerce platforms in 2025 will be "anti-involution" and a return to value. The evolutionary story of China's e-commerce ecosystem has turned a new page.

As Hong Yong, an expert at the China Forum for Digital-Real Integration 50, stated, abandoning complex gameplay not only enhances the consumer experience but also aligns with consumers' focus on product quality, value for money, and services. Commercial Ecosystem Optimization: Reducing the Burden and Increasing Efficiency for Merchants From the merchants' perspective, they are shifting from "survival of the fittest" to "support and symbiosis," and the imbalanced commercial ecosystem is being reshaped. Major e-commerce platforms are prioritizing platform governance and improving the business environment for merchants, with ecosystem construction and service quality upgrades taking center stage. The "2024 E-commerce Platform 'Refund Only' Investigation Report" indicates that among the survey samples, 25% of users use the "refund only" service to "snatch up deals." In March of this year, Luo Wen, Director of the State Administration for Market Regulation, introduced at the first "Ministers' Corridor" of the 14th National People's Congress, Third Session, that efforts will be made this year to optimize regulatory methods and means to vigorously promote the healthy development of the platform economy. To address the prominent issue of platforms abusing "refund only" rules, leading to merchants losing both goods and money, platforms will be urged to clarify the scope and specific circumstances for the application of these rules. Furthermore, regarding prominent issues such as platforms implementing "automatic price following" and "lowest price on the entire network" rules, platforms will be urged to standardize promotional activities. On the eve of "618," mainstream e-commerce platforms comprehensively canceled the "refund only" policy. Requests for "refund without returning goods" after consumers receive their orders will be handled by merchants themselves. "Macro policies have created significant opportunities for the development of the e-commerce industry. By decoupling 'refund only,' upgrading shipping insurance, and moving away from low-price involution, we can effectively address long-standing problems in the e-commerce industry and bring about a positive and stable business environment," stated Chu Duan, Vice President of Alibaba Group Holding Limited (hereinafter referred to as "Alibaba") and President of the Taobao Platform Business Unit. Intensive "real money and silver" burden-reduction actions have also been implemented. Taobao and Tmall have launched 12 sets of merchant-benefiting measures to comprehensively improve the business environment. JD.com has broken through traffic barriers with "zero commission entry" and strengthened merchant competitiveness with "10 billion subsidies." Douyin E-commerce has significantly lowered the deposit threshold and launched a "0 yuan trial operation for all categories." A healthy ecosystem where consumers dare to buy, merchants dare to sell, and platforms dare to innovate is accelerating its formation in the crucible of "618." Platform "Dismantling Walls and Breaking Barriers": From Closed Internal Strife to Open Traffic Attraction This year's "618" sees major e-commerce platforms proactively dismantling the walls of traffic blockade, payment fragmentation, and logistics isolation, embarking on a path of win-win cooperation. Payment and logistics, two business areas once considered core barriers by e-commerce, have now become breakthroughs for platform cooperation. In this year's "618" promotion, consumers can experience using WeChat Pay to purchase Taobao items, and JD Logistics delivering goods for Tmall merchants. Wu Jia, Vice President of Alibaba and President of the Taotian User Platform Business Unit, stated that since integrating WeChat Pay, the usage frequency of young users and users in lower-tier markets on Taobao has also increased. Data from commercial intelligence data service provider QuestMobile shows that in May of this year, the scale of overlapping users between Taobao and WeChat increased by 6.7% year-on-year, reaching 875 million. The scale of overlapping users between JD.com and Alipay increased by 20.4% year-on-year, reaching 581 million. Furthermore, a grand alliance has been formed among major e-commerce platforms, with new cooperative relationships constantly emerging. On the eve of "618," Taobao and Tmall collaborated with Xiaohongshu to create the "Red Cat Plan," integrating the entire journey from "seed planting" to purchasing. JD.com has also integrated Xiaohongshu's direct link functionality and partnered with the regional retail leader Pang Donglai to strengthen its fulfillment capabilities through its physical network. "Before, if I saw something I wanted to buy on Xiaohongshu, I had to take a screenshot and then search for it on e-commerce platforms to buy it. This year for '618,' I can jump directly between platforms, and the shopping experience is becoming increasingly seamless," said Ms. Yu, a consumer, to this reporter. Guo Tao, Deputy Director of the China E-commerce Expert Service Center, stated that in a market with maturing growth and limited incremental opportunities, e-commerce platforms are beginning to embrace "traffic giants." This is essentially a desire to win allies and expand more traffic sources, further driving the commercial scale of the e-commerce ecosystem. Incremental Market Development: Global Gold Mining is Now the Time With domestic traffic reaching its peak, "going global" has become the inevitable choice for e-commerce platforms seeking new growth. In 2024, China's cross-border e-commerce imports and exports reached 2.63 trillion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 10.8%. The potential of cross-border e-commerce in "selling globally" is being further unleashed, and its advantage in "buying globally" continues to be leveraged. The global network of infrastructure is accelerating the pace of "going global." Since April, downloads of DHgate, Taobao, and Alibaba.com on the US App Store have surged. "Going global" has become an important strategy for e-commerce platforms to help merchants achieve new growth. It is understood that the number of merchants participating in Tmall's 2025 "618" overseas event has exceeded one million. Hang Xin, head of Tmall Taobao's overseas growth plan, told a reporter from Securities Daily that "going global" not only expands new markets for merchants but also drives explosive growth in some industries. Among them, cross-border transaction volumes in 11 categories on the Taobao platform, including beauty and skincare, sports shoes, and milk powder, have doubled year-on-year. On June 17th, Liu Qiangdong, founder of JD.com, stated: "I hope that one day I can hand over all domestic business to the CEO as soon as possible, and I will devote myself full-time to international business." An insider from Alibaba International Station told reporters that the platform is currently holding a major promotion for the US market in June. This promotion will not only allow Chinese foreign trade merchants to enjoy overseas traffic support and receive foreign orders but will also benefit more "beginner merchants" interested in foreign trade business through promotional policies. "For Chinese enterprises to achieve high-quality global development, they must enhance their brand power to extend their product capabilities and elevate their value. We have good products and strong manufacturing capabilities, but we still lack the ability to 'tell' and 'spread' these advantages. Brands need not only to 'do well' but also to 'speak well'," said Wu Yulin, Senior Business Development Director of The Trade Desk China, a digital advertising technology company, to reporters. The essence of this "going global" wave is value reconstruction. E-commerce platforms will use cross-border infrastructure as their vessel, and merchants will use product innovation as their oars, jointly sailing towards the deep waters of brand building, where "doing well is as important as speaking loudly." As Zhuang Shuai, a retail e-commerce industry expert and visiting consultant for the China Chain Store & Franchise Association, put it, the main theme for e-commerce platforms in 2025 will be "anti-involution" and a return to value. The evolutionary story of China's e-commerce ecosystem has turned a new page.

title_en: "Super long version of '618', reflecting which new consumer trends"
body_en: Xinhua News Agency reporters Wang Yuxiao, Gong Liankang, and Li Xiaoting The "618" shopping festival has an extended "standby" period, allowing "shopaholic-style consumption" to return to rational shopping; emerging niche markets such as trendy toys and cute pets are on the rise, with more vertical tracks emerging as new blue oceans; AI accelerates the transformation of the entire consumer industry chain, helping the industry move from "smart" to "new" ... This year's "618" reflects new trends in the consumption field. Consumers are becoming more rational "618" is getting longer and longer, which is a common feeling among many consumers in recent years. In mid-May this year, platforms such as JD.com, Taobao, and Douyin started the "618" pre-sale promotion activities. It was learned that some platform promotion activities will continue until June 20, with a total duration of more than one month, setting a record for the longest time for "618". Saying goodbye to complex "math problems," platform subsidy rules are also becoming simpler and more direct. In addition to the discounts such as "each person can receive over 6180 yuan in subsidies per day," JD.com has further increased the subsidy intensity for "618"; Tmall has canceled discounts that require complex calculations such as "spend a certain amount to get a discount," and only offers "official discounts" combined with various coupons; Douyin's e-commerce has invested billions in consumer vouchers to subsidize popular products, with each user able to receive up to 2280 yuan... "This year's major promotional activities have a long duration, allowing us to slowly choose the things we really need, avoiding many impulsive purchases and not having to rack our brains to meet the requirements for discounts. I feel that '618' has become more refreshing and relaxed." Ms. Zhao, a consumer from Zhengzhou, Henan, said. Focusing on creating diverse consumption scenes and experiences, offline businesses have also seized the opportunity of "618" to carry out a series of consumer promotion activities. Customized AI photos, trying on glasses to experience AI translation, and other interactive activities attract people to queue up for check-ins; in the e-sports experience area, a variety of top-notch computer equipment makes e-sports enthusiasts feel satisfied; immersive real-life model rooms and whole-house customization services provide customers with a "one-stop" solution for home appliances and home decoration... At the recently unveiled JD MALL Shuangjing store in Beijing, a variety of integrated formats bring people a unique consumption experience. "We have launched multiple discounts such as 'JD subsidies + brand subsidies + bank subsidies,' and through setting up immersive experience zones and introducing first-store trendy products, we allow consumers to enjoy more personalized and diversified goods and services offline." Chen Rui, deputy store manager of JD MALL Shuangjing store in Beijing, said. Li Mingtao, an expert consultant on the National E-commerce Demonstration City Creation Working Committee, analyzed that this year's "618," the flow distribution mechanism of various platforms has shifted from "the one with the lowest price wins" to "the one with the best wins," and offline supermarkets are paying more attention to the sense of experience and scene creation. This is a reflection of consumers' shift from being "price-sensitive" to pursuing quality and rational consumption. Starting from demand orientation, major promotional activities can effectively activate consumption momentum. "Shopping carts" reflect new trends in consumption As an important annual consumption promotion node, "618" is undoubtedly an important indicator of new trends in the consumer market. The rise of niche markets such as trendy toys and pets— Labubu has sparked a "crazy unboxing" frenzy on social platforms, with online and offline products in high demand; the trend of "raising pets like raising children" has led to a large consumption of pet products... This "618," more niche subcategories are heating up, opening up new space to activate consumption. "This year's '618,' multiple merchants in the toy and trendy toy field on Taobao and Tmall have sales exceeding one hundred million yuan, with nearly 800 single products exceeding one million yuan in sales. The overseas orders for 'valley-like' products have achieved triple-digit growth year-on-year, with the vast majority of transactions being derivatives of domestic IP." The head of the Taobao trendy toy industry told reporters. Service consumption becomes a new engine— "I took my child to Guizhou during the Dragon Boat Festival holiday and also booked a set of parent-child travel photography services online during the '618' promotion. The experience was very good," said Song Qian, a resident of Shenzhen. "From the hot ice and snow economy to the rise of the silver-haired economy, service consumption is increasingly becoming a new engine driving consumption growth," said Zou Yunhan, deputy director of the Economic Forecasting Department of the National Information Center's Macroeconomic Research Office. Actively expanding service consumption scenarios and increasing the supply of high-quality services will better meet the growing consumer demand in areas such as elderly care, childcare, and entertainment. "Instant retail" accelerates entry— This year's "618," major platforms are accelerating the layout of instant retail formats, with Meituan Flash Purchase joining hands with millions of offline stores under well-known catering and retail brands to launch major promotional activities, and Taobao Flash Purchase also linking more offline entities during "618" to further increase subsidies. "Users are increasingly pursuing 'instant satisfaction,' and instant retail is gradually extending to multiple fields such as maternity and baby products, 3C products, beauty, and clothing. From May 28 to June 1 alone, more than 800 brand merchants and retailers on Meituan Flash Purchase doubled their turnover year-on-year, with mobile phones, small home appliances, and liquor being very popular during '618'." The person in charge of Meituan Flash Purchase said. AI helps businesses to "smartly" increase efficiency "By choosing clothing, models, and scenes, we can use AI to generate various styles of real-person short videos with just one click, helping us quickly complete the product video matrix during the major promotion period and achieve visual upgrades," said a person in charge of Yunshang Wuhan International Fashion Center. This person told reporters that the traditional clothing industry has a fast pace of new arrivals, and the production cost of graphic and video content is high. AI video tools greatly improve the efficiency of traditional video production, allowing companies to devote more energy to product design and marketing. "AI is not only a production tool but also an amplifier of market insights," said Chang Ningxixi, co-founder of the oral care brand Canban. By intelligently analyzing user behavior data, it can help brands discover potential market demands and provide more precise decision-making references for product development. JD Cloud has opened free AI marketing products to merchants, serving more than 13,000 brand merchants with JD Digital People; Taobao has launched the Business Manager "Tusheng Video" series of tools, generating over 1.5 million video materials for merchants in just over a month... This year's "618," AI is accelerating its integration into e-commerce formats, helping more platform merchants to "smartly" increase efficiency. This year's "618," some consumers received a "surprise voice message" when receiving express delivery—"Grandma, my girlfriend and I wish you a happy Dragon Boat Festival. When we settle down, please come to Shenzhen to visit" "The college entrance examination is coming soon, remember that health comes first and exams come second. Brother will always be your support"... "We recently launched the 'surprise call' feature, with AI outbound calls providing technical support. Consumers can choose to record a voice message or let the 'AI versatile voice' generated by JD use their own voice. When the recipient receives the express delivery, they can also receive this voice message," said a person in charge of JD. Chen Lifen, a researcher at the Market Economy Research Institute of the Development Research Center of the State Council, said that artificial intelligence is accelerating its integration into various industries, becoming an important force in activating consumer potential and driving industrial upgrading. With the gradual enrichment of technology iteration and landing scenarios, the combination of artificial intelligence and the consumer field is developing towards personalization and diversification, and is expected to activate more consumption increments in the future. (Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, June 18)

title_en: Huaian Bureau focuses on the rotation of samples for the investigation of batch, retail, accommodation, and catering restrictions.
body_en: This year, the Huainan Municipal Bureau of Statistics has conscientiously carried out the rotation of sample units for wholesale and retail businesses, accommodation and catering businesses below the quota. The Bureau has clearly defined the number of quarterly sample replacements and the standards for replacing samples that have been closed, cancelled, or suspended, verifying nearly 200 national samples and promptly replacing invalid samples to ensure the effectiveness of quarterly samples. They have held training sessions for the statistical business of sampling surveys below the quota, providing training on the statistical system below the quota, the scope of major statistical indicators, data reporting processes and timelines, refining statistical methods, system standards, and explaining indicator calibers, emphasizing the reporting requirements and key areas for economic indicators that are prone to underreporting or misreporting. They have strengthened the audit of reported sample data, ensuring immediate verification upon reporting, screening and verifying abnormal data changes daily, requiring enterprises and individual businesses to provide timely data support materials such as WeChat, Alipay, cash register systems, and tax certificates, conducting detailed audits, comparisons, and retention, and promptly making corrections when problems are found.

title_en: International Business Daily: 618 battle report data released, is the "temperature difference" bigger this year?
body_en: As of 23:59 on June 18, 2025, JD's 618 set a new record, with the number of orders increasing by over 100% year-on-year, and the overall order volume of JD's online retail business, offline formats, and JD Takeout exceeding 2.2 billion orders. During 618, the number of daily active users on the JD app reached a historic high. The scale and growth rate of the 3C and home appliance categories remained industry leaders, while the fashion and beauty, and daily necessities categories led the industry in growth. The diverse formats resonated together, driving strong growth in orders for millions of offline stores, with JD's live streaming sales volume increasing by 285% year-on-year. As of 24:00 on June 18, the simplified 2025 Tmall 618 saw record user scale and activity, with efficient growth in brand transactions throughout the entire cycle. Transactions for 453 brands on Tmall 618 exceeded one billion, a 24% year-on-year increase. Brands such as Apple, Midea, Haier, Xiaomi, Huawei, Genki Forest, Nike, Gree, FeiLe, Vivo, Pechoin, Adidas, L'Oreal, and others firmly held their place in the "billion club" of Tmall 618. Every time a major promotion ends, there is always a report card to summarize the original intention, but I don't know how everyone views it (feel free to leave a comment). Following 618 for almost 10 years, I feel like I'm getting more and more "temperature difference" (because I really "don't have time" to shop... luckily I placed an order early and feel like I didn't lose a billion). However, through the month-long "hype" on various platforms, we can still smell the gunpowder of this year's 618 and see where the new focus of the platforms is. At the 618 Media Open Day held by JD on June 18, various business leaders from JD took turns to passionately talk about data and trends. Overall, this year's 618, based on being "good and cheap," JD provided users with a comprehensive experience upgrade through greater discounts, guaranteed quality, better services, more interesting gameplay, and wider coverage. Under this promotion, Chinese brands are accelerating their rise, releasing vitality in the sinking market, and witnessing explosive growth in instant retail and life service consumption, with highlights in consumption data. 618 has become a strong booster for consumption growth and industry development. JD stated that this year's 618 consumption trends have changed again, showing four significant characteristics: First, the AI wave has driven high attention to AI-related products, while national trend products are more favored by consumers. Under the dual drive of "technology + traditional culture," over 70% of the top 100 brands in terms of popularity during 618 are Chinese brands, with searches for "AI elements" and "intangible cultural heritage elements" products increasing by over 120% and 270% year-on-year, respectively. Second, the consumption vitality in the sinking market is strong, with orders in county and rural areas increasing by over 130% year-on-year, and the number of users increasing by over 140% year-on-year. Nanchang County in Nanchang City and Chengwu County in Heze City have become the areas with the strongest consumption power and the strongest growth in consumption power during JD 618. In addition, as of now, JD's group buying stores have landed in Hefei, Beijing, and Suqian, with a total coverage of users increasing by 34 times year-on-year. Third, instant retail is booming, with JD Takeout's daily order volume exceeding 25 million, and over 1.5 million high-quality dining establishments joining. JD Fresh's online orders increased by over 150% year-on-year, sales of JD Fresh's own brand products increased by 340% year-on-year, and the recently launched "6.18L Pilsen Original Beer" and the "Fengyou Exploding Soft Candy" co-branded with Longhu are selling like hotcakes. Lastly, there is a significant growth in life service consumption, with the turnover of JD's self-operated housekeeping services exceeding one billion, and orders for self-operated home appliance cleaning and laundry increasing by 211% and over 10 times year-on-year, respectively. JD has 120,000 full-time delivery riders and nearly 300,000 professional technicians, including car maintenance technicians, home appliance engineers, and housekeeping cleaners, ready to respond to user needs at any time. Additionally, this year's 618 saw a significant increase in subsidies, with the addition of national subsidies for trade-ins and JD Takeout's billion-yuan subsidy for the first time, combined with various other benefits, allowing each person to receive over 6180 yuan in subsidies per day, achieving "more subsidies on top of savings." Sales of mobile communications, home appliances, and food and seasoning products increased by 88%, 161%, and 138% year-on-year, respectively. In the price range of 4000 to 6000 yuan, the transaction volume of mobile phones increased by 50% year-on-year, while the transaction volume of AI notebooks and 100-inch TVs increased by 151% and 260% year-on-year, respectively. Tmall focused on two main aspects of effectiveness: "simplifying the rules of major promotions, lowering the threshold for participation, and unleashing consumer vitality" and "deepening the anti-internal competition process through mechanism adjustments to help businesses improve quality and efficiency." In the former, during this year's 618, Tmall eliminated complex discount models such as "spend X get Y" and only set an official gameplay of "official discounts" combined with large coupons, with basic discounts starting at 15% off and a maximum discount of up to 50%. On top of the discount, consumers could stack additional benefits such as 88VIP coupons, industry category coupons (beauty coupons, fashion coupons, etc.), and live streaming room red envelopes. This made transactions simpler and the benefits for consumers more direct. By May 26, during the first phase of Tmall 618, the total transaction volume of categories participating in national subsidies such as home appliances, home furnishings, and mobile electronics increased by 283% compared to last year's Double 11, with 40 brands including Midea, Haier, Karcher, and Genki Forest achieving transactions exceeding one billion. This drove double-digit year-on-year growth in overall transactions for industries such as home appliances, home furnishings, home decor, and 3C electronics, with over 3000 brands doubling their transactions year-on-year, unleashing strong consumer vitality. In the latter, as the rules of 618 were simplified and price differentials were squeezed out, the way forward for brands was to reconstruct their value dimensions. On the product side, there needs to be a focus on technological differentiation, while on the user side, an emotional connection needs to be established to transform consumers from buyers to participants. On the channel side, there needs to be a focus on refined operations, abandoning mass coverage and focusing on deep services for high repeat-purchase customer groups. The platform's traffic allocation mechanism is shifting from "the lowest price wins" to "the best wins more," and brands need to use their product innovation capabilities and ability to meet consumer demands to achieve growth. During 618, brands that were early to market with new products on Tmall saw a concentrated effort. In the month leading up to 618, nearly 40,000 brands launched 1.09 million new products on Tmall. During 618, over 200 "super new products" from top brands were launched on Tmall, with the number of "super new products" increasing by 90% year-on-year. In addition, Taobao is focusing more on the battlefield of instant retail. It was announced on May 26 that during 618, Taobao Flash Sale and Ele.me jointly announced that the daily order volume had exceeded 40 million. This was less than a month after the official launch of Taobao Flash Sale. Data shows that the order structure of Taobao Flash Sale has significantly expanded to cover all categories, with non-beverage products accounting for 75% and orders for non-food categories growing far beyond expectations. Instant retail business brings higher user activity. Alibaba's financial report for the fourth quarter and full year of the 2025 fiscal year revealed that in the long run, Taobao Flash Sale will bring benefits to Taobao in terms of user activity and user scale. title_en: Postal Savings Bank of China Henan Branch: Financial vitality nourishes the Central Plains, rural revitalization writes a new chapter.
body_en: In the summer season, the Central Plains are a scene of abundant harvest and busy activity. Rural revitalization, financial leadership. In 2025, the Central Committee issued Document No. 1, proposing to promote financial institutions to increase funding for rural revitalization. Vigorously carry out the "hundreds of counties, thousands of towns, and tens of thousands of villages" deep service action, deepen political and financial cooperation, explore rural industrial needs, optimize social service models... During the critical period of summer harvest and planting, the Postal Savings Bank of China Henan Branch focuses on financial support for rural revitalization, continuously innovates financial products and services, uses financial "living water" to accurately "irrigate" the fields, and escorts the production during the "three summers" and the development of rural characteristic industries. More convenient, political and financial cooperation enables comprehensive funding connection "Thanks to the Postal Savings Bank's loan of 300,000 yuan, I have enough funds to carry out the next planting work." Although many days have passed, on June 4th, when talking about the "political and financial exchange meeting" she attended last month, farmer Guo still expressed gratitude. The "political and financial exchange meeting" mentioned by Guo is called the "Political and Financial Cooperation, Promoting Rural Revitalization" launch meeting, held in the conference room of the Grape Frame Township Government in Lankao County on the morning of May 15th. The exchange meeting was jointly organized by the Postal Savings Bank Lankao County Branch, the Lankao County Development and Reform Commission, and the Grape Frame Township Government. At the meeting, the staff of the Postal Savings Bank Lankao County Branch used simple language to introduce the bank's loan business and process to the participating farmers. Especially after understanding everyone's funding needs, the staff conducted on-site credit assessment for more than a dozen farmers and granted nearly 5 million yuan in credit. "I never thought that the loan would be approved on the spot." Guo said she is a large-scale planter in Grape Frame Township, with 300 mu of land under contract for large-scale sweet potato planting. She also built a 500 cubic meter cold storage for storage and staggered sales. After the sweet potato planting work started in April this year, her expenses gradually increased: land leasing fees, hiring farmers for field management fees, purchasing organic and chemical fertilizers. In addition, there were also fees for renting agricultural machinery, with a funding gap of about 300,000 yuan. Recommended by the village committee, Guo participated in the "political and financial exchange meeting." At the meeting, the staff carefully guided her to fill out the relevant information, completed a pre-credit assessment of 300,000 yuan for the "industrial loan" within 5 minutes, and the loan funds were credited on the same day. After the funds were in place, Guo promptly paid the labor costs of her fellow villagers, purchased fertilizers, and booked agricultural machinery services to ensure the smooth progress of sweet potato planting. Leading at the county level, promoting at the township level, and rooting in the countryside, the Postal Savings Bank Henan Branch has established a hierarchical joint system with county, township governments, and village-level organizations, building a universal financial service network, clearly assigning responsible management personnel and village customer managers, holding township and village promotion meetings irregularly, increasing the frequency of door-to-door visits to promote financial knowledge... Continuously promote financial services to rural areas, unblocking the "last mile" of financial services for the masses. Currently, the Postal Savings Bank Henan Branch's "hundreds of counties, thousands of towns, and tens of thousands of villages" deep service action has covered all counties and major townships in the province, holding nearly ten thousand village promotion meetings. As of the end of April 2025, the bank's agricultural loan scale reached 190.3 billion yuan, with nearly 45 billion yuan already disbursed this year. More professional, tailored to help characteristic industries thrive In June, Zhecheng is seamlessly transitioning from summer harvest to summer planting. In the intercropped fields, after harvesting wheat, they immediately start transplanting peppers, and the straw left in the ground becomes fertilizer for the pepper plants. Unlike the busy fields, the pepper market in Zhecheng is a bustling scene: piles of bright red dried peppers, trading stalls buzzing with activity, and farmers looking at the constantly flashing numbers on the electronic settlement screen with joy on their faces. Mr. Cao has been operating in the pepper market for many years, with an annual turnover exceeding 20 million yuan. To expand the scale of procurement and storage, he planned to finance from the bank. Thinking that with an annual turnover of over ten million yuan, he could easily get a bank loan approved, he encountered the problem of "flowing accounts." It turned out that the bank required Mr. Cao to provide bank statements, but Mr. Cao had been manually recording his purchases and transactions for many years, and daily settlements were made through various methods such as WeChat, Alipay, and bank transfers. When organizing credit materials, it was not only time-consuming and laborious but also prone to omissions and errors. "I no longer have to worry about keeping accounts in the future. With a light tap on my phone, everything is clear and transparent. 'Jiaoyitong' has been a great help to me!" Mr. Cao said happily. The "Jiaoyitong" platform is a special service tailored by the Postal Savings Bank Henan Branch after in-depth research on the development of the Zhecheng pepper industry, meeting the financial needs of industry associations, large purchasers, and cooperatives. This platform has functions such as transaction settlement, fund supervision, and data statistics, providing full-chain financial support for the pepper industry in Zhecheng County. This is just a glimpse of the bank's service to local industry development. The Postal Savings Bank Henan Branch focuses on "small and beautiful, beautiful and excellent" rural characteristic industries, according to the "one industry, one plan" approach, tailoring exclusive business plans for characteristic industry clusters and leading enterprises within its jurisdiction based on the operating characteristics, financial needs, and funding cycles of rural industries, matching loan elements such as quotas, interest rates, and repayment methods. The Postal Savings Bank Lankao County Branch has launched special products such as musical instrument industry loans to provide strong financial support for the musical instrument processing industry in Lankao; the Postal Savings Bank Taiqian County Branch actively supports the local down industry, helping a small business that used to collect duck and goose feathers on the streets grow into a characteristic industry; the Postal Savings Bank Zhoukou City Branch, based on industrial loans, has innovatively launched products such as "land transfer loans" and "cattle breeding loans" to inject financial vitality into the development of local county-level characteristic industries. When industries thrive, the economy thrives, and when the economy thrives, rural areas thrive. Focusing on weak areas of inclusive finance development in the province, the Postal Savings Bank Henan Branch's various branches actively cooperate with local agricultural departments and industry associations to provide special financial services for grain production, characteristic industries, agricultural product processing, etc., effectively matching financial resources with rural industries, continuously improving business efficiency, and truly enabling customers to "walk less and get money faster." In the future, the Postal Savings Bank Henan Branch will continue to deepen the "hundreds of counties, thousands of towns, and tens of thousands of villages" deep service action, through political and financial cooperation to comprehensively connect funding needs, tailor support for characteristic industry development, optimize business processes through digital empowerment, deeply cultivate key areas, continuously innovate products, and enhance service levels, accelerating the creation of the main force for rural revitalization. Growing together with rural areas, developing together with industries, and prospering together with farmers. The Postal Savings Bank Henan Branch will always adhere to the original intention of serving agriculture, rural areas, and farmers, painting a magnificent picture of rural revitalization with the brush of finance.

title_en: Why is it difficult for express packaging to "lose weight"?
body_en: Xinhua News Agency "Xinhua Viewpoint" reporter The corrugated cardboard box is wrapped with difficult-to-tear tape, and the packaging box contains a large number of bubble bags, foam plastics... Many people will encounter this "nested doll" style packaging when receiving express delivery. Why is it difficult for express packaging to "lose weight"? How to promote the industry to achieve green transformation? "Xinhua Viewpoint" reporter conducted an investigation. "Nesting doll" packaging, pungent odor, surge in garbage Mr. Xu from Chengdu, Sichuan Province, purchased a mini CD player online. The size of the product is not large, but the package size is twice the size of the product, filled with bubble bags. "I understand that the merchant wants to protect the product, but these fillers not only take up space but also make it difficult to dispose of." Mr. Xu said. The investigation found that some merchants will stack films, nets, and other materials in the packaging; some merchants will place a large number of ice packs, moisture-proof pads, and other "functional" packaging materials in the express delivery. Previously, the Shaanxi Survey Team of the National Bureau of Statistics conducted a survey of 462 consumers in 20 cities and counties in the province, of which more than 64% of consumers believed that there was too much tape winding in express packaging, more than 33% of consumers believed that there were too many fillers in express packaging, and more than 32% of consumers believed that express packaging was too large. To reduce costs, some merchants choose low-quality tapes, plastics, and cardboard for packaging. In some areas where express delivery is concentrated, even wearing a mask, you can smell a pungent odor. The indoor air quality standard that will be implemented on February 1, 2023, stipulates that the one-hour average concentration of formaldehyde indoors should not exceed 0.08mg/m3. Reporters randomly tested five express stations in Changchun, Jilin with a formaldehyde concentration detector, and after staying for only a few minutes, the formaldehyde concentration value displayed on the detector quickly exceeded this standard, with some values even seven times higher than the standard. Excessive packaging also leads to a surge in waste. At a waste sorting center in Beijing, reporters saw classified garbage placed in rows. The person in charge of the center said that this garbage mainly comes from multiple communities, and about 60 tons of recyclables are sent to the center every day. The proportion of express packaging paper made mainly of yellow cardboard is increasing, and it has now exceeded 60%. Wang Qi, academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, said that with the continuous increase in the annual business volume of express delivery in China, a large amount of paper and plastic waste is generated every year, and the total amount of express packaging waste in China in 2023 is close to 20 million tons. Why is it difficult to "lose weight" and "go green" Why is it difficult for express packaging to "lose weight"? The person in charge of an express delivery company told reporters that more than 95% of the goods packaging responsible for delivery by the company is handled by platform e-commerce, and many e-commerce platforms either focus on enhancing brand premiums and unboxing experiences or avoid damage to goods during transportation, generally putting effort into packaging, leading to excessive packaging. Zhang Tao, an e-commerce seller engaged in food processing, told reporters that if the goods are not "properly" packaged, they may be damaged or crushed during transportation, and consumers often complain or give negative reviews when they receive them. "It costs more to resolve these complaints and negative reviews, so it's better to over-package before sending them out," he said. Some consumers also have requirements for packaging when purchasing goods. "When buying gifts like lipstick, perfume for friends, some buyers will ask to put the gifts in large gift boxes or shopping bags, creating a romantic atmosphere on the one hand, and also allowing the other party to feel the level of care." Li Min, an e-commerce seller engaged in cosmetics sales, admitted. The newly revised "Interim Regulations on Express Delivery" will be implemented from June 1 this year. The regulations propose to encourage companies operating express delivery services and senders to use environmentally friendly packaging materials that are degradable and reusable. "Compared with traditional corrugated cardboard or tape packaging, the cost of environmentally friendly material packaging boxes is often twice as high or even higher. The extensive use may weaken the price competitiveness of merchants." A person in charge of an express delivery station admitted. In addition, e-commerce platforms assess merchants based on sales volume, positive review rate, and express delivery efficiency, without giving much weight to the environmental friendliness of express packaging, so most merchants do not have much motivation to use environmentally friendly materials for express packaging. In terms of green recycling, the revised "Interim Regulations on Express Delivery" propose to encourage the setting up of packaging material recycling facilities in express business premises, enterprise units, residential communities, and other appropriate places. Reporters visited 20 express business outlets and express stations in Changchun, most of which have green recycling bins, designed to promote the reuse of more express boxes. However, reporters found that most of the recycling bins were either idle in the corner or filled with miscellaneous items or garbage, and the number of bins that could truly serve their purpose was limited. In addition, many consumers do not unpack at the site of the express station, and some express boxes that could be recycled are eventually thrown into the trash. "The recycled cardboard boxes will be properly stored and provided free of charge to sending customers for reuse, but there is not much publicity about this, and many people still do not understand." Express deliveryman Zhao Zijun said. Achieving green and reduced express delivery requires full-chain management The governance of excessive express packaging involves multiple links such as production, use, recycling, and disposal, and joint efforts along the entire chain are the key to achieving both symptomatic and fundamental treatment. Many express delivery companies are taking a series of measures to give express packaging a "makeover." Cainiao has increased the overall box fullness rate by 18% and reduced the number of box types by 11% through algorithm design and refined operation to match the size of the cardboard boxes. "For example, we customize gift boxes for some companies, recommend the best box type through intelligent box design algorithms, combine packaging with logistics boxes, and reduce the use of plastic materials." Yuan Liu, responsible for global supply chain green technology products at Cainiao, said. Biodegradable and environmentally friendly stone plastic boxes made from waste stone materials are the new packaging boxes that ZTO Express is currently piloting. "These packaging boxes are relatively expensive, and we are promoting the intelligent construction of warehouses, applying a series of equipment to reduce logistics costs." Xu Yonggui, head of the brand department of ZTO Cloud Warehouse Market, said. The network outlets are key to forming a closed loop for governance, and promoting express packaging to "lose weight" and "go green" requires cultivating awareness of delivery and recycling. Zhejiang University has set up "Green Box" express packaging recycling devices at all 14 sites. "Take the Baisha Mail Delivery Service Station at Zijingang Campus as an example, more than 200 express packages are recycled and reused here every day." Yao Xin, secretary of the Party Committee and chairman of the Logistics Group of Zhejiang University, said that after nearly 10 years of daily guidance and green activities, recycling and reuse of cardboard boxes has become a routine operation at the service station. Xu Yong, vice chairman of the Express Logistics Branch of the China Communications and Transportation Association, said that relevant departments should strengthen supervision, investigate and rectify factories that produce unqualified and environmentally unfriendly packaging materials from the source, and prevent packaging materials that do not meet requirements from entering the market. "To achieve green and reduced express delivery, clear responsibilities need to be assigned to producers, e-commerce platforms, express logistics, and other responsible entities." Zhao Guojun, director of the Postal Development Research Center at Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, said that further coordination with relevant departments can bring e-commerce platforms and packaging material manufacturers together as responsible entities for strict regulation. "Many consumers do not trust simple packaging, and the level of concern for green packaging also needs to be raised." Zhao Guojun said that it is necessary to enhance consumers' awareness of green and reduced express packaging and promote companies to make changes, designing packaging solutions that can enhance protection and are relatively lightweight based on the characteristics of different products and transportation environments. (Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, June 19)

"I understand that the merchant wants to protect the product, but these fillers not only take up space but also make it difficult to dispose of." Mr. Xu said. The investigation found that some merchants will stack films, nets, and other materials in the packaging; some merchants will place a large number of ice packs, moisture-proof pads, and other "functional" packaging materials in the express delivery. Previously, the Shaanxi Survey Team of the National Bureau of Statistics conducted a survey of 462 consumers in 20 cities and counties in the province, of which more than 64% of consumers believed that there was too much tape winding in express packaging, more than 33% of consumers believed that there were too many fillers in express packaging, and more than 32% of consumers believed that express packaging was too large. To reduce costs, some merchants choose low-quality tapes, plastics, and cardboard for packaging. In some areas where express delivery is concentrated, even wearing a mask, you can smell a pungent odor. The indoor air quality standard that will be implemented on February 1, 2023, stipulates that the one-hour average concentration of formaldehyde indoors should not exceed 0.08mg/m3. Reporters randomly tested five express stations in Changchun, Jilin with a formaldehyde concentration detector, and after staying for only a few minutes, the formaldehyde concentration value displayed on the detector quickly exceeded this standard, with some values even seven times higher than the standard. Excessive packaging also leads to a surge in waste. At a waste sorting center in Beijing, reporters saw classified garbage placed in rows. The person in charge of the center said that this garbage mainly comes from multiple communities, and about 60 tons of recyclables are sent to the center every day. The proportion of express packaging paper made mainly of yellow cardboard is increasing, and it has now exceeded 60%. Wang Qi, academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, said that with the continuous increase in the annual business volume of express delivery in China, a large amount of paper and plastic waste is generated every year, and the total amount of express packaging waste in China in 2023 is close to 20 million tons. The person in charge of an express delivery company told reporters that more than 95% of the goods packaging responsible for delivery by the company is handled by platform e-commerce, and many e-commerce platforms either focus on enhancing brand premiums and unboxing experiences or avoid damage to goods during transportation, generally putting effort into packaging, leading to excessive packaging. Zhang Tao, an e-commerce seller engaged in food processing, told reporters that if the goods are not "properly" packaged, they may be damaged or crushed during transportation, and consumers often complain or give negative reviews when they receive them. "It costs more to resolve these complaints and negative reviews, so it's better to over-package before sending them out," he said. Some consumers also have requirements for packaging when purchasing goods. "When buying gifts like lipstick, perfume for friends, some buyers will ask to put the gifts in large gift boxes or shopping bags, creating a romantic atmosphere on the one hand, and also allowing the other party to feel the level of care." Li Min, an e-commerce seller engaged in cosmetics sales, admitted. The newly revised "Interim Regulations on Express Delivery" will be implemented from June 1 this year. The regulations propose to encourage companies operating express delivery services and senders to use environmentally friendly packaging materials that are degradable and reusable. The extensive use may weaken the price competitiveness of merchants." A person in charge of an express delivery station admitted. Express deliveryman Zhao Zijun said. Many express delivery companies are taking a series of measures to give express packaging a "makeover." "For example, we customize gift boxes for some companies, recommend the best box type through intelligent box design algorithms, combine packaging with logistics boxes, and reduce the use of plastic materials." Yuan Liu, responsible for global supply chain green technology products at Cainiao, said. Biodegradable and environmentally friendly stone plastic boxes made from waste stone materials are the new packaging boxes that ZTO Express is currently piloting. "These packaging boxes are relatively expensive, and we are promoting the intelligent construction of warehouses, applying a series of equipment to reduce logistics costs." Xu Yonggui, head of the brand department of ZTO Cloud Warehouse Market, said. Zhejiang University has set up "Green Box" express packaging recycling devices at all 14 sites. "Take the Baisha Mail Delivery Service Station at Zijingang Campus as an example, more than 200 express packages are recycled and reused here every day." Xu Yong, vice chairman of the Express Logistics Branch of the China Communications and Transportation Association, said that relevant departments should strengthen supervision, investigate and rectify factories that produce unqualified and environmentally unfriendly packaging materials from the source, and prevent packaging materials that do not meet requirements from entering the market. "To achieve green and reduced express delivery, clear responsibilities need to be assigned to producers, e-commerce platforms, express logistics, and other responsible entities." Zhao Guojun, director of the Postal Development Research Center at Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, said that further coordination with relevant departments can bring e-commerce platforms and packaging material manufacturers together as responsible entities for strict regulation. "Many consumers do not trust simple packaging, and the level of concern for green packaging also needs to be raised." Zhao Guojun said that it is necessary to enhance consumers' awareness of green and reduced express packaging and promote companies to make changes, designing packaging solutions that can enhance protection and are relatively lightweight based on the characteristics of different products and transportation environments. (Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, June 19)
