title_en: The "triple gate" of China's AI glasses super prosperity.
body_en: "Lucky, pay XX yuan," said the user wearing Rokid Glasses, and Rokid Glasses recognized the Alipay payment code. Then, the user said "confirm payment," and the payment could be completed without the need for any operation on the phone. On June 17th, Rokid announced that smart glasses can now be used for payments, and the scene described above became a part of daily life. This event expanded the use cases of smart glasses, indicating a shift from just "seeing" to "using," further expanding the range of applications. Since the beginning of this year, smart glasses have become one of the hottest consumer electronics products. In May alone, there were over 10 new smart glasses models launched. Manufacturers such as Rebird, Xreal, and Liweike all released their new products. Apart from terminal manufacturers, upstream companies are also gearing up. On June 11th, Qualcomm even released the Snapdragon AR1+Gen 1 for smart glasses, which includes a built-in neural processing unit capable of running small language models on the edge. With the entry of companies like Qualcomm and Google, the standardization of systems and chips has been further promoted, pushing smart glasses towards a more lightweight transformation. With so many products available, there is bound to be one that meets the needs of consumers. The audience for smart glasses is gradually expanding from tech enthusiasts to a more mainstream user base, and the smart glasses market is rapidly growing. According to IDC, the global smart glasses market shipped 1.487 million units in the first quarter alone, an 82.3% year-on-year increase. In China, the shipment of smart glasses reached 494,000 units, a 116.1% year-on-year increase. Under the thriving market, some trends different from consumer electronics are quietly emerging. If smart glasses are to be used in more scenarios and reach a wider consumer base, lightweight and aesthetics are key, even more important than intelligence. Secondly, smart glasses can meet the needs of people with myopia, making offline traditional glasses sales channels a significant growth point for the industry. Currently, the global smart glasses market is still dominated by Meta, with a focus on the US market and a growing presence in Western Europe. The domestic smart glasses market is more like a battle among various players, aptly described as the "Battle of a Hundred Glasses." Data shows that in the first quarter of China, the market for audio and audio recording glasses shipped 359,000 units, a 197.4% year-on-year increase. Among them, audio glasses products are the main focus, with major players including Xiaomi, Huawei, and Jiehuan. The launch of Rebird's new product V3 in the first quarter significantly boosted the growth of the audio recording glasses market. "Domestic manufacturers' products are mostly benchmarked against Ray-Ban Meta," said a smart glasses manufacturer's design director to reporters. "Compared to Meta, there are no obvious technological barriers in the supply chain in China. It's more about what kind of play the manufacturers can make on the glasses, fully utilizing the camera function for AI interaction and practical value. Whether Meta's play and ignition path can be replicated in China remains to be seen in the market," said IDC China's research director Pan Xuefei in an interview with 21st Century Business Herald. One obvious change is that in the past two quarters, the focus of the Chinese AR/VR market has gradually shifted towards the AR (transparent or semi-transparent binocular display, supporting 3D object manipulation) & ER (capable of displaying 3D digital images and the external world simultaneously) market. In the first quarter, the AR&ER market shipped 86,000 units, accounting for 63.8% of the market share, with a year-on-year growth of 64.0%. Xreal, Rebird, and Xingji Meizu have jointly driven market growth. As the market for viewing glasses becomes saturated and growth slows down, lightweight glasses are providing new consumer applications such as light sports and health, light business travel, etc., giving the AR/ER market new opportunities. Public information shows that the Rokid Glasses, weighing only 49g, has already received orders for over 250,000 units worldwide and will begin delivery at the end of June. In response to this phenomenon, IDC China analyst Ye Qingqing analyzed that lightweight glasses for the consumer market have a wider range of applications and lower user thresholds. Compared to traditional glasses/headsets devices with entertainment and audiovisual scenes as the core, the commercialization path is clearer and faster, making it easier for manufacturers to enter the market, thus significantly leading the growth ahead of other forms of products. It is worth noting that the growth of the lightweight glasses market is also benefiting from the rapid development of large models. Models such as Tongyi Qianwen, DeepSeek, and Wenxin large models are the mainstream underlying models for AI glasses products at present. Leveraging large models not only enhances the semantic understanding and contextual processing capabilities of smart glasses but also improves the multimodal interaction capabilities in speech and vision, making glasses truly AI glasses. It is expected that from June 2025 to the end of the year, more manufacturers will launch smart glasses in China. With the support of large models, smart glasses will bring more graphic interface expandability and playability to glasses-shaped devices with lower market thresholds. The development of AI glasses not only requires mature large models but also strong hardware support and battery life. Among them, there has long been a dilemma known as the "impossible triangle": lightweight, high performance, and long battery life are difficult to achieve simultaneously. How to balance the relationship between the three, different manufacturers have different considerations, which is also one of the challenges in mass production of smart glasses. Will, the founder of Even Realities, mentioned in a sharing session that smart glasses are generally understood as "smart + glasses," but the key issue is the proportion of intelligence and glasses. Currently, most people wear traditional glasses, and for the next generation of smart products, the question is whether to significantly increase the proportion of intelligence from the beginning or gradually penetrate. This is the starting point that needs to be considered. "In our view, the proportion of intelligence should not exceed 40%," Will pointed out. The implication here is that glasses should not sacrifice aesthetics and comfort for intelligence. "From the perspective of traditional glasses manufacturers, functionality, stylish appearance, and comfort are all indispensable. Our goal is to create a pair of smart glasses that are both practical and in line with fashion trends, which can be paired with different sunglasses or optical lenses, complementing the individual's face shape and overall style. The designed glasses should not cause too much burden during wear," the design director mentioned above told reporters. Using stronger and more integrated chips helps achieve the lightweight and low power consumption of smart glasses, as no consumer wants to be burdened by glasses pressing on their nose. Taking the core control chip as an example, the Qualcomm Snapdragon AR1 is the first choice for flagship models of many manufacturers, with significant advantages in image signal processing and AI computing power, making it a popular choice among many AI glasses manufacturers for their flagship products. In addition, some manufacturers have adopted the UNISOC W517 chip, such as the AI camera glasses from FlashExtreme. However, after the launch of these AI glasses, user feedback has not been positive, with complaints about Bluetooth connectivity and power consumption. "Based on the current conditions, combining software application ecology with hardware functionality trade-offs, manufacturers can temporarily allocate some computing power to smartphones and the cloud for collaboration to reduce the burden on glasses, balancing weight, battery life, product usability, and playability," suggested Pan Xuefei. Currently, smart glasses are more of a supplement to the mobile phone scene, with hopes for the future that tasks such as calling a taxi or navigation can be completed through glasses without the need to take out a phone. The growth of the audio and audio recording glasses market in the first quarter of 2025 partly came from the expansion of offline channels. IDC data shows that the retail channel shipment volume of audio and audio recording glasses in China in the first quarter increased by 75.3% year-on-year. This is because smart glasses are more in line with human senses, providing the most natural way of interaction, and are more similar to traditional glasses in terms of appearance, weight, and price. In addition, Pan Xuefei analyzed that myopia glasses require the introduction of a lens matching process that demands professionalism. Currently, the smart glasses market is still dominated by technology companies, which is a relatively weak point. This is also why the market is seeing more cooperation with traditional glasses channels. Previously, reporters from 21st Century Business Herald visited several physical eyewear stores in Shenzhen and found that some chain eyewear brands have set up smart glasses sections, with prices ranging from hundreds to thousands of yuan. Taking Dr. Glasses (300622.SZ) as an example, the company revealed on its investor interaction platform that it has already partnered with brands such as Xingji Meizu, Rebird Innovation, XREAL, Jiehuan, Liweike, and Rokid in the smart glasses business. IDC believes that for AR/VR products, smart hardware manufacturers and traditional eyewear manufacturers have more advantages in offline channels. The entry of new players has further intensified the channel competition pressure on technology innovation manufacturers, prompting the entire AR/VR market to shift from focusing on online to a diversified full-channel layout. title_en: Stock prices have surged by 200% in the past two months, while the main business of Yongan Pharmaceutical continues to "bleed".
body_en: In just two and a half months, the stock price of Yongan Pharmaceutical (002365.SZ) soared from 9 yuan to 28 yuan, with a cumulative increase of over 200%. As of the close on June 19, Yongan Pharmaceutical's price-earnings ratio (TTM) was as high as 261 times, far exceeding the average price-earnings ratio of 32 times for the pharmaceutical manufacturing industry. However, the taurine price that supported this market surge has fallen from a peak of 25,000 yuan/ton in May to 16,000 yuan/ton. Currently, Yongan Pharmaceutical still faces the dual challenges of "bleeding" in its main business and whether its new business can continue. From 2022 to 2024, the company's revenue has fallen by 42.6%, with a loss of over 4 million yuan in the first quarter of this year. Stock price surged 200% in 2 months Since the market started in April, Yongan Pharmaceutical has experienced three waves of increases, with the stock price rising from less than 9 yuan to a high of 29.19 yuan, with a cumulative increase of up to 224%. After experiencing a new round of increases, Yongan Pharmaceutical hit the limit down on June 19, closing at 25.44 yuan per share. The core logic of the market speculation on Yongan Pharmaceutical revolves around the "supply-demand gap" of taurine. In April 2025, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) required taurine to be added to infant formula and pet food. As China accounts for 90% of global production capacity and faces domestic environmental production restrictions and overseas competitors shutting down, the supply shortage has worsened. According to Yongan Pharmaceutical's 2024 annual report, the company's current taurine production capacity is 58,000 tons per year, accounting for around 50% of the market share, with most of the company's taurine products exported worldwide, with overseas revenue accounting for 60.23% in 2024. Market analysts said that there are no companies in the U.S. that produce taurine on a large scale domestically, relying entirely on imports, with China accounting for over 90% of the supply, directly driving export demand. There are even market rumors that taurine prices have surged several times. Affected by the above news, Yongan Pharmaceutical started an upward trend in April, recording its first limit up on April 8, followed by a brief pullback, and then recording 6 consecutive limit up days from the 21st to the 29th, with the stock price quickly rising to 14.34 yuan. On the evening of April 29, Yongan Pharmaceutical issued a reply to the abnormal stock price movement report, stating that recent rumors circulating on the internet about "taurine prices surging several times" were found to be untrue by the relevant departments of the company, and the next day Yongan Pharmaceutical hit the limit down. On May 5, Yongan Pharmaceutical announced that its actual controller and chairman, Chen Yong, was under investigation and placed under investigation. Yongan Pharmaceutical hit the limit down again on the 6th. However, even with the actual controller being investigated and placed under investigation, Yongan Pharmaceutical only briefly adjusted for less than 7 trading days, with the stock price falling to around 10 yuan, and then hitting the limit up again on May 14 to start the next round of increases, recording 7 consecutive limit up days in 11 days, with the stock price reaching 24.63 yuan, a 146.3% increase. The reason for this round of speculation is that, in addition to its main taurine business, Yongan Pharmaceutical's attempts in the health product sector have also attracted market attention. The solid functional beverage "Yijianeng" launched by its subsidiary is selling well on platforms such as Taobao, Douyin, Pinduoduo, JD.com, and Kuaishou, with a total of 25,000 orders from May 12 to 18, with a daily average increase of 60%. However, according to Yongan Pharmaceutical's 2024 annual report, its health food revenue was 103 million yuan, accounting for only 12.37% of its total revenue. After a brief pullback from May 29 to June 5, Yongan Pharmaceutical rose again, hitting a new high of 29.19 yuan per share on June 17, and finally hitting the limit down on the 19th. Behind the sharp rise in Yongan Pharmaceutical's stock price is speculative capital taking over, with data from the Dragon and Tiger List showing that individual investors have been on the list 25 times in the past two months. "Lhasa Group", Yongxing Securities Ningbo and Yuanlu, Dongguan Securities Nanjing Branch, and Lianchu Securities Shanghai Songlin Road and other speculative seats have frequently appeared to boost the stock price. According to the details of the top ten shareholders disclosed in the 2024 annual report, well-known "bullish" Wang Chenghua also participated, with a new holding of 4.030467 million shares, accounting for 1.37%, becoming the fourth largest shareholder. Main business continues to "bleed" Behind the over 200% surge in stock price, Yongan Pharmaceutical is experiencing a dual situation of "ice and fire" in its operational dilemma. With continuously deteriorating financial data, shrinking core business, and management turmoil, the fundamental crisis of this taurine leading enterprise contrasts with the frenzy in the secondary market. Disclosure data shows that from 2022 to 2024, Yongan Pharmaceutical's revenue plummeted from 1.462 billion yuan to 839 million yuan, a cumulative decline of 42.6% over three years. In 2023, a 33.48% drop in revenue directly plunged Yongan Pharmaceutical into a deep loss. Although in 2024, it achieved a net profit of 61.766 million yuan through cost control. The return to profit was not sustained. In 2025, the company's performance deteriorated further, with first-quarter revenue falling to 171 million yuan, a 12.96% year-on-year decline; a net loss of 4.3672 million yuan, a staggering 115.23% year-on-year decline. As the core business accounting for 75.67% of total revenue, the company's taurine segment had revenue of 635 million yuan in 2024, a 4.14% year-on-year decline. In a situation of increasing volume and falling prices, although sales volume increased by 16.32%, the average selling price fell, directly leading to a drop in gross profit margin from 29.4% in the previous year to 24.02%. In May of this year, there were market rumors of a surge in taurine prices. According to data from commodity pricing websites, taurine prices briefly rose to a peak of 25,000 yuan/ton in the first five days of May, but have since fallen back to the normal price range of 16,000 yuan/ton. The uncertainty remains as to whether taurine prices will continue to rise in the future. To reverse the downturn in the taurine business, Yongan Pharmaceutical is expanding its presence in the C-end of the health sector through its subsidiary Yongan Kangjian's Yijianeng product. Yongan Pharmaceutical stated on an interactive platform that its subsidiary Yongan Kangjian's Yijianeng self-owned brand product was officially launched and operational by the end of 2024. In terms of channel expansion, in addition to online sales, Yongan Kangjian's Yijianeng products have begun to be stocked in some chain pharmacies in certain regions and promoted at the end, continuously strengthening the brand's consumer end layout. However, the proportion of the above business is still relatively small. In 2024, Yongan Pharmaceutical's health food revenue was 103 million yuan, accounting for only 12.37% of its overall revenue. The performance crisis has not been alleviated, and management turmoil has followed. On May 5, 2025, the company announced that its actual controller and chairman, Chen Yong, was under investigation and placed under investigation by the Supervisory Committee of Hefeng County, Hubei Province. Although the board of directors promptly appointed his son, Chen Zidi, to act on his behalf the next day, the market responded with a limit down. In the frenzy of stock price speculation spurred by rumors of a surge in taurine prices, Yongan Pharmaceutical's fundamental crisis has come to the surface. title_en: Small factory, big order, AI has become the new "matchmaker"
body_en: On the old machines with peeling paint, production plans written on whiteboards, and tea rooms with a strong smell of engine oil mixed in... Among the 6 million manufacturing companies in China, there is a type of "small workshop" that has few employees, small scale, average environment, lacks publicity, but is large in number and wide in coverage, like capillaries supporting many nodes of the supply chain. When buyers are worried about not finding quality suppliers, when small and medium-sized manufacturers are struggling with order acceptance and lack of customers, a transformation driven by AI technology is breaking down barriers of geography, language, and information, awakening the long-buried manufacturing capabilities. Digital "matchmakers" help supply and demand shake hands An injection molding factory from Wuhu, Anhui, used to struggle with a lack of orders in the early days of its business. By chance, they came into contact with the digital platform focusing on industrial components - Haizhi Online, and since then became its loyal "fans". With the help of this platform, the factory successfully established stable cooperation with more than ten customers, and its annual output value grew from zero to 6 million yuan. From the perspective of the entire component market, over 80% of components are non-standardized. Producing a car requires tens of thousands of parts, producing a mobile phone also requires thousands of parts, the vast majority of which are non-standard components. When product designs change, components need to be customized again, and small and medium-sized factories generally face the pain points of order acceptance difficulties and inconsistent income. "The characteristic of the non-standard component market is that the buyer defines the product, with many technical details, but the buyer cannot access the production process. Once there are errors or misunderstandings in the information transmission process, it may lead to many risks," said Liu Haitao, Vice President of Haizhi Online. Therefore, communication between buyers and sellers is crucial. At Haizhi Online, journalists saw an "image search" AI tool, which, by uploading drawings into the system, can turn "finding a needle in a haystack" into precise navigation, quickly matching several drawings with high similarity and factories that have produced similar parts. "The operation is very similar to Taobao's image recognition," Liu Haitao said. An intelligent quotation system that can price in one minute and place an order in three minutes, an online collaboration system that automatically annotates processing key points on drawings... At Haizhi Online, there are many such intelligent AI tools. This is made possible by the support of large-scale model technology, which, with the help of millions of historical drawings, has created the first truly deployed large-scale model in the industrial field, breaking through the recognition difficulties of 2D drawings and saving over 60% of time. To further improve transaction efficiency, based on on-site inspection experience, Haizhi Online has also built two databases covering over 700,000 factories and more than 200,000 buyers. Different types of factories and buyers from around the world are analyzed and standardized into hundreds of tags, including production equipment, process level, production capacity, and other dimensions, enabling quick matching in seconds. "Person-to-person" matching has also become possible, as the platform can recommend more suitable partners based on the actual characteristics of the account users, such as recommending buyers from the same hometown to factory owners who are not fluent in Mandarin. In addition to independently developing AI tools, Haizhi Online actively collaborates with technology companies in the industrial artificial intelligence field, with the platform providing data and transaction scenarios, while other companies provide algorithm development capabilities, jointly promoting the deep development of large-scale model technology. Recently, Haizhi Online announced a cooperation agreement with Xuelangyun, aiming to improve the speed and quality of extracting key elements such as shapes and dimensions from drawings, creating more accurate large-scale models for component processing parameters. AI "scouts" driving "cross-border breakthroughs" "Look at the wheels of this organ transplant box, its original production factory was a toy car wheel factory on the verge of bankruptcy. After being found through image search, it went through two leaps. The first time, it became the knob of the largest industrial camera manufacturer in the United States; the second time, it became the wheel of the organ transplant box," shared She Ying, founder of Haizhi Online, with a reporter from China Electronics News. There are countless examples of such "counterattack" cases of cross-border production. A part originally used for cosmetic tools transformed into an important component for a medical company's blood pump; a factory that used to make inner cups for thermos flasks now supplies water storage equipment inner cups for the aviation industry; a factory engaged in gas stoves and lighters production, whose biggest dream was to produce lighters for large companies, can now produce diesel engines... In the past, many factories possessed unique skills but were unaware of them, used to working hard in familiar territories without realizing that their capabilities were far beyond that. Buyers also had no way of knowing that in these seemingly ordinary or even somewhat rudimentary workshops, parts that passed strict inspections could be produced. The significance of digital platforms like Haizhi Online is to provide a better development path for the transformation and upgrading of small factories. Factories no longer need to be evaluated based on which industry they belong to, or passively wait for introductions from acquaintances, but can define their capabilities based on bottom-level processes, allowing factories to be discovered accurately based on their own strengths. Through various AI tools, combined with two large databases, complex drawings can be accurately interpreted, further breaking down the processing requirements, equipment parameters, material requirements, and other key processing points, and automatically matching factories with the same manufacturing processes in the system. Small and medium-sized factories that were previously on the periphery of the supply chain have gained more exposure opportunities through the platform, enabling them to enter high-value-added industries and move closer to core industries. Some factories, with the assistance of AI technology, have transformed suppliers into buyers, pushing more factories to integrate into the industrial chain. A metal manufacturing company in Guangzhou, through the Haizhi Online platform, integrated resources from surrounding factories, shared orders with other factories, formed a collaborative manufacturing network, significantly improving order acceptance capabilities, with 70% of its output value coming from collaborative manufacturing. Intelligent engines driving enterprises overseas A small factory owner with equipment, processes, and experience, but who happens to not understand English, may one day receive an order from overseas. Due to not understanding the client's language and not being able to read English drawing annotations, he may need to spend a lot of time and effort, and may even miss the opportunity for cooperation. Language may be a common problem encountered by many small and medium-sized factories when going overseas. With the help of digital platforms, factories that were originally clueless about international business may now have the confidence to engage with the world. Currently, Haizhi Online's trading platform has AI intelligent translation capabilities in 27 languages, and the company is also focusing on developing online audio and video translation services, suitable for complex scenarios such as technical exchanges and product demonstrations between multinational factories. This means that even if a factory owner in China does not speak Spanish, they can still conduct business negotiations and production discussions with Latin American customers through the platform, smoothly entering the international business arena. Not only does this help Chinese companies "go global," but it also achieves "bringing in." Overseas buyers who were originally skeptical of Chinese manufacturing, through the platform, can intuitively feel the hard strength of Chinese factories in terms of price, efficiency, and service, prompting them to move from observation to placing orders, eventually becoming regular customers, driving more international orders to China. "As long as you take overseas buyers to see Chinese factories, the success rate of placing orders is 100%," She Ying said. With the support of the Haizhi Online platform, many small and medium-sized factories have successfully crossed mountains and seas to reach the global market. A factory in Qingdao with an annual output value of 2 million yuan, by connecting with overseas customers through the platform, can now secure over 1 million yuan in foreign trade orders every year; a factory in Suzhou, after cooperating with the platform, quickly opened up the international market, reaching deals with 40 large and small buyers globally, doubling the value of overseas orders. Technology continues to evolve, but the mission of solving problems remains unchanged. In the face of the increasingly close integration of manufacturing with artificial intelligence technology, Liu Haitao believes that the biggest problem with applying artificial intelligence technology to industry is that those who master the technology may not necessarily understand industry, manufacturing, or the market. "Developing based on imagined needs without actual industrial work experience is like working in isolation," he said. "We need to think about in what scenarios we can truly unleash the real value of artificial intelligence." The goal of AI technology development is not to show off, but to respond to the pain points and needs of the industry in real business scenarios. "The goal is not to use artificial intelligence, but the business results obtained after using it are the focus," Liu Haitao said. "First, in some highly digitized scenarios, let industrial enterprises start using artificial intelligence, then promote the resolution of detailed issues in some detailed scenarios, gradually accumulating into a fully digitized end-to-end process." As of July 2024, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology has promoted the establishment of more than 1,780 public service institutions for small and medium-sized enterprises covering national, provincial, municipal, and county levels, with a coverage rate of administrative regions at the city level and above reaching 84%. With the support of national policies and the blessing of new-generation information technologies such as artificial intelligence, more fair, efficient, and intelligent digital platforms are continuously integrating into industries, significantly accelerating the pace of digital transformation for small and medium-sized enterprises, effectively assisting in the development of specialized, refined, and new industries.

title_en: What kind of company? Can make "stingy" young people dig out a market worth billions.
body_en: Dialogue with decision-makers "We are a group of heroes from Liangshan, doing practical things directly and decisively." This is how Zhang Ning, co-founder of HotMaxx, defined his team in an interview with the China Toy Association's All-Media Center, and it is the key to their ability to stand out in the fiercely competitive retail market. When inventory backlog became a "major problem" for brand owners, and traditional retailers were deeply mired in the quagmire of traffic competition, HotMaxx, in just 5 years, transformed from a one-day sales surge to 80,000 yuan in "accidental clearance sales," into a chain retail enterprise with nearly a thousand stores nationwide. What kind of business considerations are behind this? Is it the huge treasure hidden in the discount store industry, or did he keenly capture a new opportunity to solve the inventory problem for companies? Zhang Ning's insightful views are as follows: 1. Consumers' enthusiasm for surprise discounts far exceeds their sensitivity to traditional low prices. 2. The generation of tail goods stems from brand innovation attempts, and HotMaxx's business model is essentially helping brands reduce the cost of innovation failures. 3. "Emotional satisfaction" is becoming the core variable driving consumer decision-making and continues to permeate all categories of the retail industry. 4. Enter the market with a symbiotic mindset to achieve a pain point closure at both ends of supply and demand. 5. New retail is actually a way to use technology to solve problems that traditional retail cannot solve. The following is the full text of the dialogue (with deletions and modifications): 01. Entrepreneurial Origins From the fire of clearance sales to the awakening of business cognition China Toy Association: How did HotMaxx's business model initially emerge? Zhang Ning: The market fluctuations at the beginning of 2020 caused a large backlog of inventory for brand owners and retailers. HotMaxx's founder, Gu Xiaojian, and the team keenly seized this business opportunity and opened the first discount store for near-expiry food products. What we didn't expect was that the sales on that day exceeded 80,000 yuan! Compared to the previous daily sales of 1,500 yuan, it was a world of difference. This unexpected event made us realize that consumers' enthusiasm for surprise discounts far exceeds their sensitivity to traditional low prices. Therefore, we discovered the market demand and created a unique shopping experience. China Toy Association: What is the core competitiveness of HotMaxx's tail goods sales model compared to traditional retail models? Zhang Ning: In the trend of the retail industry moving towards high quality and high cost-effectiveness, HotMaxx stands out with its tail goods sales model. Its core advantage lies in relying on brand goods to guarantee quality, achieving "high quality + low price" to the utmost extent at affordable prices for consumers. HotMaxx realized that the generation of tail goods stems from brand innovation attempts, and its business model essentially helps brands reduce the cost of innovation failures, providing consumers with high cost-effective goods and solving the problem of handling tail goods for brand owners, paving a unique and socially valuable path in the retail market. 02. From "Buying Things" to "Buying Emotions" The consumption logic behind the hot sales of toys China Toy Association: From the fire of clearance sales to systematic operation, what is the biggest cognitive shift? Zhang Ning: I initially thought it was price-driven, but upon review, I found that when the shelves were cleared and the products were displayed in piles, consumers experienced a "treasure hunt shopping experience." We once conducted a test: the sales of the same trendy blind box in the limited-time discount area were three times that of the regular shelf. This made us realize that we must transform the randomness of surprises into replicable retail logic. China Toy Association: Besides blind box categories, what other categories does HotMaxx sell? What are the main toy brands you cooperate with? Zhang Ning: Most of the toys sold by HotMaxx are authorized contract near-expiry IP products. The main sales are Disney, Marvel, Harry Potter, Crayon Shin-chan, and other IP authorized products; in educational toys, the main sales are LEGO mechanical sets, TOPTOY Chinese building blocks, Bruco Ultraman armor, and other building puzzles. China Toy Association: What considerations are there when choosing to cooperate with trendy toy brands? What principles do you follow? Zhang Ning: HotMaxx mainly considers the market popularity, brand value, product competitiveness, supply chain stability, cooperation mode, brand fit, and consumer demand of trendy toy brands from multiple aspects. China Toy Association: What is the expected proportion of trendy toys and baby products in the product structure? Zhang Ning: We hold a strategic positive attitude towards the trendy toy and baby product categories, planning to increase the sales proportion of these two major categories to double digits in the future. To ensure supply chain stability and product safety control, this category will strictly select cooperation partners and only establish deep cooperation relationships with industry-leading big brands. China Toy Association: How do you view the development trend of the toy industry, and what advice would you like to give to toy companies? Zhang Ning: I believe that the current market's emphasis on the value of "emotional consumption" has become an industry consensus. The hot sales of toy categories reflect consumers' deep pursuit of emotional value in products. This demand is evolving into a "new rigid demand" for young groups. Against the backdrop of consumption upgrading, users' demand for products has surpassed the functional level and shifted towards long-term value exploration in dimensions such as emotional experience, social attributes, and self-expression. With the iteration of Generation Z's consumption concepts, "emotional satisfaction" is becoming the core variable driving consumer decision-making and continues to permeate all categories of the retail industry. This trend is not only reshaping the relationship between people and goods but also requiring retail companies to shift from being mere product providers to creators of emotional value. Toy companies should keenly capture consumers' emotional needs, integrate emotions into design; increase innovation efforts, keep up with trends in intelligence and environmental protection, provide personalized services; actively seek cross-border cooperation, leverage well-known IP to enhance influence; optimize marketing, use social media to expand dissemination, and strengthen supply chain management to ensure product supply and establish a foothold in the market. 03. Technological breakthrough of the soft discount model Reshaping the operational logic of tail goods retail China Toy Association: Since its establishment, HotMaxx has developed rapidly and has established deep cooperation with over 1000 well-known brands at home and abroad. What unique strategies and advantages does HotMaxx have in expanding cooperation with brands that can attract many brands to choose to work with HotMaxx? Zhang Ning: HotMaxx's core strategy focuses on helping brands reach young users. In response to the current situation of declining brand penetration rates in first-tier cities, it naturally presents goods to non-targeted young consumers through offline scenes. Its unique value lies in the fact that even if consumers are not specifically buying a certain type of product, they can complete their first trial through scene guidance, achieve large-scale exposure and penetration among young consumers in first-tier cities, and become an important channel for brands to connect with young users. title_en: Notice on holding the 2024 Academic Annual Conference of the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association (Second Round)
body_en: Relevant units: Pharmaceutical excipients are an important foundation in China's pharmaceutical industry, and are one of the key factors determining the quality of generic drugs and the high-quality development of innovative formulations. The security of the supply chain of pharmaceutical excipients used in high-end formulations in China urgently requires the strengthening of technical innovation and industrial support for domestically produced pharmaceutical excipients. At the same time, ensuring the quality of clinical medication, reducing drug costs, and alleviating the pressure on medical insurance to a large extent also depend on the improvement of the quality of domestically produced pharmaceutical excipients. In line with the principle of "promoting technological innovation in pharmaceutical excipients and enhancing the new quality productivity of the pharmaceutical industry," the "2024 Annual Academic Conference of the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association," hosted by the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association, is scheduled to be held in Hefei, Anhui Province from November 8th to 10th, 2024. This academic conference will feature conference reports in the fields of materials science related to pharmaceutical excipients, innovative drugs, and innovative formulations, analyzing the development difficulties and innovations of pharmaceutical excipients; inviting authoritative experts to deeply discuss the in vivo processes of pharmaceutical excipients and drug delivery carriers, as well as the improvement and innovation of excipient quality. The conference will set up expert venues and young scholar sub-venues on the themes of "Pharmaceutical Excipients, Packaging Materials, and Drug Delivery Devices," "New Materials, New Carriers, and Innovative Formulations," and "Pharmaceutical Excipients and Innovative Drugs," promoting the wide participation of enterprises, academia, and young scholars to jointly focus on the technological innovation and industrial research and development of pharmaceutical excipients. The relevant matters are hereby notified as follows: 1. Conference theme: Promoting technological innovation in pharmaceutical excipients and enhancing the new quality productivity of the pharmaceutical industry. 2. Time and place: November 8th Registration Venue: Hefei Xinji Hotel (2766 Wenzhong Road, Yaohai District, Hefei City, Anhui Province) The main venue and sub-venues on November 9-10 are both at the Shaoquan Lake Campus of Anhui University of Chinese Medicine in Hefei, Anhui Province (350 Longzihu Road, Yaohai District, Hefei City, Anhui Province). 3. Conference arrangements: The conference will adopt a format of reports at the main venue and sub-venues. The conference will invite well-known experts and scholars from domestic universities, research institutes, pharmaceutical companies, research and development units, medical institutions, regulatory agencies, etc., to give keynote speeches and special lectures. Please refer to Annex 1 for the detailed schedule. 4. Participants: Researchers, managers, and graduate students engaged in research and development related to pharmaceutical excipients, pharmaceutical packaging materials, drug delivery devices, formulation quality control, formulation equipment, pharmaceutical services, etc., from higher education institutions, research institutes, pharmaceutical companies, research and development units, medical institutions, drug regulatory agencies, and other related institutions. 5. Call for papers: 1. Requirements for submission of papers: Chinese and English abstracts and paper format. Papers that have not been published in publicly distributed journals or presented at national academic conferences are the responsibility of the authors; please ensure clear expression and accurate data. We welcome active submissions from researchers in the pharmaceutical field. 2. Paper submission method: Please submit the abstract of the paper to the conference website https://yyfl2024.sciconf.cn before October 20, 2024, click on the "Online Paper Submission" button on the right, and follow the process to upload your paper abstract. After successful upload, you will receive an automatic email confirmation of the online submission. After expert review, the organizing committee will select several papers for further communication or publication in the "Drug Analysis" journal. 3. Poster submission method and time: Same as the paper. The conference welcomes poster submissions, which should be in A1 standard size. 6. Registration: (1) Registration method: 1. Please register by clicking on the "Individual Representative Registration" or "Group Representative Registration" button on the conference website link https://yyfl2024.sciconf.cn; 2. Or scan (or long press to recognize) the QR code below with your mobile phone, click on the "Individual Representative Registration" or "Group Representative Registration" button to fill in the registration information and submit. (2) Registration deadline: The registration deadline is October 30, 2024. (3) Notes on registration: 1. To ensure that participants receive registration confirmation, invoices, etc., please fill in accurate and true email addresses, mobile phone numbers, and other information; 2. This registration website is only for registration, and the payment channel is not yet open; 3. Registered individuals can log in to the personal center of the conference website to check and modify their registration information; 4. Participants who do not submit papers can also attend the conference. 7. Conference fees: (1) Conference registration fee: 1. Registration fee standard: The registration fee includes conference material fees and lunch during the conference. 2. Payment methods: (1) Telegraphic transfer method: After registering for the conference, participants should pay the registration fee by bank transfer, supporting both corporate and personal transfers to the following account: Payee: Chinese Pharmaceutical Association Bank: Bank of China Head Office Account number: 778350009320 It is recommended to use online banking for personal transfers, or you can also use the Alipay transfer function (transfer to a bank card, with the name field filled in as "Chinese Pharmaceutical Association"). Please indicate "Pharmaceutical Excipients + Participant's Name + Unit Abbreviation" in the remittance note. After successful payment, please upload the remittance voucher to the conference website in a timely manner for the secretariat to confirm the payment information and issue an invoice; (2) On-site payment: You can pay the registration fee by mobile online banking, or scan the payment QR code on-site (Alipay, WeChat) for payment; there is no POS machine on-site, and payment methods such as card swiping and UnionPay QuickPass are not supported. (2) Matters related to invoices: 1. This conference can provide a VAT ordinary invoice for "conference registration fees" (electronic invoice). After uploading the personal remittance voucher (photo of the complete order, screenshot, etc.) to the conference system, please accurately fill in the invoice information in the billing instructions section of your personal information. 2. In cases where the name of the remitter does not match the participant's name, one unit remits money for multiple representatives, or the unit requests separate invoices, please send a detailed explanation by email to the secretariat at z38@cpa.org.cn, providing the remitter's name, participant's name, work unit, contact information, detailed information for issuing the invoice, number of invoices and amounts, as well as the person receiving the invoice and mailing address. 3. Representatives who are unable to attend the conference due to special reasons after remittance can apply for a full refund of the registration fee by sending an email to the secretariat. The refund process will be handled uniformly after the conference, and the refund will be returned along the original payment path. For accurate refund processing, please indicate the full name and account information (account number, bank) of the original remitter in the refund application email. 8. Other matters: Accommodation and transportation expenses for participants are self-funded. Please refer to Annex 2 for hotel reservation and transportation information. 9. Conference credits: Full-time participants will be awarded 3 continuing education credits from the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association. 10. Contact person and contact information: 1. Contact person: Zhu Yizi (conference paper submission, registration fee payment, etc.) Peng Can, Duan Xiaohui, Lu Jia (conference consultation, accommodation arrangements, etc.) 2. Contact information: 010-67095606, 13956024560, 13956990010, 15212451687 3. Secretariat email: z38@cpa.org.cn Annex 1. title_en: Top 100 chain stores have a new layout: scale exceeds 2 trillion, specialty stores are eye-catching.
body_en: On June 18, the China Chain Store Association (CCFA) released the "2024 China Top 100 Chain Stores". According to CCFA data, the overall sales of the top 100 chain enterprises in China in 2024 reached 2.13 trillion yuan, with a total of 257,200 stores, representing a growth of 4.9% and 13.5% respectively compared to 2023. Companies such as Walmart (China), Juran Smart Home New Retail, Suning.com, Gaoxin Retail (Runfeng), Hema (China), Yonghui Superstores, Wumart Technology, Wangfujing, and Mei Yi Jia have maintained their leading positions. Walmart (China) topped the list with sales of 158.845 billion yuan. In terms of changes in the list, five new companies including Wanchen Biology, Liangpinpuzi, West Asia and America, Juewei Food, and Guizhou Heli have entered the list. Hunan Mingming Busy made it to the top ten for the first time with sales exceeding 55 billion yuan. In terms of scale, the number of companies with sales exceeding 30 billion yuan increased from 21 in 2023 to 24 in 2024. Comparing the lists from 2022 and 2023, companies like Harbin Central Red, Xingsheng Community, and Renrenle continued to decline in rankings and exited the top 100 in 2024. Renrenle announced the termination of its stock listing on June 5, 2025, due to consecutive losses. In the 2024 Top 100 chain enterprises, there are 46 comprehensive retail stores, 23 supermarkets, 13 convenience stores, and 18 specialty stores. From the list data, comprehensive retail enterprises face greater growth pressure. Only 19 companies saw year-on-year sales growth, with only 9 achieving growth in both sales and number of stores, while the rest performed poorly. Some former retail giants are being marginalized by e-commerce and new formats due to limited "positive expansion". For example, in 2024, Suning.com and CR Vanguard saw a 14.1% and 23.1% year-on-year decrease in sales respectively, with a 7.0% and 18.3% decrease in the number of stores. Other leading comprehensive retail enterprises, such as Tianhong Technology and Yinzuo Group, are also facing varying degrees of contraction and adjustment under profit shrinkage. In fact, the development of comprehensive retail enterprises has been hindered not only in 2024. The "2023 China Top 100 Chain Stores" showed that comprehensive retail enterprises were already facing sales difficulties. In 2023, Suning.com saw a 15.5% year-on-year decrease in sales, CR Vanguard saw a 9.7% decrease, and the number of stores decreased by 13.9%. Comprehensive retail is characterized by its "large" format. When facing the rapidly changing consumer market, the lack of flexibility and difficulty in adapting the model to changes can lead to stagnation in development. With rising fixed costs such as labor and rent, the penetration rate of online sales is gradually increasing, leading to the closure of inefficient stores and the contraction of non-core areas for many comprehensive retail enterprises. Previously, Peng Jianzhen, the president of the China Chain Store Association, pointed out that in the current economic cycle, comprehensive retail enterprises that are "not having a good time" need to pay attention to the decrease in customer traffic. This means that the absolute decrease in the number of customers represents whether the company's positioning, products, and services meet the needs of the target customers, and maintaining customer traffic is more important than maintaining the average customer spending. It is worth noting that the data from the "2024 China Top 100 Chain Stores" list shows that supermarket enterprises are gradually improving. Among the 23 supermarkets on the list, 12 saw a year-on-year increase in sales, with 6 companies including Hema, Jiajia Yue, and Century Lianhua achieving growth in both sales and number of stores. Hema (China) saw sales exceed 75 billion yuan, a 27.1% year-on-year increase, with the number of stores exceeding 420, a 16.7% increase. Pandonglai saw sales exceed 16.9 billion yuan, a 58.5% year-on-year increase, showing outstanding performance. The stable and positive sales trend is the result of breakthroughs in operations. Some new chain supermarket enterprises (such as Hema, Pandonglai, etc.) focus on high-frequency categories (such as fresh food, cooked food, pre-made dishes, etc.), strengthen their local life service functions, and have gained strong user stickiness and high repurchase rates, improving their single-store operating capabilities. Pandonglai, with 13 stores, achieved revenue of 10.7 billion yuan and a net profit of 140 million yuan. Since its rise to fame, it has been a benchmark for many supermarkets to learn from. Chen Liping, a professor at the Capital University of Economics and Business Consumer Big Data Research Institute, previously told 21st Century Economic Report that at present, value-creating supermarkets like Pandonglai are showing positive development trends and are expected to become mainstream in the future. This is mainly due to their direct procurement and self-owned supply chain system, which allows for a wide range of products in the supermarket at affordable prices, with excellent freshness. They also focus on on-site processing, providing excellent service. In the market environment of the rise of experiential economy, this innovative and differentiated business model meets the diverse needs of consumers. In addition, convenience store enterprises overall continue to show a trend of growth in both sales and number of stores. However, comparing the lists from 2023 and 2024, well-known convenience store companies such as Mei Yi Jia, 7-Eleven, and Lawson saw a significant slowdown in sales growth, dropping from 20.1%, 30.0%, and 23.7% in 2023 to 3.1%, 19.7%, and 4.7% in 2024. Convenience stores mainly provide temporary services that can be obtained immediately. Initially, both foreign convenience stores like 7-Eleven, Lawson, and local convenience stores like Bianlifeng and Mei Yi Jia, expanded their store networks and aggressively expanded into lower-tier markets through measures such as "brutal growth". However, due to saturation in expansion, rising operating costs, the impact of new retail formats, and consumer differentiation, convenience store enterprises have gradually entered a bottleneck period in their development. Some of the new stores added to the Top 100 enterprises in 2024 come from convenience store companies. Analysts believe that in order for these companies to maintain stable growth and not fall behind, they need to focus on operational strategies, find new growth points, and adapt to market changes. From the list data, specialty store enterprises in 2024 have the best operating conditions, becoming the new driving force of retail. Whether it is in the pharmaceutical, beauty, maternity and baby, eyewear, or pet industries, overall sales and the number of stores have seen double-digit growth, highlighting the strong demand and high user stickiness in segmented markets. Specifically, in the pharmaceutical chain field, Dashenlin has expanded its stores rapidly, with a 17.6% year-on-year increase compared to the previous year. Haiziwang has also performed well in the maternity and baby products sector, with sales exceeding 16.9 billion yuan in 2024. In the vibrant snack industry, emerging discount stores have risen, not only impacting the market share of traditional supermarkets, but also having a profound impact on the business model of the entire industry. Hunan Mingming Busy Commercial Chain Co., Ltd. (including Snacks Busy and Zhao Yiming Snacks) made a breakthrough into the top 10 of the 2024 China Chain Store list, with a 132.7% year-on-year increase in sales and a 105.6% increase in the number of stores. However, Zhu Danpeng, a Chinese food industry analyst, pointed out to the 21st Century Economic Report that the entire snack retail industry in China is facing significant problems in terms of store expansion and survival from the industry side. Secondly, the competition in the entire product pricing is very fierce, and companies also need to pay attention to the hidden dangers of vicious competition in the industry. The "2024 China Top 100 Chain Stores" not only reflects the performance of various enterprises but also reflects the restructuring trend of the overall structure of the retail industry in China. In the future, the competition among chain enterprises will increasingly rely on user operation capabilities, service experience, product accuracy, and technological support. At the intersection of consumption upgrading and rational return, those who can understand users, innovate continuously, will be able to occupy new industry highlands and maintain growth momentum. With the continuous development of the retail market, competition is becoming increasingly fierce. Specialty store chain retailers need to continuously improve their competitiveness to cope with the competition pressure from other retail formats and e-commerce platforms. title_en: Resolutely crack down on counterfeiting and inferior products, safeguard quality sleep | Mousse successfully cooperates with the police to crack down on multiple cases of counterfeit mattresses.
body_en: Crackdown on Counterfeiting and Safeguarding Rights Mousse Group has always regarded brand protection and combating counterfeit products as important tasks. Recently, we have cooperated with police forces in multiple provinces, taking strong measures to successfully crack down on a series of cases involving counterfeit "Mousse" trademarks. Recently, the court sentenced six suspects in one of the cases: all individuals involved were sentenced to imprisonment and fines; the main culprit was sentenced to five years and six months in prison, fined over 1.4 million yuan, and ordered to forfeit illegal gains. In addition, the counterfeit goods and production tools involved were confiscated, and the counterfeit production sites were completely destroyed. This series of crackdown and rights protection actions have achieved significant results! [Case 1] Lin and others Counterfeiting Registered Trademarks In January 2024, based on the information we provided, the Changyuan Public Security Bureau in Henan quickly conducted investigations and filed cases, and after investigations in Guangdong, Zhejiang, Hunan, Shandong, Guangxi, and other provinces and cities, a unified crackdown was carried out to comprehensively strike the criminal chain. Through these actions, the production and sales criminal dens were successfully destroyed, and the six suspects involved were arrested and brought to justice. Recently, the court conducted the first trial and verdict on the case. The individuals involved were sentenced to imprisonment and fines, with two main suspects each sentenced to five years and six months in prison, and fined over 1.4 million and 900,000 yuan respectively. In addition, the court also required them to forfeit illegal gains, and the counterfeit goods and production equipment involved were confiscated. This judgment once again highlights the determination of judicial authorities to combat intellectual property crimes and sets an important example for enterprise rights protection. [Case 2] Liu and others Counterfeiting Registered Trademarks During the process of safeguarding and cracking down on counterfeiting on online platforms, the legal department of Mousse Group discovered that multiple Taobao stores were suspected of selling counterfeit products and were related. The legal department immediately reported the case to the Zhongshan Public Security Bureau. The police responded promptly, filed a case, and launched an investigation. Through in-depth data analysis, the police successfully identified the identities of the members of the criminal gang. In November 2024, the police conducted simultaneous operations in Dongguan, Foshan, Yibin, Huanggang, and other places, successfully arresting Liu, Li, Xu, and 6 other suspects, and seized 78 counterfeit mattresses and a large number of counterfeit Mousse Group registered trademarks' packaging, labels, and semi-finished products in warehouses and factories in Foshan and Huanggang. In addition, one fugitive suspect was successfully captured in February 2025. Currently, this case is still in the trial process. Despite these counterfeit products bearing the same logo as "Mousse," their manufacturing costs, craftsmanship, and product quality are vastly different from the genuine products. Some unscrupulous merchants even deceive consumers with low prices and false advertising, not only seriously harming the legitimate rights and interests of consumers but also seriously disrupting market order and undermining the fair competition environment. Determination to Safeguard Rights and Cooperation Mechanism As the "gatekeeper" of Mousse's intellectual property protection, we always emphasize: ✓ Determination to Safeguard Rights: We adopt a "zero tolerance" attitude towards infringement! In 2024 alone, Mousse successfully removed over 50,000 infringing links from online platforms, with compensation for infringement by individual e-commerce stores reaching up to 1.5 million yuan; ✓ Cooperation Mechanism: Establish long-term cooperation with law enforcement departments in multiple provinces and cities nationwide; join Alibaba's Anti-Counterfeiting Alliance (AACA) and JD.com's Rights Protection Alliance to provide rights protection solutions from the platform side. Consumer Tips 1. Choose legitimate channels: Tmall/JD flagship stores, authorized offline stores (can be checked on the official website and official WeChat account). 2. Beware of low-price traps: Genuine mattresses have transparent pricing, prices far below market prices = counterfeit goods! 3. Build a fake-free ecosystem together: If you find suspected counterfeit products, you can contact us immediately. Every report you make helps protect your family's sleep safety! · Reporting hotline: (0769) 85586668--6951 (extension number) · Email: chen.yan@derucci.com Protecting intellectual property is protecting innovative vitality. The legal department of Mousse Group will continue to cooperate with regulatory authorities to crack down severely on infringement and also call on consumers to jointly strengthen brand protection defenses. Some brand protection achievements of Mousse: 1. E-commerce platform handling: In the first quarter of 2025, over 26,000 infringing product links have been successfully removed. 2. Mousse sued Xiao Xiang and Foshan Xi Yue Furniture Co., Ltd. for trademark infringement and unfair competition disputes, with the defendants ordered to immediately stop the infringement and compensate Mousse for economic losses and reasonable expenses of 1.5 million yuan. 3. Mousse sued Wang Ruifeng and Foshan Mengye Furniture Co., Ltd. for trademark infringement disputes, with the defendants ordered to compensate Mousse for economic losses and reasonable expenses of 1.5 million yuan. 4. Mousse sued Suzhou Muse Noble Home Furnishings Co., Ltd. for trademark infringement and unfair competition disputes, with the defendants ordered to compensate Mousse for economic losses and rights protection expenses totaling 900,000 yuan, with Xu Fenglan bearing joint liability. 5. Mousse sued Duan Chaoqi for trademark infringement and unfair competition disputes, ultimately applying for compulsory enforcement of 500,000 yuan. 6. Mousse sued Foshan Muse Home Products Co., Ltd., Guo Fanping, Guo Shuibing, and Xiao Bihong for trademark infringement and unfair competition disputes, with the defendants ordered to compensate Mousse for economic losses and reasonable expenses of 600,000 yuan. 7. Mousse sued Suzhou Muse Aristocratic Home Furnishings Co., Ltd. for trademark infringement and unfair competition disputes, with the defendant Suzhou Muse Aristocratic Company ordered to compensate for economic losses and rights protection expenses totaling 800,000 yuan.

title_en: [Financial News Broadcast] Ele.me's former CEO taken away by police! Stamp duty on securities transactions increased by 52.4% in the first 5 months.
body_en: ★ Macro Dynamics ★ Ministry of Commerce: From January to May 2025, the total amount of foreign investment absorbed nationwide was 358.19 billion yuan. From January to May, a total of 24,018 new foreign-invested enterprises were established nationwide, an increase of 10.4% year-on-year; the actual use of foreign investment was 358.19 billion yuan, a decrease of 13.2% year-on-year. In terms of industries, the actual use of foreign investment in the manufacturing industry was 91.52 billion yuan, and in the service industry, it was 259.64 billion yuan. The actual use of foreign investment in high-tech industries was 109.04 billion yuan, with the actual use of foreign investment in e-commerce services, aerospace equipment manufacturing, chemical pharmaceutical manufacturing, and medical equipment manufacturing increasing by 146%, 74.9%, 59.2%, and 20% respectively. In terms of sources, actual investment from the ASEAN region in China increased by 20.5%, while actual investment from Japan, the UK, South Korea, and Germany increased by 70.2%, 60.9%, 10.3%, and 7.1% respectively (including investment data through free trade zones). Ministry of Finance: Securities transaction stamp duty in January-May was 66.8 billion yuan, an increase of 52.4% year-on-year. Ministry of Finance data shows that the stamp duty from January to May was 178.7 billion yuan, an increase of 18.8% year-on-year. Among them, the securities transaction stamp duty was 66.8 billion yuan, an increase of 52.4% year-on-year. The "Guobu" policy of replacing old with new will continue, and central funds will be allocated in batches. According to Xinhua News Agency, relevant departments have reported that there is no change in the policy of expanding the scope of the replacement of old products with new ones, and the progress of subsidy funds is in line with expectations. Central funds will be gradually allocated in the third and fourth quarters. It is understood that since the beginning of this year, in accordance with the deployment of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry of Commerce, and other relevant departments have jointly implemented the policy of expanding the scope of the replacement of old products with new ones, following the good practices of 2024, directly allocating 300 billion yuan of national debt funds to expand the scope of the implementation of the replacement of old products with new ones to localities within the year. In January and April of this year, a total of 162 billion yuan in central funds has been allocated to support localities in carrying out the replacement of old products with new ones in the first and second quarters. According to the established work arrangements, the National Development and Reform Commission and the Ministry of Finance will respectively allocate central funds to support the replacement of old products with new ones in the third and fourth quarters in July and October, and localities will continue to provide support for supporting funds. Relevant departments will guide localities to further optimize and improve the subsidy distribution methods to ensure that the policy is implemented more smoothly and orderly, and that funds are used in a balanced manner until the end of the year. title_en: Strong responsibility promotes compliance and stable development.
body_en: This newspaper (Tan Xing reporter Zhang Xiaohang) The Market Supervision Administration of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region recently held a video conference on administrative guidance for platform enterprises in the entire region, further strengthening the main responsibility of platform enterprises, improving the compliance level of platform enterprises, and promoting the high-quality development of the platform economy in Guangxi. The meeting pointed out that platform enterprises should strictly implement their main responsibilities, actively cooperate with market supervision departments, and jointly create an orderly and competitive online market development environment; focus on prominent issues in the platform economy such as "no refunds" and "automatic price adjustment" to carry out self-inspection and rectification, establish, modify, improve, and publicize platform agreement rules, and strictly fulfill obligations such as verification registration, product information inspection, and monitoring. The meeting emphasized that platform enterprises should fulfill their obligations to review merchants, ensure food safety and service quality; optimize algorithm rules to protect the labor rights and interests of delivery riders; eliminate unfair competition such as "big data discrimination" and practices such as "substituting fines for management"; continuously strengthen guidance and promotion for merchants and consumers to form a good social trend of preventing food waste. The meeting required market supervision departments at all levels in Guangxi to carry out administrative guidance and publicity and education to various platform enterprises in their jurisdiction in a targeted manner according to their territorial and business functions, effectively strengthen work responsibilities, improve regulatory effectiveness, achieve "finding people, clarifying matters, and assigning responsibilities", ensure that relevant opinions are conveyed and implemented. Focus on prominent issues that consumers strongly reflect and public opinion concentrates on in areas such as current platform rules, platform fees, and live e-commerce, comprehensively investigate the current situation of platform rules, vigorously rectify phenomena that use rules to disrupt fair competition and infringe on the legitimate rights and interests of platform merchants and consumers. At the meeting, the heads of relevant departments of the Market Supervision Administration of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region respectively provided administrative guidance on the implementation of compliance management responsibilities by platform enterprises, investigation and rectification of prominent issues in the platform economy, urging food delivery platforms to prevent food waste, lawfully safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of instant delivery riders, and key areas of network market supervision such as prices, unfair competition, advertising, product quality, and food safety. National platform enterprise leaders in Guangxi, such as JD.com, Taotian, Douyin, Pinduoduo, Meituan, Ele.me, Shansong, SF Express, Dada Express, and UU Run Errands, attended the meeting at the main venue. About 550 people, including relevant officials from market supervision bureaus in various cities (prefectures) of Guangxi, platform enterprise leaders in various cities, national platform enterprise local agents, and distribution partners, attended the meeting at the sub-venue.

body_en: Product and Corporate News 01. LEGO Group launches Grand Line One Piece Building Set The second season of "One Piece" is set to premiere on the Netflix platform, and LEGO Group has released a series of treasure building sets inspired by the show. The LEGO "One Piece" series includes seven sets of nautical-themed sets, with a variety of styles, including cute figures of Luffy and Buggy, as well as the luxurious Baratie restaurant replica set - made up of 3402 pieces and comes with 10 mini-figures crew members, full of details. It is reported that these seven building sets will officially go on sale on August 1st, coinciding with the premiere of the new season on Netflix, bringing fans a double surprise. (Toy Book) 02. Hasbro launches Beyblade X 25th Anniversary Commemorative Set Hasbro has announced a Beyblade X 25th Anniversary Commemorative Set, which includes four launchers, four attack-type tops with attack blades, and the iconic X-Accelerator Gear System. (Toy Book) 03. Pop Mart opens its first store in Bali on Kuta Beach Recently, Pop Mart's first store in Bali opened grandly on the shores of Kuta Beach. Bali is a globally renowned tourist destination, known as the "Island of the Gods." On the opening day of the first store in Bali, several events with strong local cultural characteristics were held, attracting a large crowd to the store. (Pop Mart official website) 04. Pop Mart launches new product - Weird Convenience Store Pop Mart's new blind box series "Weird Convenience Store" from Labubu will be officially released on June 12th. This blind box series is inspired by various classic foods found in Japanese convenience stores and features Labubu in various forms, including rice balls, grilled chicken skewers, milk, cup noodles, potato chips, corn, fried noodles, salad, tempura, and grilled sausages, among other popular convenience store snacks. (Pop Mart official website) 05. Pokémon introduces the Crimson and Violet Rival Elite Trainer Box, collaborates with Squishmallow for a new collection The Crimson and Violet Rival Elite Trainer Box contains everything a trainer needs to participate in the classic trading card game. It includes 9 booster packs, a foil promo card featuring Team Rocket, 65 card sleeves, 45 Pokémon TCG energy cards, a player's guide, six dice, a coin flip die, two markers, and a code card. The Pokémon Squishmallows collaboration adds a new member: a cheerful Pikachu with a happy expression, and Torchic, a Fire-type starter Pokémon from the Hoenn region. The series has previously featured fan-favorite Pokémon such as Gengar, Togepi, Snorlax, Piplup, and Dragonite. These plush toys are made of soft fabric and feature embroidered details, making them an excellent choice for Pokémon fans to collect. (Toy Book) 06. 52TOYS launches NINNIC and NOOK Dragon Trainer collaboration, Laplly Roaming Antique Shop On June 11th, 52TOYS launched the NINNIC and NOOK Dragon Trainer collaboration: NINNIC - Toothless Limited Plush Keychain and NOOK Limited Edition - Toothless NOOK. The two Toothless figures are dressed in fierce yet adorable outfits, resonating with a brave and fearless theme across different tribes. The popular IP Laplly returns with a new "Roaming Antique Shop" series! The series includes six regular figures and one hidden figure, each with unique features. In "Rose of Love," Laplly is surrounded by vibrant retro roses, creating a romantic and slightly mysterious atmosphere with the color of the roses matching her expression. In "Girl in the Portrait," Laplly transforms into the protagonist of a portrait, cleverly blending with the background frame design, creating a moving vintage painting. The hidden figure is full of surprises, with design elements cleverly echoing the antique shop theme, mysterious and rare, like discovering a priceless treasure in an antique shop. Although the probability is low, it is worth everyone's effort to find it. (52TOYS) 07. Blueco becomes the exclusive strategic partner of the "Journey of Light·Prospect Ultraman 60th Anniversary Theme Exhibition" On June 11th, Blueco announced its partnership as the exclusive strategic partner of the "Journey of Light·Prospect Ultraman 60th Anniversary Theme Exhibition." Looking back on the 4-year journey of Blueco and Ultraman, the two have jointly released more than 10 versions and over 80 Ultraman building block products, featuring 140+ character images. The diverse Blueco Ultraman series building block products cater to Ultraman fans of all ages. (Blueco) 08. Asmodee announces the acquisition of iconic game IP - Zombicide Asmodee, a leading global tabletop game industry company, has officially announced the inclusion of the famous game series - Zombicide - in its IP lineup. "Zombicide" is a groundbreaking tabletop game that has set the industry benchmark since its launch in 2012, using crowdfunding in the board game field. The series has sold over 2 million copies worldwide. In the future, the "Zombicide" series will be part of the Guillotine Games brand and will be integrated into the Asmodee Group's lifestyle business division for operation. (Asmodee official) 09. Moose Toys to release two SDCC exclusive Pomni dolls Moose Toys will release two dolls inspired by the popular YouTube animated series "Amazing Digital Circus," including two poses - Pomni Possessed and Pomni Puking. Each limited edition doll comes with 3000 pieces and is packaged in a custom collector's box, priced at $14.99. (Toy Book) 10. title_en: The "Clear and Rectify the Abuse of AI Technology" special action has disposed of more than 3,500 illegal AI products.
body_en: Beijing, June 20th (China Youth Daily, China Youth Online reporter He Chunchung) The data released by the Cyberspace Administration of China today shows that since the launch of the "Clear Sky and Crackdown on the Abuse of AI Technology" special action in April 2025, more than 3,500 illegal AI products such as mini-programs, applications, and intelligent entities have been disposed of in the first phase, clearing more than 960,000 pieces of illegal information, and handling more than 3,700 accounts. During the special action, local cyberspace authorities have taken multiple measures to fulfill their territorial management responsibilities. The Beijing Cyberspace Administration has set up a reporting channel for the governance of AI technology abuse, handling 26 related reports. The Shanghai Cyberspace Administration has promoted the implementation of identification requirements, organized 4 sessions of legal publicity and special exchanges, and key enterprises in the region have basically completed the explicit identification norms online. The Zhejiang Cyberspace Administration has increased supervision over local AI applications and website platforms, with various platforms intercepting and clearing more than 25.5 million pieces of illegal information and questions. Key website platforms have strengthened the governance of the abuse of AI technology at the source. Tencent has raised the admission threshold, optimized inspection mechanisms, rejected and disposed of a total of more than 570 illegal mini-programs, applications, and so on. Weibo has reviewed and disposed of more than 4,800 pieces of illegal content through strategic identification, user reports, and other channels, and published typical cases. Tongyi Platform has established a secure management system around the data lifecycle, strengthening training corpus management in data collection, training, and use stages. Key platforms such as Alibaba and Kuaishou are actively promoting the implementation of implicit identification of metadata.
