title_en: Stone Technology goes to Hong Kong for a second listing, aiming to increase globalization efforts.
body_en: China Business News reporter Li Kun and Li Zhenghao reported from Beijing Recently, Stone Technology (688169.SH) announced that the company plans to issue shares overseas and list on the main board of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. Regarding the reasons for listing in Hong Kong at this time, Stone Technology told China Business News that it is to expand financing channels and optimize capital structure. Listing in Hong Kong can provide a broader financing platform for Stone Technology, meeting the substantial funding needs for its business expansion. At the same time, introducing new investors can help optimize the company's capital structure, enhance financial stability, and lay a solid economic foundation for future sustainable development. In response to this, Ding Daoshi, director of the Speed ​​Research Institute, told reporters, "Several domestic companies have started preparations for listing in Hong Kong, and some have already successfully listed. This indicates that the capital market has shown signs of recovery. In addition, when A-shares fell before, the market later showed some signs of recovery. Coupled with a series of policies and measures to promote consumption introduced by the country in the second half of last year, I think now is still a relatively good listing window compared to the past two years. Therefore, many companies have intensively opened the IPO path. Moreover, previously, companies like CATL, Alibaba, and JD.com have listed in Hong Kong. Looking at their subsequent development performance, it is a good choice, and the Hong Kong stock market has a large number of investors and liquidity, which can support these companies' expectations for substantial development through listing in Hong Kong." Listing in Hong Kong Data provided by Stone Technology to reporters shows that from 2022 to 2024, Stone Technology's operating income will be 6.629 billion yuan, 8.654 billion yuan, and 11.945 billion yuan, showing a steady growth trend. In the first quarter of 2025, the operating income reached 3.428 billion yuan, an 86.22% increase from the same period last year, indicating that the company's business is continuously expanding, and there is strong demand for its products in the market. Financial reports show that Stone Technology's revenue in 2024 was 11.945 billion yuan, a 38% increase from the same period last year. Stone Technology's net profit in 2024 was 1.977 billion yuan, a 3.64% decrease from 2.051 billion yuan in the same period last year; the non-net profit was 1.62 billion yuan, an 11.26% decrease from 1.826 billion yuan in the same period last year. At the same time, Stone Technology's revenue in the first quarter of 2025 was 3.428 billion yuan, an 86% increase from 1.841 billion yuan in the same period last year. Stone Technology's net profit in the first quarter of 2025 was 267 million yuan, a 33% decrease from 400 million yuan in the same period last year; the non-net profit was 242 million yuan, a 29.28% decrease from 342 million yuan in the same period last year. Based on such business development and performance, Stone Technology stated that listing can enhance global brand awareness and competitiveness. Leveraging Hong Kong's status as an international financial center and its global investor base, Stone Technology's brand exposure will be significantly enhanced, helping further open up international markets, enhance its influence and competitiveness in the global smart appliance field, and consolidate its leading position in the industry. Additionally, it can better utilize the advantages of the international capital market. Hong Kong's capital market is highly internationalized, with free capital flow, attracting a more diverse range of international investors, such as sovereign wealth funds and pension funds. This will not only bring financial support to Stone Technology but also provide abundant market resources and strategic advice, promote the deep integration of the company with the international market, enhance the company's governance level and operational management capabilities. Furthermore, it meets the company's business development needs and strategic planning: With the continuous expansion and diversification of Stone Technology's business, including product research and development, market expansion, and industrial chain extension, a large amount of capital and resources are needed. Listing can provide strong financial support, help the company achieve global layout and long-term development strategic goals, further increase the company's market share and profitability. In response to this, Ding Daoshi said, "From a financial perspective, Stone Technology still maintains a double-digit high-speed development pace. Although this kind of medium-high-speed development sacrifices some profit, and even profit growth has declined, in the long run, this strategy is correct because consumers in the past two years are more willing to spend less money to buy more products and better services. Not only Stone Technology, many companies in various industries are experiencing rapid revenue growth, but profit growth is not as fast, and some companies even see a decline in profits. This development approach is a strategy to cope with the changes of the times. If your income is not increasing as much, but your profit is growing significantly, this is actually dangerous, indicating that you are not giving benefits to your consumers or partners, but taking most of the cake for yourself. This is actually a strategy for longer-term development of a large company." Development Layout Information shows that Stone Technology's main business covers the design, research and development, production, and sales of smart hardware such as smart floor-sweeping robots and washing machines. Among them, smart floor-sweeping robots are the company's core business segment. The company's annual report shows that in 2024, Stone Technology's global floor-sweeping machine sales reached 3.45 million units, a year-on-year increase of 32.9%. According to IDC data, Stone Technology's share in the global floor-sweeping machine market is 16.0%, ranking second, only after iRobot. In the Chinese market, Stone Technology also ranks second, only after Ecovacs. Stone Technology was listed on the A-share market in February 2020. If successful in listing in Hong Kong this time, it will become one of the few "A+H" dual-platform smart hardware companies. Public information shows that Stone Technology's founder is Chang Jing. In the first half of 2024, Chang Jing cashed out at least 400 million yuan, Stone Technology's investor Ding Di cashed out more than 200 million yuan, and Xiaomi cashed out more than 600 million yuan. It is understood that since 2023, Chang Jing has reduced his holdings of Stone Technology's stock twice, cashing out a total of 888 million yuan, and his shareholding ratio has also decreased from 23.15% to 21.03%. Regarding the future development layout, Stone Technology told reporters that the company will first deepen its globalization strategy, continue to expand overseas markets, strengthen market penetration in different countries and regions, enhance brand awareness and market share. By listing in Hong Kong, it will further attract international investors, utilize their financial and resource support, optimize overseas supply chain layout, improve overseas capital turnover efficiency, reduce tariff risks, enhance the company's competitiveness in the global market, and achieve coordinated development in domestic and international markets. Secondly, promote product diversification and innovation. Increase research and development investment, continuously enrich the product matrix, expand further into other smart appliance fields beyond existing floor-sweeping robots, floor washing machines, such as dryers, washing and drying machines, to meet diverse consumer needs. At the same time, strengthen cooperation with research institutions, universities, etc., actively explore the application of cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence and robotics, enhance product intelligence and user experience, and lead the development trend of the smart home industry. Thirdly, strengthen industrial chain integration and cooperation. With the financing from listing, Stone Technology is expected to integrate and cooperate upstream and downstream in the industrial chain, invest in or acquire related companies to improve its own industrial chain layout, enhance control over raw material procurement, production, sales channels, reduce costs, improve operational efficiency, and profitability. Finally, enhance brand and service quality. With the intensification of market competition, the importance of brand and service is increasingly prominent. Stone Technology will strive to shape a high-end, intelligent, and reliable brand image, strengthen brand building and promotion, increase brand added value. At the same time, improve after-sales service network, enhance service quality, provide consumers with better, more convenient pre-sales, in-sales, and after-sales services, enhance user stickiness and brand loyalty. In addition, strengthen data and privacy protection. In the digital age, data security and privacy protection have become the focus of consumer attention. Stone Technology will attach great importance to the security and privacy protection of user data, strengthen technological research and development and management measures, ensure the legal collection, storage, and use of user data, comply with data protection regulations in different countries and regions, create a safe and reliable user environment, enhance user trust in the brand. In response to this, Ding Daoshi believes that there are still uncertainties in the future development of Stone Technology, but some of its products have been recognized by consumers in many countries at home and abroad, and it is in a leading position in the industry. Therefore, as long as the fundamentals of the products are good, even if there are fluctuations in the company's finances or management at a certain stage, the problems are not significant because ultimately, this industry relies on the products.

Not only Stone Technology, many companies in various industries are experiencing rapid revenue growth, but profit growth is not as fast, and some companies even see a decline in profits. This development approach is a strategy to cope with the changes of the times. Development Layout Information shows that Stone Technology's main business covers the design, research and development, production, and sales of smart hardware such as smart floor-sweeping robots and washing machines. It is understood that since 2023, Chang Jing has reduced his holdings of Stone Technology's stock twice, cashing out a total of 888 million yuan, and his shareholding ratio has also decreased from 23.15% to 21.03%. Regarding the future development layout, Stone Technology told reporters that the company will first deepen its globalization strategy, continue to expand overseas markets, strengthen market penetration in different countries and regions, enhance brand awareness and market share. By listing in Hong Kong, it will further attract international investors, utilize their financial and resource support, optimize overseas supply chain layout, improve overseas capital turnover efficiency, reduce tariff risks, enhance the company's competitiveness in the global market, and achieve coordinated development in domestic and international markets. Secondly, promote product diversification and innovation. Increase research and development investment, continuously enrich the product matrix, expand further into other smart appliance fields beyond existing floor-sweeping robots, floor washing machines, such as dryers, washing and drying machines, to meet diverse consumer needs. At the same time, strengthen cooperation with research institutions, universities, etc., actively explore the application of cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence and robotics, enhance product intelligence and user experience, and lead the development trend of the smart home industry. Thirdly, strengthen industrial chain integration and cooperation. With the financing from listing, Stone Technology is expected to integrate and cooperate upstream and downstream in the industrial chain, invest in or acquire related companies to improve its own industrial chain layout, enhance control over raw material procurement, production, sales channels, reduce costs, improve operational efficiency, and profitability. Stone Technology will strive to shape a high-end, intelligent, and reliable brand image, strengthen brand building and promotion, increase brand added value. title_en: Under the influence of the epidemic, how can fruits and vegetables flow smoothly through the supply chain?
body_en: Affected by factors such as the COVID-19 epidemic, both passenger and logistics flows have been pressed with a "slow start" button, leading to declining prices and sluggish sales of fresh agricultural products in some areas. Online sales, live streaming sales by leading cadres, and the opening of green channels... various regions are adopting a series of measures to solve the problem of unsaleable goods and ensure the smooth flow of fruits and vegetables. Secretary Live Streams Sales and Opens Green Channel "Babies, this is my first time participating in a live stream, I'm actually a little nervous." At 8 PM on February 24, Yin Meiying, Secretary of the County Party Committee of Huimin County, Shandong Province, greeted netizens in a Taobao live stream room and recommended local agricultural and sideline products. Due to the impact of the COVID-19 epidemic, enterprises in Huimin County faced inventory backlogs and raw material shortages to varying degrees, and many agricultural and sideline products encountered sales difficulties. To solve this problem, Huimin launched a county-wide live streaming campaign, with the County Party Secretary taking the lead, and all county-level leaders and heads of departments and units participating to serve the people. During the two-hour live stream that evening, Yin Meiying helped local farmers and businesses sell 20,000 jin of mushrooms, 20,000 jin of pears, and other products in the Taobao live stream room. Across the country, leading cadres helping farmers sell goods online has become a scenic line. On February 24, Zhong Mingming, Secretary of the Municipal Party Committee of Wenchang City, Hainan Province, and Mayor Wang Xiaoqiao, Mayor Zhang Changfeng of Dongfang City, Secretary Liu Xuexin of Qianjia Town Party Committee of Ledong Li Autonomous County, and Chen Fang, Director of the Haikou Municipal Bureau of Agriculture, all went live on Taobao to recommend agricultural products such as pineapples, sweet potatoes, bird's eye chilies, edamame, mangoes, and Buddha's hand melons from Hainan that were unsaleable due to the epidemic. In addition to online e-commerce, various regions have also introduced policies to encourage the transportation of fruits and vegetables and open green channels. Hainan Province has introduced policies stating that before February 29, transportation and sales merchants who purchase melons and vegetables in Hainan will not only receive a freight subsidy of 0.18 yuan - 0.22 yuan/kilometer, but can also receive a direct reward of 200,000 to 500,000 yuan for purchasing more than 5,000 tons. Sanya City has increased the freight subsidy to 0.5 yuan/kilometer. Hainan, Shandong, and other regions also prioritize the passage of vehicles transporting fresh agricultural products. To strengthen point-to-point direct supply, Hainan Province has organized leaders from each city and county to lead teams to one or two key wholesale markets in the country to set up offices and carry out promotional work for fruits and vegetables. Sales Gradually Recover, Farm-Gate Prices Rise In recent days, through online platforms, various "buy groceries at home" services have rapidly launched in multiple cities and counties in Hainan, Shandong, Henan, and other places. E-commerce service centers, melon and vegetable planting cooperatives, and local vegetable farmers have acted together, placing orders on the same day and delivering the next day, alleviating the problem of agricultural products being "difficult to sell." According to Liang Gang, deputy general manager of Nanhai Net, as of February 20, a total of 6.88 million jin of bulk orders had been successfully coordinated through the Hainan Poverty Alleviation Network; through the "Haikou Community Public Welfare Group Purchase" method, the total sales of agricultural products reached 7.74 million jin. As of February 25, Alibaba's "Caring Farmers Assistance Line" had covered 20 provinces including Hainan, Sichuan, Fujian, and Shandong, and Taobao Tmall had sold 54,000 tons of unsaleable agricultural products. More than ten days ago, vegetables in Shanghe County, Shandong Province, were unsaleable on a large scale. Recently, with the active assistance of the Shanghe County Bureau of Commerce, vegetable planting bases in various townships in Shanghe have been connected with major supermarkets in Jinan City, and sales channels are no longer a concern. Bai Chaoyang, director of the Shanghe County Bureau of Commerce, said, "The transaction volume has increased, and the price has also gone up. Cucumbers have risen from a low of 0.8 yuan per jin to 2.7 yuan per jin now." In Wenjia Street, Shouguang City, Shandong Province, Sangjia Village, the village used to have only 4 vegetable collection points and 4 domestic routes a few days ago, but now it has basically returned to the normal level of 20 routes. An Suotai, a vegetable merchant who travels regularly between Shandong and Tianjin, said that in the same period last year, he transported 10 tons of vegetables to Tianjin every day, but now he transports less than 10 tons in two days. However, compared to more than ten days ago, the volume of vegetable transportation has greatly improved. Shortage of Agricultural Workers Will Gradually Be Resolved with Resumption of Work and Production Although fruit and vegetable sales are gradually recovering, "lack of manpower" remains the biggest obstacle to clearing the "bottleneck" in production and sales. After mangoes in Sanya City were unsaleable, online fresh food platforms such as Alibaba and JD.com strongly promoted Sanya mangoes, and many consumers placed orders. However, the delivery was very slow. In this regard, a mango farmer in Sanya who opened a store on JD.com said that due to the shortage of manpower, the speed of mango picking, sorting, and packing could not keep up, and the speed of express delivery companies receiving, sorting, and delivering goods also decreased significantly due to the shortage of manpower, resulting in slow delivery. Industry insiders predict that as the epidemic continues to improve, the rate of enterprise resumption of work and production gradually increases, and workers return to work one after another, the fruit and vegetable industry is expected to recover rapidly in the future. According to statistics from the Qudi Cucumber Wholesale Market in Jinan, the market trades about 400,000 jin of cucumbers every day in recent days, which is basically the same as in the same period last year. Customers sending goods to Beijing, Tianjin, Nanjing, Hefei, Xi'an, and other places have gradually resumed receiving and shipping. Under the influence of a series of stimulus policies, the outbound volume of winter melons and fruits from Hainan has gradually recovered to the level of the same period last year, and the farm-gate purchase prices have steadily risen.

title_en: The power bank safety storm continues, with companies such as Anker Innovation and Anpus being suspended from 3C certification.
body_en: After brands such as Romoss and Anker Innovation announced the recall of mobile power sources at risk of spontaneous combustion, safety issues related to power banks are receiving greater attention. Recently, data from the National Certification and Accreditation Administration of China's National Certification and Accreditation Information Public Service Platform showed that since early June, several products from well-known mobile power source brands such as Romoss, Anker Innovation, Baseus, and Green Union have had their 3C certification certificates in a "suspended" status. Previously, Romoss power banks were banned by several universities in Beijing due to incidents of explosions and fires. On June 14, Romoss issued an apology statement and promised to take full responsibility for products identified as defective by authoritative institutions. On June 16, according to the website of the Shenzhen Market Supervision Administration, Romoss will recall a total of 491,745 units of three models of mobile power sources due to issues with the raw materials of some battery cells, which may cause overheating and a risk of combustion in extreme scenarios. Not only Romoss, on June 20, another well-known consumer electronics company, Anker Innovation, announced the voluntary recall of certain batches of basic model mobile power sources with model numbers A1642/A1647/A1652/A1680/A1681/A1689/A1257 due to safety risks. Anker Innovation stated that during quality and safety inspections, they found that some batches of industry-standard battery cells from a supplier had unauthorized material changes, which could lead to insulation failure of the separator in a very small number of products after long-term use, causing overheating and even combustion hazards. As of now, Anker Innovation has removed all related model products from official e-commerce platforms and terminated cooperation with the supplier. It was noted that Romoss has removed 10,000-30,000 mAh power bank products from official flagship stores on e-commerce platforms such as Douyin, JD, and Taobao. Apart from the recalled models, other power bank products from Anker Innovation are still available. Baseus, Green Union, and other power bank brands are also in normal sales status. As for the suspension of the 3C certification certificates, as of the time of writing, Romoss, Anker Innovation, Baseus, Green Union, and others have not provided further responses. According to data from the National Certification and Accreditation Information Public Service Platform, the majority of certificates were suspended starting on June 14, 2025, with an end date of September 13, 2025. The 3C certification is a mandatory product certification system implemented in China to protect consumer safety and national security, and strengthen product quality management in accordance with laws and regulations. Starting from August 1, 2024, lithium-ion batteries, battery packs, and mobile power sources without CCC certification and labeling are not allowed to be manufactured, sold, imported, or used in other business activities. It is worth noting that several related battery and battery cell products from Amperex (Wuxi) Co., Ltd., a battery supplier for many power bank brands, also had their 3C certification certificates suspended. The company, jointly established by a wholly-owned subsidiary of Amperex from the United States and Wuxi Industrial Development Group Co., Ltd., has a total investment of 200 million US dollars. Amperex (Wuxi) Co., Ltd. mainly engages in the research, development, production, and sales of consumer lithium-ion batteries and components, providing high-density lithium-ion battery products to many well-known companies such as Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Anker, Amazon, and Baseus. On June 22, another power bank brand, Coolreall, stated that during the design and manufacturing process of their No. 6 mobile power source, they followed national standards. In third-party sampling work, a discrepancy in testing methods between one project and the testing method used for the CCC certification application for Coolreall No. 6 mobile power source resulted in an anomaly in the CCC certification qualification for that model. Coolreall stated that they have submitted materials to the relevant certification body explaining the technical parameters of the product and providing compliance documents, and have initiated the certification process while actively cooperating with third-party testing agencies for a full standard review. Currently, the certification restoration work is progressing steadily according to plan, with the expectation of completing all processes by July 2025 and relaunching the product.

title_en: UnionPay China collaborates with various industries to help revitalize the country.
body_en: In recent times, various online and offline discounts, including the "trade-in" activities for consumer goods, have been frequent, and consumer enthusiasm continues to rise. Currently, the "trade-in" activities in many provinces and cities across the country, such as Anhui, Shanghai, Fujian, Tianjin, Heilongjiang, are still ongoing. After the subsequent distribution of 138 billion yuan of central funds, the national subsidy will continue to benefit more consumers. In this activity, China UnionPay actively responds to the national call, leverages its "platform" advantages, undertakes the dual roles of provincial platform construction and coupon distribution platform channel for the "trade-in" activities, and collaborates with e-commerce platforms, commercial banks, payment institutions, and other industry parties to implement various "trade-in" activities for home appliances, 3C products, cars, and other consumer goods in provinces and cities nationwide. Reporters have learned that China UnionPay has collaborated with JD.com, Taobao, Tmall, and Douyin to implement diversified payment methods in more than 25 provinces and cities nationwide. Consumers can complete qualification collection, product selection, and use various payment methods such as JD Pay, Alipay, Douyin Pay, UnionPay App, bank cards, etc. to verify the national subsidy qualification on the above e-commerce platforms. In addition, through the output of UnionPay's cloud network capabilities, consumers can also check, collect, and pay for the national subsidy qualification through multiple bank apps they have installed. On this basis, several commercial banks have added credit card installment payments, discounts, and UnionPay QR code installment merchant subsidies to make the "trade-in" activities more attractive. Up to now, 15 national banks and 32 regional banks have invested in the UnionPay platform to add resources for "trade-in" activities, forming an alliance to boost consumer finance and help more subsidies reach consumers, stimulating consumption in the market.

title_en: 58 entrepreneurs from Shenzhen made the list.
body_en: Shenzhen Special Zone News (Reporter Xiong Ziheng) The value creation ability of Chinese private enterprises is accelerating, and a new wave of wealth creation is surging. Today, "New Fortune" magazine released the 23rd edition of the Top 500 Wealth Creation List. The list shows that the total market value of the 500 entrepreneurs (or families) on the list is 13.7 trillion yuan, an 11% increase compared to last year, with an average market value of 273.8 billion yuan. The threshold for making the list is 6.62 billion yuan, and there are a total of 58 entrepreneurs (or families) from Shenzhen on the list. In this year's top ten wealth creation list, AI dominates. 42-year-old ByteDance founder Zhang Yiming topped the list for the first time with a shareholding value of 481.57 billion yuan, while 7 years ago he made his first appearance on the list. 40-year-old DeepSeek founder Liang Wenfeng advanced to the top ten with a shareholding value of 184.6 billion yuan. Tencent founder Ma Huateng, Alibaba founder Jack Ma, and NetEase founder Ding Lei all significantly increased their wealth, firmly holding their positions in the top ten. Lei Jun also saw his wealth increase by 96% to 201 billion yuan, ranking sixth. In terms of the number of entrepreneurs on the list by industry, TMT (technology, media, and telecommunications), pharmaceuticals and biotechnology, and daily consumer goods occupy the top three wealth creation tracks. Among them, the TMT track saw a strong increase with 110 people on the list, an increase of 22 people from last year, with the total wealth of entrepreneurs on the list reaching as high as 3.34 trillion yuan, accounting for 1/4 of the total wealth on the list. The wealth creation dividend mainly comes from three major drivers: chips, artificial intelligence, and consumer electronics, which in turn promote each other. It is worth noting that there are a total of 58 entrepreneurs (or families) from Shenzhen on the list. Looking at the top 10, the internet, new energy, technology, and healthcare have become the main tracks for wealth creation. Ma Huateng, BYD founder Wang Chuanfu, and Luxshare Precision founder Wang Laisheng/Wang Laichun respectively rank in the top three.

title_en: Cross-border e-commerce transactions are busy, live streaming sales are hot.
body_en: This newspaper (reporter Chang Yuan, Han Chengyuan, Shu Wen) learned from the special session of foreign trade achievements of the 9th South Asia Expo and the release conference of economic and trade achievements in the Indian Ocean, RCEP, and Lancang-Mekong countries on June 23 that this year's South Asia Expo held cross-border e-commerce docking activities and set up a cross-border e-commerce live streaming zone. The cross-border e-commerce transactions were busy at the exhibition, and live streaming sales were lively. During this South Asia Expo, two special sessions of cross-border e-commerce docking activities were held. The global well-known cross-border e-commerce platforms focused on going global, inviting leaders of 7 platforms such as Amazon, Alibaba International Station, TikTok (Douyin) to share policies, operation modes, and market trends related to going global, and had in-depth exchanges with Yunnan Foreign Trade Open Platform and enterprise representatives. The comprehensive service session for cross-border e-commerce gathered service providers in logistics, payment, overseas warehouses, supply chains, and other fields to provide enterprises with "one-stop" operational solutions, and 35 companies reached cooperation intentions with the platforms. For the first time, this South Asia Expo set up a cross-border e-commerce live streaming zone. "Internet celebrities" anchor teams from the United States, Canada, and other countries introduced Yunnan's characteristic products such as cloud flowers, cloud coffee, cloud tea, and ethnic clothing to global audiences through mainstream global social media platforms. The cumulative number of views in the live streaming room reached 5.7 million, with an average of over 1,500 customer inquiries per day, achieving cross-border orders of $1.2 million, expanding the channels for Yunnan's products to go global. At the release conference, the person in charge of the Cross-border E-commerce Department of the Provincial Department of Commerce introduced that the province will introduce a package of support policies. In terms of overseas warehouse operations, 70% support will be provided for eligible overseas warehouses in operating expenses such as site leasing or usage, information platform construction, warehousing logistics, product display and sales, and international network marketing promotion; in the construction of cross-border e-commerce industrial parks, 70% support will be provided for operating expenses such as site leasing or usage, information platform construction, international network marketing promotion, helping companies set up overseas stores, new media (live streaming), enterprise training, etc., generated by eligible cross-border e-commerce industrial parks; in the cultivation of cross-border e-commerce entities, support will be provided for various market entities to expand cross-border e-commerce business through third-party e-commerce platforms, independent websites, or new media (live streaming) channels. For eligible companies, 70% support will be provided for platform usage fees, advertising fees, and foreign trade management software usage fees.

title_en: Notice on holding the 2024 Academic Annual Conference of the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association (Second Round)
body_en: To all relevant units: Pharmaceutical excipients are an important foundation in China's pharmaceutical industry, and are one of the key factors determining the quality of generic drugs and the high-quality development of innovative formulations. The supply chain security of pharmaceutical excipients used in high-end formulations in China urgently needs to strengthen the technological innovation and industrial support for domestic pharmaceutical excipients. At the same time, ensuring the quality of clinical medication, reducing drug costs, and alleviating the pressure on medical insurance to a large extent also depend on the quality improvement of domestic pharmaceutical excipients. In line with the principle of "promoting technological innovation in pharmaceutical excipients and enhancing the new quality productivity of the pharmaceutical industry," the "2024 Annual Academic Conference of the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association," hosted by the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association, is scheduled to be held in Hefei, Anhui Province from November 8th to 10th, 2024. This academic conference will feature conference reports in the fields of materials science related to pharmaceutical excipients, innovative drugs, and innovative formulations, analyzing the development difficulties and innovations of pharmaceutical excipients; inviting authoritative experts to deeply discuss the in vivo processes of pharmaceutical excipients and drug delivery carriers, as well as the quality improvement and innovation of excipients. The conference will set up expert venues and young scholar sub-venues with three themes: "Pharmaceutical Excipients, Packaging Materials, and Drug Delivery Devices," "New Materials, New Carriers, and Innovative Formulations," and "Pharmaceutical Excipients and Innovative Drugs," to promote the wide participation of enterprises, academia, and young scholars, and jointly focus on the technological innovation and industrial research and development of pharmaceutical excipients. Conference theme: Promoting technological innovation in pharmaceutical excipients and enhancing the new quality productivity of the pharmaceutical industry 2. Time and location: November 8th Registration Venue: New Ji Hotel, Hefei (2766 Wenzhong Road, Yaohai District, Hefei City, Anhui Province) November 9-10 Main venue and sub-venues are both at Shaoquanhu Campus of Anhui University of Chinese Medicine, Hefei City, Anhui Province (350 Longzihu Road, Yaohai District, Hefei City, Anhui Province) 3. Conference arrangements: The conference will adopt the form of main venue and sub-venue reports for communication. The conference will invite well-known experts and scholars from domestic universities, research institutes, pharmaceutical companies, research and development units, medical institutions, regulatory agencies, etc., to give keynote speeches and special lectures. Please see the attached schedule for the conference schedule. 4. title_en: Dairy industry "618" differentiation: Yili leads, infant formula, fresh milk cold
body_en: The "618" promotion is significant for driving the consumer market. Data released by the National Bureau of Statistics shows that in May 2025, the total retail sales of consumer goods in the country reached 4.1326 trillion yuan, an increase of 6.4% year-on-year. Among them, the retail sales of consumer goods excluding automobiles reached 3.7316 trillion yuan, an increase of 7.0% year-on-year. The subsidy for trading in old for new combined with the e-commerce "618" promotion is the main driving force for the growth of the retail sector. For example, in May, sales of household appliances and audio-visual equipment reached 116.6 billion yuan, an increase of 53% year-on-year; sales of communication equipment reached 87.1 billion yuan, an increase of 33% year-on-year. Objectively speaking, the dairy industry is not the main focus of the "618" promotion, and the industry's attitude towards the mid-year promotion is diverging. Clearly, Yili is paying more and more attention to "618". The company disclosed that during "618", Yili's liquid milk products ranked first in the industry, with a 12.3% year-on-year increase in purchasing users on the three major core e-commerce platforms, reaching nearly one billion members, with JD.com and Douyin having the largest user base in the industry. At the same time, Yili stated that its infant and toddler nutrition products increased by over 33% year-on-year, and adult nutrition products topped the e-commerce platform's milk powder category sales chart. Yogurt achieved a 15% year-on-year growth rate during the "618" promotion, expanding its e-commerce channels; the cheese category achieved a 240% year-on-year growth relying on the Tmall flagship store. It is worth noting that Yili's momentum may be related to increased discounts. Yili believes that its growth during "618" is related to a combination of marketing strategies. The company stated that by leveraging themes such as "Yili can play like this during 618", "Milk can perform better than me", and "Yili opens a new season", Yili has built a triple engine of "creative gameplay + innovative products + live content energy field" to drive sales growth. However, behind the frenzy of "618", Yili faces sales pressure. In 2024, Yili's revenue was 115.78 billion yuan, a decrease of 8.2% year-on-year. Among them, revenue from liquid milk/milk powder and dairy products/cold drinks was 75.0/29.68/8.72 billion yuan, a decrease of 12.3%/7.5%/18.4% respectively. In the first quarter of 2025, Yili's revenue returned to the expansion range, increasing by 1.4% year-on-year to 33.02 billion yuan. However, Yili's most critical revenue from liquid milk decreased by 3.1% year-on-year to 19.64 billion yuan. During the same period, revenue from Yili's milk powder and dairy products/cold drinks increased by 18.6%/5.3% year-on-year to 8.81/4.11 billion yuan. It is important to understand that the fluctuation in Yili's performance is due to the overall contraction in industry demand. In this situation, in 2024, Mengniu's revenue was 88.6748 billion yuan, a decrease of 10.1% year-on-year. In the same year, revenue from Bright Dairy was 24.278 billion yuan, a decrease of 8.33%; revenue from Xin Dairy was 10.67 billion yuan, a decrease of 2.9%. In the first quarter of 2025, revenue from Bright Dairy decreased by 0.76% year-on-year to 6.368 billion yuan; revenue from Xin Dairy increased by 0.4% year-on-year to 2.62 billion yuan. In fact, in the context of shrinking industry demand, Yili's decision to sprint during 618 carries risks. The confidence of this giant in moving forward is better than that of its competitors. In 2024, Yili's net profit attributable to shareholders was 8.453 billion yuan, while Mengniu's was 1.05 billion yuan during the same period. As mentioned earlier, the dairy industry as a whole is experiencing a decline in performance, which explains the relatively conservative discounts in the dairy industry during "618". The "limited discounts" are particularly evident in the infant formula market. During this year's "618", Feihe introduced a recharge shopping voucher with discounts as low as 98%. Several infant formula brands such as Feihe, Mead Johnson, Aptamil, and Junlebao launched activities such as free trial drinks. This is in stark contrast to brands like Nike, which have launched "more than 50% off" promotions. Behind this is the fact that as the number of newborns decreases, the infant formula market, which is moving towards a stock market, needs to rely on premium pricing to achieve growth. At this moment, in terms of market share, the ultra-high-end + market accounts for 33.2%, the ultra-high-end market accounts for 31.2%, the high-end market accounts for 24.2%, the high-middle-end market accounts for 8.6%, and the middle-low-end market accounts for 2.7%. Brand performance also confirms a similar trend. In 2024, Danone's market share in China significantly increased. "We are particularly satisfied with the performance of our ultra-high-end brand Aptamil." Danone said. According to the 2024 financial report of Friesland, its core infant formula brand Friso maintained double-digit growth in the Chinese market in 2024. Nestle China revealed that its infant formula business achieved high single-digit growth in 2024. Among them, the previously declining Wyeth S-26 business rebounded, and the infant formula business became the largest contributor to performance growth in the China region. Among domestic brands, in 2024, Feihe's ultra-high-end product Xingfeifan Zhuorui's sales increased by more than 60% year-on-year, reaching 6.7 billion yuan. The classic Xingfeifan series had revenues of 5.8 billion yuan, with sales in a shrinking range. Through the replacement of old and new products, Feihe successfully achieved a price increase. In this situation, infant formula brands moving towards the ultra-high-end market need to stabilize their position. Discounts are not the preferred option and can also damage profits. It is also important to note that the discounts on fresh milk in the "618" promotion are also limited, but there are some differences in logic compared to infant formula. On the one hand, the price war in the fresh milk market has been ongoing. In May 2025, a reporter from 21st Century Business Herald found that the price war in the fresh milk market had intensified in the Beijing market. However, on the other hand, based on the limited shelf life of fresh milk, the demand in the fresh milk market itself is relatively stable, and the demand side does not have the conditions to increase volume during the "618" promotion. In addition, the supply chain and channels cannot meet the demand for increased supply. "We still focus on offline channels, and distributors are not willing to disrupt pricing online. In core markets, prices still have autonomy. So this year's 618 will not increase investment." A senior executive of a leading fresh milk brand told a reporter from 21st Century Business Herald. In fact, in the context of shrinking industry demand, Yili's decision to sprint during 618 carries risks. The confidence of this giant in moving forward is better than that of its competitors. In 2024, Yili's net profit attributable to shareholders was 8.453 billion yuan, while Mengniu's was 1.05 billion yuan during the same period. As mentioned earlier, the dairy industry as a whole is experiencing a decline in performance, which explains the relatively conservative discounts in the dairy industry during "618". The "limited discounts" are particularly evident in the infant formula market. During this year's "618", Feihe introduced a recharge shopping voucher with discounts as low as 98%. Several infant formula brands such as Feihe, Mead Johnson, Aptamil, and Junlebao launched activities such as free trial drinks. This is in stark contrast to brands like Nike, which have launched "more than 50% off" promotions. Behind this is the fact that as the number of newborns decreases, the infant formula market, which is moving towards a stock market, needs to rely on premium pricing to achieve growth. At this moment, in terms of market share, the ultra-high-end + market accounts for 33.2%, the ultra-high-end market accounts for 31.2%, the high-end market accounts for 24.2%, the high-middle-end market accounts for 8.6%, and the middle-low-end market accounts for 2.7%. Brand performance also confirms a similar trend. In 2024, Danone's market share in China significantly increased. "We are particularly satisfied with the performance of our ultra-high-end brand Aptamil." Danone said. According to the 2024 financial report of Friesland, its core infant formula brand Friso maintained double-digit growth in the Chinese market in 2024. Nestle China revealed that its infant formula business achieved high single-digit growth in 2024. Among them, the previously declining Wyeth S-26 business rebounded, and the infant formula business became the largest contributor to performance growth in the China region. Among domestic brands, in 2024, Feihe's ultra-high-end product Xingfeifan Zhuorui's sales increased by more than 60% year-on-year, reaching 6.7 billion yuan. The classic Xingfeifan series had revenues of 5.8 billion yuan, with sales in a shrinking range. Through the replacement of old and new products, Feihe successfully achieved a price increase. In this situation, infant formula brands moving towards the ultra-high-end market need to stabilize their position. Discounts are not the preferred option and can also damage profits. It is also important to note that the discounts on fresh milk in the "618" promotion are also limited, but there are some differences in logic compared to infant formula. On the one hand, the price war in the fresh milk market has been ongoing. In May 2025, a reporter from 21st Century Business Herald found that the price war in the fresh milk market had intensified in the Beijing market. However, on the other hand, based on the limited shelf life of fresh milk, the demand in the fresh milk market itself is relatively stable, and the demand side does not have the conditions to increase volume during the "618" promotion. In addition, the supply chain and channels cannot meet the demand for increased supply. "We still focus on offline channels, and distributors are not willing to disrupt pricing online. In core markets, prices still have autonomy. So this year's 618 will not increase investment." A senior executive of a leading fresh milk brand told a reporter from 21st Century Business Herald. title_en: Why are internet giants rushing into the "stablecoin" market?
body_en: Recently, Ant Group disclosed that its two independent subsidiaries, Ant Technology and Ant International, are preparing to apply for a stablecoin license in Hong Kong; prior to this, companies such as JD Coin Chain Technology and Circle Coin Technology have already participated in the Hong Kong "stablecoin issuer sandbox." In addition, Xiaomi's subsidiary, Tianxing Bank, also announced a stablecoin partnership with JD Coin Chain Technology... As the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region's "Stablecoin Regulations" are about to take effect, domestic internet giants are "rushing in" to accelerate the pace of stablecoin deployment. Stablecoins are a type of cryptocurrency anchored to real assets, with their value usually pegged to a fiat currency, commodity, or other asset. Unlike the price fluctuations of Bitcoin, stablecoin prices are relatively stable, giving them certain monetary properties in the digital currency field. As of now, the global issuance of stablecoins has exceeded $240 billion. Countries and regions such as the United States, European Union, United Kingdom, Japan, and Singapore have all experimented with using stablecoins as a means of payment. In recent years, the Hong Kong government has actively embraced virtual asset innovation. In July 2024, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority announced the first batch of 3 stablecoin issuer sandbox participants, with JD Coin Chain Technology, Circle Coin Technology, and Standard Chartered Bank being the first "trailblazers." In May of this year, the Hong Kong Legislative Council passed the "Stablecoin Regulations Bill," which will come into effect on August 1. JD Coin Chain Technology CEO Liu Peng revealed that the first phase of issuance will tentatively involve stablecoins anchored to the Hong Kong dollar and the US dollar, with specific details adjusted based on regulatory and market demand. JD's stablecoin is currently in the second phase of sandbox testing, providing mobile and PC applications to retail and institutional users, with testing scenarios mainly including cross-border payments, investment transactions, and retail payments. Recently, Ant Group has also actively followed suit. It is understood that the group's Ant Financial has initiated the application for a Hong Kong stablecoin license, listing Hong Kong as the global headquarters of the company, and has already completed regulatory sandbox trials in Hong Kong; Ant International has also revealed that it will submit a license application as soon as the "Stablecoin Regulations" come into effect and relevant channels open. The "desire" of internet giants for stablecoin licenses mainly stems from the inadequacy of the existing cross-border payment system to adapt to the development of the digital economy era. Recently, at the 2025 Lujiazui Forum, People's Bank of China Governor Pan Gongsheng also pointed out that traditional cross-border payment methods lag behind emerging digital technologies, with issues such as low efficiency, high costs, and poor universality in urgent need of improvement. Zhang Ming, Deputy Director of the Institute of World Economics and Politics at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences and Research Fellow at the National Global Strategy Think Tank of the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, pointed out that stablecoins have now evolved into a trading medium connecting virtual assets with real assets, making payment exchanges between various currencies in the real world very convenient. "When Ant International's trillion-dollar fund flow partially shifts to the stablecoin track, and when global sales within the JD ecosystem are settled in seconds instead of waiting for days, this transformation will penetrate the surface of the financial system and reshape the underlying logic of global business flow," Zhang Ming said. "I hope to apply for stablecoin licenses in major currency countries around the world, so that through stablecoin licenses, global enterprises can exchange currencies, reducing global cross-border payment costs by 90% and increasing efficiency to within 10 seconds," said JD founder Liu Qiangdong.

title_en: Zhejiang holds the second "live streaming sales of local specialties" skills competition.
body_en: On the morning of June 23, the "Yan Return" multifunctional hall at Alibaba's Xixi Park was crowded with people. Yang Zhengru, a contestant from Lishui City, Zhejiang Province, appeared and immediately attracted a crowd. She held a fragrant walnut in her hand and said loudly to the camera, "How do you peel it? Look, there are two 'eyes' here. Just pinch lightly, and it will open with a 'pop'." As the walnut cracked open with a "pop," the fragrance seemed to penetrate the screen, and the audience left messages in the barrage: "Too tempting!" After the competition, Yang Zhengru said with a smile, "Live streaming is not about showing talent, but real business - allowing consumers to 'peel' online and place an order immediately." This vivid unboxing not only won her applause, but also reflected a rule: using the most down-to-earth scenario-based operation to truly bridge the "last mile" between live streaming and consumption. On that day, the second "Specialty Products Live Streaming Sales" skills competition finals in the province, jointly organized by the Zhejiang Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, the Provincial Department of Human Resources and Social Security, the Provincial Federation of Trade Unions, and the Provincial Communist Youth League Committee, and hosted by the Zhejiang Rural Revitalization Promotion Center and the Hangzhou Municipal Bureau of Agriculture and Rural Affairs (Hangzhou Rural Revitalization Bureau), was held in a heated atmosphere, attracting 33 groups of contestants from 11 cities in the province to sign up, with 6 groups eventually advancing to the finals. It is reported that compared to the first competition, this competition highlighted the "three more": more precise empowerment, more distinctive competition venues, and more effective competition. At the finals, the village streamers showed their strengths, facing the camera with confident and fluent expressions, sometimes humorous, sometimes energetic, or narrating vividly, by detailed introduction of the stories, cultural values, nutritional components, and main features behind the "specialty products," using their unique ways of promoting products to help agricultural products sell online nationwide. In the end, the village streamer Tang Jie from Shaoxing City came out on top. In recent years, Zhejiang has attached great importance to the revitalization of rural talents, promoted the entry of youth into rural areas, and innovatively implemented the modern "new farmer" cultivation action, through the systematic layout of advantageous industries, resource elements, market concepts, public services, and heartwarming policies to rural areas, fully constructing a rural talent matrix. Last year, the Zhejiang Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs specifically proposed the Million "New Farmer" Cultivation Project, incorporating e-commerce talent into the "Ten-Road Talent Cultivation System." The holding of this competition aims to cultivate talents through competition, promote production through competition, and forge a "live streaming iron army" that cannot be taken away. As the "capital of e-commerce in China" and the "number one city in digital economy," Hangzhou further supports youth entering rural areas, strengthens the team of rural e-commerce talent promoting prosperity, and innovatively implements the "Village Streamer Growth Plan" to cultivate rural live streaming e-commerce leaders who can promote products, dare to start businesses, and revitalize villages. Up to now, the city has cultivated more than 2,600 "village streamers" of all kinds, continuously incubating representative Hangzhou village streamers such as "Jiangnan Uncle," "Three Rural Family," and "Agricultural Food Valley," contributing to the realization of live streaming and rural revitalization. The representative of "One Village, One Streamer," Kong Huachao, Secretary of the Party Branch of Zhanjiadai Community in Linpu Town, Xiaoshan District, Hangzhou, shared his work experience and insights in rural live streaming e-commerce. He said with emotion, "My idea is simple, to develop the village and help the villagers make money. At the beginning, I also encountered many pitfalls and took many detours, but I grew step by step with everyone's trust and exploration. It is very lucky to be able to catch the wave of the e-commerce era, and I must use this opportunity to promote Zhanjiadai's pickled cabbage and Xiaoshan's agricultural products nationwide." The relevant person in charge of the Hangzhou Municipal Bureau of Agriculture and Rural Affairs (Hangzhou Rural Revitalization Bureau) stated that with just a mobile phone, a tripod, and a spotlight, live streaming is becoming a new way to drive product sales, enrich rural formats, and promote the integration of culture and tourism, cultivating a new vision of "industrial prosperity, talent aggregation, and rural vitality" in the fields. In Hangzhou, "village streamers" have become a link to rural revitalization, bridging the gap between farmers going online and products going from the village to the city, injecting new energy into deepening the "Million Projects" of the new era, narrowing the "three major gaps" of urban-rural, regional, and income disparities. By: Farmers' Daily · China Agricultural Network reporter Zhu Haiyang Intern Sha Yu Zhe

title_en: Shenzhen "Hui Min Bao" life really needs
body_en: [Shenzhen Commercial Daily News] (Reporter Qiu Qingyue) It was learned by reporters that the government-supervised "Shenzhen Huimin Bao" for the year 2025 has entered the final countdown stage. The enrollment channel will officially close on June 30th, with only 6 days left until the deadline for enrollment. In response to the confusion of citizens about enrollment, the reporter has specially compiled some hot topics for clarification. I have been hospitalized for a serious illness, can I enroll? Yes, you can enroll! There is no limit on previous medical history, and previous conditions can be covered and compensated at the same rate as healthy individuals. My parents are in their 60s, can they enroll? Yes, they can enroll! Shenzhen residents who are covered by basic medical insurance and those who participate in medical insurance in other places with Shenzhen household registration can voluntarily participate in "Shenzhen Huimin Bao" according to the regulations. Enrollees can enroll themselves and their immediate family members (spouse, parents, children). There is no age limit for enrollment, no limit on previous conditions, and no waiting period. I have been enrolled for two years but have not used it, do I still need to buy it? In addition to providing a safety net for critical medical expenses, even if the coverage is not used, enrolled citizens can enjoy seven categories of exclusive health services, including live drug broadcasts, health assessments, text and image consultations, live broadcasts on adolescent health, free decoction of Chinese medicine, disease assessments, and autism counseling courses. The enrollee (purchaser) has already linked their phone number, can it be changed? Yes, you can. You can follow the "Shenzhen Huimin Bao" WeChat official account, click on the bottom menu [Service Center-Personal Center], click on the top left corner avatar, click on [Phone Number], enter the new phone number and verification code, and click confirm. I do not have Shenzhen medical insurance, can I enroll? Yes! Individuals who are normally enrolled and pay Shenzhen medical insurance or Shenzhen residents who are normally enrolled and pay medical insurance in other places can enroll. At the same time, you can use the balance in your medical insurance personal account to pay premiums for yourself, spouse, parents, and children who meet the enrollment conditions. I participate in medical insurance in another place with Shenzhen household registration, can I use the balance in my medical insurance personal account to pay premiums? No, you cannot! You can choose to pay premiums through "WeChat Pay" or other methods. The annual premium is 88 yuan per person, with a coverage limit of over 4 million yuan per year. There is no age limit or health condition requirement, and even individuals with conditions such as hypertension or diabetes can be covered and compensated at the same rate as healthy individuals. My child has Shenzhen household registration but is studying in another city, can they enroll? Yes! College students who participate in medical insurance in another place and have Shenzhen household registration will be prompted to confirm their identity when enrolling. After carefully reading and confirming that they meet the identity requirements, they can click "Confirm Belonging" and follow the prompts to complete enrollment. As a Shenzhen resident participating in medical insurance in another place, how do I claim after enrolling? When claiming, Shenzhen residents participating in medical insurance in another place need to first apply for reimbursement through the local basic medical insurance, and then apply for claims online through the "Shenzhen Huimin Bao" official account. For other questions regarding enrollment, claims, etc., you can follow the "Shenzhen Huimin Bao" WeChat official account, click on the bottom menu at the lower right corner [Service Center]-[Online Customer Service], or call the official customer service hotline of "Shenzhen Huimin Bao" at 4006152066 for inquiries. You can also consult with staff from the 4 member units of the "Shenzhen Huimin Bao" co-insurance body. Enrollees can make payments through various convenient channels, such as following the official designated enrollment platform "Shenzhen Huimin Bao" WeChat official account, or through "Shenzhen Medical Insurance" "Weibao" WeChat official account, "Alipay" "UnionPay QuickPass" "iShenzhen" "Bank of Communications" "Yue Sheng Shi" APP and "Yue Sheng Shi" mini-program, or visit offline service windows for inquiries and processing.

title_en: Youth AI partners debut, more than 8,000 internship positions gathered, thousands of youth apartments guarantee "one-stop" service for graduating students in Haidian.
body_en: Reporter Sun Ying The graduation season is not just about parting sorrows, but also about setting sail. Yesterday, Beijing's Haidian District, which has 37 universities, launched the Zhongguancun graduation season - introducing the youth intelligent entity "Hi Youth," releasing the "Youth Partner Start-up Policy Acceleration Package," launching the first batch of "Haidian Alumni Card" ... inviting young people to set sail towards the "sea" and become the "youth partners" of Haidian. Graduates from universities interact with robots. Photo by reporter Wang Haixin Hi Youth youth intelligent entity. The debut of the youth intelligent entity "Hi Youth" Yesterday morning, the Zhongguancun National Independent Innovation Demonstration Zone Exhibition Center was filled with youthful figures, with hundreds of graduate representatives from 37 universities in Haidian District gathering here. As the innovation wave surges into the deep waters of AI, Haidian has tailored a youthful AI partner for young people - the Hi Youth youth intelligent entity, making its first appearance at the Zhongguancun graduation season. "The latest policies are accurately interpreted, from settling down to starting a career, every growth issue of yours can find precise answers..." Hi Youth is a round-headed, round-faced robot boy image, confidently showcasing its "superpowers" to students, providing government affairs, educational resources, job information, entrepreneurial support, cultural tourism, and other services. According to the Haidian District Committee, Hi Youth is a professional intelligent entity jointly designed and developed by them in collaboration with Tsinghua University, Mianbi Intelligence, and other well-known universities, research institutions, and enterprises. Currently, it has learned over 20,000 latest documents within the scope of Haidian District, covering important information related to young people's entrepreneurship, employment, and learning in Haidian District in a systematic and comprehensive manner. During the graduation season, the "Haidian Gravity Field Alumni Assembly Call" action was also launched simultaneously. Haidian District, together with representatives of alumni from 12 universities including Peking University and Tsinghua University, jointly launched the "Haidian Alumni Card." This exclusive electronic identity badge integrates policy support, comfortable living, shopping enjoyment, exclusive AI, and other functions, providing a "lifelong innovation community" identity for the vast Haidian alumni community, connecting the digital life and career development support provided by Haidian. Nearly a thousand sets of ready-to-move-in apartments are offered at a discount "Service for the youth" is the theme of innovation and development in Haidian. Xiao Dan, member of the Haidian District Committee and Minister of the Organization Department, announced the "Start-up Policy Acceleration Package" on the spot, inviting young people to become the youth partners of Haidian with a hardcore "start-up gift." Want to join companies like ByteDance, Alibaba, Tencent, etc.? Haidian will support you - targeting students, Haidian has launched the "College Student Internship Practice Action Plan," coordinating more than 300 companies to offer nearly 8,000 high-quality internship positions to help students enhance their adaptability to enterprises. Additionally, 57 district-owned institutions, enterprises, streets, communities, and villages have provided 110 internship positions for students to showcase their talents in social governance practices. For job-seeking youth, Haidian has created the "Hai Zhihui" employment service system at their doorstep, supporting private enterprises and small and medium-sized enterprises to expand their recruitment of young people, releasing no less than 80,000 positions annually. Want to start a business? Haidian has resources and opportunities! Projects that clear the way for funding, technology talent loans of up to 50 million yuan, a billion-dollar technology growth fund... "Real money" makes the cost of entrepreneurship lower and the confidence stronger. title_en: The first ecological civilization practice station of "West Lake Think Tank" has been established.
body_en: Hangzhou, June 24th (Reporter Tang Junyao, correspondent Yao Lingling) On the 20th anniversary of the proposal of the concept "Green mountains and clear waters are golden mountains and silver mountains", Zhejiang Newspaper Group and the Provincial Academy of Social Sciences have joined hands to explore new models of serving the grassroots and have achieved fruitful results. On the 24th, the "West Lake Think Tank", jointly established by the Hangzhou Branch of Zhejiang Newspaper Group and the Development Strategy and Public Policy Research Institute of the Provincial Academy of Social Sciences, set up the first ecological civilization practice station in Huanghu Town, Yuhang District, Hangzhou, and released a three-year action plan to create an innovative collaborative ecosystem of "media think tank empowerment + social resource integration + practice results transformation + rural model output". According to the action plan, the "West Lake Think Tank" ecological civilization practice station will strive to achieve the "123" development goals: strive to achieve full coverage of the practice station in 13 districts (counties, cities) in Hangzhou within 3 years, build a platform for empowering ecological civilization practice innovation in various places through "media + think tank"; establish a core team of "experts + journalists" and equip each practice station with two station masters; implement integrated media matrix communication actions, youth scholars' on-site actions, and element resource integration actions to explore effective mechanisms for empowering rural revitalization. The person in charge of the "West Lake Think Tank" stated that they will focus on breakthroughs in branding, IP, and mechanisms to empower the prosperity and development of industries in Huanghu. Huanghu Town is the "Future Rural Experimental Area" of Yuhang District. As early as 2015, it joined hands with Alibaba Public Welfare Foundation, Wanxiang Trust, and other "ecological partners" to launch the country's first water fund trust "Shanshui Fund" and establish the country's first village-wide market-oriented diversified ecological protection compensation mechanism - the "beneficiary pays" mechanism in Qingshan Village. Currently, Huanghu Town has introduced more than 40 ecological industry units such as Qingshan Nature School and Rong Design Library, as well as over 120 domestic and foreign young talents, with an annual visitor number increasing to nearly 100,000. As the ecological civilization practice deepens, the ecological protection compensation mechanism and the Shanshui Fund in Huanghu Town are also being iterated. On that day, the village-wide ecological protection compensation mechanism and Shanshui Fund 2.0 were released in Huanghu Town. "More social welfare organizations, green financial institutions, village collective economic organizations, universities, state-owned enterprises, etc., will join." Zhou Linwei, Deputy Secretary of the Party Committee and Mayor of Huanghu Town, told reporters that Shanshui Fund 2.0 has been upgraded in terms of expanding protection space, increasing protection funds, and diversifying participating entities, aiming to make Huanghu Town a village-wide ecological protection compensation area with a larger protection scope, more partners, and a greater variety of project types. The "ecological partners" of Huanghu Town are continuing to expand. Projects such as the Zero Carbon Smart House project of Zhejiang University's Chinese Rural Development Research Institute, the Huanghu Ecological Civilization Museum project, and the Tomorrow Library project of the Smile Tomorrow Foundation have been signed and landed. "We want to see how a rural area can truly achieve low carbon, zero carbon, or even negative carbon." Gong Binlei, Vice President of the School of Social Sciences at Zhejiang University and Executive Vice President of the Chinese Rural Development Research Institute, stated that the team will standardize the use of chemical fertilizers and pesticides in the experimental fields of Qingshan Village, increase the promotion and application of agricultural and rural emission reduction technologies, create a "living laboratory", and implement rural emission reduction in practice. On the same day, the provincial pilot project of integrated supervision of ecological environment "sky and land" in Yuhang was also released.
