title_en: Implementing the arrangements of the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th Central Commission for Discipline Inspection Series Observation ④ Deepening the Construction of a Unified National Market
body_en: Disciplinary inspection and supervision organs focus on clearing obstacles and difficulties to promote the construction of a unified national market in depth. Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission Website Li Yunshu "Shared Big Market · Export China" 2026's first event and the Beijing International Boutique Exhibition launch event were recently held at Wanli·Wangfujing WellTown, creating a "one-stop" global good procurement exhibition area to inject vitality into the New Year consumption of citizens. The picture shows visitors visiting exhibits from various countries in the imported goods promotion area. Photo by Xinhua News Agency reporter Ju Huanzong The Disciplinary Inspection Commission and Supervision Commission of Shishi City, Fujian Province, closely follows the requirements of safeguarding the construction of a unified national market, focuses on key areas such as law enforcement involving enterprises and the implementation of policies benefiting enterprises, conducts regular supervision and inspection at the forefront, understands the bottlenecks and difficulties in production factors and logistics and transportation through on-site visits, presses the responsibilities of relevant functional departments, and promotes the resolution of urgent and difficult issues for enterprises. The picture shows that recently, disciplinary inspection and supervision cadres in the city are understanding the situation of factor guarantees such as logistics and transportation in an enterprise in the jurisdiction. Photo by Lin Zhicheng General Secretary Xi Jinping pointed out that as the world's second-largest consumer market, China must build a unified national market well, enhancing our confidence in calmly responding to risks and challenges. The "Proposals of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on the Formulation of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development" made an important deployment to "resolutely break down the obstacles and bottlenecks hindering the construction of a unified national market." The Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th Central Commission for Discipline Inspection clearly proposed to focus on tasks such as building a unified national market, follow up supervision in a timely manner, and ensure a smooth start to the "15th Five-Year Plan." At the historical juncture of the beginning of the "15th Five-Year Plan," disciplinary inspection and supervision organs firmly grasp the fundamental responsibility of political supervision, taking the safeguarding of the construction of a unified national market as an important battlefield for promoting the implementation and effectiveness of major decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee, breaking down barriers with precise supervision, and clearing obstacles and dredging淤 with strict discipline, so as to fully release the advantages of the super-large market and provide strong guarantees for building a new development pattern and promoting Chinese modernization. The construction of a unified national market is an inherent requirement for building a high-level socialist market economic system and an important guarantee for building a new development pattern and promoting high-quality development. The construction of a unified national market is a major decision made by the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core from a global and strategic perspective. General Secretary Xi Jinping, with his foresight and overall grasp, based on the critical historical stage of China's market transformation from large to strong, has made a series of important expositions on the issue of building a unified national market. To understand this strategic deployment, we must deeply understand the historical background of promoting the construction of a unified national market in depth. At present, the world is undergoing profound changes unseen in a century, global industrial and supply chains are continuously turbulent, trade protectionism is rising, and the complexity, severity, and uncertainty of the external environment are increasing. Domestically, China's economic development still faces challenges such as insufficient effective demand, and the tasks of stabilizing growth, stabilizing employment, and stabilizing prices are arduous. In the face of a development environment where strategic opportunities and risks coexist, and uncertain and unpredictable factors are increasing, we must leverage China's super-large and highly potential market advantages to enhance our confidence in calmly responding to risks and challenges. General Secretary Xi Jinping profoundly pointed out: "Building a unified national market is not only a need for building a new development pattern and promoting high-quality development, but also a need for winning the initiative in international competition." - The construction of a unified national market is the fundamental support for building a new development pattern. General Secretary Xi Jinping emphasized: "Market resources are a huge advantage for our country, and we must make full use of and leverage this advantage, continuously consolidate and strengthen this advantage, and form strong support for building a new development pattern." The key to building a new development pattern is the unimpeded economic circulation; to achieve smooth domestic circulation, we must build a unified national market, break down local protectionism and market segmentation, unblock key bottlenecks restricting economic circulation, and promote the smooth flow of goods, factors, and resources on a larger scale. At the same time, building a strong domestic market will enhance the attraction of global factors and resources, better connect the domestic and international markets, and achieve mutual promotion between domestic and international dual circulation. - The construction of a unified national market is an inherent requirement for promoting high-quality development. Promoting high-quality development requires a sound market system and institutional environment that is compatible with it. The construction of a unified national market is to clear obstacles and empower high-quality development: it is conducive to the emergence of higher quality goods and services, breaking down local protectionism; it is conducive to leveraging the scale and agglomeration effects of the market, preventing "involutionary" vicious competition; it is conducive to leveraging the advantages of the super-large market with rich application scenarios and amplified innovation returns, providing a broad stage for technological self-reliance and the development of new quality productive forces; it is conducive to expanding domestic demand and stimulating market vitality, injecting certainty into economic recovery and growth. In recent years, China has successively issued the "Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of a Unified National Market" and a series of supporting measures, and has made positive progress in promoting the construction of a unified national market: the National Development and Reform Commission has iterated and released 5 versions of the negative list for market access, reducing the number of items from 151 in the 2018 version to 106, and has centrally cleared 4,218 policy measures that hinder the unified national market and fair competition; the "Regulations on Fair Competition Review" have been officially implemented, prohibiting 19 specific behaviors by departments and local governments that affect fair competition and the construction of a unified national market from the source... As of now, the "four pillars and eight beams" of the unified national market have been basically established. "Building a unified national market" means "the whole country is a chessboard." The central and local governments, local governments and local governments, governments and enterprises, and enterprises and enterprises should strengthen coordination and cooperation to form a joint force for promotion. Grasp the direction through deep learning and understanding, and embed political supervision into the entire process of building a unified national market. To promote the construction of a unified national market in depth, we must grasp the basic requirements of "five unifications and one opening." "Five unifications" refer to unified market basic systems, unified market infrastructure, unified government behavior standards, unified market supervision and law enforcement, and unified factor market; "one opening" refers to continuous expansion of opening up, implementing internal and external opening-up linkages, and not operating in a closed manner. The construction of a unified national market is both a tough battle and a protracted war. All regions and departments should grasp its implementation from a political and overall perspective. Disciplinary inspection and supervision organs deeply study and understand the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions, focus on strengthening political supervision around the construction of a unified national market, and promote the implementation and effectiveness of the Party Central Committee's decisions and deployments through specific, precise, and regular supervision and inspection. The Disciplinary Inspection and Supervision Group stationed at the National Development and Reform Commission of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Supervisory Commission regards the construction of a unified national market as a key task of political supervision. Focusing on the responsibilities undertaken by the stationed unit, it breaks down tasks into specific projects and supervision entry points, forming an annual political supervision task list. The disciplinary inspection and supervision group adheres to the "first topic" system, promptly studies and implements General Secretary Xi Jinping's important expositions on the construction of a unified national market, and continuously improves the precision of supervision. The construction of a unified national power market is a key task in building a unified national market. The Disciplinary Inspection and Supervision Group stationed at the National Development and Reform Commission closely monitors this key area and promotes the implementation of reform tasks through precise supervision. In view of the fact that only a few provincial power spot markets had entered formal operation at the beginning of 2025, the disciplinary inspection and supervision group strengthened supervision and reminders, promoted the stationed unit to fight according to the map and reverse the schedule, and supervised provinces with slower progress one by one. As of November 2025, 28 provinces nationwide have continuously carried out spot transactions, and provincial power spot markets have achieved basic full coverage. "We will further enhance our sense of political responsibility and consciousness of serving the overall situation by focusing on the functional responsibilities and important tasks of the stationed unit to do political supervision well," said a responsible comrade of the Disciplinary Inspection and Supervision Group stationed at the National Development and Reform Commission. In the next step, we will focus on key tasks such as promoting the construction of a unified national market in depth, strengthen cross-departmental and cross-regional supervision coordination, and promote the unblocking of bottlenecks and difficulties, so as to provide strong guarantees for a good start to the "15th Five-Year Plan." The Disciplinary Inspection and Supervision Group stationed at the State Administration for Market Regulation of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Supervisory Commission deeply studies and implements General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions and the Party Central Committee's major decisions and deployments on building a unified national market, adheres to the combination of an effective market and a capable government, and carries out specific, precise, and regular political supervision to safeguard the construction of a unified national market. Focusing on key areas such as anti-monopoly, registration, and bidding, it urges the stationed unit to strengthen anti-monopoly enforcement in the people's livelihood sector, legally crack down on monopolistic behaviors in industries such as pharmaceuticals, testing, and resident life security, and strictly investigate and deal with issues such as monopolistic agreements and abuse of market dominant positions, so that the market order of fair competition is tangible and perceivable. Focusing on the chaos in the bidding field, it promotes strengthened enforcement against unfair competition and credit supervision, and strictly investigates and deals with related disciplinary and legal violations, so that bidding operates in the sunshine. Public utilities such as water supply, electricity supply, gas supply, and heating have natural monopoly segments. Public utility operators are prone to extend their monopoly advantages to upstream and downstream competitive segments, affecting the basic fairness of market transactions. In view of this situation, in recent years, the main responsible comrade of the Disciplinary Inspection and Supervision Group stationed at the State Administration for Market Regulation has led teams to conduct special research and supervision in places such as Liaoning and Heilongjiang, focusing on solving problems such as inadequate metering price policies and suspended preferential policies. Under supervision and promotion, the stationed unit, together with relevant departments, has improved relevant systems and measures, promoted the implementation of "apply-free" policies, and urged public utility companies for water, electricity, and gas to refund a total of approximately 301 million yuan. Turning our attention to Henan. As a major economic province and transportation hub, the "transparency" of its market environment directly affects the "smoothness" of domestic circulation. The Henan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision insists on taking the implementation of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions as the top priority. Focusing on the strategic goals of the provincial Party committee and provincial government to accelerate the construction of a "unified national market circulation hub" and build a "dual circulation pivot for domestic and international markets," it focuses on breaking down the bottlenecks and obstacles hindering the construction of a unified national market, continuously deepens the systematic governance of prominent issues, and actively takes responsibility and acts better in actively integrating into and serving the unified national market. As the spring deepens, the core functional area of the Zhengzhou International Land Port in Henan presents a busy scene. A continuous stream of China-Europe freight trains loaded with new energy vehicles and electronic products depart, outlining the new year's picture of an inland opening-up highland. This international land port, planned to cover an area of 50 square kilometers with an investment of 17.8 billion yuan in its core area, is a key measure for Henan to thoroughly implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instruction to "build a logistics channel hub connecting domestic and foreign countries and radiating to the East, Central, and West." Wherever major projects are promoted, supervision and inspection follow. Focusing on the construction and development of major projects such as the Zhengzhou International Land Port, the Disciplinary Inspection and Supervision Working Committee of Zhengzhou Airport Economy Zone has formulated the "Implementation Plan for Safeguarding Major Project Construction with Strong Political Supervision," established a closed-loop supervision system of "goal guidance—list management—process control—effect evaluation," and transformed political supervision requirements into operable and assessable specific tasks. Focusing on the Zhengzhou International Land Port project, the Airport Economy Zone Disciplinary Inspection and Supervision Working Committee has sorted out 8 key links such as fund management and approval processes, formulated 48 supervision lists, and implemented a dynamic management mechanism of "one dispatch per week, one evaluation per month," clarifying the responsibilities of disciplinary inspection and supervision organs, industry competent authorities, and project construction units, forming a supervision pattern that is vertically connected and horizontally coordinated. "After the core functional area of the Zhengzhou International Land Port is put into operation, we will extend our supervision to the operational front line, regularly go deep into the China-Europe freight train assembly center, experience the customs clearance process on-site, and listen to the demands of foreign trade enterprises. At the same time, focusing on reducing international logistics costs and improving customs clearance efficiency, we will promote customs, transportation, and other departments to optimize processes, achieve 'one arrival, one declaration, one loading and unloading, one inspection and release,' and significantly improve customs clearance efficiency," said a responsible comrade of the Zhengzhou Airport Economy Zone Disciplinary Inspection and Supervision Working Committee. Focus on key difficulties and clear obstacles and safeguard with high-quality supervision and discipline enforcement. The direction is clear, but the requirements of "five unifications and one opening" must be truly implemented, and we must face the current challenges. General Secretary Xi Jinping's words hit the nail on the head: "To implement these basic requirements, the most urgent task is to focus on key difficulties and resolve to eliminate deep-seated problems." Eliminating deep-seated problems requires not only rectifying the chaos of low-price disorderly competition among enterprises, the chaos of government procurement bidding, and the chaos of local investment promotion, but also correcting the deviation of the concept of performance. It also requires efforts to promote the integrated development of domestic and foreign trade and fill the shortcomings in laws and regulations. In implementing the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee, disciplinary inspection and supervision organs focus on the most difficult bones in the construction of a unified national market and the most strongly reflected pain points of the masses, unblock bottlenecks and break down barriers with high-quality supervision and discipline enforcement, and dredge the market circulation. Solidly carry out the governance of prominent problems in law enforcement involving enterprises, making market competition fairer. The standardization of administrative law enforcement involving enterprises is a key link in promoting the construction of a unified national market. The Disciplinary Inspection and Supervision Group stationed at the Provincial Administration for Market Regulation of the Shandong Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision has included the rectification of prominent problems in the law enforcement field in its key tasks of political supervision, and promoted the formulation of the "Implementation Plan for a Special Action to Standardize Administrative Law Enforcement Involving Enterprises in the Market Regulation Field of Shandong Province." Focusing on the responsibility, work style, and corruption problems behind the chaos of illegal cross-regional law enforcement and profit-oriented law enforcement, the disciplinary inspection and supervision group, through special research and supervision and in-depth visits to the forefront of law enforcement, promotes the stationed department to establish and improve a full-process closed-loop supervision mechanism, and embeds supervision throughout the entire process of law enforcement. At the same time, focusing on issues of lax law enforcement and lack of industry guidance and supervision, a mechanism for transferring and consulting problem clues has been established, and relevant regulatory and law enforcement departments are convened regularly to analyze relevant situations. Under supervision and promotion, the province has filed and investigated 755 cases of price violations, with fines and confiscations totaling 14.4786 million yuan; revised the rules for the application of discretionary power in administrative penalties, adjusted 113 discretionary benchmarks, and handled 26,500 cases of reduced or exempted penalties. Focus on subjectivism and utilitarianism, and promote the establishment and practice of a correct concept of performance. "Involutionary" competition, investment promotion chaos, and "half-finished" projects are rooted in the deviation of the concept of performance. The Hunan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision has carried out thematic supervision on deepening "establishing a correct concept of performance and promoting high-quality development," taking it as an important grasp for making political supervision specific, precise, and regular, focusing on prominent problems of deviation in the concept of performance, strengthening daily supervision, and promoting the formation of a clear orientation of promoting high-quality development with a correct concept of performance. The Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision has conducted special research on thematic supervision work, issued an implementation plan, and proposed 12 specific measures from four aspects: responsibility, supervision, case handling, and governance, urging all responsible units to refine measures in accordance with their responsibilities, effectively embed thematic supervision into inspections, investigations, and other daily work, and strengthen coordination and integrated promotion. Disciplinary inspection and supervision organs throughout the province have strictly investigated prominent problems such as illegal investment decisions and investment promotion chaos in industrial parks, promoted the classified disposal of "half-finished" projects, and taken the distortion of the concept of performance as a key point in case investigation, established a ledger for clues, paid attention to investigating cases by uncovering cases, and continuously improved systems such as the elevated review of accountability cases for key problems and case review. Unblock the "middle obstruction" in key areas and make market circulation smoother. The Disciplinary Inspection and Supervision Group stationed at the Provincial Development and Reform Commission of the Henan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision supervises and promotes the Provincial Development and Reform Commission to play its leading role, conduct systematic research, and strengthen overall coordination, promote the establishment of a departmental coordination mechanism for integrating into and serving the unified national market, and based on dimensions such as the level of market rule standardization, the efficiency of market facility circulation, and the capacity of market factor allocation, promote the Provincial Development and Reform Commission to conduct multiple rounds of communication and repeated adjustments with various units, establish a monitoring indicator system for Henan's integration into and service of the unified national market, research and build a data platform, and establish a mechanism for collecting and providing feedback on problems that violate the construction of a unified national market, so as to promote the implementation of problem rectification through ledger management and cancellation-based promotion. "During the '15th Five-Year Plan' period, we will deeply study and understand General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions and deployments, focus on breaking down the bottlenecks and obstacles in integrating into and serving the construction of a unified national market, adopt supervision methods such as element benchmarking, functional embedding, and process immersion, embed supervision 'probes' into key links and fields, clear obstacles and open up paths for the free flow of factors and the fair and unified market, and safeguard the construction of a unified national market," said a responsible comrade of the Disciplinary Inspection and Supervision Group stationed at the Provincial Development and Reform Commission of the Henan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision. When the market is smooth, circulation is smooth; when circulation is smooth, national strength is strong. On the new journey, the continuous in-depth promotion of the construction of a unified national market is further releasing the potential of China's super-large market, injecting strong momentum into China's high-quality economic development, and continuously enhancing our confidence in calmly responding to risks and challenges. Short Comment | Let the Unified National Market "Flow" Li Yunshu Recently, 18.76 million kilowatt-hours of green electricity from Qinghai crossed thousands of kilometers to be directly supplied to Jilin, illuminating the "night economy" of Northeast China. This transaction of green electricity is a reflection of the in-depth promotion of the construction of a unified national market. The construction of a unified national market is not limited to the power sector. From breaking administrative boundaries to achieving "cross-regional, batch recruitment," to building a unified medical service market and promoting the mutual recognition of medical examination and testing results... As the channels for the free flow of factors become smoother, ordinary people can also truly feel the convenience brought by the construction of a unified national market in their production and life. While acknowledging the achievements, we must also soberly recognize that the construction of a unified national market still faces many challenges. Some regions are still obsessed with competing for "policy highlands," and local protectionism and market segmentation are difficult to eradicate despite repeated prohibitions. title_en: CCID Consulting: The AI Cloud Behind the Spring Festival Gala - A Systemic Leap from Computing Power Support to Intelligent Collaboration
body_en: From the lifelike digital avatars in "Dream Bottom" to the blooming "Twelve Flower Gods" in "Flower God's Greeting," the 2026 CCTV Year of the Horse Spring Festival Gala presented audiences with an unprecedented immersive audio-visual feast that blended technology and humanity. Behind all these stunning moments lies an invisible supporting force – AI Cloud. With its powerful cloud computing power and model capabilities, it supported the precise construction of digital avatars and the real-time rendering of the Flower God special effects, allowing every extreme artistic creation to be stably realized and appear natural. Spring Festival Gala Underlying Technology Upgrade: From "Cloud Services" to "AI Cloud" Since 2015, cloud computing has been the core technical support for the Spring Festival Gala, laying a solid technical foundation for smooth live broadcasts and interactions for this grand event over the years, withstanding the extreme challenges of hundreds of millions of concurrent users. In 2026, AI Cloud officially took over, injecting intelligent genes into the content creation, stage presentation, and audience interaction of the Spring Festival Gala, giving rise to a new paradigm of expression. Architecture Renewal: Making Spring Festival Gala Interactions Seamless and Natural. During the Spring Festival Gala, when hundreds of millions of viewers watch and interact in real-time through terminals such as TVs, mobile phones, and iPads, the underlying support is the "cloud-edge-end" intelligent full-link architecture. This architecture, as a core breakthrough in the evolution from traditional cloud to AI cloud, precisely addresses the industry pain points of high latency in pure cloud AI and limited capabilities in pure terminal AI, allowing intelligent services to be integrated into every scenario as naturally as breathing: complex model training and global strategy optimization are borne by the cloud, regional real-time inference is handled by edge nodes, and terminal devices run lightweight models for millisecond-level response; the computing power scheduling platform can achieve cross-regional computing power pooling and dynamically allocate resources on demand; new-generation communication technologies such as 5G-A and Wi-Fi 6 provide low-latency, high-bandwidth guarantees for data flow, ensuring that interactions under hundreds of millions of concurrent users tend towards "zero stuttering, zero latency, zero interruption." MaaS Debuts: Giving the Spring Festival Gala Creation an Instant "Super Brain." MaaS (Model as a Service), as a key service form that bridges the evolution from traditional cloud services to AI cloud, encapsulates the entire process of large model training, inference, optimization, and security review into standardized APIs and low-code tools, allowing creators to enjoy industry-exclusive intelligence as if "ordering takeout." In scenarios like the Spring Festival Gala with diverse creative needs, the creative team can call various intelligent capabilities on demand according to stage creativity without needing to delve deeply into underlying AI technology. In particular, the MaaS platform's low-code tools and automatic containerized deployment capabilities can quickly solve pain points such as complex traditional development coding, difficult environment adaptation, and slow peak expansion, compressing the development cycle of intelligent applications related to stage creation and content security in large live broadcast scenarios from "monthly" to "hourly." Emergence of Intelligent Agents: Making Spring Festival Gala Creativity "What You Think Is What You Get." Intelligent agents, as the exit for AI Cloud to empower business value, shift the application development logic from "technology coding-driven" to "business demand-driven," achieving a development experience of "what you think is immediately presented." It can accurately understand the business logic of scenario creation like the Spring Festival Gala, autonomously decompose abstract stage creativity and interaction design requirements into executable steps, and efficiently promote the full implementation of stage presentation and scenario scheduling by coordinating various underlying resources and capability modules. At the same time, intelligent agents have real-time autonomous perception and dynamic adaptation capabilities, and can autonomously adjust execution strategies based on the on-site status of the Spring Festival Gala live broadcast and changes in the scale of audience interaction, ensuring the stable operation of various intelligent applications in highly dynamic scenarios, and ultimately transforming the value of AI Cloud into perceptible stage effects and audience experience. Beyond the Stage, AI Cloud Enters a New Chapter of Growth and Layout. The stunning real-time rendering and intelligent interaction on the Spring Festival Gala stage are just the tip of the iceberg of AI Cloud's capabilities. Beyond the dazzling display under the spotlight, the AI Cloud market is undergoing a structural leap driven by both technological evolution and industry demand. While the scale is rapidly expanding, manufacturers' strategic focus is shifting to the in-depth construction of full-stack services and enterprise-level Agent ecosystems. Technology Advances Rapidly, Enterprises Can Use It, AI Cloud Development Presses the Fast-Forward Button. On the technology side, large model inference efficiency continues to improve, the collaborative architecture of large and small models is becoming increasingly mature, and "universal connection protocols" represented by MCP are gradually being implemented, effectively alleviating the problem of model hallucinations, making AI applications more reliable and cost-effective, and laying a solid foundation for the development of the underlying AI Cloud market. On the demand side, industry procurement models are shifting from scattered project-based pilots to group-level system deployments, directly driving the release of full-stack service demands such as intelligent computing infrastructure, model training and inference, and intelligent agent orchestration and operation. At the same time, the growth of multimodal pre-training demand and the rise of the post-training market for vertical fields such as finance, healthcare, and manufacturing are driving rapid market growth. In the first half of 2025, the market size of China's AI Cloud full-stack services reached 28.09 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 195.7%. With the comprehensive deployment of "Artificial Intelligence +" industry applications, market growth momentum remains strong, and the market size is expected to exceed 110 billion yuan in 2026. Competing for Full Stack, Snatching Intelligent Agents, AI Cloud Manufacturers Accelerate "Positioning." AI Cloud manufacturers such as Alibaba Cloud and Baidu AI Cloud are accelerating their deployment of full-stack hardware and software capabilities, building full-stack solutions from heterogeneous intelligent computing resources and model development platforms to industry applications, and connecting the "chip-computing power-model-application" chain. Through hardware-software collaborative optimization, manufacturers are improving computing power efficiency while achieving unified control over data security, model governance, and intelligent agent development, building full-stack delivery capabilities from underlying infrastructure to upper-level industry applications. At the same time, enterprise-level Agent development platforms are rapidly becoming core components of the AI Cloud service system. Products such as Amazon Bedrock Agent Core, Alibaba Cloud Agent Run, and Volcano Engine AgentKit are being launched intensively, covering the entire lifecycle of intelligent agent construction, operation, invocation, and governance, focusing on solving the pain points of "difficult governance, difficult iteration, and difficult integration" in enterprise AI applications. Scenario Layered Evolution, High-Value Landing Breakthroughs Yet to Be Solved. Currently, AI Cloud has achieved partial large-scale commercial use in standardized, clearly defined scenarios such as search engines and store inspections, verifying technical feasibility. However, deep penetration into complex and high-value scenarios still faces challenges, the crux of which lies in the mismatch between some technical supply and industry demand. On the one hand, although general AI technology has broad generalization capabilities, it is difficult to accurately capture the unique business logic, data formats, and compliance constraints of vertical fields, and it lacks deep insight into the deep pain points of scenarios. On the other hand, although some landing projects have completed technical deployment, they have not been embedded into the core business processes of enterprises, resulting in some AI systems becoming "showcases" that cannot be converted into quantifiable cost reduction and efficiency improvement or revenue growth, limiting the large-scale extension of AI Cloud to high-value scenarios. The AI Cloud Behind the Spring Festival Gala is Entering a New Stage. The 2026 Spring Festival Gala can be considered a concentrated review of the evolution of AI Cloud capabilities. The stunning performance on stage is backed by the overall evolution of AI Cloud from underlying architecture to service logic. In the future, this wave of technology validated by the Spring Festival Gala will accelerate its penetration into thousands of industries, promoting AI Cloud from "technically usable" to the next stage of development: "scenario-friendly and measurable results." Infrastructure Moves Towards a New Paradigm of Hardware-Software Collaboration. The integration of hardware and software in AI Cloud is shifting from competition in hardware performance to full-stack system-level collaboration. In the future, the differentiation of AI Cloud service providers will not lie in how many AI chips they develop themselves, but in whether they can manage the entire link from terminal, edge to cloud. This capability is reflected in two directions: first, deep collaboration on the cloud side, i.e., joint optimization of the upper-level AI Cloud platform and underlying hardware, improving resource utilization efficiency through instruction set matching, memory scheduling, etc.; second, integrated delivery on the edge side, i.e., AI all-in-one machines integrate pre-optimized algorithms and dedicated hardware to achieve "plug and play," supporting unified cloud management and model updates. These two paths are like the "dual engines" of AI Cloud: one drives the operation of ultra-large-scale tasks with high concurrency and high reliability, such as the Spring Festival Gala live broadcast, while the other empowers edge scenarios such as factory production lines and store terminals to achieve rapid deployment and flexible response. Product Forms Evolve Towards High-Low Code Collaboration. Enterprise demand for AI Cloud shows clear stratification: small and medium-sized teams pursue rapid online deployment and ease of operation, while large organizations require deep customization and long-term iteration capabilities. Therefore, the product form of AI Cloud in the future will present a "dual-track" architecture that evolves with high-low code collaboration: for small and medium-sized teams, the platform provides drag-and-drop interfaces, pre-built templates, and automated optimization to achieve "zero-code" rapid startup; for large organizations, the platform opens APIs, provides programmable workflows, and supports DevOps integration to achieve continuous iteration and fine-grained control. Although low-code can lower the initial usage threshold, it is difficult to sustain in core systems with high reliability and high complexity due to insufficient flexibility and difficulty in later maintenance. In the future, AI Cloud platforms will build a layered product system of "low-code entry, high-code in-depth cultivation," allowing users to choose freely according to their technical capabilities and business stages, achieving the transition from "getting started" to "doing well." Service Models Shift from Call Billing to Value Co-creation. The current market measures AI Cloud activity by the number of tokens called by large models. This standard has obvious limitations: it only reflects the frequency of calls and the scale of text, and it is difficult to reflect business value, usage depth, and service complexity. For example, high-value supply chain prediction and optimization consume few tokens, while a large amount of inefficient testing pushes up the total volume. The latter should obviously not be considered a "more successful" application. In fact, the value of AI Cloud is increasingly reflected in quantifiable business results, including not only the delivery results of customized projects but also dimensions such as task completion quality, improved decision accuracy, and reduced labor costs. In the future, the key to measuring the maturity of AI Cloud will no longer be solely "how many tokens have been used," but will also focus on "how much verifiable business revenue has been generated." Billing models oriented towards value, with application effects as the core, will also be favored by more users.

During the Spring Festival Gala, when hundreds of millions of viewers watch and interact in real-time through terminals such as TVs, mobile phones, and iPads, the underlying support is the "cloud-edge-end" intelligent full-link architecture. This architecture, as a core breakthrough in the evolution from traditional cloud to AI cloud, precisely addresses the industry pain points of high latency in pure cloud AI and limited capabilities in pure terminal AI, allowing intelligent services to be integrated into every scenario as naturally as breathing: complex model training and global strategy optimization are borne by the cloud, regional real-time inference is handled by edge nodes, and terminal devices run lightweight models for millisecond-level response; the computing power scheduling platform can achieve cross-regional computing power pooling and dynamically allocate resources on demand; new-generation communication technologies such as 5G-A and Wi-Fi 6 provide low-latency, high-bandwidth guarantees for data flow, ensuring that interactions under hundreds of millions of concurrent users tend towards "zero stuttering, zero latency, zero interruption." MaaS (Model as a Service), as a key service form that bridges the evolution from traditional cloud services to AI cloud, encapsulates the entire process of large model training, inference, optimization, and security review into standardized APIs and low-code tools, allowing creators to enjoy industry-exclusive intelligence as if "ordering takeout." In scenarios like the Spring Festival Gala with diverse creative needs, the creative team can call various intelligent capabilities on demand according to stage creativity without needing to delve deeply into underlying AI technology. In particular, the MaaS platform's low-code tools and automatic containerized deployment capabilities can quickly solve pain points such as complex traditional development coding, difficult environment adaptation, and slow peak expansion, compressing the development cycle of intelligent applications related to stage creation and content security in large live broadcast scenarios from "monthly" to "hourly." Emergence of Intelligent Agents: Making Spring Festival Gala Creativity "What You Think Is What You Get." Intelligent agents, as the exit for AI Cloud to empower business value, shift the application development logic from "technology coding-driven" to "business demand-driven," achieving a development experience of "what you think is immediately presented." It can accurately understand the business logic of scenario creation like the Spring Festival Gala, autonomously decompose abstract stage creativity and interaction design requirements into executable steps, and efficiently promote the full implementation of stage presentation and scenario scheduling by coordinating various underlying resources and capability modules. At the same time, intelligent agents have real-time autonomous perception and dynamic adaptation capabilities, and can autonomously adjust execution strategies based on the on-site status of the Spring Festival Gala live broadcast and changes in the scale of audience interaction, ensuring the stable operation of various intelligent applications in highly dynamic scenarios, and ultimately transforming the value of AI Cloud into perceptible stage effects and audience experience. Beyond the Stage, AI Cloud Enters a New Chapter of Growth and Layout. The stunning real-time rendering and intelligent interaction on the Spring Festival Gala stage are just the tip of the iceberg of AI Cloud's capabilities. Beyond the dazzling display under the spotlight, the AI Cloud market is undergoing a structural leap driven by both technological evolution and industry demand. While the scale is rapidly expanding, manufacturers' strategic focus is shifting to the in-depth construction of full-stack services and enterprise-level Agent ecosystems. Technology Advances Rapidly, Enterprises Can Use It, AI Cloud Development Presses the Fast-Forward Button. On the technology side, large model inference efficiency continues to improve, the collaborative architecture of large and small models is becoming increasingly mature, and "universal connection protocols" represented by MCP are gradually being implemented, effectively alleviating the problem of model hallucinations, making AI applications more reliable and cost-effective, and laying a solid foundation for the development of the underlying AI Cloud market. On the demand side, industry procurement models are shifting from scattered project-based pilots to group-level system deployments, directly driving the release of full-stack service demands such as intelligent computing infrastructure, model training and inference, and intelligent agent orchestration and operation. At the same time, the growth of multimodal pre-training demand and the rise of the post-training market for vertical fields such as finance, healthcare, and manufacturing are driving rapid market growth. In the first half of 2025, the market size of China's AI Cloud full-stack services reached 28.09 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 195.7%. With the comprehensive deployment of "Artificial Intelligence +" industry applications, market growth momentum remains strong, and the market size is expected to exceed 110 billion yuan in 2026. AI Cloud manufacturers such as Alibaba Cloud and Baidu AI Cloud are accelerating their deployment of full-stack hardware and software capabilities, building full-stack solutions from heterogeneous intelligent computing resources and model development platforms to industry applications, and connecting the "chip-computing power-model-application" chain. Through hardware-software collaborative optimization, manufacturers are improving computing power efficiency while achieving unified control over data security, model governance, and intelligent agent development, building full-stack delivery capabilities from underlying infrastructure to upper-level industry applications. At the same time, enterprise-level Agent development platforms are rapidly becoming core components of the AI Cloud service system. Products such as Amazon Bedrock Agent Core, Alibaba Cloud Agent Run, and Volcano Engine AgentKit are being launched intensively, covering the entire lifecycle of intelligent agent construction, operation, invocation, and governance, focusing on solving the pain points of "difficult governance, difficult iteration, and difficult integration" in enterprise AI applications. Scenario Layered Evolution, High-Value Landing Breakthroughs Yet to Be Solved. Currently, AI Cloud has achieved partial large-scale commercial use in standardized, clearly defined scenarios such as search engines and store inspections, verifying technical feasibility. However, deep penetration into complex and high-value scenarios still faces challenges, the crux of which lies in the mismatch between some technical supply and industry demand. On the one hand, although general AI technology has broad generalization capabilities, it is difficult to accurately capture the unique business logic, data formats, and compliance constraints of vertical fields, and it lacks deep insight into the deep pain points of scenarios. On the other hand, although some landing projects have completed technical deployment, they have not been embedded into the core business processes of enterprises, resulting in some AI systems becoming "showcases" that cannot be converted into quantifiable cost reduction and efficiency improvement or revenue growth, limiting the large-scale extension of AI Cloud to high-value scenarios. The stunning performance on stage is backed by the overall evolution of AI Cloud from underlying architecture to service logic. In the future, this wave of technology validated by the Spring Festival Gala will accelerate its penetration into thousands of industries, promoting AI Cloud from "technically usable" to the next stage of development: "scenario-friendly and measurable results." The integration of hardware and software in AI Cloud is shifting from competition in hardware performance to full-stack system-level collaboration. In the future, the differentiation of AI Cloud service providers will not lie in how many AI chips they develop themselves, but in whether they can manage the entire link from terminal, edge to cloud. This capability is reflected in two directions: first, deep collaboration on the cloud side, i.e., joint optimization of the upper-level AI Cloud platform and underlying hardware, improving resource utilization efficiency through instruction set matching, memory scheduling, etc.; second, integrated delivery on the edge side, i.e., AI all-in-one machines integrate pre-optimized algorithms and dedicated hardware to achieve "plug and play," supporting unified cloud management and model updates. These two paths are like the "dual engines" of AI Cloud: one drives the operation of ultra-large-scale tasks with high concurrency and high reliability, such as the Spring Festival Gala live broadcast, while the other empowers edge scenarios such as factory production lines and store terminals to achieve rapid deployment and flexible response. Product Forms Evolve Towards High-Low Code Collaboration. Enterprise demand for AI Cloud shows clear stratification: small and medium-sized teams pursue rapid online deployment and ease of operation, while large organizations require deep customization and long-term iteration capabilities. Therefore, the product form of AI Cloud in the future will present a "dual-track" architecture that evolves with high-low code collaboration: for small and medium-sized teams, the platform provides drag-and-drop interfaces, pre-built templates, and automated optimization to achieve "zero-code" rapid startup; for large organizations, the platform opens APIs, provides programmable workflows, and supports DevOps integration to achieve continuous iteration and fine-grained control. Although low-code can lower the initial usage threshold, it is difficult to sustain in core systems with high reliability and high complexity due to insufficient flexibility and difficulty in later maintenance. In the future, AI Cloud platforms will build a layered product system of "low-code entry, high-code in-depth cultivation," allowing users to choose freely according to their technical capabilities and business stages, achieving the transition from "getting started" to "doing well." Service Models Shift from Call Billing to Value Co-creation. The current market measures AI Cloud activity by the number of tokens called by large models. This standard has obvious limitations: it only reflects the frequency of calls and the scale of text, and it is difficult to reflect business value, usage depth, and service complexity. For example, high-value supply chain prediction and optimization consume few tokens, while a large amount of inefficient testing pushes up the total volume. The latter should obviously not be considered a "more successful" application. In fact, the value of AI Cloud is increasingly reflected in quantifiable business results, including not only the delivery results of customized projects but also dimensions such as task completion quality, improved decision accuracy, and reduced labor costs. In the future, the key to measuring the maturity of AI Cloud will no longer be solely "how many tokens have been used," but will also focus on "how much verifiable business revenue has been generated." Billing models oriented towards value, with application effects as the core, will also be favored by more users.

AI cloud vendors such as Alibaba Cloud and Baidu AI Cloud are accelerating the deployment of their full-stack hardware and software capabilities, possessing growth potential.

title_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation has approved and released 9 national standards for digital standardization.
body_en: Reported by He Ke, our correspondent Recently, the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAC) approved and released 9 national standards in the field of standardization digitalization, providing unified norms and technical support for China's digital transformation of standards. Standards unify basic general rules. Part 2 of Standardization Digitalization, from the three dimensions of capability characteristics, life cycle, and application level, clarifies the core elements of standardization digitalization activities and their interrelationships, solving the problems of inconsistent understanding and unclear implementation paths within the industry. Part 3 of Standardization Digitalization clarifies the conceptual definition, attribute content, and conceptual relationship rules of standard ontology, breaking through the traditional linear document structure and constructing a multi-dimensional semantic network, solving the problem of semantic fragmentation in traditional standards. Part 4 of Standardization Digitalization clarifies the rules for managing standard data, processes, stakeholder roles, and collaborative development processes in a digital environment, which helps to break down information barriers in traditional standard development and improve the efficiency and quality of standard research and development. Standards standardize the construction of semantic knowledge bases. Part 1 of Standard Semantic Knowledge Base establishes the principles and rules for semantic expression of standard content, promoting the transformation of standard texts into machine-parsable structured knowledge. Part 2 of Standard Semantic Knowledge Base unifies the data interface rules between semantic knowledge bases and external systems, which helps to improve the interoperability of cross-system and cross-domain standards. Part 3 of Standard Semantic Knowledge Base clarifies the integration rules between standard semantic knowledge bases and application scenario objects, solving the problem of data interaction and integration between semantic knowledge bases and application scenario objects. Standards facilitate intelligent retrieval and reasoning. Part 1 of Standard Content Modularization establishes the rules for establishing and configuring the main structure of standards in a digital environment, supporting the reuse of common hierarchical structures in standard content. Part 3 of Standard Machine Language Expression provides the feature element model in the general model of digital standards expressed in machine language, supporting intelligent retrieval, automatic comparison, and reasoning applications of standards. Standards support the construction of digitalization platforms. Part 1 of Standardization Digitalization Platform constructs a platform system architecture covering business, resources, support, and implementation, and clarifies the core functional modules of the platform, providing a basis for the design, development, and deployment of standardization digitalization platforms, and assisting in the digital management of the entire life cycle of standards. The State Administration for Market Regulation (SAC) will strengthen the promotion and dissemination of standards, and guide relevant institutions and industry enterprises in their implementation and application. At the same time, it will continue to track technological development trends at home and abroad, continuously improve the standard system for standardization digitalization, promote the in-depth development of China's standardization digitalization work, and provide strong support for the high-quality development of the digital economy.

title_en: Two departments further strengthen recall supervision of cross-border e-commerce retail imported food
body_en: Reported by Li Qing Recently, the State Administration for Market Regulation and the Ministry of Commerce jointly issued the "Announcement on Further Strengthening the Supervision of Recalls of Imported Food for Cross-border E-commerce Retail" (hereinafter referred to as the "Announcement"). The Announcement further clarifies the primary responsibility for recalls of imported food for cross-border e-commerce retail, effectively prevents food safety risks associated with such imports, and ensures consumer safety. The Announcement implements the relevant requirements of the "Opinions of the General Office of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the General Office of the State Council on Further Strengthening the Whole-Chain Supervision of Food Safety." It also incorporates recent regulatory practices, focusing on clarifying the domestic recall responsibility holder as a starting point to further tighten and solidify the responsibilities of cross-border e-commerce enterprises, entrusted enterprises, and cross-border e-commerce platforms. Clarifies the domestic recall responsibility holder for imported food for cross-border e-commerce retail. The Announcement designates cross-border e-commerce enterprises as the primary responsible parties for the food safety of imported food for cross-border e-commerce retail. It requires them to entrust a domestic food production and business enterprise to carry out recall work for such imported food. Strengthens the relevant obligations of cross-border e-commerce enterprises. The Announcement requires cross-border e-commerce enterprises to immediately stop sales upon discovering quality and safety risks or problems with relevant food. They must notify the entrusted enterprise to recall already sold food and handle it properly. The recall and handling situation should be reported to market regulation and other departments in a timely manner. Consolidates the responsibilities of cross-border e-commerce platforms. The Announcement requires cross-border e-commerce platforms to urge cross-border e-commerce enterprises to strengthen quality and safety risk prevention and control, and to urge cross-border e-commerce enterprises and entrusted enterprises to carry out recall work effectively. For cross-border e-commerce enterprises that fail to take proactive recall measures, their platform services will be suspended. Market regulation departments will increase supervision of recalls. Cross-border e-commerce enterprises, entrusted domestic enterprises, and cross-border e-commerce platforms that fail to fulfill their recall-related obligations will be dealt with strictly in accordance with laws and regulations, and relevant departments will be notified to include them in credit management.

title_en: A-shares start the year with a bang after the Spring Festival
body_en: On the first trading day of the Year of the Wood Horse (February 24th), the A-share market welcomed a strong start. After the market opened, the three major stock indices fluctuated and strengthened, then rose and fell back. By the close, the Shanghai Composite Index rose 0.87% for the day to 4117.41 points; the Shenzhen Component Index rose 1.36% to 14291.57 points; and the ChiNext Index rose 0.99% to 3308.26 points. The total turnover of A-shares exceeded 2.2 trillion yuan, an increase of over 219.2 billion yuan compared to the last trading day before the Spring Festival holiday. More than 4,000 stocks rose across the market. Concept sectors showed significant differentiation: on February 24th, Wind's cultivated diamond and fiberglass indices surged 12.05% and 8.98% respectively; the phosphorus chemical and oil and gas exploration concepts also rose by about 8%, while some AI concepts experienced significant declines, with Wind's seedance video large model and DeepSeek indices falling 5.83% and 4.22% respectively. "The market's frenzy for AI large models is returning to rationality. Funds are beginning to scrutinize the actual commercialization capabilities of these technologies in both B2B and B2C markets. As the period of intensive financial report disclosures approaches, high-valuation sectors lacking performance support are most vulnerable to sell-offs," interviewees pointed out to 21st Century Business Herald reporters. Looking ahead, China Galaxy Securities' strategy research team stated in a research report that the A-share market is likely to be driven by policy catalysts, with funds speculating around policy-oriented industrial mainstays and thematic opportunities, characterized by "rotating policy hotspots and rapid style shifts." During the domestic Spring Festival holiday, external geopolitical disturbances continued, pushing international oil prices to a nearly six-month high (as of February 19th), and risk aversion sentiment also drove up gold prices. Against this backdrop, on February 24th, 2026, the first trading day after the Spring Festival holiday, the three major A-share stock indices collectively rose, with upstream resource products performing strongly. In the morning session that day, the oil and gas sector led the surge, with more than 10 stocks including Xin Jin Power, Tong Yuan Petroleum, Qian Neng Heng Xin, Zhong You Engineering, Lan Yan Holdings, COSCO SHIPPING Energy Transportation, and Zhun You Shares hitting the daily limit. For the entire day, the oil and gas exploration index rose by nearly 8%, ranking among the top gainers in Wind's popular concept indices. At the same time, A-share cultivated diamond, fiberglass, and phosphorus chemical concepts performed impressively, with their respective indices surging 12.05%, 8.98%, and 8.41%. The superhard materials and natural gas concept indices rose by about 7%. In terms of industry sectors, on February 24th, Wind's energy equipment, petroleum and natural gas, maritime transport, and precious metals indices led the gains, rising 7.82%, 5.64%, 5.07%, and 4.72% respectively. "During the Spring Festival, global geopolitical uncertainty increased, and localized friction in some key shipping lanes or expectations of tight capacity directly boosted the prosperity expectations of the maritime transport and oil and gas sectors," Pan Jun, an investment manager at Cheese Fund, told reporters. At the same time, Pan Jun further explained that due to recent changes in US tariff rulings causing fluctuations in the US dollar's credit and a return of risk aversion, coupled with global geopolitical risk aversion sentiment, gold and other precious metals have once again demonstrated their strong asset preservation and hedging properties. Furthermore, with the rise in expectations for Federal Reserve interest rate cuts, the global manufacturing cycle is stabilizing at the bottom, leading to a repair in demand expectations for upstream resource products (oil, copper, etc.), thus driving the strengthening of related cyclical resource stocks. It is worth noting that before the Spring Festival holiday, the fiberglass concept had already attracted capital. According to Wind statistics, in the week of February 9th-13th, the fiberglass index rose by over 13%, ranking first in the weekly gain list of popular concept indices. Electronic-grade fiberglass is one of the basic raw materials for printed circuit boards (PCBs). Industry insiders pointed out that the rise in the fiberglass sector is mainly influenced by the demand for AI computing power, and the price increase of electronic cloth before the festival confirms the logic of tight supply. In addition, core basic materials and core hardware sectors in the upstream of the AI computing power industry chain saw strong gains: on February 24th, Wind's copper clad laminate index rose by nearly 5%; the optical module and optical communication indices both rose by more than 4%. However, some AI concept sectors also experienced significant declines. On February 24th, Wind's seedance video large model, DeepSeek, Kimi, AIGC, and ChatGPT concept indices fell 5.83%, 4.22%, 4.2%, 3.55%, and 3.2% respectively. The short drama game concept performed weakly, with its related index falling by more than 4.2% for the day, and the influencer economy and virtual human concept indices both falling by about 3.3%. In Pan Jun's view, AI concepts represented by domestic large models such as DeepSeek and Kimi, as well as themes like short drama games, have undergone repeated speculation, and their valuations have been pushed up. At the opening of the Year of the Horse, funds tended to lock in profits and reallocate to cyclical dividend sectors that are at low levels and have performance support. "The market's frenzy for AI large models is returning to rationality. Funds are beginning to scrutinize the actual commercialization capabilities of these technologies in both B2B and B2C markets. Many cultural media and software companies, despite being supported by AI concepts, are finding it difficult to reflect this in their profit statements in the short term, and even face the drag of high R&D and computing power costs. As the period of intensive financial report disclosures approaches, high-valuation sectors lacking performance support are most vulnerable to sell-offs," Pan Jun explained. Looking ahead, how will the A-share market perform? Which industry sectors are expected to become the main themes of the market? "After the Spring Festival, driven by policy expectations, liquidity support, and industrial trend catalysts, the market is likely to trend upwards with volatility, while also needing to closely monitor the short-term impact of overseas uncertainties on market sentiment," China Galaxy Securities' strategy research team stated in a research report. The team predicts that around the Two Sessions, the A-share market will likely be driven by policy catalysts, with funds speculating around policy-oriented industrial mainstays and thematic opportunities, characterized by "rotating policy hotspots and rapid style shifts." The market logic in March will gradually shift from "policy expectations" to "performance realization," and the disclosure of listed companies' 2025 annual reports and subsequent 2026 first-quarter reports will become the anchor points for the market trend, with stocks exceeding performance expectations likely to attract capital focus. In the medium term, an insider at China Asset Management believes that following the easing of Sino-US trade friction, both China and the US have embarked on long-term, self-controllable industrial chain security construction, and investment in related fields is expected to continue to boost economic growth. Global markets are experiencing persistently high volatility due to risks such as geopolitics, US stagflation, and accelerated AI capital expenditure. The previous market volatility has significantly cleared leverage in the existing market, and the decline in leverage has accelerated the release of downside risk for stock and commodity prices. "Challenges to risk assets from the geopolitical environment still exist and may create buying opportunities in rebound markets through event shocks. Driven by the combined forces of increased credit growth in the first quarter, strengthening liquidity, and the start of the '15th Five-Year Plan,' the domestic stock market still has the opportunity to initiate a trend of monthly-level market movements," the insider said. Regarding specific allocation strategies, Pan Jun believes that the main themes of the market will revolve around "certainty" and "new quality productive forces." "We are optimistic about the robotics industry chain and technology hardware and AI infrastructure sectors represented by storage, as well as cyclical industries such as non-ferrous metals and chemicals that benefit from monetary easing and supply-side consolidation." Dongwu Securities' strategy research team suggests focusing on two lines of thought: medium-term industrial trend certainty (with greater elasticity after being oversold) and cyclical industry distressed reversals (lack of favorable odds before a full recovery of the traditional economy, but with defensive attributes). Specific areas include: cloud computing in AI and pan-AI fields, domestic chip manufacturing (semiconductor equipment, materials, packaging and testing, etc.), CPO-related segments, AI power construction peripherals such as gas turbines and diesel engine liquid cooling, and the robotics industry chain; emerging industry varieties such as commercial aerospace, quantum technology, hydrogen energy, and brain-computer interfaces; cyclical sectors such as chemicals, building materials, consumer leaders, and construction machinery; energy storage, and strategic resource products (rare earths, etc.). In addition, Yang Delong, Chief Economist and Fund Manager at Qianhai Kaiyuan Fund, also mentioned that during the Spring Festival Gala in the Year of the Horse, "black technology" showcased its prowess, and large models also appeared in large-scale applications, laying the foundation for the technology stock market in 2026. However, it should be noted that due to the significant gains of technology stocks in 2025 and the accumulation of substantial profits, technology stocks may experience significant differentiation in 2026. Companies with genuine R&D capabilities that can secure orders from major manufacturers and deliver performance will continue to strengthen, while stocks that purely speculate on concepts and themes may fall sharply. This poses some difficulty for technology stock investment in the Year of the Horse. Yang Delong suggests adopting a relatively balanced approach: in addition to allocating to leading technology innovation stocks, one can also invest in the new energy sector with a performance turnaround, consumer blue-chip stocks with improving performance, and sectors with rising prosperity such as military and non-ferrous metals. This combination, which can be both offensive and defensive, will help to fully diversify risks in the Year of the Horse market. title_en: The 8 billion AI red envelope war has ended. After the carnival, where do we go from here?
body_en: The AI "red envelope war," which burned over 8 billion yuan, has concluded with the Year of the Horse Spring Festival. Internet platforms like Tencent, Alibaba, and ByteDance took turns, completely transforming the traditional "red envelope grabbing" peak season into a stress test for AI's integration into daily life. While the battle reports released by each company were more impressive than the last, the industry landscape behind the data became increasingly clear: leading platforms are accelerating their market capture with triple barriers of capital, technology, and ecosystem. It is becoming increasingly difficult for smaller players to enter the general AI track. And the more brutal test has just begun – after the Spring Festival traffic recedes, whether users stay or leave will be the ultimate standard for evaluating this carnival. Industry insiders believe that this Spring Festival positioning battle will not only affect the competitive landscape of the AI industry but also bring forward the node of China's internet transitioning to AI internet. Spring Festival has always been a golden window for internet platforms to acquire new users. This window in 2026 is given new meaning – it is no longer a simple traffic competition, but the first "major exam" of AI technology directly facing users nationwide. A senior executive from a major tech company told a reporter from 21st Century Business Herald that the competition during this Spring Festival is related to the company's front-end business layout and even investment and financing landscape for the next few years. It can be said that the competitive landscape established by the entire industry at the Spring Festival node will directly determine the seats at the future "card table." It is this sense of urgency that has led major platforms to invest heavily. With an investment of over 8 billion yuan, this Spring Festival has become the largest civilian test field in the history of the AI industry. In the past, Spring Festival red envelopes were about payment scenarios; this year, they are about AI entry points. Tencent, Alibaba, and ByteDance deployed heavy forces, while Baidu, JD.com, Meituan, and Kuaishou also launched AI interactive gameplay – everyone wants to seize a place in the AI era by leveraging the Spring Festival traffic. The battle report data is indeed astonishing: Tencent Yuanbao, relying on the WeChat ecosystem, tied AI with social fission. The main venue had over 3.6 billion draws, and lucky red envelopes were sent over 11 million times. Alibaba's Qianwen integrated AI into consumption scenarios, leading 130 million people to experience "AI shopping" for the first time, with AI movie ticket orders surging 372 times month-on-month. ByteDance's Doubao, through exclusive cooperation with CCTV's Spring Festival Gala, secured the "top traffic" position in this competition. On New Year's Eve, AI interactions reached 1.9 billion, with over 50 million New Year-themed avatars generated and over 100 million New Year greetings sent. Chen Liteng, an analyst at the E-commerce Research Center, stated, "The 2026 Spring Festival AI red envelope war is not just a set of impressive data, but also a signal that China's AI industry is shifting from 'technology competition' to 'scenario competition'." This trial also makes a trend increasingly apparent: the industry is accelerating towards consolidation at the top. Leading companies have money, technology, and ecosystems, enabling them to quickly graft AI onto existing scenarios; smaller players have limited resources, making it increasingly difficult to get a piece of the general AI entry point. This means that the future AI competitive landscape may be settled quickly, and the general AI assistant track may only accommodate a few leading players. In this year's AI Spring Festival, ByteDance, Tencent, and Alibaba firmly stood in the first tier. Each relied on its core ecosystem and took three different paths, but all pointed to the same goal: deeply integrating AI with existing businesses and securing entry points. Doubao's biggest killer feature was its exclusive cooperation with CCTV's Spring Festival Gala. This national-level traffic entry point allowed it to reach a wider audience with its products and technologies across the entire platform. Technologically, the multimodal capabilities of Seedance 2.0 and the high concurrency processing of Doubao Large Model 2.0 supported interactive gameplay such as avatar generation and New Year greeting creation. In terms of computing power, Volcano Engine withstood a peak throughput of 63.3 billion tokens per minute on New Year's Eve, verifying the capability of large models for large-scale deployment. Chen Liteng commented, "Doubao, relying on exclusive AI cooperation with the Spring Festival Gala, strongly occupied the national mind with its super high interaction volume and multimodal gameplay, converting Spring Festival traffic into AI entry point recognition." Alibaba's approach is more pragmatic – turning AI red envelopes directly into tools for driving consumption. The mature consumption ecosystem built by Taobao and Alipay is Qianwen's biggest backing. The red envelopes received by users through AI interaction can be directly used for shopping, buying movie tickets, and ordering takeout. The fact that 130 million people experienced AI shopping for the first time and AI ticket orders surged 372 times verified a key issue: AI can drive real transactions. Qianwen's goal is not to be a simple conversational assistant, but to become a tool to assist in consumption decisions. By embedding AI entry points into consumption scenarios, users naturally use AI when using Taobao or Alipay – this is much more efficient than building a standalone app and then acquiring new users. Tencent's strategy is more like a "light cavalry raid." WeChat's social relationship chain is Yuanbao's biggest moat. By embedding AI interactions into group chats and Moments, and launching lucky red envelopes and in-group AI gameplay, Yuanbao achieved massive user reach with almost no traffic costs through social fission. Chen Liteng believes that Tencent Yuanbao, relying on the WeChat ecosystem, stabilized its base with social fission and in-group AI interactions, achieving user penetration at low cost and securing the AI entry point for social scenarios. The three paths are essentially the maximization of their respective core advantages. This has also become the core rule of the current AI industry: simply competing on technology is meaningless; only by deeply integrating AI with the ecosystem can true positioning be achieved. After the Spring Festival, the real test has just begun. The massive interactions during the festival are essentially "pulsed traffic." New Year avatars, New Year greetings, and lucky red envelopes – these are all festival demands. Once the festival is over, the demand disappears. If AI products cannot offer functions that solve daily essential needs, the 8 billion yuan spent in the early stage may just be a lively event. Angel investor Guo Tao summarized three key factors that determine user stickiness: whether it can directly address users' real pain points and form differentiated barriers; whether user data can feed back into model iteration, making the product better with use; and whether it can seamlessly integrate into users' existing social, office, and consumption ecosystems, lowering the barrier to entry. In other words, Spring Festival gameplay can only attract users "to try once"; what truly makes them stay is whether AI can solve practical problems. Ge Xiaobin, a professor at Anhui University of Finance and Economics, stated, "Whether this AI red envelope war can retain users depends not on the amount of red envelopes, but on the core value of the product beyond the red envelopes. What truly allows users to stay is whether the AI assistant can be integrated into practical scenarios such as life, work, and consumption, and solve real problems." Major platforms are clearly aware of this. Recently, Doubao announced the launch of "Expert Mode" on its app, desktop client, and web version, integrating Doubao Large Model 2.0 Pro; Alibaba's Qianwen continues to deepen consumption scenarios; Tencent previously stated that Yuanbao is continuously iterating and updating, and will implement more update plans in the future. However, the effect remains to be seen whether users will accept it. This retention challenge is actually a long-term challenge for the entire AI industry. Rapid technological iteration does not equate to a good product experience. Inaccurate answers, stiff interactions, and superficial scenario integration – these problems were masked by the Spring Festival data and will gradually be exposed after the festival. The 2026 AI Spring Festival is a carnival of traffic, and also a sobering agent for the industry. It has shown everyone the possibility of AI becoming ubiquitous, and also made everyone realize that the short-term positioning during Spring Festival is just the beginning; long-term user retention and value conversion are the core. After the traffic recedes, whoever can truly solve user problems and achieve scenario closure will be able to secure their position at the re-established AI card table. The future AI industry will not be about temporary excitement, but about long-term capabilities.
