title_en: Decree of the State Council of the People's Republic of China (No. 834)
body_en: Regulations of the State Council on Supply Chain Security Article 1. These Regulations are formulated to prevent supply chain security risks, enhance supply chain resilience and security, and safeguard economic and social stability and national security, in accordance with the Cybersecurity Law of the People's Republic of China, the Law of the People's Republic of China on Foreign Relations, the Anti-Foreign Sanctions Law of the People's Republic of China, the Foreign Trade Law of the People's Republic of China, and other laws. Article 2. Supply chain security work shall implement the overall national security concept, coordinate development and security, coordinate domestic and international affairs, promote high-level opening up, and facilitate the stable and smooth flow of global supply chains. Article 3. The state shall establish and improve a supply chain security working mechanism to coordinate supply chain security work. Article 4. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of State Security, the Ministry of Justice, the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry of Natural Resources, the Ministry of Transport, the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, the Ministry of Commerce, the People's Bank of China, the General Administration of Customs, the State Administration for Market Regulation, the Cyberspace Administration of China, and other departments under the State Council shall be responsible for supply chain security work in accordance with their respective duties. Relevant departments of the State Council shall strengthen coordination and cooperation in supply chain security work. Article 5. People's governments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall be responsible for supply chain security work related to their respective administrative regions under the overall coordination of the state. Article 6. The state shall guide the rational and orderly layout of supply chains, promote the digitalization and intelligentization of supply chains, enhance the security and controllability of supply chains, and promote the high-quality development of supply chains. Article 7. Enterprises shall be encouraged and supported to explore diversified supply channels, carry out supply chain cooperation, participate in market competition fairly, and improve their ability to prevent supply chain security risks. Article 8. The state shall adhere to the principles of equality and mutual benefit, and win-win cooperation, strengthen international cooperation in the field of supply chains, and actively participate in the formulation of international rules related to supply chains. Article 9. Relevant departments of the State Council and people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall fully consider the potential impact on supply chain security during the formulation of relevant plans. Article 10. The state shall strengthen supply chain security guarantees in key areas. Relevant departments of the State Council shall formulate and dynamically adjust lists of key areas to maintain the stable and continuous production and circulation of raw materials, technologies, equipment, and products in key areas. Article 11. Relevant departments of the State Council shall promote information sharing in key areas of supply chains, strengthen information platform support, guide industries and enterprises to strengthen information interconnection in key areas of supply chains, and take effective measures to ensure data security. Article 12. The state shall establish and improve a system for monitoring and early warning of supply chain security risks in key areas. Relevant departments of the State Council shall organize assessments and monitoring of the stability of supply channels for raw materials, technologies, equipment, and products in key areas and their impact on economic and social stability and national security, identify supply chain security risks, and issue early warning information in a timely manner. Article 13. Enterprises, industry associations, and chambers of commerce that discover situations affecting supply chain security may report them to relevant departments of people's governments at or above the county level. Article 14. The state shall establish and improve a system for preventing supply chain security risks in key areas. Relevant departments of the State Council shall organize the physical and capacity reserves in key areas, increase investment in research and development of technologies, equipment, and products, and enhance the risk resistance of supply chains in key areas. Article 15. Relevant departments of the State Council and local people's governments shall take targeted measures to prevent supply chain security risks in accordance with the characteristics of their respective industries and regions. Article 16. The state shall establish and improve a system for emergency management of supply chain security in key areas, and relevant departments of the State Council shall formulate emergency work plans. In the event of a situation affecting the security of supply chains in key areas that endangers economic and social stability and national security, emergency disposal measures such as emergency dispatch, use of reserves, and organization of production, transportation, and supply may be taken upon the decision of the State Council or departments authorized by the State Council. If laws and administrative regulations provide otherwise, they shall be followed. Article 17. Relevant departments of the State Council and local people's governments shall implement emergency disposal measures in accordance with their respective duties and powers, and terminate the implementation in a timely manner after the relevant situation is eliminated. Relevant organizations and individuals shall cooperate with the implementation of emergency disposal measures. Article 18. Social capital shall be encouraged and guided to invest in scientific and technological research and development and core technology breakthroughs in key areas, and promote the industrialization of scientific and technological achievements. Article 19. Enterprises and research institutions shall improve their risk prevention and control systems to achieve secure and controllable core technologies and related information systems and data. Relevant departments shall strengthen guidance and training. Article 20. Any organization or individual that violates Chinese laws, administrative regulations, departmental rules, and relevant national regulations by conducting investigations or other information collection activities related to supply chains within China shall be subject to corresponding measures taken by relevant departments in accordance with the law. Article 21. If a foreign country, region, or international organization violates international law and basic norms of international relations by adopting discriminatory prohibitions, restrictions, or other similar measures against China in terms of supply chains, or by implementing or assisting in actions that harm China's supply chain security, relevant departments of the State Council shall have the right to conduct supply chain security investigations into the relevant measures or actions. Article 22. title_en: The 2026 China Internet Development Symposium was held in Beijing.
body_en: Report: On April 19th, the China Internet Development Symposium was held in Beijing. Zhang Yunming, Member of the Party Group and Vice Minister of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, and Zhong Zhihong, Chief Engineer, attended the meeting and delivered speeches. The meeting pointed out that this day marked the 10th anniversary of General Secretary Xi Jinping presiding over a symposium on cybersecurity and informatization and delivering an important speech. Over the past decade, under the strong leadership of the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core, the internet industry has deeply implemented the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, playing its role in serving the overall situation and forging ahead in the face of challenges. The modernization of the industry has progressed steadily, and its competitive advantages and leading position have been continuously consolidated and enhanced. During the "14th Five-Year Plan" period, China's basic telecommunications enterprises have become world-class, the scale of the internet industry has continued to expand, the innovation capabilities of digital technologies have continuously improved with an increasing number of advantageous areas, breakthroughs have been made in frontier fields such as chips and operating systems, digital service models have been continuously optimized and service levels have been continuously improved, the adaptation of websites and apps for the elderly and people with disabilities has been deeply promoted, and the industrial internet has achieved full coverage of all 41 major industrial categories, making positive contributions to fostering and developing new quality productive forces and accelerating the promotion of new industrialization. The meeting emphasized that the "15th Five-Year Plan" period is a critical period for consolidating the foundation and making all-out efforts to basically achieve socialist modernization. The entire industry must deeply implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important thought on building a strong cyber power, anchor the main goals of economic and social development during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, strengthen coordination with major national strategies and key plans, solidly promote the high-quality development of the industry, and demonstrate new aspirations, new responsibilities, and new achievements in the new era and on the new journey. We must have the courage to forge ahead and be pioneers in leading innovation. Increase R&D investment, strengthen basic research and the tackling of key core technologies, and strive to overcome difficulties in "hard technology" fields. We must have an inclusive mindset and be promoters of integrated development. Actively open up technology, data, and market resources, drive enterprises upstream and downstream in the industrial chain, and build a good ecosystem for the integrated development of large, medium, and small enterprises. We must have the determination to be rooted in the real economy and be good enablers of industrial upgrading. Plan ahead for the construction of new infrastructure such as 6G and the Internet of Intelligent Bodies, cultivate and strengthen emerging industries, make forward-looking arrangements for future industries, and accelerate the development of the intelligent economy. We must have the responsibility to benefit society and strive to be practitioners of compliance and goodness. Adhere to the people-centered development philosophy, continuously improve service quality, effectively protect user rights and interests, build a strong cybersecurity barrier, and let the fruits of internet development benefit the people more equitably. We must have a broad vision and aspire to be pioneers in global development. Firmly believe in the confidence of global development, accelerate the "going out" of digital products and services, and promote the common development and prosperity of the global digital economy. This symposium was hosted by the Internet Society of China. Responsible comrades from relevant departments of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, heads of relevant basic telecommunications enterprises, internet enterprises, artificial intelligence enterprises, social organizations, and industry experts attended the meeting. (Yao Wen)

title_en: Opinions of the State Council on Promoting the Expansion and Quality Improvement of the Service Industry I. Overall Requirements II. Strengthening Weak Links in Producer Services Across the Entire Chain III. Enhancing the Development Level of Key Areas in Consumer Services IV. Improving the Digital, Intelligent, Standardized, Integrated, and Internationalized Level of the Service Industry V. Improving the Supporting Policy System
body_en: Opinions of the State Council on Promoting the Expansion and Quality Improvement of the Service Industry Guo Fa [2026] No. 7 To the People's Governments of Provinces, Autonomous Regions, and Municipalities directly under the Central Government, and the Ministries and Commissions and directly subordinate agencies of the State Council: To promote the expansion and quality improvement of the service industry, foster high-quality and efficient development of the service sector, and better leverage its role in supporting industrial upgrading, meeting people's needs, and expanding employment, the following opinions are hereby put forward. I. Overall Requirements Guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, thoroughly implementing the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and its subsequent plenary sessions, earnestly carrying out the deployments of the Fourth Plenary Session, fully and accurately implementing the new development philosophy, adhering to the combination of a well-functioning market and an effective government, and balancing expansion with quality improvement and development with regulation, we will focus on demand-driven growth, reform breakthroughs, technological empowerment, and open cooperation. We will coordinate the optimization of new growth areas and the revitalization of existing resources, deeply implement the action plan for expanding and improving the service industry, break down institutional and mechanical barriers hindering the development of the service sector, promote the extension of producer services towards specialization and the high-end of the value chain, foster the high-quality, diversified, and convenient development of consumer services, and provide strong support for accelerating the construction of a modern industrial system. By 2030, significant progress will be made in the high-quality development of the service industry. The total scale of the service industry will exceed 100 trillion yuan, and a development pattern characterized by higher quality, optimized structure, better standards, and greater vitality will be largely established. More "China Service" brands will be cultivated, and the global competitiveness and influence of the service industry will be significantly enhanced, leading to a continuous improvement in people's sense of gain. II. Strengthening Weak Links in Producer Services Across the Entire Chain (I) Enhancing the Supporting Role of Technology Services Research and Development Design: Cultivate leading enterprises in industrial design, improving their professionalism and internationalization. Enhance the service capabilities of the national network management platform for major scientific research infrastructure and large scientific instruments, and improve the evaluation and assessment mechanisms for the open sharing of scientific research facilities and instruments. Improve the overall service level of engineering survey, design, and supervision. Intellectual Property: Develop services such as intellectual property strategic consulting and patent navigation, and screen for high-value patents. Support the construction of patent pools for key industries, systematically enhance intellectual property service levels, and strengthen the capacity for responding to foreign intellectual property risks and providing legal services. Strengthen the capacity building for international copyright operations. Technology Transfer and Commercialization: Strengthen policy support for the high-quality development of incubators, and establish incubators oriented towards emerging and future industries. Build a pilot-scale testing service network for manufacturing, cultivate pilot-scale testing platforms for manufacturing in a tiered manner, and build national pilot-scale testing bases for artificial intelligence applications with high quality. Improve the network of technology trading service platforms and foster high-level technology transfer and promotion institutions. Establish regional technology transfer and commercialization centers at universities to promote the aggregation of scientific and technological innovation elements. Inspection, Testing, and Certification: Benchmark against world-class standards, enhance inspection and testing service capabilities, and promote international mutual recognition of results. Promote the construction of laboratories for quality control and technical evaluation of industrial products, quality inspection and testing centers, and industrial metrology and testing centers. Enhance the capacity for testing and evaluating infrastructure conditions, agricultural product quality, and other aspects. Strengthen the research and development of high-end metrology instruments and inspection and testing equipment and facilities. (II) Enhancing the Comprehensive Competitiveness of Modern Logistics Freight Transportation: Improve the multimodal transport system and promote the implementation of "single bill" and "single container" systems. Vigorously develop rail-water intermodal transport and accelerate the shift of bulk cargo and medium- and long-distance freight transportation from road to rail and water. Accelerate the transformation of railway freight transport to railway logistics and improve industry rules for railway dispatch, settlement, and track connection. Improve the operation and dispatch mechanism of oil and gas pipeline networks and accelerate the promotion of nationwide interconnection. Vigorously develop international maritime and air transport services. Accelerate the cultivation of integrated logistics integrators and strengthen resource dispatch and supply-demand matching. Warehousing: Promote the renovation and upgrading of old logistics and warehousing facilities, explore the revitalization and utilization of idle facilities and railway freight yards, and promote the construction of distributed warehousing facilities. Enhance the service capabilities for on-farm cold storage and preservation, post-harvest pre-cooling, and sorting and packaging of agricultural products. Coordinate the layout of public, circulation-oriented, and functionally composite cold storage facilities, and renovate old cold storage facilities. Wholesale: Guide the rational layout of bulk commodity spot markets and promote the coordinated development of futures and spot markets. Enrich the business formats of industrial consumer goods markets and explore integrated services such as centralized procurement and warehousing and distribution. Strengthen the systematic layout and policy support for agricultural product wholesale markets and promote the renovation and upgrading of agricultural product wholesale markets. (III) Accelerating the Innovative Development of Software and Information Services Software: Deeply implement the "Artificial Intelligence Plus" action, accelerate the research and development and application of intelligent programming tools, and support the procurement of large models and intelligent agent services. Accelerate breakthroughs in industrial software innovation and build demonstration centers for compatibility, adaptation, and application of industrial software in key industries. Strengthen the ecosystem of basic software and open-source communities. Optimize the ecosystem of smart audio-visual systems. Information Transmission: Deeply promote the large-scale application of fifth-generation mobile communication (5G). Promote the development of 5G-A networks and strengthen research and development of sixth-generation mobile communication (6G) technologies. Build mobile Internet of Things (IoT) infrastructure with moderate foresight. Develop satellite internet application services. Data and Information Technology: Deeply implement the innovation and development project for the industrial Internet. Promote the industrial data foundation action, cultivate data cooperation consortia, and build a number of high-quality industry datasets. Develop specialized services such as data labeling and certification, and explore the establishment of a classified and tiered mechanism for data ownership confirmation, evaluation, and pricing. Orderly promote the layout of computing power and the construction of edge computing power, and improve the intelligent computing cloud service system. Accelerate the application of urban information modeling platforms and building information modeling technologies. (IV) Enhancing Professional Services in Supply Chain Finance Banking, Securities, and Insurance: Guide financial institutions to carry out pledge financing of movable property and rights based on inventory, orders, and warehouse receipts, in compliance with laws and regulations and under controllable risks. Establish a full-lifecycle financing system that invests in early-stage, small-scale, long-term, and hard-tech companies. Leverage the role of national venture capital guidance funds, optimize and promote the "innovation score system" and the evaluation of specialized, refined, unique, and new development of small and medium-sized enterprises. Promote new financial service tools such as supply chain bills. Expand the coverage of product liability insurance, promote trial service insurance, and effectively implement insurance compensation policies for first sets of major equipment. Carry out digital RMB empowerment actions. Explore mutual recognition of cross-border supply chain finance standards. Financial Leasing: Encourage financial leasing companies to coordinate the use of service models such as direct leasing, sale-and-leaseback, and joint leasing to provide customized solutions and reduce the operating costs of lessees. Strengthen the monitoring and evaluation of lessees' credit status and repayment ability, and establish and improve a valuation system for leased assets. Leverage the role of government-backed financing guarantee institutions and establish a risk-sharing mechanism for supply chain finance. (V) Actively Developing Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Services Energy Conservation and Carbon Reduction: Promote energy efficiency diagnosis in key industries, promote the service model of energy cost托管 for public institutions, and carry out energy conservation and carbon reduction renovation for public institutions and large public buildings. Prudently carry out pledge financing for carbon emission rights, pollutant discharge rights, and water rights in accordance with the law. Promote financial institutions' participation in carbon market trading, explore the development of carbon insurance business, and promote innovative products such as carbon neutrality bonds. Environmental Governance: Develop technical services for green, high-yield, and high-efficiency agriculture and services for the treatment and utilization of agricultural waste. Accelerate the development of environmental protection services such as marine ecological restoration and pollution control. title_en: MIIT: Industrial contribution to economic growth was nearly 40% in the first quarter
body_en: Beijing, April 21 (People's Daily Online) - (Reporter Shen Jiaping) "In the first quarter, the development of industry and information technology achieved a good start overall." On April 21, Zhang Yunming, Vice Minister of Industry and Information Technology, introduced at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office that in the first quarter, the value added of industrial enterprises above designated size increased by 6.1% year-on-year, and the contribution of industry to economic growth was nearly 40%. Zhang Yunming stated that the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology actively leveraged the synergy of policies such as "two heavy" and "two new" and guided local areas to increase policy implementation and work execution. In the first quarter, the value added of industrial enterprises above designated size increased by 6.1% year-on-year, with all 31 provinces achieving positive growth, an industry growth rate of over 80%, and the contribution of industry to economic growth being nearly 40%. The development and growth of the digital industry were promoted, and the layout and construction of new information infrastructure were accelerated. The total business volume of telecommunications services increased by 8.3% year-on-year in the first quarter, an increase of 0.6 percentage points compared to the same period last year. The business revenue of the software and information technology services industry from January to February increased by 11.7% year-on-year, an increase of 1.8 percentage points compared to the same period last year. At the same time, industrial technological innovation deepened and became more practical, and growth potential was further stimulated. title_en: Good news is coming! The State Council has issued a major document!
body_en: By 2030, the total scale of the service industry will reach 100 trillion yuan, and more "China Service" brands will be cultivated. According to Xinhua News Agency, in order to thoroughly implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions on the development of the service industry and the spirit of the National Service Industry Conference, the State Council recently issued the "Opinions on Promoting the Expansion and Quality Improvement of the Service Industry" (hereinafter referred to as the "Opinions"). By 2030, the total scale of the service industry will reach 100 trillion yuan, more "China Service" brands will be cultivated, the global competitiveness and influence of the service industry will be significantly enhanced, and the sense of gain of the people will be continuously improved. The "Opinions" propose to strengthen weak links in producer services throughout the entire chain, enhance the supporting role of scientific and technological services, strengthen the comprehensive competitiveness of modern logistics, accelerate the innovative development of software and information services, enhance the professional service capabilities of supply chain finance, actively develop energy-saving and environmental protection services, and strengthen and optimize business services. It is necessary to enhance the development level of key areas of consumer services, increase the supply of high-quality resident services, improve the adaptability of elderly care and childcare services, enhance the professional capabilities of health services, and innovate service models for culture, tourism, and sports. It is necessary to improve the digitalization, standardization, integration, and internationalization levels of the service industry, promote the digital and intelligent transformation of the service industry, accelerate the standardization construction of the service industry, improve the level of integrated development of modern services with advanced manufacturing and modern agriculture, and steadily promote the opening up and cooperation of the service industry. The "Opinions" clarify that it is necessary to improve the policy system supporting the expansion and quality improvement of the service industry, deepen reform and innovation, enrich fiscal and financial policy tools, enhance the supporting and guaranteeing capacity of infrastructure, expand high-quality service industry market entities, strengthen talent construction, and enhance safety supervision. The "Opinions" require that all regions and departments, under the centralized and unified leadership of the Party Central Committee, should conscientiously implement and put into practice in conjunction with their actual conditions, and strive to create a new situation for the high-quality development of the service industry. The government assessment system should be further improved to fully mobilize the enthusiasm and initiative of all parties. All regions should implement and refine various tasks and measures in light of local conditions, and all departments should promote them in accordance with their responsibilities and divisions. The National Development and Reform Commission should strengthen overall coordination and monitoring and evaluation. Opinions of the State Council on Promoting the Expansion and Quality Improvement of the Service Industry Guo Fa [2026] No. 7 To the people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, and the ministries and directly affiliated agencies of the State Council: In order to promote the expansion and quality improvement of the service industry, promote the high-quality and efficient development of the service industry, and better leverage the role of the service industry in supporting industrial upgrading, meeting people's needs, and expanding employment, the following opinions are hereby put forward. Improve the level of full-process services such as engineering survey, design, and supervision. Intellectual Property. Develop services such as intellectual property strategic consulting and patent navigation, and screen high-value patents. Support the construction of patent pools for key industries, systematically improve the level of intellectual property services, and enhance the ability to respond to foreign intellectual property risks and provide legal services. Strengthen the construction of international copyright operation capabilities. Transformation of Scientific and Technological Achievements. Strengthen policy support for the high-quality development of incubators, and build incubators oriented towards emerging industries and future industries. Build a pilot service network for manufacturing, cultivate pilot platforms for manufacturing in a tiered manner, and build national artificial intelligence application pilot bases with high quality. Improve the network of technology trading service platforms and build high-level technology transfer and promotion institutions. Build regional technology transfer and transformation centers in universities to promote the aggregation of scientific and technological innovation elements. Inspection, Testing, and Certification. Benchmark against world-class standards, improve inspection and testing service capabilities, and promote international mutual recognition of results. Promote the construction of laboratories for quality control and technical evaluation of industrial products, quality inspection and testing centers, and industrial metrology and testing centers. Enhance the detection and evaluation capabilities of infrastructure status and agricultural product quality. Strengthen the research and development of high-end metrology instruments and inspection and testing equipment and facilities. (2) Enhancing the Comprehensive Competitiveness of Modern Logistics Freight Transportation. Improve the multimodal transport system and promote the implementation of "one-stop" and "one-container" services. Vigorously develop rail-water intermodal transport, and accelerate the "road-to-rail" and "road-to-water" transfer of bulk cargo and medium- and long-distance freight transportation. Accelerate the transformation of railway freight transportation to railway logistics, and improve industry rules for railway dispatch, clearing, and connection. Improve the operation and dispatch mechanism of oil and gas pipeline networks, and accelerate the promotion of interconnection nationwide. Vigorously develop international maritime and air transport services. Accelerate the cultivation of integrated logistics integrators and strengthen resource dispatch and supply-demand matching. Warehousing. Promote the renovation and upgrading of old logistics and warehousing facilities, explore the revitalization and utilization of idle facilities and railway freight yards, and promote the construction of distributed warehousing facilities. Enhance the service capabilities of cold chain preservation at the origin of agricultural products, pre-cooling after harvest, and selection and packaging. Coordinate the layout of public, circulation, and functional composite cold storage, and renovate old cold storage. Wholesale. Guide the rational layout of bulk commodity spot markets and promote the coordinated development of futures and spot markets. Enrich the business formats of industrial consumer goods markets and explore integrated services such as centralized procurement and warehousing and distribution. Strengthen the systematic layout and policy support of agricultural product wholesale markets and promote the renovation and upgrading of agricultural product markets. (3) Accelerating the Innovative Development of Software and Information Services Software. Deeply implement the "Artificial Intelligence +" action, accelerate the research and development and use of intelligent programming tools, and support the procurement of large models and intelligent agent services. Accelerate breakthroughs in industrial software innovation and build compatibility and application demonstration centers for industrial software in key industries. Strengthen the construction of basic software ecosystems and open-source communities. Optimize the smart audio-visual system ecosystem. Information Transmission. Deeply promote the large-scale application of 5G mobile communication. Promote the development of 5G-A networks and strengthen the research and development of 6G mobile communication technology. Build mobile Internet of Things infrastructure with moderate foresight. Develop satellite Internet application services. Data and Information Technology. Deeply implement the innovation and development project for the industrial Internet. Promote the action of building industrial data foundations, cultivate data cooperation consortia, and build a number of high-quality industry datasets. Develop professional services such as data annotation and certification, and explore the establishment of classified and graded data property rights, evaluation, and pricing mechanisms. Orderly promote the layout of computing power and the construction of edge computing power, and improve the intelligent computing cloud service system. Accelerate the application of urban information modeling platforms and building information modeling technology. (4) Enhancing Professional Service Capabilities of Supply Chain Finance Banks, Securities, and Insurance. Guide financial institutions to carry out pledge financing of movable property and rights based on inventory, orders, warehouse receipts, etc., in accordance with laws and regulations and under the premise of controllable risks. Establish a full life cycle financing system that invests in early-stage, small-scale, long-term, and hard-tech companies. Leverage the role of national venture capital guidance funds, optimize and promote the "innovation point system" and the evaluation of specialized, refined, and innovative small and medium-sized enterprises. Promote new financial service tools such as supply chain bills. Expand the coverage of product research and development liability insurance, promote pilot service insurance, and implement insurance compensation policies for the first set of (sets of) equipment. Carry out digital RMB empowerment actions. Explore the mutual recognition of cross-border supply chain finance standards. Financial Leasing. Encourage financial leasing companies to coordinate the use of service models such as direct leasing, sale and leaseback, and joint leasing to provide customized solutions and reduce the operating costs of lessees. Strengthen the monitoring and evaluation of lessees' credit status and repayment ability, and establish and improve a valuation system for leased assets. Leverage the role of government financing guarantee institutions to establish a risk-sharing mechanism for supply chain finance. (5) Actively Developing Energy-Saving and Environmental Protection Services Energy Saving and Carbon Reduction. Promote energy efficiency diagnosis in key industries, promote the energy cost托管 service model for public institutions, and carry out energy-saving and carbon-reduction renovation for public institutions and large public buildings. Carry out guarantee financing for carbon emission rights, pollutant discharge rights, water rights, etc., in a lawful and prudent manner. Promote financial institutions to participate in carbon market transactions, explore the development of carbon insurance business, and promote innovative products such as carbon neutrality bonds. Environmental Governance. Develop green, high-yield, and high-efficiency technical services for agriculture and services for the treatment and utilization of agricultural waste. Accelerate the development of environmental protection services such as marine ecological restoration and pollution control. Expand services such as water-saving assessment, environmental monitoring, and pollution insurance. Recycling and Utilization. Advocate the concept of green and tiết kiệm, encourage the renewal and use of products with higher energy efficiency grades, and eliminate products that have reached the mandatory scrapping standard or do not meet safety technical specifications in accordance with laws and regulations. Improve the layout of recycling outlets for renewable resources, improve the "replacement + recycling" logistics system, and coordinate the construction of sorting centers for renewable resources. Support the development of remanufacturing services in key industries. Establish a certification system for recycled materials and promote international cooperation and mutual recognition. Deepen research on carbon footprint accounting standards and methods for key recycled materials. (6) Strengthening and Optimizing Business Services Legal and Consulting Services. Actively develop foreign-related legal services and cultivate a number of internationally first-class arbitration institutions and law firms. Vigorously develop professional services such as business consulting, asset appraisal, accounting and auditing, taxation, and advertising, and enhance the capabilities of quality consulting and supply chain management services. Strengthen the construction of industry think tanks and create world-class consulting brands. Human Resource Management. Issue a directory of "high-end, sophisticated, and scarce" talent needs, and continue to implement the knowledge updating project for professional technical talents. Improve the vocational skills competition system with Chinese characteristics. Develop service products such as recruitment large models and virtual reality training. Deeply carry out the "Belt and Road" human resource service action. III. Enhancing the Development Level of Key Areas of Consumer Services (7) Increasing the Supply of High-Quality Resident Services Community Home Services. Innovate integrated community service models and promote the expansion and quality improvement of complete communities. Implement the action plan for improving property service quality. Carry out institutional and model innovation in the home service industry, expand new types of home services, improve the quality and professional service level of practitioners, and improve the micro-perceptions of the people. Focus on meeting the special care needs of vulnerable groups. Retail. Promote the rational planning and layout of the retail industry in urban and rural areas, implement the innovation and upgrading project for the retail industry, and support cities with conditions to create new consumption scenarios with "one store, one policy." Encourage the development of instant delivery formats such as community micro-cold storage and front-end warehouses. Implement the high-quality development project for rural e-commerce and promote the renovation and upgrading of "thousands of markets and tens of thousands of stores." (8) Improving the Adaptability of Elderly Care and Childcare Services Elderly Care. Improve the three-level elderly care service network at the county, township, and village levels, expand the coverage of community elderly care services, and encourage home-based age-friendly renovation. Expand the supply of rehabilitation nursing, medical-elderly integration, and long-term care services, and develop new services such as travel-based elderly care. Childcare. Develop inclusive childcare and integrated childcare and early childhood education services, deeply carry out demonstration pilot projects for childcare subsidies, and support child welfare institutions in providing care, rehabilitation, special education, and other services for children with disabilities who have needs. (9) Enhancing the Professional Capabilities of Health Services Medical and Health Services. Support medical and health institutions in carrying out personalized family doctor contract services, providing health assessment, chronic disease management, home visits, medication guidance, and other services. Prudently promote pilot international medical services. Preventive Healthcare. Develop preventive healthcare for women and integrated medical and healthcare services, and improve the health service network for children and the elderly. Strengthen the construction of a socialized service system for mental health and psychological well-being. Accelerate the development of services such as sports data analysis and nutrition consulting. (10) Innovating Service Models for Culture, Tourism, and Sports Culture and Tourism. Guide the healthy and orderly development of industries such as performing arts entertainment, game animation, and online literature, and promote positive energy. Encourage popular scenic spots, cultural and museum venues, etc., to extend their opening hours. Improve public facilities in scenic spots, revitalize existing tourism projects, strengthen refined management, and optimize service supply. Sports and Fitness. Widely carry out national fitness activities and improve people's physical fitness. Promote the high-quality development of the event economy and the ice and snow economy, cultivate new business formats such as RV camping, and build high-quality outdoor sports destinations. Cultivate new models of intelligent, customized, and experiential sports consumption. Accommodation and Catering. Adapt to the upgrading of people's needs from "having a place to live" to "living well and living worth it," improve safety and hygiene standards, expand new service models, and develop new accommodation formats with historical, cultural, technological, and parent-child elements. Cultivate catering services that are healthy, safe, nutritionally balanced, and reflect local characteristics, and release a number of boutique gourmet tourism routes. IV. Improving the Digitalization, Standardization, Integration, and Internationalization Levels of the Service Industry (11) Promoting the Digital and Intelligent Transformation of the Service Industry. Focus on key links such as R&D design, inspection and testing, logistics and distribution, wholesale and trade, and consulting services, build vertical industry industrial Internet platforms, and use "small, fast, light, and precise" solutions to lower the threshold for digitalization. Implement special actions to accelerate the development of digital supply chains and promote the digital empowerment project for commercial logistics. Focus on data empowerment, implement major comprehensive scenarios and high-value application scenario projects, cultivate digital transformation service providers, and create benchmarks for the collaborative application of data, algorithms, and scenarios. (12) Accelerating the Standardization Construction of the Service Industry. Strengthen top-level design and improve the standard system in key areas. Improve standards and norms in areas such as home services, care, and catering. Accelerate the formulation of service standards for new business formats and integrated business formats such as low-altitude services and agricultural socialized services. Build a standard system and interconnection technical specifications for industrial Internet platforms, establish a standard system for computing power services, and revise and formulate green service standards. Improve service standards for the platform economy. Promote the establishment of international industry and standard organizations and promote the "going out" of Chinese standards. (13) Improving the Level of Integrated Development of Modern Services with Advanced Manufacturing and Modern Agriculture. Focus on key areas to deepen pilot projects for the integrated development of advanced manufacturing and modern services. Innovate and develop service-oriented manufacturing, and promote manufacturing enterprises to transform into "product + service" solution providers. Improve a convenient and efficient agricultural socialized service system and optimize the functions of agricultural product market information service platforms. Actively promote the deep integration of agriculture with health and wellness, culture and tourism. (14) Steadily Promoting the Opening Up and Cooperation of the Service Industry. Further expand pilot programs in areas such as value-added telecommunications, biotechnology, and wholly foreign-owned hospitals. Improve the negative list management system for cross-border trade in services. Enhance service capabilities such as compliance assessment and security certification for data export. Strengthen trade in services cooperation with key countries and regions, and coordinate the layout and construction of major opening-up and cooperation platforms such as service trade innovation and development demonstration zones. Promote the export of cultural services and tourism services, and promote the expansion of inbound consumption. V. Improving the Policy Support System (15) Deepening Reform and Innovation. Adhere to both "allowing flexibility" and "effective management," clean up unreasonable standards and restrictive measures in the service industry, and promptly eliminate barriers in factor acquisition, qualification certification, bidding and tendering, and government procurement. Deepen the reform of public institutions in the service sector to enhance development vitality. Optimize the market access environment in fields such as healthcare and technological innovation. Enrich the supply of service scenarios and release lists of application scenario projects in batches. Improve the statistical system, build a multi-dimensional comprehensive evaluation index for the development of the service industry, and accelerate the promotion of big data regulation. (16) Enriching Fiscal and Financial Policy Tools. Enhance the targeting and effectiveness of policy support, and improve the financing and credit enhancement system covering elements such as quality, standards, brands, trademarks, patents, and copyrights. Make good use of policy tools for service consumption and re-lending for elderly care. Enrich and develop elderly care financial products and promote long-term care insurance. Optimize the implementation of loan interest subsidy policies for service industry market entities, provide phased interest subsidies for loans to eligible small, medium, and micro private enterprises in the producer services sector, and increase financial support for new consumption scenarios. Support the integration and development of advanced manufacturing and modern services through existing national government investment funds. Support eligible projects in the service industry to issue real estate investment trusts (REITs) in the infrastructure sector. (17) Enhancing Infrastructure Support and Guarantee Capacity. Revitalize and make good use of various existing resources. Accelerate the construction of urban parking and charging facilities, and promote the renovation and upgrading of old equipment. Strengthen the construction of modern agricultural service centers. Layout and construct integrated and efficient quality infrastructure, and vigorously support investment in intangible assets such as software, R&D, and data. Systematically promote the construction and functional improvement of national logistics hubs, and optimize the layout of overseas warehouses. Promote the expansion and upgrading of urban 15-minute convenient living circles. Promote the renovation of commodity trading markets, urban retail stores, and rural commercial outlets. Renovate old streets and factory areas, and support the upgrading of business districts and cultural industry parks. (18) Expanding High-Quality Service Industry Market Entities. Accelerate the cultivation of backbone enterprises in the service industry and support eligible enterprises in listing and financing, mergers and acquisitions. Promote the specialized, refined, and innovative development of small and medium-sized enterprises in the service industry, and vigorously cultivate "famous, special, excellent, and new" individual businesses. Cultivate and strengthen agricultural socialized service entities. Strengthen the collection of industry credit information, encourage market entities to make service quality commitments, and advocate for high quality and high prices. Support enterprises in strengthening brand building and communication, and cultivate new scenarios for brand experience. (19) Strengthening Talent Construction. Optimize the layout of disciplines and professional programs related to the service industry, and support eligible regions in building urban industry-education consortia and industry-education integration communities. Deeply implement the "Skills Illuminate the Future" training action, and carry out large-scale vocational skills improvement training focusing on urgently needed industries and key employment groups. Broaden the scope of professional talent introduction and promote the construction of one-stop service platforms for overseas talents. (20) Strengthening Safety Supervision. Improve cross-departmental and cross-industry approval and supervision models that adapt to business format integration, and avoid management and service gaps. Improve safety management systems for densely populated areas such as performance venues, event venues, exhibition venues, and tourist attractions, and implement safety production responsibilities. Standardize catering service business operations and strictly adhere to the bottom line of food safety. Resolutely rectify chaos such as "take-it-or-leave-it" clauses and false advertising, and effectively protect consumer rights and interests. Strengthen the protection of the rights and interests of workers in new employment forms. All regions and departments should, under the centralized and unified leadership of the Party Central Committee, conscientiously implement these opinions in conjunction with their actual conditions and strive to create a new situation for the high-quality development of the service industry. title_en: JD.com acquires more land, investing over 10 billion yuan in three years, with new businesses "burning cash" for growth.
body_en: Liu Qiangdong's frequent land acquisitions reveal the e-commerce giant's strategic ambitions. On April 20, 2026, JD.com focused its attention on Hangzhou, the headquarters of Alibaba, where its wholly-owned subsidiary Hangzhou JD Jiewei Information Technology Co., Ltd. successfully bid for a prime riverside commercial land parcel in the core area of Hangzhou Qianjiang Century City for a starting price of 663 million yuan, with a floor price of 5,600 yuan/square meter. This plot, located next to the Hangzhou Asian Games Village and approximately 160 meters from the Qiantang River, is planned to be developed into a regional hub integrating office, technology, and JD MALL functions, with a total planned investment of about 2 billion yuan and capacity for over 4,000 employees. According to the strategic cooperation agreement signed between the Hangzhou Xiaoshan District Government and JD.com Group on June 24, 2025, JD.com Group will leverage its comprehensive advantages in e-commerce, modern logistics, new entity enterprises, and technological innovation. The company plans to invest in the construction of a regional center, logistics sector, and retail sector in Xiaoshan District, aiming to jointly gather innovation resources, promote the development of omnichannel retail formats, build a smart living service system, and jointly create a digitalized Xiaoshan and a city that young people aspire to live in, thereby fostering new drivers for the digital economy. In addition to this land acquisition in Hangzhou, JD.com has been actively acquiring land in various locations in recent years, with different development focuses for each parcel. On November 11, 2025, in Nanjing, JD.com Group successfully bid for the NO. Ning2025Y05 land parcel in Jianye District, marking the official establishment of the JD.com Nanjing R&D Center. Notably, this plot is adjacent to the headquarters of leading companies such as Alibaba and Xiaomi, and is positioned as JD.com Group's regional headquarters, serving dual functions of headquarters office and R&D center. The JD.com Nanjing R&D Center will focus on attracting R&D talent in cutting-edge fields such as artificial intelligence, robotics, and autonomous driving, comprehensively deploying diversified business segments including retail, technology, finance, and health. In Shenzhen, JD.com acquired a commercial and service industry land parcel in the Shenzhen Bay Super Headquarters Base in 2021 for 3.109 billion yuan. This project will strategically house the Jingxi headquarters and simultaneously establish the JD.com Group Innovation Center, JD.com Group Greater Bay Area Data Cooperation Center, and JD.com Group Greater Bay Area Artificial Intelligence Research Institute, aiming to build industrial clusters for intelligent manufacturing, technological innovation, and modern services. In Beijing, JD.com has acquired multiple land parcels in areas such as Yizhuang and the Beijing Daxing International Airport Economic Zone, primarily for the construction of headquarters, industrial parks, and employee support facilities. In 2023, a land parcel in the Yizhuang New City of Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area was acquired by Beijing Yuexin Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. at the reserve price of 3.112 billion yuan, with its planned use being residential. In Hong Kong, on December 9, 2025, JD.com acquired office floors totaling 11,200 square meters in the Bank of China Tower in Central for HK$3.498 billion. This move signifies JD.com's expansion in Hong Kong from retail and logistics into the core commercial real estate sector, further intensifying its commitment to the Hong Kong market. According to incomplete statistics, since 2023, JD.com has been making substantial investments in land acquisition, building construction, and industrial park expansion in core cities across the country. The core investment areas are headquarters offices, technological R&D, smart logistics, and industrial parks, with a total investment exceeding 10 billion yuan. While JD.com is generously investing in land acquisition, the profitability pressure it faces during its strategic investment period cannot be ignored. The latest financial report shows that JD.com Group's 2025 performance is characterized by a significant "revenue growth without profit growth." While the scale of operating revenue has steadily expanded, the company's net profit attributable to the parent company has seen a substantial decline, and its operating profit margin has also narrowed significantly. JD.com's full-year operating revenue in 2025 increased from 1,158.819 billion yuan in 2024 to 1,309.085 billion yuan, an increase of approximately 13%, returning to double-digit growth after a two-year hiatus. However, in stark contrast to the revenue growth, profitability has sharply declined. The company's net profit attributable to the parent company fell from 41.359 billion yuan in 2024 to 19.631 billion yuan, a decrease of 52.5%. The operating profit margin also contracted significantly from 4.25% to 1.32%, a decrease of nearly 3 percentage points. Concurrently, the company's total assets saw a slight adjustment, shrinking from 313.297 billion yuan in 2024 to 293.783 billion yuan in 2025, a decrease of approximately 6.2%. In terms of business contributions to operating profit, JD Logistics and JD Retail maintained relatively stable growth. JD Retail's operating profit increased from 35.925 billion yuan in 2023 to 41.077 billion yuan in 2024, and further rose to 51.402 billion yuan in 2025. JD Logistics' operating profit surged from 1.005 billion yuan in 2023 to 6.317 billion yuan in 2024, and continued to grow in 2025, reaching 5.269 billion yuan. However, the losses in new business segments expanded sharply in 2025, with the loss amount increasing from 329 million yuan in 2023 to 2.865 billion yuan in 2024, and soaring to 46.641 billion yuan in 2025. As JD.com aggressively acquires land for business expansion, these investments have severely eroded the group's profits in the short term.

title_en: Chairman Shang Bing delivered a speech at the 2026 China Internet Development Symposium.
body_en: On April 19th, the 2026 China Internet Development Symposium was held in Beijing. The symposium, themed "Intelligent Empowerment for the 15th Five-Year Plan, Internet Gathering New Momentum," was presided over by Shang Bing, Chairman of the Internet Society of China, who delivered a speech. Chairman Shang Bing stated that artificial intelligence, as a forward-looking and strategic technology leading the new round of technological revolution and industrial transformation, has become a commanding height of global competition, a new battlefield for great power games, and a new engine for economic development. 2026 marks the beginning of the "15th Five-Year Plan." The "Government Work Report" mentioned new concepts such as the intelligent economy and intelligent agents for the first time, clearly requiring the promotion of commercialized and large-scale applications of artificial intelligence in key industries and fields, and the cultivation of new intelligent-native business formats and models. Fourth, build a solid security defense line to ensure the healthy development of the industry. Innovation-driven development and standardized development must be equally emphasized, and development and security must be coordinated. Strengthen data security and privacy protection, improve mechanisms for data annotation, cleaning, and operation, and promote the circulation and use of high-quality data resources. Improve the normalized monitoring and early warning system, establish a dynamic and trustworthy source evaluation mechanism, and strengthen source governance and risk mitigation for prominent risks such as large model data poisoning and false information, to ensure that artificial intelligence is safe, reliable, and controllable.
