title_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology: Overall good start for industrial and information technology development in the first quarter
body_en: On the morning of April 21, 2026, the State Council Information Office held a press conference to introduce the development of the industrial and information technology sectors in the first quarter of 2026. Zhang Yunming, Vice Minister of Industry and Information Technology, attended the press conference along with Tao Qing, spokesperson for the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and Director of the Department of Operation Monitoring and Coordination, and Xie Cun, spokesperson for the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and Director of the Department of Information and Communication Development, to introduce relevant information and answer questions. The following is a transcript of the press conference. Jia Huili, Deputy Director and Spokesperson of the Information Office of the State Council: Ladies and gentlemen, good morning! Welcome to the press conference of the State Council Information Office. Today, we are holding a regular release of economic data. We have invited Mr. Zhang Yunming, Vice Minister of Industry and Information Technology, to introduce the development of the industrial and information technology sectors in the first quarter of 2026 and answer your questions. Also attending today's press conference are Ms. Tao Qing, spokesperson for the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and Director of the Department of Operation Monitoring and Coordination, and Mr. Xie Cun, spokesperson for the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and Director of the Department of Information and Communication Development. Now, I invite Mr. Zhang Yunming to make his introduction. Introduction of the Situation Zhang Yunming, Vice Minister of Industry and Information Technology: Ladies and gentlemen, friends from the press: Good morning! First of all, thank you for your long-term care and support for the cause of industry and information technology. Since the beginning of this year, under the strong leadership of the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology has thoroughly implemented the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and all its plenary sessions, conscientiously implemented the deployments of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 20th Central Committee and the Central Economic Work Conference, and fully implemented the work arrangements of the National Two Sessions. We have actively worked with all regions and departments to take proactive measures and play a leading role. In the first quarter, the development of industry and information technology has achieved a good start overall. First, the operation of the industrial economy is stable and progressing, and the driving force for development has been further strengthened. We have actively leveraged the synergy of policies such as "two heavy" and "two new" and guided various regions to intensify policy implementation and work execution. In the first quarter, the value-added of industrial enterprises above designated size increased by 6.1% year-on-year. All 31 provinces achieved positive growth, with the growth rate of industries exceeding 80%, and the contribution of industry to economic growth reaching nearly 40%. We have promoted the development and growth of the digital industry and accelerated the layout and construction of new information infrastructure. The total volume of telecommunications business increased by 8.3% year-on-year in the first quarter, an increase of 0.6 percentage points compared to the same period last year. The revenue of the software and information technology services industry increased by 11.7% year-on-year in January-February, an increase of 1.8 percentage points compared to the same period last year. Second, industrial science and technology innovation has deepened and become more substantial, and growth potential has been further unleashed. We have promoted the deep integration of technological innovation and industrial innovation, and accelerated the transformation of innovative achievements into real productivity. As of now, we have selected the first batch of 21 national manufacturing pilot platforms and 14 excellent technology enterprise incubators, building a smooth bridge from "laboratories" to "production lines." In the first quarter, we released 304 industry standards for the upgrading of traditional industries, the growth of emerging industries, and the layout of future industries. The value-added of high-tech manufacturing enterprises above designated size increased by 12.5% year-on-year. The application of new technologies such as artificial intelligence in the electronics and consumer goods industries has accelerated, with an increasing variety of terminal products such as drones and AI glasses. The output of industrial robots and integrated circuits increased by 33.2% and 24.3% year-on-year, respectively. Third, the pace of advanced manufacturing has accelerated, and industrial vitality has been further released. We have continuously promoted the optimization of industrial structure, and the proportion of equipment manufacturing enterprises above designated size in the industrial value-added increased by 1.4 percentage points compared to the same period last year. We have released the list of the first batch of 16 cities for the creation of national new industrialization demonstration zones, and the total number of national high-tech zones has reached 179. We have intensified efforts to promote the intelligent upgrading of manufacturing, completed the acceptance of 37 "challenge-based" projects for intelligent manufacturing system solutions, and released 7 new national standards and 2 industry standards for intelligent manufacturing. We have focused on guiding energy conservation and carbon reduction in the industrial sector, carried out pilot projects for the comprehensive application of hydrogen energy, and released 2,038 new green factories and 128 green industrial parks. The energy consumption per unit of value-added of industrial enterprises above designated size nationwide continues to decline. Fourth, services for enterprises have been improved in quality and efficiency, and the strength of enterprises has been further enhanced. We have improved the tiered cultivation system for high-quality enterprises, issued the "Management Measures for the Cultivation of High-Quality Small and Medium-sized Enterprises," carried out special actions such as "Entering Universities to Recruit Talents" and SME talent services, and accelerated the clearing of arrears owed to enterprises. We have continuously standardized the competitive order in key industries, thoroughly addressed the chaos in the automotive industry's online market, and urged enterprises to strictly fulfill their 60-day payment term commitments. We have continuously and deeply promoted capacity early warning and control, standardized price competition, and strengthened product quality supervision. The competitive order in industries such as new energy vehicles and photovoltaic has continued to improve, and the prices of products such as photovoltaic modules, lithium carbonate, and power-type lithium iron phosphate have generally rebounded. Currently, external uncertainties are rising, but China's industrial system is complete, its industrial resilience is strong, and its market size is large. The basic trend of stable and positive industrial economic operation will not change. Next, we will adhere to the general principle of seeking progress while maintaining stability, coordinate domestic and international situations, better coordinate development and security, focus on stabilizing growth, strengthening innovation, promoting integration, optimizing governance, and preventing risks, and continuously improve the quality and efficiency of industrial economic operations, achieving a good start for the "15th Five-Year Plan." This is what I have to introduce. Next, my colleagues and I will be happy to answer your questions. Thank you. Questions and Answers Reporter from People's Post and Telecommunications News: Recently, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology issued the "Notice on Carrying out the Special Action of Inclusive Computing Power Empowerment for the Development of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises." What is the current development status of China's computing power industry? What are the key priorities for future development? Zhang Yunming: Thank you for your question. I will answer this. In recent years, computing power infrastructure has become a key foundation for driving the development of artificial intelligence. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology has thoroughly implemented the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, and has coordinated the high-quality development of the computing power industry with a "point, chain, network, and surface" approach. Recently, we have continued to focus on key tasks such as inclusive computing power empowerment for small and medium-sized enterprises and the coordination of computing power and electricity, and the computing power industry is developing well. First, computing power supply is more abundant. We have guided the construction of computing power infrastructure in an orderly manner, building a multi-level computing power architecture of "hub-region-edge." As of the end of March, the scale of intelligent computing power in China reached 1882 EFLOPS (FP16). Second, industrial innovation is more vigorous. We have deeply implemented the "challenge-based" action to strengthen computing power and accelerated technological and product innovation. We have carried out policy research and standard formulation for computing power and electricity coordination, and promoted the accelerated implementation of source-grid-load-storage and green electricity direct connection. Third, network transmission is smoother. We have accelerated the construction of high-speed broadband networks. In the past two years, more than 70 computing power super-highways have been built around computing power hubs, which are like "high-speed roads" specifically for computing power construction. We have implemented the special action of "millisecond computing" in metropolitan areas to improve the efficient transportation capacity of computing power. Fourth, industrial empowerment has achieved results. We have issued policy documents on inclusive computing power empowerment for the development of small and medium-sized enterprises, proposing "5 actions" and "16 measures" to focus on building an inclusive computing power service system, making it accessible, affordable, and usable for the vast number of small and medium-sized enterprises. Next, we will follow the idea of "improving quality at single points, strengthening chains through innovation, connecting computing power into a network, and empowering comprehensively" to continuously promote the systematic and high-quality development of the computing power industry. First, "improving quality at single points" of computing power resources. We will guide the orderly construction of computing power infrastructure according to demand, promote the coordinated layout of green power and computing power, and promote the full coverage of automated monitoring of computing power. We will improve the China Computing Power Platform to promote precise matching of computing power supply and demand and improve the utilization efficiency of computing power resources. Second, "strengthening chains through innovation" in technology and products. We will deeply implement the "challenge-based" action to strengthen computing power and promote the transformation and application of achievements and innovation empowerment. We will improve the construction of the computing power standard system. We will support forward-looking research on space computing power technology and orderly promote the development of the space computing power industry. Third, "connecting computing power into a network" for computing power transmission. We will promote the construction of "millisecond computing" networks in a tiered manner across the country, and build efficient and smooth computing power transmission channels around "hub-region-edge" to improve the interactive experience of computing power applications. Fourth, "empowering comprehensively" the industrial ecosystem. We will deeply carry out the special action of inclusive computing power empowerment for the development of small and medium-sized enterprises, explore innovative businesses such as "computing power banks" and "computing power supermarkets," and reduce the threshold and cost of computing power for small and medium-sized enterprises. Thank you. Reporter from Xin Huanghe Client: What is the situation of information and communication infrastructure construction in the first quarter of this year? What new progress has been made? And what are the considerations for the next step? Xie Cun, Spokesperson for the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and Director of the Department of Information and Communication Development: Thank you for your question. This year marks the beginning of the "15th Five-Year Plan." The industrial and information technology system has deeply implemented the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, and has made positive progress in promoting the construction of information and communication infrastructure, consolidating the foundation for the digital and intelligent transformation of the economy and society. Here, I would like to introduce it with three "more." First, network capabilities are stronger. As of the end of March, the total number of 5G base stations nationwide reached 4.958 million. The number of 10G PON ports capable of providing gigabit network services reached 32.01 million. 168 communities, factories, and parks in 86 cities nationwide have carried out pilot deployments of 10-gigabit optical networks. 5G-A (5G evolution network) currently covers 330 cities. The mobile Internet of Things has developed vigorously, with terminal users reaching 2.948 billion. Second, network coverage is wider. As of now, the country has achieved "gigabit access in every county and 5G access in every township." Administrative villages have achieved 100% broadband access and over 95% 5G access. Border management and trade institutions have achieved 100% 4G/5G network access. 269,000 key locations nationwide have achieved deep network coverage, and 654,000 kilometers of roads and railways and 316 subway lines have achieved continuous network coverage. Everyone should be able to deeply feel these changes and improvements. Third, network applications are better. As of now, 5G and gigabit optical networks have been integrated into 91 out of 97 major categories of the national economy. In the medical field, 5G applications have covered the entire process from pre-hospital emergency, in-hospital emergency, inpatient treatment, to rehabilitation discharge, and have been implemented and promoted in more than 500 tertiary hospitals. In the education field, 5G applications cover all scenarios of teaching, examination, evaluation, school, and management, and have been deployed in nearly 3,000 primary and secondary schools, vocational colleges, and higher education institutions. Next, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology will fully implement the deployments of the National "15th Five-Year Plan" Outline, further strengthen the construction of information and communication infrastructure, consolidate and enhance the competitive advantage and leading position of the information and communication industry, and continuously consolidate the digital foundation for high-quality economic and social development. We will focus on three aspects of work: First, leverage advantages. We will promote deep coverage of 5G and gigabit optical networks, continue to promote the special action of "signal enhancement," deepen the construction of "broadband frontiers" and "broadband forestry and grassland," and continuously improve network coverage and supply capacity. Second, promote upgrading. We will accelerate the large-scale commercial use of 5G-A, orderly carry out pilot projects for 10-gigabit optical networks, promote the evolution from "dual gigabit" networks to "dual 10-gigabit," and accelerate the development of mobile Internet of Things for "intelligent interconnection of all things." Third, strengthen coordination. We will systematically plan the research and development of cutting-edge technologies such as 6G and next-generation Internet, and promote the coordinated innovation between the information and communication industry and vertical industries. Thank you. Reporter from Upstream News: What is the overall operation status of the equipment industry in the first quarter? What new breakthroughs have been made in promoting the high-end and intelligent development of the industry? What are the key tasks for the next step? Tao Qing, Spokesperson for the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and Director of the Department of Operation Monitoring and Coordination: Thank you for your question. Overall, the equipment industry started well in the first quarter, showing three major characteristics: stable production, rising investment, and strong exports. First, production growth is stable. In the first quarter, the value-added of the equipment industry increased by 6.2% year-on-year, contributing 19.4% to industrial growth. Second, investment in major industries is recovering. In the first quarter, fixed asset investment in five major industries of the equipment industry achieved positive growth. Among them, railway, shipbuilding, aerospace and other transportation equipment manufacturing, and general equipment manufacturing increased by 27.7% and 12.5% year-on-year, respectively. Third, export contribution is prominent. In the first quarter, the export value of equipment manufacturing products, denominated in RMB, increased by 19.2% year-on-year, accounting for more than 60% of the total export value. In terms of the high-end and intelligent development of the equipment industry, it can be summarized as "three continuations." First, innovation capabilities continue to be strengthened. The world's first invasive brain-computer interface medical device was approved for marketing, filling a clinical gap in the world. Domestic spot welding industrial robots have achieved batch application for the first time in automotive welding lines. The world's first wire EDM machine with five-axis linkage has been successfully developed, significantly improving processing efficiency. Second, high-end products continue to increase. Among passenger cars priced above 500,000 yuan, the sales volume of domestic brands increased by 97% year-on-year, and the market share reached 69.5%. The second domestically built large cruise ship, "Adora Magic City," was successfully undocked. The world's largest pile-driving vessel, "CRCC Bridge Pile No. 1," was delivered. The "Xiangyun" AS700 manned airship has accumulated 42 confirmed orders. Third, the level of intelligence continues to improve. The equipment industry has built 197 excellent intelligent factories, reducing the average product defect rate by 48.4% and increasing production efficiency by 22.3%. In January-February, the penetration rate of new passenger cars with L2 level combined driving assistance functions reached 69%, an increase of 10 percentage points compared to the same period last year. In other words, for every 100 passenger cars sold new, more than 69 have L2 level combined driving assistance functions. Next, we will implement the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, and focus on three tasks: First, top-level design. We will accelerate the compilation of the "15th Five-Year Plan" for intelligent connected new energy vehicles and other industries, and study and issue guiding opinions on accelerating the innovative development of intelligent equipment. Second, stabilize operations. We will implement the new round of work plans to stabilize growth in industries such as machinery, automobiles, and power equipment, continue to promote equipment renewal and trade-in of automobiles, and standardize the industrial competitive order with a persistent spirit. Third, focus on tackling key problems. We will continue to implement the action plan for high-quality development of key industrial chains in the equipment industry, strengthen the tackling of iconic products, and promote the application of achievements. Thank you. Reporter from CCTV News Center, China Central Radio and Television: In the first quarter of 2026, the value-added of industrial enterprises above designated size nationwide increased by 6.1% year-on-year, an acceleration of 1.1 percentage points compared to the fourth quarter of the previous year. Since the beginning of this year, the industrial economy has shown an overall trend of moving towards newness and improvement, and stable progress, effectively playing the role of a "ballast stone" in stabilizing the macro economy. Overall, there are three main characteristics. The first characteristic is the relatively rapid growth of the industrial economy. From the industry perspective, key industries have driven growth significantly. Among the 41 major industrial categories, 34 achieved year-on-year increases in value-added. Industries such as electronics, electrical machinery and equipment, chemicals, petrochemicals, general equipment, and special equipment contributed 51.4% to industrial growth. From the regional perspective, key regions have played a prominent role. The growth rate of industrial enterprises above designated size in 10 major industrial provinces was about 7.2%. Industrial growth in major industrial provinces such as Zhejiang, Henan, Jiangsu, and Hubei maintained relatively rapid growth on the basis of a high base in the same period last year. Emerging industries such as integrated circuit manufacturing and biological product manufacturing are growing rapidly. Technological changes such as artificial intelligence have promoted the accelerated implementation of new technologies and new products in industries such as consumer electronics. The output of products with high technical content and high added value, such as robot reducers and memory chips, achieved high-speed growth of over 40%. The third characteristic is the continuous accumulation of positive momentum. In the first two months, the profits of industrial enterprises above designated size increased by 15.2% year-on-year, with a growth rate 14.6 percentage points faster than last year. The production and efficiency of small and medium-sized industrial enterprises above designated size were both higher than the average level of industrial enterprises above designated size. Manufacturing investment stabilized and rebounded, increasing by 4.1% year-on-year in the first quarter, with a growth rate 3.5 percentage points faster than last year. Investment in emerging fields showed strong growth. Investment in industries such as computer and office equipment manufacturing and aerospace vehicle and equipment manufacturing achieved double-digit growth. Currently, domestic effective demand is insufficient, small and medium-sized enterprises and some industries are facing tight cash flow, and operations in industries such as petrochemicals are disrupted. Consolidating the positive trend of the industrial economy still requires arduous efforts. Next, we will adhere to the general principle of seeking progress while maintaining stability, focus on expanding demand, improving quality, cultivating momentum, and further improving the quality and efficiency of industrial economic operations, and continuously consolidate the trend of recovery and improvement. Beidou navigation is further integrated into scenarios such as dynamic monitoring of scenic spots and indoor and outdoor navigation in commercial areas. On the one hand, we will enhance supply capacity and promote the matching of supply and demand, encourage domestic and foreign enterprises to increase investment, and improve production capacity. full_text: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology: Overall good start for industrial and information technology development in the first quarter. On the morning of April 21, 2026, the State Council Information Office held a press conference to introduce the development of the industrial and information technology sectors in the first quarter of 2026. Zhang Yunming, Vice Minister of Industry and Information Technology, attended the press conference along with Tao Qing, spokesperson for the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and Director of the Department of Operation Monitoring and Coordination, and Xie Cun, spokesperson for the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and Director of the Department of Information and Communication Development, to introduce relevant information and answer questions. The following is a transcript of the press conference. Jia Huili, Deputy Director and Spokesperson of the Information Office of the State Council: Ladies and gentlemen, good morning! Welcome to the press conference of the State Council Information Office. Today, we are holding a regular release of economic data. We have invited Mr. Zhang Yunming, Vice Minister of Industry and Information Technology, to introduce the development of the industrial and information technology sectors in the first quarter of 2026 and answer your questions. Also attending today's press conference are Ms. Tao Qing, spokesperson for the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and Director of the Department of Operation Monitoring and Coordination, and Mr. Xie Cun, spokesperson for the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and Director of the Department of Information and Communication Development. Now, I invite Mr. Zhang Yunming to make his introduction. Introduction of the Situation Zhang Yunming, Vice Minister of Industry and Information Technology: Ladies and gentlemen, friends from the press: Good morning! First of all, thank you for your long-term care and support for the cause of industry and information technology. Since the beginning of this year, under the strong leadership of the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology has thoroughly implemented the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and all its plenary sessions, conscientiously implemented the deployments of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 20th Central Committee and the Central Economic Work Conference, and fully implemented the work arrangements of the National Two Sessions. We have actively worked with all regions and departments to take proactive measures and play a leading role. In the first quarter, the development of industry and information technology has achieved a good start overall. First, the operation of the industrial economy is stable and progressing, and the driving force for development has been further strengthened. We have actively leveraged the synergy of policies such as "two heavy" and "two new" and guided various regions to intensify policy implementation and work execution. In the first quarter, the value-added of industrial enterprises above designated size increased by 6.1% year-on-year. All 31 provinces achieved positive growth, with the growth rate of industries exceeding 80%, and the contribution of industry to economic growth reaching nearly 40%. We have promoted the development and growth of the digital industry and accelerated the layout and construction of new information infrastructure. The total volume of telecommunications business increased by 8.3% year-on-year in the first quarter, an increase of 0.6 percentage points compared to the same period last year. The revenue of the software and information technology services industry increased by 11.7% year-on-year in January-February, an increase of 1.8 percentage points compared to the same period last year. Second, industrial science and technology innovation has deepened and become more substantial, and growth potential has been further unleashed. We have promoted the deep integration of technological innovation and industrial innovation, and accelerated the transformation of innovative achievements into real productivity. As of now, we have selected the first batch of 21 national manufacturing pilot platforms and 14 excellent technology enterprise incubators, building a smooth bridge from "laboratories" to "production lines." In the first quarter, we released 304 industry standards for the upgrading of traditional industries, the growth of emerging industries, and the layout of future industries. The value-added of high-tech manufacturing enterprises above designated size increased by 12.5% year-on-year. The application of new technologies such as artificial intelligence in the electronics and consumer goods industries has accelerated, with an increasing variety of terminal products such as drones and AI glasses. The output of industrial robots and integrated circuits increased by 33.2% and 24.3% year-on-year, respectively. Third, the pace of advanced manufacturing has accelerated, and industrial vitality has been further released. We have continuously promoted the optimization of industrial structure, and the proportion of equipment manufacturing enterprises above designated size in the industrial value-added increased by 1.4 percentage points compared to the same period last year. We have released the list of the first batch of 16 cities for the creation of national new industrialization demonstration zones, and the total number of national high-tech zones has reached 179. We have intensified efforts to promote the intelligent upgrading of manufacturing, completed the acceptance of 37 "challenge-based" projects for intelligent manufacturing system solutions, and released 7 new national standards and 2 industry standards for intelligent manufacturing. We have focused on guiding energy conservation and carbon reduction in the industrial sector, carried out pilot projects for the comprehensive application of hydrogen energy, and released 2,038 new green factories and 128 green industrial parks. The energy consumption per unit of value-added of industrial enterprises above designated size nationwide continues to decline. Fourth, services for enterprises have been improved in quality and efficiency, and the strength of enterprises has been further enhanced. We have improved the tiered cultivation system for high-quality enterprises, issued the "Management Measures for the Cultivation of High-Quality Small and Medium-sized Enterprises," carried out special actions such as "Entering Universities to Recruit Talents" and SME talent services, and accelerated the clearing of arrears owed to enterprises. We have continuously standardized the competitive order in key industries, thoroughly addressed the chaos in the automotive industry's online market, and urged enterprises to strictly fulfill their 60-day payment term commitments. We have continuously and deeply promoted capacity early warning and control, standardized price competition, and strengthened product quality supervision. The competitive order in industries such as new energy vehicles and photovoltaic has continued to improve, and the prices of products such as photovoltaic modules, lithium carbonate, and power-type lithium iron phosphate have generally rebounded. Currently, external uncertainties are rising, but China's industrial system is complete, its industrial resilience is strong, and its market size is large. The basic trend of stable and positive industrial economic operation will not change. Next, we will adhere to the general principle of seeking progress while maintaining stability, coordinate domestic and international situations, better coordinate development and security, focus on stabilizing growth, strengthening innovation, promoting integration, optimizing governance, and preventing risks, and continuously improve the quality and efficiency of industrial economic operations, achieving a good start for the "15th Five-Year Plan." This is what I have to introduce. Next, my colleagues and I will be happy to answer your questions. Thank you. Questions and Answers Reporter from People's Post and Telecommunications News: Recently, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology issued the "Notice on Carrying out the Special Action of Inclusive Computing Power Empowerment for the Development of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises." What is the current development status of China's computing power industry? What are the key priorities for future development? Zhang Yunming: Thank you for your question. I will answer this. In recent years, computing power infrastructure has become a key foundation for driving the development of artificial intelligence. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology has thoroughly implemented the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, and has coordinated the high-quality development of the computing power industry with a "point, chain, network, and surface" approach. Recently, we have continued to focus on key tasks such as inclusive computing power empowerment for small and medium-sized enterprises and the coordination of computing power and electricity, and the computing power industry is developing well. First, computing power supply is more abundant. We have guided the construction of computing power infrastructure in an orderly manner, building a multi-level computing power architecture of "hub-region-edge." As of the end of March, the scale of intelligent computing power in China reached 1882 EFLOPS (FP16). Second, industrial innovation is more vigorous. We have deeply implemented the "challenge-based" action to strengthen computing power and accelerated technological and product innovation. We have carried out policy research and standard formulation for computing power and electricity coordination, and promoted the accelerated implementation of source-grid-load-storage and green electricity direct connection. Third, network transmission is smoother. We have accelerated the construction of high-speed broadband networks. In the past two years, more than 70 computing power super-highways have been built around computing power hubs, which are like "high-speed roads" specifically for computing power construction. We have implemented the special action of "millisecond computing" in metropolitan areas to improve the efficient transportation capacity of computing power. Fourth, industrial empowerment has achieved results. We have issued policy documents on inclusive computing power empowerment for the development of small and medium-sized enterprises, proposing "5 actions" and "16 measures" to focus on building an inclusive computing power service system, making it accessible, affordable, and usable for the vast number of small and medium-sized enterprises. Next, we will follow the idea of "improving quality at single points, strengthening chains through innovation, connecting computing power into a network, and empowering comprehensively" to continuously promote the systematic and high-quality development of the computing power industry. First, "improving quality at single points" of computing power resources. We will guide the orderly construction of computing power infrastructure according to demand, promote the coordinated layout of green power and computing power, and promote the full coverage of automated monitoring of computing power. We will improve the China Computing Power Platform to promote precise matching of computing power supply and demand and improve the utilization efficiency of computing power resources. Second, "strengthening chains through innovation" in technology and products. We will deeply implement the "challenge-based" action to strengthen computing power and promote the transformation and application of achievements and innovation empowerment. We will improve the construction of the computing power standard system. We will support forward-looking research on space computing power technology and orderly promote the development of the space computing power industry. Third, "connecting computing power into a network" for computing power transmission. We will promote the construction of "millisecond computing" networks in a tiered manner across the country, and build efficient and smooth computing power transmission channels around "hub-region-edge" to improve the interactive experience of computing power applications. Fourth, "empowering comprehensively" the industrial ecosystem. We will deeply carry out the special action of inclusive computing power empowerment for the development of small and medium-sized enterprises, explore innovative businesses such as "computing power banks" and "computing power supermarkets," and reduce the threshold and cost of computing power for small and medium-sized enterprises. Thank you. Reporter from Xin Huanghe Client: What is the situation of information and communication infrastructure construction in the first quarter of this year? What new progress has been made? And what are the considerations for the next step? Xie Cun, Spokesperson for the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and Director of the Department of Information and Communication Development: Thank you for your question. This year marks the beginning of the "15th Five-Year Plan." The industrial and information technology system has deeply implemented the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, and has made positive progress in promoting the construction of information and communication infrastructure, consolidating the foundation for the digital and intelligent transformation of the economy and society. Here, I would like to introduce it with three "more." First, network capabilities are stronger. As of the end of March, the total number of 5G base stations nationwide reached 4.958 million. The number of 10G PON ports capable of providing gigabit network services reached 32.01 million. 168 communities, factories, and parks in 86 cities nationwide have carried out pilot deployments of 10-gigabit optical networks. 5G-A (5G evolution network) currently covers 330 cities. The mobile Internet of Things has developed vigorously, with terminal users reaching 2.948 billion. Second, network coverage is wider. As of now, the country has achieved "gigabit access in every county and 5G access in every township." Administrative villages have achieved 100% broadband access and over 95% 5G access. Border management and trade institutions have achieved 100% 4G/5G network access. 269,000 key locations nationwide have achieved deep network coverage, and 654,000 kilometers of roads and railways and 316 subway lines have achieved continuous network coverage. Everyone should be able to deeply feel these changes and improvements. Third, network applications are better. As of now, 5G and gigabit optical networks have been integrated into 91 out of 97 major categories of the national economy. In the medical field, 5G applications have covered the entire process from pre-hospital emergency, in-hospital emergency, inpatient treatment, to rehabilitation discharge, and have been implemented and promoted in more than 500 tertiary hospitals. In the education field, 5G applications cover all scenarios of teaching, examination, evaluation, school, and management, and have been deployed in nearly 3,000 primary and secondary schools, vocational colleges, and higher education institutions. Next, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology will fully implement the deployments of the National "15th Five-Year Plan" Outline, further strengthen the construction of information and communication infrastructure, consolidate and enhance the competitive advantage and leading position of the information and communication industry, and continuously consolidate the digital foundation for high-quality economic and social development. We will focus on three aspects of work: First, leverage advantages. We will promote deep coverage of 5G and gigabit optical networks, continue to promote the special action of "signal enhancement," deepen the construction of "broadband frontiers" and "broadband forestry and grassland," and continuously improve network coverage and supply capacity. Second, promote upgrading. We will accelerate the large-scale commercial use of 5G-A, orderly carry out pilot projects for 10-gigabit optical networks, promote the evolution from "dual gigabit" networks to "dual 10-gigabit," and accelerate the development of mobile Internet of Things for "intelligent interconnection of all things." Third, strengthen coordination. We will systematically plan the research and development of cutting-edge technologies such as 6G and next-generation Internet, and promote the coordinated innovation between the information and communication industry and vertical industries. Thank you. Reporter from Upstream News: What is the overall operation status of the equipment industry in the first quarter? What new breakthroughs have been made in promoting the high-end and intelligent development of the industry? What are the key tasks for the next step? Tao Qing, Spokesperson for the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and Director of the Department of Operation Monitoring and Coordination: Thank you for your question. Overall, the equipment industry started well in the first quarter, showing three major characteristics: stable production, rising investment, and strong exports. First, production growth is stable. In the first quarter, the value-added of the equipment industry increased by 6.2% year-on-year, contributing 19.4% to industrial growth. Second, investment in major industries is recovering. In the first quarter, fixed asset investment in five major industries of the equipment industry achieved positive growth. Among them, railway, shipbuilding, aerospace and other transportation equipment manufacturing, and general equipment manufacturing increased by 27.7% and 12.5% year-on-year, respectively. Third, export contribution is prominent. In the first quarter, the export value of equipment manufacturing products, denominated in RMB, increased by 19.2% year-on-year, accounting for more than 60% of the total export value. In terms of the high-end and intelligent development of the equipment industry, it can be summarized as "three continuations." First, innovation capabilities continue to be strengthened. The world's first invasive brain-computer interface medical device was approved for marketing, filling a clinical gap in the world. Domestic spot welding industrial robots have achieved batch application for the first time in automotive welding lines. The world's first wire EDM machine with five-axis linkage has been successfully developed, significantly improving processing efficiency. Second, high-end products continue to increase. Among passenger cars priced above 500,000 yuan, the sales volume of domestic brands increased by 97% year-on-year, and the market share reached 69.5%. The second domestically built large cruise ship, "Adora Magic City," was successfully undocked. The world's largest pile-driving vessel, "CRCC Bridge Pile No. 1," was delivered. The "Xiangyun" AS700 manned airship has accumulated 42 confirmed orders. Third, the level of intelligence continues to improve. The equipment industry has built 197 excellent intelligent factories, reducing the average product defect rate by 48.4% and increasing production efficiency by 22.3%. In January-February, the penetration rate of new passenger cars with L2 level combined driving assistance functions reached 69%, an increase of 10 percentage points compared to the same period last year. In other words, for every 100 passenger cars sold new, more than 69 have L2 level combined driving assistance functions. Next, we will implement the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, and focus on three tasks: First, top-level design. We will accelerate the compilation of the "15th Five-Year Plan" for intelligent connected new energy vehicles and other industries, and study and issue guiding opinions on accelerating the innovative development of intelligent equipment. Second, stabilize operations. We will implement the new round of work plans to stabilize growth in industries such as machinery, automobiles, and power equipment, continue to promote equipment renewal and trade-in of automobiles, and standardize the industrial competitive order with a persistent spirit. Third, focus on tackling key problems. We will continue to implement the action plan for high-quality development of key industrial chains in the equipment industry, strengthen the tackling of iconic products, and promote the application of achievements. Thank you. Reporter from CCTV News Center, China Central Radio and Television: In the first quarter of 2026, the value-added of industrial enterprises above designated size nationwide increased by 6.1% year-on-year, an acceleration of 1.1 percentage points compared to the fourth quarter of the previous year. How should we view the overall performance of industrial operations in the first quarter? Zhang Yunming: Thank you for your question. I will answer this. Since the beginning of this year, the industrial economy has shown an overall trend of moving towards newness and improvement, and stable progress, effectively playing the role of a "ballast stone" in stabilizing the macro economy. Overall, there are three main characteristics. The first characteristic is the relatively rapid growth of the industrial economy. From the industry perspective, key industries have driven growth significantly. Among the 41 major industrial categories, 34 achieved year-on-year increases in value-added. Industries such as electronics, electrical machinery and equipment, chemicals, petrochemicals, general equipment, and special equipment contributed 51.4% to industrial growth. From the regional perspective, key regions have played a prominent role. The growth rate of industrial enterprises above designated size in 10 major industrial provinces was about 7.2%. Industrial growth in major industrial provinces such as Zhejiang, Henan, Jiangsu, and Hubei maintained relatively rapid growth on the basis of a high base in the same period last year. The second characteristic is the continuous optimization of the industrial structure. The value-added of equipment manufacturing enterprises above designated size increased by 8.9% year-on-year, contributing nearly 50% to the growth of industrial value-added above designated size. The value-added of high-tech manufacturing enterprises above designated size increased by 12.5% year-on-year, with a growth rate 3.1 percentage points faster than last year. Emerging industries such as integrated circuit manufacturing and biological product manufacturing are growing rapidly. Technological changes such as artificial intelligence have promoted the accelerated implementation of new technologies and new products in industries such as consumer electronics. The output of products with high technical content and high added value, such as robot reducers and memory chips, achieved high-speed growth of over 40%. The third characteristic is the continuous accumulation of positive momentum. In the first two months, the profits of industrial enterprises above designated size increased by 15.2% year-on-year, with a growth rate 14.6 percentage points faster than last year. The production and efficiency of small and medium-sized industrial enterprises above designated size were both higher than the average level of industrial enterprises above designated size. Manufacturing investment stabilized and rebounded, increasing by 4.1% year-on-year in the first quarter, with a growth rate 3.5 percentage points faster than last year. Investment in emerging fields showed strong growth. Investment in industries such as computer and office equipment manufacturing and aerospace vehicle and equipment manufacturing achieved double-digit growth. In March, the ex-factory price index of industrial products (PPI) rose by 0.5% year-on-year, ending a continuous decline of 41 months. The manufacturing purchasing managers' index (PMI) rose by 1.4 percentage points from the previous month, entering the range of prosperity. Currently, domestic effective demand is insufficient, small and medium-sized enterprises and some industries are facing tight cash flow, and operations in industries such as petrochemicals are disrupted. Consolidating the positive trend of the industrial economy still requires arduous efforts. Next, we will adhere to the general principle of seeking progress while maintaining stability, focus on expanding demand, improving quality, cultivating momentum, and further improving the quality and efficiency of industrial economic operations, and continuously consolidate the trend of recovery and improvement. Thank you. Reporter from Haibao News: What is the overall development situation of the electronic information manufacturing industry in the first quarter? What new progress has been made in promoting technological innovation and integrated applications? What are the next work plans? Xie Cun: Thank you for your question. The electronic information manufacturing industry started well in the first quarter, and is expected to continue its growth trend this year. In the first quarter, the value-added of computer, communication and other electronic equipment manufacturing enterprises above designated size increased by 13.6% year-on-year, ranking first among major industrial categories. In January-February, operating revenue reached 2.6 trillion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 14.3%, which is 9 percentage points higher than the industrial growth rate. In the first quarter, the output of some products achieved double-digit growth, with the output of integrated circuits increasing by 24.3% year-on-year. The export value of upstream products increased significantly, with the export value of integrated circuits and liquid crystal flat panel display modules increasing by 72.9% and 12.5% year-on-year, respectively. Since 2026, our ministry has continuously promoted technological innovation and integrated applications in the electronic information manufacturing industry. Innovation achievements are constantly emerging. Continuous technological breakthroughs have been made in fields such as integrated circuits, new displays, high-end electronic equipment, and electronic materials. New progress has been made in 3D storage technology. Terminal product applications are diversified and expanded. New products, new models, and new scenarios are constantly emerging. For example, color TV products have launched large models based on televisions, which not only enhance the audio-visual experience but also automatically adjust brightness to protect users' visual health. Beidou navigation is further integrated into scenarios such as dynamic monitoring of scenic spots and indoor and outdoor navigation in commercial areas. Audio technology has been optimized and upgraded, enabling smart devices to filter noise and clearly hear human voices at long distances and in noisy environments. Next, our ministry will focus on the following work: First, thoroughly implement the action plan to stabilize growth, and leverage the driving role of major projects to maintain industrial operations within a reasonable range. Second, accelerate industrial digital transformation and intelligent upgrading, accelerate the integrated application of Beidou, advanced computing, artificial intelligence terminals, and vigorously explore and cultivate new application scenarios in energy, automotive, medical, education, cultural tourism, sports, and other fields. Third, improve industry governance efficiency, thoroughly address "involutionary" competition, and resolutely curb low-price and low-quality competition. Fourth, expand the industrial development ecosystem, continue to promote the adaptation of domestic operating systems and RISC-V architecture, accelerate collaborative innovation in the upstream and downstream of the artificial intelligence industry chain, and continuously improve the standard system for electronic information technology products. Recently, the rise in memory prices has led to adjustments in the prices of mobile terminal products, which has attracted widespread attention from all sectors. Regarding this issue, our ministry will take multiple measures to support the development of the memory industry and ensure the stability of the industrial chain and supply chain. On the one hand, we will enhance supply capacity and promote the matching of supply and demand, encourage domestic and foreign enterprises to increase investment, and improve production capacity. We will support terminal enterprises in strengthening interaction and docking with memory enterprises to broaden diversified supply channels. On the other hand, we will maintain market order through various means, guide memory enterprises to strengthen channel management, and cooperate with relevant departments to crack down on hoarding and other market-disrupting behaviors in accordance with the law. Thank you. Reporter from China Securities Journal: The "15th Five-Year Plan" Outline proposes to guide new supply with new demand and create new demand with new supply. Recently, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology has also issued a series of policy documents on consumer goods. Therefore, I would like to ask what is the overall deployment of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology in promoting the quality upgrading of the consumer goods industry and deepening the implementation of the "three products" strategy? Tao Qing: Thank you for your question. The consumer goods industry is a traditional advantageous industry and an important livelihood industry in China. Food, clothing, and daily necessities are all related to people's livelihoods and the happiness of their lives. Recently, our ministry has deepened the implementation of the "increase variety, improve quality, and create brands" strategy for the consumer goods industry, issued and implemented the "Implementation Plan for Enhancing Consumer Goods Supply-Demand Matching and Further Promoting Consumption," and policy documents for the high-quality development of traditional Chinese medicine, tea, and brewing industries. We have strengthened the standardized announcement management of key industries such as electric bicycles, lead-acid batteries, and printing and dyeing, improved the quality and safety traceability system for infant formula, and accelerated the promotion of industrial quality upgrading and continuous strengthening of high-quality consumer goods supply, launching a series of "combination punches" that are close to people's livelihoods and serve consumption. In the first quarter, the value-added of consumer goods industry enterprises above designated size increased by 5.1% year-on-year, accounting for 27.9% of all industrial enterprises above designated size. The export value of consumer goods manufacturing products, denominated in RMB, accounted for 17.7% of the total export value. In January-February, operating revenue reached 5.1 trillion yuan and profits reached 310.6 billion yuan, accounting for 24.3% and 30.3% of all industrial enterprises above designated size, respectively. The "15th Five-Year Plan" Outline clearly proposes to "persist in closely combining people's livelihood and consumption promotion, investment in things and investment in people, guide new supply with new demand, and create new demand with new supply." Our ministry will resolutely implement the deployment requirements of the "15th Five-Year Plan" Outline and the "Government Work Report," and focus on one "map," one "topic," and one "article." First, draw a new blueprint for planning. We will issue and implement policy documents for the high-quality development of light textile, bio-manufacturing, and pharmaceutical industries during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, formulate action plans for standard-led industrial optimization and upgrading in the textile and light industry, and vigorously cultivate new growth points such as historical classic industries, elderly and child care, local specialty foods, and ethnic innovative medicines, so as to consolidate the foundation for industrial development from the source, and transform policy documents from paper to workshops, and people's needs from vision to reality. title_en: Opinions of the State Council on Promoting the Expansion and Quality Improvement of the Service Industry
body_en: To the People's Governments of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, and all ministries and directly affiliated institutions of the State Council: To promote the expansion and upgrading of the service industry, foster high-quality and efficient development of the service sector, and better leverage its role in supporting industrial upgrading, meeting people's needs, and expanding employment, the following opinions are hereby put forward. Guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, thoroughly implementing the spirit of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and all its plenary sessions, earnestly carrying out the deployments of the Fourth Plenary Session, fully and accurately implementing the new development philosophy, adhering to the combination of an effective market and a proactive government, promoting both expansion and quality improvement, coordinating development and regulation, emphasizing demand-driven growth, reform breakthroughs, technological empowerment, and open cooperation, coordinating the optimization of new growth and the revitalization of existing resources, deeply implementing the action plan for expanding and upgrading the service industry, breaking down institutional and mechanical barriers that restrict the development of the service industry, promoting the extension of producer services towards specialization and the high-end of the value chain, fostering high-quality, diversified, and convenient development of consumer services, and providing strong support for accelerating the construction of a modern industrial system. By 2030, significant progress will be made in the high-quality development of the service industry. The total scale of the service industry will reach 100 trillion yuan, and a development pattern with higher quality, better structure, superior quality, and greater vitality will be basically formed. More "China Services" brands will be cultivated, the global competitiveness and influence of the service industry will be significantly enhanced, and the sense of gain for the people will be continuously improved. Cultivate leading enterprises in industrial design, enhancing their specialization and internationalization. Improve the service capabilities of the national network management platform for major scientific research infrastructure and large-scale scientific research instruments, and perfect the evaluation and assessment mechanisms for the open sharing of scientific research facilities and instruments. Enhance the overall service level of engineering surveying, design, and supervision. Develop services such as intellectual property strategic consulting and patent navigation, and screen high-value patents. Support the construction of patent pools for key industries, systematically improve the level of intellectual property services, and enhance the ability to respond to foreign intellectual property risks and provide legal services. Strengthen the construction of international copyright operation capabilities. Strengthen policy support for the high-quality development of incubators, and establish incubators oriented towards emerging and future industries. Build a pilot service network for manufacturing, cultivate pilot platforms for manufacturing in a tiered manner, and build national artificial intelligence application pilot bases with high quality. Improve the technical transaction service platform network and create high-level technology transfer and promotion institutions. Build university regional technology transfer and commercialization centers to promote the aggregation of scientific and technological innovation elements. Benchmark against international first-class standards, enhance inspection and testing service capabilities, and promote international mutual recognition of results. Promote the construction of laboratories for quality control and technical evaluation of industrial products, quality inspection and testing centers, and industrial metrology and testing centers. Enhance the detection and evaluation capabilities of infrastructure conditions, agricultural product quality, etc. Strengthen the research and development of high-end metrology instruments and inspection and testing equipment and facilities. Improve the multimodal transport system and promote the implementation of "one-stop" and "one-container" services. Vigorously develop rail-water intermodal transport, and accelerate the shift of bulk cargo and long-distance freight transportation from road to rail and water. Accelerate the transformation of railway freight transportation to railway logistics, and improve industry rules for railway dispatch, clearing, and track connection. Improve the operation and dispatch mechanism of oil and gas pipelines, and accelerate the promotion of nationwide interconnection. Vigorously develop international maritime and air transport services. Accelerate the cultivation of integrated logistics integrators and strengthen resource dispatch and supply-demand matching. Promote the renovation and upgrading of old logistics and warehousing facilities, explore the revitalization and utilization of idle facilities and railway freight yards, and promote the construction of distributed warehousing facilities. Enhance the service capabilities for cold chain preservation, post-harvest pre-cooling, and cleaning and packaging of agricultural products at the origin. Coordinate the layout of public, circulation, and functionally composite cold storage, and renovate old cold storage. Guide the rational layout of bulk commodity spot markets and promote the coordinated development of futures and spot markets. Enrich the business formats of industrial consumer goods markets and explore integrated services such as centralized procurement and warehousing and distribution. Strengthen the systematic layout and policy support for agricultural product wholesale markets and promote the renovation and upgrading of agricultural product markets. Deeply implement the "Artificial Intelligence +" action, accelerate the research and development and application of intelligent programming tools, and support the procurement of large models and intelligent agent services. Accelerate breakthroughs in industrial software innovation, and build demonstration centers for compatibility, adaptation, and application of industrial software in key industries. Strengthen the construction of basic software ecosystems and open-source communities. Optimize the ecosystem of smart audio-visual systems. Deeply promote the large-scale application of fifth-generation mobile communication (5G). Promote the development of 5G-A networks and strengthen the research and development of sixth-generation mobile communication (6G) technologies. Appropriately advance the construction of mobile Internet of Things. Develop satellite internet application services. Deeply implement the industrial Internet innovation and development project. Promote the action of building a foundation for industrial data, cultivate data cooperation consortia, and build a number of high-quality industry datasets. Develop professional services such as data annotation and certification, and explore the establishment of classified and tiered data ownership, assessment, and pricing mechanisms. Orderly promote the layout of computing power and the construction of edge computing power, and improve the intelligent computing cloud service system. Accelerate the application of urban information modeling platforms and building information modeling technologies. Guide financial institutions to carry out pledge financing of movable property and rights based on inventory, orders, warehouse receipts, etc., in accordance with laws and regulations and under controllable risks. Establish a full life-cycle financing system that invests in early-stage, small-scale, long-term, and hard-tech enterprises. Leverage the role of national venture capital guidance funds, and optimize and promote the "innovation积分制" (innovation point system) and the evaluation of specialized, refined, unique, and new development of small and medium-sized enterprises. Promote new financial service tools such as supply chain bills. Expand the coverage of product liability insurance for research and development, promote pilot service insurance, and implement the insurance compensation policy for the first set of (sets of) equipment. Carry out the action of empowering digital RMB. Explore mutual recognition of cross-border supply chain finance standards. Encourage financial leasing companies to coordinate the use of service models such as direct leasing, sale and leaseback, and joint leasing to provide customized solutions and reduce the operating costs of lessees. Strengthen the monitoring and assessment of lessees' credit status and repayment ability, and establish and improve a valuation system for leased assets. Leverage the role of government-funded financing guarantee institutions and establish a risk-sharing mechanism for supply chain finance. Promote energy efficiency diagnosis in key industries, promote the model of energy cost托管 (entrusted management) services for public institutions, and carry out energy-saving and carbon reduction renovation for public institutions and large public buildings. Accelerate the application of urban information modeling platforms and building information modeling technologies. Leverage the role of national venture capital guidance funds, optimize and promote the "innovation credit system" and the evaluation of specialized, refined, unique, and new development of small and medium-sized enterprises. Promote new financial service tools such as supply chain bills. Expand the coverage of product liability insurance, promote pilot service insurance, and implement insurance compensation policies for first sets (pieces) of equipment. Leverage the role of government-backed financing guarantee institutions and establish a risk-sharing mechanism for supply chain finance. Improve the vocational skills competition system with Chinese characteristics. Develop service products such as job search large models and virtual reality training. Enhancing the Development Level of Key Areas of Consumer Services (VII) Increasing the Supply of High-Quality Resident Services Community Home Services. Implement an action plan to improve property management service quality. Implement the high-quality development project for rural e-commerce and promote the renovation and upgrading of "thousands of markets and tens of thousands of stores." Expand the supply of rehabilitation nursing, medical-elderly integration, and long-term care services, and develop new services such as travel-based elderly care. Childcare. Develop inclusive childcare and integrated childcare and early childhood education services, deeply carry out demonstration pilot projects for childcare service subsidies, and support child welfare institutions in providing care, rehabilitation, and special education services for children with disabilities who need them. Support medical and health institutions in carrying out personalized family doctor contract services, providing health assessments, chronic disease management, home visits, and medication guidance. Develop preventive health care and integrated medical and health services for women, and improve the health service network for children and the elderly. Strengthen the construction of a socialized service system for mental health and psychiatric care. Accelerate the development of services such as sports data analysis and nutrition consulting. Guide the healthy and orderly development of industries such as performing arts entertainment, games and animation, and online literature, and promote positive energy. Encourage popular scenic spots, cultural and museum venues, etc., to extend their opening hours. Improve public facilities in scenic spots, revitalize existing tourism projects, strengthen refined management, and optimize service supply. Sports and Fitness. Promote the high-quality development of the event economy and the ice and snow economy, cultivate new business formats such as RV camping, and build high-quality outdoor sports destinations. Cultivate new models of intelligent, customized, and experiential sports consumption. Accommodation and Catering. Accelerate the formulation of service standards for new and integrated business formats such as low-altitude services and agricultural socialized services. Improve the statistical system, build multidimensional comprehensive evaluation indicators for service industry development, and accelerate the promotion of big data regulation. Cultivate and strengthen agricultural socialized service entities. Strengthen the collection of industry credit information, encourage market entities to make service quality commitments, and advocate for high quality and high prices. Support enterprises in strengthening brand building and communication, and cultivate new scenarios for brand experience. (XIX) Strengthening Talent Development. Optimize the layout of disciplines and majors related to the service industry, and support eligible regions in building municipal industry-education alliances and industry-education integration communities. Deeply implement the "Skills Illuminate the Future" training action, and carry out large-scale vocational skills training focusing on urgently needed industries and key employment groups. Broaden the scope of professional talent introduction and promote the construction of one-stop service platforms for overseas talent. (XX) Strengthening Safety Supervision. Improve cross-departmental and cross-industry approval and supervision models that adapt to business format integration, and avoid management and service gaps. Improve safety management systems in densely populated areas such as performance venues, sports event venues, exhibition venues, and tourist attractions, and implement safety production responsibilities. Regulate catering service business operations and strictly adhere to the bottom line of food safety. Resolutely crack down on irregularities such as "take-it-or-leave-it" clauses and false advertising, and effectively protect consumer rights and interests. Strengthen the protection of the rights and interests of workers in new employment forms. All regions and departments shall, under the centralized and unified leadership of the Party Central Committee, implement these opinions in conjunction with their actual conditions and strive to create a new situation for the high-quality development of the service industry. The government performance appraisal system should be further improved to fully mobilize the enthusiasm and initiative of all parties. All regions should base their implementation on their development stage and comparative advantages, and implement all tasks and measures in detail according to local conditions. The National Development and Reform Commission shall strengthen overall coordination and monitoring and evaluation. All departments shall promote work in accordance with their respective responsibilities and in different sectors, strengthen work coordination, enhance publicity and guidance, widely build social consensus, and create a favorable atmosphere for the participation of the entire society. Major matters shall be reported to the Party Central Committee and the State Council in a timely manner according to procedures. The State Council April 14, 2026

title_en: Must-read before market open | Service industry expansion and quality improvement to welcome major policies; CATL releases third-generation Shenxing supercharging battery
body_en: [Financial Calendar] 2026 Semiconductor Ecosystem Innovation Conference (Shanghai, 4/22-4/23) Earnings Release: Boeing ►►The State Council issued the "Opinions on Promoting the Expansion and Quality Improvement of the Service Industry," which proposes to deeply implement the "AI+" action, accelerate the research and development of intelligent programming tools, and support the procurement of large models and intelligent agent services. Accelerate breakthroughs in industrial software innovation and establish demonstration centers for compatibility, adaptation, and application of industrial software in key industries. Strengthen the construction of basic software ecosystems and open-source communities. Optimize the ecosystem of smart audio-visual systems. ►►On April 21st, Li Leche, Party Secretary and Minister of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, presided over the 19th Symposium of Manufacturing Enterprises. The meeting pointed out that China's future industrial development currently shows a good momentum of continuous expansion of industrial scale, multi-point breakthroughs in technological innovation, gradual construction of collaborative layouts, and continuous expansion of application innovation. At the same time, it should be noted that the new round of scientific and industrial revolutions is accelerating, and China's future industrial development still has some shortcomings in original innovation capabilities, key core technologies, the number of top talents, and institutional mechanisms. It is necessary to accurately grasp the development situation of future industries, seize the critical period of the "15th Five-Year Plan," accelerate the strengthening of strengths, the补短板 (making up for weaknesses), and the enhancement of weak areas, and make more efforts to proactively lay out future industries to seize the commanding heights of future development. The meeting emphasized the need to base work on China's industrial foundation and resource endowments, leverage comparative advantages, and coordinate all tasks with systematic thinking; strengthen top-level planning and guidance, improve the technology foresight mechanism, and orderly promote the construction of pilot zones for future industries; systematically plan original and leading technological breakthroughs, and strengthen scenario-driven approaches. In addition, it is necessary to fully leverage the main role of enterprises, improve differentiated support policies; continuously enhance the policy effectiveness of innovation and development, financial support, and talent cultivation in future industries; coordinate development and security, cautiously explore regulatory methods that adapt to the characteristics of future industries, ensuring both "flexibility" and "effective management." ►►The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology announced the completion of the 10 Gigabit Optical Network pilot projects. Overall, the pilot projects have been advanced in an orderly manner, and the pilot objectives have been well achieved. 10 Gigabit Optical Networks have been piloted in communities, factories, and industrial parks, fostering business applications such as cloud computers, cloud gaming, industrial optical quality inspection, AI + ultra-high-definition video surveillance, model training and inference applications, and integrated sensing and communication. This provides important references for promoting the transition of 10 Gigabit Optical Networks from technical pilots to deployment and application. ►►From 24:00 on April 21st, the retail prices of gasoline and diesel in China will be reduced by 555 yuan and 530 yuan per ton, respectively. On average nationwide: the price per liter of 92 octane gasoline, 95 octane gasoline, and 0# diesel will be reduced by 0.44 yuan, 0.46 yuan, and 0.45 yuan, respectively. This price adjustment is the eighth adjustment window of the year and the first reduction this year. Filling a 50-liter fuel tank with 92 octane gasoline will cost 22 yuan less. ►►On April 21st, China's first Pre6G test network was officially put into operation in Nanjing, Jiangsu. This test network integrates 6G innovative technologies into the 5G network, featuring high bandwidth, long-distance coverage, low-latency determinism, and native AI integration, with capabilities up to 10 times that of 5G. Currently, the test network has conducted systematic verification in fields such as low-altitude inspection, industrial manufacturing, embodied intelligence, and holographic communication. The launch of this test network marks a new stage for 6G technology from key technology verification to system capability verification, laying an important foundation for future 6G standardization and industrial applications. ►►On April 21st, at the 2026 CATL Super Technology Day, CATL released its third-generation Shenxing super-fast charging battery, which can achieve equivalent 10C and peak 15C super-fast charging capabilities. At the same time, Wu Kai, Chief Scientist of the company and Academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, announced that sodium-ion batteries have solved the core problems in the manufacturing process and will achieve mass production within the year. ►►According to the WeChat public account "WeChat Pai," currently, South Korea's ZeroPay, Sri Lanka's LANKAQR, Thailand's PromptPay, Malaysia's DuitNow QR, and Singapore's SGQR+ (with NETS and WeChat Pay logos) are integrated with WeChat Pay, allowing direct payment by scanning WeChat codes. ►►According to CCTV News, on April 21st local time, U.S. President Trump posted on his social media platform "Truth Social" stating that at the request of the Pakistani Army Chief of Staff and Prime Minister, the U.S. will temporarily suspend military strikes against Iran. Trump said that given the "serious divisions" within the Iranian government, the U.S. has decided to extend the ceasefire and requires Iran to first propose a unified negotiation plan. During this period, the U.S. military will continue to impose a maritime blockade on Iran while maintaining military readiness.
